title: Modality Discrepancy Transformer for Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
summary: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are affective states in which individuals express contradictory signals across facial, vocal, and linguistic channels. Automatically recognising A/H in clinical videos requires detecting cross-modal disagreement -- the signal that standard fusion methods suppress. Based on the conflict-aware multimodal fusion framework of Bekhouche et al., we present the Modality Discrepancy Transformer (MDT). MDT enriches the original 6-token design to a 9-token representation comprising three modality embeddings, three absolute-difference features, and three Hadamard-product discrepancy features learned through linear projections. These nine tokens undergo Transformer self-attention, with FiLM-based text-conditioned modulation and LoRA fine-tuning as core architectural components. A text-guided late fusion branch blends a text-only auxiliary head with the full multimodal output at inference. On the BAH dataset from the 3rd ABAW Challenge, MDT achieves 0.7408 Macro F1 on the labelled test split and 0.7368 on the private leaderboard, outperforming the strongest published baseline by over 10 points while training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出模态差异Transformer（MDT），通过显式建模跨模态不一致信号来识别临床视频中的矛盾与犹豫（A/H）。
AI.motivation: 矛盾与犹豫（A/H）表现为面部、语音、语言多通道的矛盾信号，其核心识别线索是跨模态不一致；而常规多模态融合会抑制这种差异信号，因此需要能保留冲突信息的方法。
AI.method: 基于Bekhouche等人的冲突感知多模态融合框架，将原6-token设计扩展为9-token表示：3个模态嵌入、3个绝对差特征、3个由线性投影学习的Hadamard积差异特征；9个token经Transformer自注意力处理，核心组件包括FiLM文本条件调制与LoRA微调；推理时用文本引导的晚期融合分支，将纯文本辅助头与完整多模态输出融合。
AI.result: 在第3届ABAW挑战赛BAH数据集上，MDT在标注测试集取得0.7408 Macro F1，在私有排行榜取得0.7368，较最强已发表基线提升超过10个点，单GPU训练时间不足20分钟。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨模态差异的9-token MDT能有效捕捉A/H冲突信号，在BAH任务上显著优于现有基线，且训练高效。

title: Subliminal Prompting Beyond Static Geometry: Causal Depth and Multi-Token Confounds
summary: Subliminal learning shows that language models can transmit a hidden trait through outputs that appear unrelated to it. One proposed explanation, token entanglement, links animal and number tokens through the model's output vocabulary. Yet existing measurements answer different questions: whether outputs co-vary, fixed output vectors align, an answer can be read from a hidden state, or that state causally controls the answer. We measure each separately in a fixed animal-number prompting protocol. From Llama-3.1-8B to 70B, fixed output-vector similarity predicts behavior less well: the paired mean correlation change is -0.080 (95% CI [-0.127, -0.035]). A fixed output-head readout shows no resolved change in normalized depth AUC. To test control, we copy the temporary answer-position state from one number prompt into another at five depths and measure which prompt the final animal score follows. Donor-control AUC rises from 0.254 to 0.540, a paired change of +0.286 (95% CI [+0.272, +0.300]), with increases for all 18 concepts. The contrast remains with exactly eight transformer blocks remaining, while specificity and identity controls remain small or exact. In two Qwen models, scoring every digit in sequence does not recover the positive one-token association. Per-token averaging instead creates a positive pooled association that disappears after controlling number width, revealing a length confound. Thus, fixed geometry, observational readability, causal timing, and multi-token measurement are distinct properties of this frozen prompting channel. They constrain token-level explanations but do not identify the mechanism of training-time trait transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文在固定的"动物-数字"提示协议下，分别测量固定几何、观测可读性、因果时机与多token测量四个性质，发现它们是同一冻结提示通道中相互独立的属性，对token层面的解释构成约束但无法确定训练期特质迁移的机制。
AI.motivation: "阈下学习"表明语言模型可通过看似无关的输出传递隐藏特质，其中一个解释是token纠缠，即通过输出词表将动物token与数字token关联。但现有测量各自回答不同问题：输出是否共变、固定输出向量是否对齐、答案能否从隐状态读出、该状态是否因果控制答案，缺乏在同一协议下对这几类性质的分辨。
AI.method: 在固定的动物-数字提示协议中逐一测量上述四类性质。跨Llama-3.1-8B到70B比较固定输出向量相似度对行为的预测；用固定输出头读出检验归一化深度AUC的变化；在五个深度上将某一数字提示的临时答案位置状态复制到另一提示，测量最终动物分数跟随哪个提示（供体控制AUC）；并在两个Qwen模型中按顺序对每个数字打分，检验单token关联能否被恢复，并进行逐token平均与数字宽度控制。
AI.result: 从Llama-3.1-8B到70B，固定输出向量相似度对行为的预测变差，配对平均相关变化为-0.080（95% CI [-0.127, -0.035]）；固定输出头读出在归一化深度AUC上无可分辨变化。供体控制AUC从0.254升至0.540，配对变化+0.286（95% CI [+0.272, +0.300]），全部18个概念均上升；在恰余八个transformer block时对比仍然存在，而特异性与身份控制保持很小或精确。在两个Qwen模型中，逐位打分未能恢复正的单token关联；逐token平均造成正合并关联，但在控制数字宽度后消失，说明存在长度混杂。
AI.conclusion: 固定几何、观测可读性、因果时机与多token测量是该冻结提示通道中彼此不同的属性，它们约束了token层面的解释，但并未识别训练期特质迁移的机制。

title: Sampling Reveals Style: Unsupervised, Training-Free Discovery of Prompt-Conditional Stylistic Axes in LLM Activations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich stylistic structure in their hidden activations, but discovering which stylistic dimensions are salient for a given prompt typically requires supervised contrastive data. We present a training-free, prompt-conditional alternative: we repeatedly sample completions of a single prompt at elevated temperature, apply Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to the pooled hidden activations, and label the resulting axes automatically from the pole generations. We validate the discovered axes against 245 human-elicited stylistic annotations in a two-phase study. On our strongest model (Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct), the top two axes match spontaneously requested human dimensions with 72.8% precision and 43.6% macro-recall, and 75.6% of validity ratings judge the axes' polar generations accurate to their labels, with 90.9% adjacent inter-annotator agreement. Discoverability is strongly model-dependent: both Qwen models and Llama-3.2-3B expose human-salient axes, while DeepSeek-7B-Chat drops to 35.3% precision, its leading components dominated by structural rather than stylistic variance. Simple PCA over a model's own decoding variance is thus an effective, low-cost probe of stylistic structure in LLM representations, one that also exposes sharp cross-model differences in how that structure is organized.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的、以提示词为条件的方法：对单条提示词在高温下重复采样，对池化隐藏激活做PCA，并从两极生成自动标注坐标轴，从而发现LLM中的风格维度，并在人类标注上验证其有效性且存在明显跨模型差异。
AI.motivation: LLM隐藏激活中编码了丰富的风格结构，但确定某条提示词下哪些风格维度显著，通常需要监督对比数据，成本高、依赖标注。因此需要一个无需训练、针对单条提示词的替代方案。
AI.method: 无训练、提示词条件化流程：对同一提示词在提高温度下反复采样生成；对池化后的隐藏激活做主成分分析（PCA）；再从坐标轴两极的生成文本自动为各轴打标签。通过两阶段研究，用245条人类诱发的风格标注进行验证。
AI.result: 最强模型Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct上，前两个轴与人类自发请求的维度匹配达72.8%精确率与43.6%宏召回；75.6%的有效性评分认为两极生成与其标签相符，相邻标注者一致率90.9%。可发现性高度依赖模型：Qwen系列与Llama-3.2-3B能暴露人类显著轴，而DeepSeek-7B-Chat精确率降至35.3%，其主导成分由结构性而非风格性方差主导。
AI.conclusion: 对模型自身解码方差做简单PCA，是一种有效、低成本探测LLM表征中风格结构的方法，同时揭示不同模型在该结构组织方式上的显著差异。

title: What Users Think of Generative AI: A Cross-Platform NLP Analysis of Trust and Friction in App Store Reviews
comment: Submitted to Array (Elsevier); currently under peer review
summary: Generative AI (GenAI) applications have achieved rapid consumer adoption, yet little large-scale research examines user-perceived quality, trust, and adoption barriers. We present one of the first cross-application analyses of app store reviews for six major GenAI applications (ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, DeepSeek, and Perplexity), comprising 17,012 English-language reviews from Google Play and the Apple App Store. We combine BERTopic topic modeling with RoBERTa sentiment classification and evaluate cross-application differences using chi-square, Kruskal-Wallis, and multinomial logistic regression with Bonferroni correction. Both components are validated against human coding using a stratified sample of 300 reviews. Results show that negative sentiment concentrates in advertising (91%), authentication (89%), server reliability (83%), and subscription pricing (73%). Sentiment differs significantly across applications, with Claude exhibiting the highest negative sentiment (47.7%) alongside a strongly enthusiastic user base, indicating statistically significant polarization. These findings are robust despite unequal review counts across applications. As exploratory observations, a subset of DeepSeek reviews raised geopolitical and data privacy concerns related to its Chinese origin, while a proposed Trust Friction Score summarizes application-specific trust and usability barriers into interpretable dimensions. The study provides validated and actionable evidence on user trust, usability, and adoption barriers in consumer generative AI applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究对六款主流生成式AI应用（ChatGPT、Gemini、Copilot、Claude、DeepSeek、Perplexity）的17,012条英文应用商店评论进行跨应用分析，结合BERTopic主题建模、RoBERTa情感分类及统计检验，揭示负面情感集中于广告、认证、服务器可靠性和订阅定价，且应用间情感存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI应用在消费端快速普及，但缺乏大规模研究考察用户感知质量、信任及采用障碍，因此需要跨应用的实证证据。
AI.method: 采集Google Play与Apple App Store共17,012条英文评论；采用BERTopic主题建模与RoBERTa情感分类；用卡方检验、Kruskal-Wallis检验及带Bonferroni校正的多项逻辑回归评估跨应用差异；并以300条分层样本进行人工编码验证。
AI.result: 负面情感集中于广告（91%）、认证（89%）、服务器可靠性（83%）与订阅定价（73%）；应用间情感差异显著，Claude负面情感比例最高（47.7%），同时拥有强烈热情的用户群，呈现统计显著的两极分化；结果在不均衡评论量下仍稳健；部分DeepSeek评论提出地缘政治与数据隐私担忧；提出Trust Friction Score以总结应用特定的信任与可用性障碍。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了经过验证且可操作的用户信任、可用性与采用障碍证据，对消费级生成式AI应用具有实践意义。

title: Algebraic Retrieval: Composable Search for Agents
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Code and reproducible examples: https://github.com/algebraicretrieval/algebraicretrieval
summary: Algebraic Retrieval lets AI agents compose search strategies at query time. Relevance criteria, eligibility constraints, and ranking preferences can be expressed together in a mathematical query. The query surface exposes available operations, so an agent can combine them for the question at hand and revise a program after inspecting results. We evaluate execution parity, not agent behavior or retrieval quality. Building on Programmatic Embedding Modulation (PEM), which exposes vector and score arithmetic during retrieval, we demonstrate contrastive scoring, candidate-pool reranking, and weighted ranking as composable queries, alongside executable SQL and PyTerrier counterparts. On the public 11,429-document Vaswani fixture, each program's implementations select the same document set with score differences below 1e-6; one tied pair orders differently across scoring paths.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"代数检索"（Algebraic Retrieval），允许AI智能体在查询时以数学查询形式组合搜索策略，并在Vaswani测试集上验证了不同实现路径之间的执行一致性。
AI.motivation: 相关性标准、资格约束与排序偏好往往需要分别表达，缺乏统一的数学查询界面供智能体即时组合与修订检索程序。
AI.method: 基于程序化嵌入调制（PEM），在检索过程中暴露向量与分数运算，将对比打分、候选池重排、加权排序等作为可组合查询，并与可执行的SQL和PyTerrier对应实现进行对照。
AI.result: 在公开的11,429篇文档的Vaswani测试集上，每个程序的各实现路径选出相同文档集合，分数差异低于1e-6；仅有一对并列文档在不同打分路径下顺序不同。
AI.conclusion: 不同实现对检索程序具有执行一致性；评估聚焦执行对等性，而非智能体行为或检索质量本身。

title: From Models to Systems: A Comprehensive Survey of Efficient Multimodal Learning
summary: The rapid expansion of multimodal models has surfaced formidable bottlenecks in computation, memory, and deployment, catalyzing the rise of Efficient Multimodal Learning (EML) as a pivotal research frontier. Despite intensive progress, a cohesive understanding of what, how, and where efficiency is manifested across the learning stack remains fragmented. This survey systematizes the EML landscape by introducing the first structured, model-to-system taxonomy. We distill insights from over 300 seminal works into three hierarchical levels--model, algorithm, and system--addressing architectural parsimony, execution refinement, and hardware-aware orchestration, respectively. Moving beyond a purely categorical review, we offer a methodological synthesis of the vertical synergies between these layers, elucidating how cross-layer co-design contributes to the fundamental "Efficiency-Utility-Privacy" trade-off. Through an integrative case study of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we trace the field's evolutionary trajectory from initial structural adjustments to modern full-stack resource orchestration. Furthermore, we provide a holistic discussion and application-specific optimization blueprints for diverse domains and posit a paradigm shift toward self-regulating intelligence, where efficiency is an intrinsic, emergent property of the model's fundamental design rather than a post-hoc constraint. Finally, we present open challenges and future directions that will define the trajectory of EML research. This survey establishes a structured framework for multimodal systems that are not only high-performing and generalizable but natively efficient and ready for ubiquitous deployment. A continuously updated version is available at https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理高效多模态学习（EML）领域，提出首个"模型-算法-系统"三层级模型到系统分类体系，综合300余篇工作，并给出跨层协同的"效率-效用-隐私"权衡分析与应用蓝图。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型规模快速扩张，在计算、内存与部署上形成严峻瓶颈，催生高效多模态学习（EML）这一关键研究方向。然而，现有研究对"效率体现在何处、如何实现、作用于哪一层"的理解仍较为碎片化，缺乏统一、连贯的认识框架，因此亟需系统化的梳理。
AI.method: 本文以综述/分类学研究为主，而非提出单一新模型。方法上引入首个结构化、从模型到系统的分类体系，将300余篇代表性工作归纳为三个层级：模型层（架构精简）、算法层（执行优化）、系统层（硬件感知编排）。在此基础上进行方法论综合，分析各层之间的纵向协同，阐释跨层协同设计如何塑造"效率-效用-隐私"三元权衡；并以多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为集成案例，追踪该领域从结构微调到全栈资源编排的演进路径。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖"模型-算法-系统"三层的EML结构化分类框架，提炼出跨层协同设计与"效率-效用-隐私"权衡的内在联系；通过对MLLMs的集成案例分析，刻画了领域从早期结构调整到现代全栈资源编排的演化轨迹；并面向不同应用领域提出了整体性讨论与针对性优化蓝图，同时给出开放挑战与未来方向。相关资源持续更新于公开仓库。
AI.conclusion: 本文为多模态系统建立了一个结构化框架，指向"自调节智能"的范式转变——即效率不再是事后附加的约束，而成为模型基础设计中内在的、涌现的属性。该综述旨在推动构建不仅高性能、可泛化，而且原生高效、可普适部署的多模态系统。

title: A State-Space Model of Figured-Bass Realization: Local Constraints, Coupled Voices, and Polynomial-Time Solvability
summary: Figured-bass realization can be described as a sequence of choices constrained both within each sonority and between successive sonorities. This paper gives an explicit mathematical model of a restricted, examination-style four-part realization problem. Pitch spelling, range, chord membership, doubling, omission, spacing, crossing, overlap, melodic motion, consecutive perfect intervals, and selected resolution requirements are expressed as predicates. We distinguish hard constraints from optional preference costs. Four labeled notes are represented visually as the vertices of a quadrilateral and computationally as one ordered voicing state. Legal progressions become paths through a layered graph. We prove that feasibility and minimum-cost realization are polynomial-time problems for a fixed number of voices with explicit finite note domains and fixed local rules. For fixed ranges, a fixed note alphabet, and adjacent-event rules, the number of graph operations is linear in the number of events. Worked two-, four-, and eight-beat examples illustrate legality, optimization, and the failure of a greedy choice. The result concerns the stated formal model; it is not a claim that every musical judgment is captured by local predicates.

AI.tldr: 本文将数字低音实现形式化为受约束的选择序列问题，用谓词表达各类规则，并以分层图中的路径刻画合法进行，进而证明固定声部数、有限音域与局部规则下的可行性与最小代价实现均可在多项式时间内求解。
AI.motivation: 数字低音实现涉及音高拼写、音域、和弦成员、重复与省略、间距、交叉与重叠、旋律进行、连续完全音程及解决要求等多重约束，既有必须满足的硬性条件，也有可权衡的偏好。作者希望为这类受限的、考试风格的四声部实现问题给出显式的数学模型，厘清硬约束与可选偏好代价的区分，并回答其计算复杂度问题。
AI.method: 把四声部实现中的规则表达为谓词，区分硬约束与可选偏好代价；将四个带标签的音符既可视化为四边形顶点，又在计算上表示为一个有序的声部状态；合法进行对应于分层图中的路径，从而用图搜索刻画可行性、优化与贪心策略失效。
AI.result: 证明了在固定声部数、显式有限音符域与固定局部规则下，可行性与最小代价实现均为多项式时间问题；当音域、音符字母表与相邻事件规则固定时，图操作次数关于事件数呈线性。二拍、四拍与八拍的实例展示了合法性、优化以及贪心选择的失效。
AI.conclusion: 该结论仅针对所陈述的形式模型，并不主张所有音乐判断都能被局部谓词完全刻画。

title: Federated Soft Clustering via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
summary: We study federated soft clustering over federated learning (FL) networks of devices that each hold a private local dataset and fit a personalized Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Generalized total variation minimization (GTVMin) couples the local maximum likelihood problems through a graph regularizer that penalizes a discrepancy between the models of connected nodes. The choice of discrepancy measure is a key design decision: we compare a squared Euclidean distance between model parameters, which requires component matching, with two measures that compare the local model distributions directly and hence need no matching: a Monte-Carlo approximated Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and a closed-form maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). All three resulting GTVMin instances are optimized by synchronous projected gradient updates; for the smooth MMD instance we provide a convergence guarantee to stationary points. We characterize their computational cost and evaluate their robustness to data heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 论文研究联邦软聚类：多个设备各自持有私有数据集并拟合个性化高斯混合模型（GMM），通过广义全变差最小化（GTVMin）以图正则项耦合本地最大似然问题。作者比较三种模型间差异度量——需组件匹配的参数间平方欧氏距离、无需匹配的蒙特卡洛近似KL散度、闭式MMD——均以同步投影梯度法求解，并对光滑的MMD实例给出收敛到驻点的保证，同时刻画计算成本并评估其对数据异构的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在联邦学习网络中，各设备数据私有且可能存在数据异构（非独立同分布），需要在不共享原始数据的前提下进行个性化软聚类。GTVMin的图正则项中"差异度量"的选择是关键设计决策，但不同度量在是否需要组件匹配、计算成本与对异构数据的鲁棒性上差异明显，因此需要系统比较。
AI.method: 以GTVMin框架建模：各节点拟合个性化GMM的本地最大似然问题，并引入图正则项惩罚相连节点模型之间的差异。比较三种差异度量：（1）模型参数间的平方欧氏距离（需组件匹配）；（2）蒙特卡洛近似的KL散度；（3）闭式MMD——后两者直接比较分布、无需匹配。三种GTVMin实例均用同步投影梯度更新优化，其中光滑的MMD实例给出收敛到驻点的理论保证。此外分析各方法的计算复杂度。
AI.result: 三种GTVMin实例均可通过同步投影梯度更新求解；对光滑MMD实例证明了收敛到驻点。论文刻画了各度量的计算成本，并通过实验评估其在数据异构下的鲁棒性（具体数值结果未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: 差异度量的选择应兼顾是否需要组件匹配与计算成本；直接比较分布的度量（KL近似、MMD）避免了组件匹配问题，其中MMD因光滑性而具备收敛保证，为联邦个性化GMM聚类提供可行且鲁棒的设计方案。

title: Position Paper: Neurotransmitters as a Missing Dimension in Artificial Neural Networks
summary: Artificial neural networks (ANNs), as core components of modern deep learning (DL) systems, lack the adaptive flexibility and long-term stability exhibited by biological systems. This limitation largely stems from the fact that conventional ANNs rely on uniform, local, and gradient-based parameter updates, while neglecting internal learning principles that are biological mechanisms such as neurotransmitters signalling or neuroplasticity. Consequently, many existing approaches focus on architectural expansion or mathematical fine-tuning techniques such as regularisation or parameter isolation. Inspired by the superior adaptability and plasticity of mammalian brains, we posit that neuromodulation with neurotransmitters constitutes a third axis of learning, complementary to neural activity and synaptic plasticity, and should be explicitly modelled in artificial neural networks. In this positional paper, we argue that incorporating neuromodulatory principles into ANN design represents a promising and underexplored research direction, and we advocate for greater attention to this perspective in the development of adaptive and continual learning systems.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文主张将神经调质机制作为学习的"第三轴"显式建模于人工神经网络中，以弥补传统ANN在自适应性与长期稳定性上的不足，并呼吁关注这一未被充分探索的方向。
AI.motivation: 传统ANN依赖统一、局部、基于梯度的参数更新，缺乏生物系统所具备的自适应灵活性与长期稳定性；现有工作多聚焦于架构扩展或正则化、参数隔离等数学微调手段，忽视了神经递质信号与神经可塑性等内部学习原理。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场论文（positional paper），通过受哺乳动物大脑卓越适应性与可塑性启发，提出神经调质（neuromodulation）应与神经活动和突触可塑性并列，构成学习的第三轴，并论证应将其显式建模到ANN设计中。
AI.result: 本文不报告实验性结果，而是提出并论证了将神经调质原理融入ANN设计是富有前景且尚未被充分探索的研究方向这一核心观点。
AI.conclusion: 作者倡导在自适应与持续学习系统的开发中，给予神经调质这一视角更多关注，以推动ANN在灵活性与稳定性方面向生物系统靠拢。

title: Open ultrasound foundation model for robust segmentation and clinical measurement across heterogeneous settings
comment: The PDF includes the Supplementary Information
summary: Ultrasound is the most widely deployed imaging modality worldwide, yet clinical AI remains fragmented into narrow single-task models that fail when device, operator, or anatomy changes. Here we present SonoCorpus, an open resource unifying 456,963 images and 1,626,085 expert masks from 53 public datasets spanning 24 clinical applications and 17 countries, and SonoBase, an interactive segmentation foundation model pretrained on it. Across fifteen evaluation datasets introducing new organs, devices, operators, and geographies, SonoBase outperforms SAM2, MedSAM2, and the concept-promptable MedSAM3 on every dataset and matches per-dataset specialist models trained on the same data; on fully external data it exceeds the accuracy these baselines achieve on their own in-distribution benchmarks. Ejection fraction derived from its segmentations falls within inter-observer variability (6.63\% error), with fewer misclassifications at the defibrillator-candidacy threshold than either promptable baseline (13\% versus 18--42\%); fetal head-circumference (1.81~mm) and gestational-age (1.2 days) errors fall below inter-observer variability. Where a baseline fails outright, one in four test cases, SonoBase recovers a usable segmentation in 81\% of them, including on handheld probes operated by minimally trained users in two low- and middle-income countries (Sierra Leone and Tanzania). Five labeled examples can help the model adapt to a new setting, and the identical training protocol transfers well to newer models such as SAM3, locating the advantage in ultrasound-specific pretraining rather than any single architecture. To ensure reproducibility and enable the community to build on SonoBase as a platform, we release all checkpoints, optimizer states, data-split indices, deduplication hashes, and starter code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超声影像开放资源SonoCorpus与交互式分割基础模型SonoBase，在多中心、多设备、跨解剖结构场景下全面超越SAM2、MedSAM2、MedSAM3，并在外部数据上兼具临床可用性与可复现性。
AI.motivation: 超声是全球部署最广的影像模态，但现有临床AI多为狭窄的单任务模型，当设备、操作者或解剖结构变化时性能失效，缺乏统一、跨域鲁棒的超声基础模型与公开资源。
AI.method: 构建SonoCorpus数据集（456,963张图像、1,626,085个专家掩膜，来自53个公开数据集，覆盖24类临床应用、17个国家），并据此预训练交互式分割基础模型SonoBase；在15个引入新器官、新设备、新操作者、新地域的评测集上，与SAM2、MedSAM2、概念提示型MedSAM3及同数据训练的专科模型对比，并进行下游临床指标验证（射血分数、胎儿头围、孕龄）与跨新模型的训练协议迁移实验。
AI.result: SonoBase在所有15个评测数据集上均优于SAM2、MedSAM2与MedSAM3，并匹配同数据训练的专科模型；在完全外部数据上，其精度超过基线在自身分布内基准上的表现。射血分数误差6.63%，处于观察者间变异范围内，除颤器适应证阈值处误分类率13%（基线18%–42%）；胎儿头围误差1.81 mm、孕龄误差1.2天，均低于观察者间变异。在基线完全失败的案例（占测试的1/4）中，SonoBase对81%恢复出可用分割，包括塞拉利昂与坦桑尼亚两国由低训练度用户操作手持探头的场景。5个标注样本即可适配新场景，相同训练协议可迁移至SAM3等新模型。
AI.conclusion: 超声专用预训练（而非单一网络架构）是性能优势的来源；SonoBase可作为可复现、可扩展的超声AI平台，作者公开全部检查点、优化器状态、数据划分索引、去重哈希与入门代码。

title: AthenaZero: A low-inertia, bimanual robot for dynamic manipulation
comment: Videos attached as ancillary. Cover article to September 2026 issue of Science Robotics
summary: AthenaZero is a bimanual manipulator designed to minimize inertia without compromising control authority. By utilizing quasi-direct drive actuation and transmission remotization techniques, the system achieves an effective endpoint mass comparable to that of a human---about an order of magnitude less than conventional robot manipulators. This characteristic, combined with its inherent torque transparency, makes AthenaZero exceptionally well-suited for dynamic manipulation. We describe the methodology} that led to this design and demonstrate the robot's capabilities on three baseball-inspired tasks: throwing, catching, and batting, which showcase complex interactions on human-comparable timescales where milliseconds matter. AthenaZero was capable of throwing at speeds in excess of 30 m/s, with catching and batting at speeds in excess of 14 m/s over a short 7.3 m distance. Batting practice and a game of catch were subsequently performed in robot-to-robot and human-to-robot variations, showcasing the efficacy and adaptability of our system in tasks that require high acceleration.

AI.tldr: AthenaZero是一款双臂机械臂，通过准直接驱动与传动远端化设计大幅降低惯量，实现接近人类的末端有效质量，并在棒球式抛、接、击打任务中展现高速动态操作能力。
AI.motivation: 传统机械臂惯量大、力矩透明性差，难以胜任毫秒级、高加速度的动态操作任务；本文旨在在不牺牲控制权限的前提下最小化惯量，使其适用于与人类时间尺度相当的高速交互。
AI.method: 采用准直接驱动（quasi-direct drive）执行与传动远端化（transmission remotization）技术进行双臂机械臂设计，并阐述其设计方法学。
AI.result: 末端有效质量约比常规机械臂低一个数量级，接近人类水平，且具备固有力矩透明性；在7.3 m距离内实现超过30 m/s的投掷速度，接球与击打速度超过14 m/s；完成机器人—机器人及人—机器人的击打练习与接球游戏。
AI.conclusion: AthenaZero验证了低惯量、高力矩透明性设计在高加速度动态操作任务中的有效性与适应性。

title: Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning: Stability under Constant Stepsizes
summary: Emphatic temporal-difference learning (ETD) stabilizes the expected off-policy TD update and changes its projection geometry, but neither property determines constant-stepsize sampled dynamics. We construct an ergodic two-state counterexample in which the ETD mean map contracts while the sampled product has a positive top Lyapunov exponent. Regenerative-cycle analysis separates this sign from the infinite variance of the follow-on trace. We introduce regularized emphatic TD (RETD), a normalized first-order post-shock repair that leaves the trace and importance ratios unchanged, stores the emphatic TD signal in a leaky scalar state, and releases a delayed correction. RETD's raw equilibrium is an affine shift of the ETD equilibrium; single- and two-regularization readouts recover the ETD fixed point exactly. We prove almost-sure convergence for harmonic diminishing stepsizes and a conditional constant-stepsize moment-contraction result from a Markovian random-product bound. RETD has certified negative exponents on the two-state construction and one Baird point, whereas the positive Baird ETD sign remains numerical. Paired 10,000-run experiments validate both separations, fixed-point recovery, a nonmonotone stability region, and task dependence. RETD changes post-shock dynamics; it does not reduce the shared follow-on-trace variance.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了ETD采样动力学不稳定的两状态反例，并提出正则化强调式时序差分学习(RETD)以修复冲击后动力学，证明其几乎必然收敛并给出常步长矩收缩条件。
AI.motivation: ETD虽稳定了期望的离策略TD更新并改变其投影几何，但这两个性质均无法决定常量步长下的采样动力学行为，即期望意义下的收缩性未必保证采样乘积稳定，因此需要厘清该差异并提出修复方法。
AI.method: 构造遍历两状态反例，其中ETD均值映射收缩而采样乘积具有正的最大Lyapunov指数；用再生周期分析将该符号与follow-on迹的无限方差分离。提出RETD：一种归一化的一阶冲击后修复，保持迹与重要性比率不变，用泄漏标量状态存储强调TD信号并释放延迟修正；其原始平衡为ETD平衡的仿射平移，单/双正则化读出可精确恢复ETD不动点。
AI.result: 证明调和递减步长下的几乎必然收敛，并基于马尔可夫随机乘积界给出条件性常步长矩收缩结果。RETD在两状态构造与一个Baird点上具有可认证的负指数，而Baird上的正ETD符号仍为数值结果。10,000次配对实验验证了两种分离、不动点恢复、非单调稳定区域及任务依赖性。RETD改变冲击后动力学，但不降低共享的follow-on迹方差。
AI.conclusion: ETD的期望稳定与几何性质并不能决定其采样动力学稳定性；RETD通过延迟的一阶冲击后修复实现收敛与矩收缩，并精确恢复ETD不动点，但其改善源于改变冲击后动力学而非降低follow-on迹方差。

title: Generative Query Suggestion via Intent Coverage and Query-Level Credit Assignment
summary: Generative query suggestion aims to enhance user engagement by anticipating user intents and recommending relevant follow-up queries. A central challenge is to generate slates whose individual queries are useful while the slate covers distinct intents. We propose an Intent-Driven Query Suggestion Framework with dual-stage optimization. First, intent-aware diversity modeling constructs intent-aligned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data and uses an Intent-Aware Diversity Reward to optimize intent coverage. Second, query-level credit assignment routes individual quality signals to the corresponding query tokens while sharing a slate-level diversity signal across the slate. Experiments on a large-scale production dataset, including online A/B testing and offline evaluation, show improvements in click-through rate, query quality, and intent coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出意图驱动的生成式查询建议框架，采用双阶段优化：意图感知多样性建模 + 查询级信用分配，在大规模生产数据上提升点击率、查询质量与意图覆盖。
AI.motivation: 生成式查询建议的核心挑战在于：既要保证候选列表（slate）中单条查询有用，又要使整个列表覆盖不同意图，即兼顾个体质量与列表级意图多样性。
AI.method: 双阶段优化框架。第一阶段为意图感知多样性建模：构建与意图对齐的监督微调（SFT）数据，并采用意图感知多样性奖励（Intent-Aware Diversity Reward）优化意图覆盖。第二阶段为查询级信用分配：将个体质量信号路由至对应查询的token，同时在全列表范围内共享列表级多样性信号。
AI.result: 在大规模生产数据集上开展在线A/B测试与离线评估，结果显示点击率、查询质量与意图覆盖均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该意图驱动双阶段优化框架能有效平衡单查询效用与列表级意图多样性，并在真实生产环境中验证了其有效性。

title: FakeSpotter: A content and strategy agnostic Viral Misinformation Detection Tool
summary: Misinformation detection tools often rely on binary true and false classifications or models trained on historical examples, limiting their usefulness when novel misleading narratives emerge. Here, we present FakeSpotter, a content- and strategy-agnostic tool designed to estimate the viral misinformation risk of textual content by measuring structural fingerprints of misinformation rather than directly adjudicating truthfulness. FakeSpotter operationalizes a theory-driven framework across linguistic, narrative, logical, and critical-thinking dimensions, using repeated LLM assessments and domain-specific logistic regression classifiers for short and long texts. In a labelled corpus of 764 texts from social media and FakeNewsNet, FakeSpotter achieved macro F1 scores of 0.788 for short texts and 0.793 for long texts on a held-out test set. FakeSpotter's interpretive layer provides explainable outputs through feature-based scores, signal agreement, and a caution index, and can be used for social listening. These findings suggest that identifying the structural fingerprints of misinformation can support early, explainable, and human-supervised assessment of potentially viral misinformation.

AI.tldr: FakeSpotter是一款内容与策略无关的工具，通过测量文本中虚假信息的“结构性指纹”来估计病毒式虚假信息风险，而非直接判定真伪，在764条文本语料上短文本与长文本宏F1分别达0.788和0.793，并提供可解释输出。
AI.motivation: 现有虚假信息检测工具依赖真/假二元分类或基于历史样本训练的模型，当出现新型误导性叙事时适用性受限，因此需要一种不依赖具体内容与策略、能提前评估潜在病毒式虚假信息风险的方法。
AI.method: FakeSpotter基于理论驱动框架，从语言学、叙事、逻辑与批判性思维四个维度提取特征，采用重复LLM评估与面向领域的逻辑回归分类器，分别针对短文本和长文本构建模型；解释层通过特征分数、信号一致性与警示指数提供可解释输出，并可用于社交聆听。
AI.result: 在来自社交媒体与FakeNewsNet的764条标注文本语料上，于留出测试集取得宏F1：短文本0.788，长文本0.793。
AI.conclusion: 识别虚假信息的结构性指纹可支持对潜在病毒式虚假信息的早期、可解释且有人工监督的评估。

title: Beyond Similarity through Zero-Token Geometric Graphs for Multi-Hop RAG
summary: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires evidence that remains relevant to a query while introducing enough novelty to bridge semantic gaps. Dense retrieval tends to concentrate on semantically similar documents, whereas graph-based alternatives often depend on costly Large Language Model (LLM) entity extraction and may propagate through noisy connections. We introduce Geometric Gain Graph RAG (G$^3$RAG), a document-only framework whose offline graph construction uses no LLM calls or generated tokens. G$^3$RAG assigns each edge a geometric gain score, $\cosθ\cdot \sinθ$, that jointly captures directional consistency and orthogonality between document representations. A density-aware topological penalty suppresses highly connected hubs, while single-step controlled diffusion expands from filtered query seeds toward complementary evidence. We evaluate G$^3$RAG on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA using Nv-embed-v2 and Qwen3-8B-embed. G$^3$RAG obtains the best average F1 and answer-document hit rate among the evaluated graph-based baselines in both embedding settings, with gains of up to 4.26 F1 points in average performance and 5.76 points on MusiQue. It also removes the graph-construction token cost incurred by entity-based graph methods. These results show that geometric structure can support efficient multi-hop evidence discovery without LLM-based graph construction. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/G3RAG-99D9/

AI.tldr: 提出仅基于文档的图检索框架G³RAG，用几何增益分数构建图，无需LLM调用，在多跳RAG任务上取得更优性能并降低构造成本。
AI.motivation: 多跳RAG需要在保持查询相关性的同时引入足够新颖性以跨越语义鸿沟。稠密检索易集中于语义相似文档，而图方法常依赖昂贵的LLM实体抽取且易沿噪声连接传播。
AI.method: G³RAG为文档级框架，离线构图不使用LLM调用或生成token。为每条边赋予几何增益分数cosθ·sinθ，联合刻画文档表示间的方向一致性与正交性；引入密度感知拓扑惩罚抑制高度连接的中心节点；并通过单步受控扩散从过滤后的查询种子向互补证据扩展。
AI.result: 在MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA上，使用Nv-embed-v2与Qwen3-8B-embed评测。两种嵌入设置下，G³RAG在所评估的图基线中取得最佳平均F1与答案文档命中率，平均性能提升最高4.26个F1点，MusiQue上提升5.76点；同时消除了基于实体的图方法的构图token开销。
AI.conclusion: 几何结构可支持高效的多跳证据发现，无需基于LLM的图构建。

title: Trigger Timing, Deadline Readiness, and Event-Aligned Accounting for Dynamic Ad Insertion
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; 11-page supplement in ancillary files. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22774143
summary: Dynamic ad insertion comparisons can conflate trigger, reach, readiness, playback, billability and measurement even when the accounting is arithmetically correct. We separate these events with an observed-event ledger, a candidate-invariant reference deadline and pod-level contribution accounting. The deadline rule is fixed before candidate assignment and tests whether an admissible transition state remains valid, not whether preparation merely finished earlier. A restricted monotone-playback representation states when media-position summaries suffice; a counterexample shows why they fail over a wider path class. An offline synthetic study exercises the definitions over nine short-lifetime conditions informative for the readiness comparison and nine long-lifetime conditions serving as analytic controls. Across 45,000 shared scripts, two trigger policies share imposed playback paths, latency draws and hypothetical value and cost coefficients. Playhead summaries substantially misclassify reach events in the nonmonotone mixtures, yet neither shortcut reverses the contribution contrast in this grid, because some errors cancel under the shared design. Replacing validity at the deadline with completion by the deadline reverses the comparison in three of the nine informative conditions, all at one of the three latency settings. Scoring readiness at actual viewer arrival rather than at the reference deadline shifts pause-path readiness but changes no contribution sign. These outcomes are consequences of the event definitions applied to established misclassification mechanisms. Conservative bounds retain uncertainty when records are missing, and the artifact records code, seeds, event histories and checking procedures. The evidence is synthetic, uses no commercial telemetry, and ranks neither server-side nor server-guided insertion.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以"观测事件台账 + 候选不变参考截止 + pod级贡献核算"分离动态广告插入中的触发、触达、就绪、播放、可计费与测量事件，并通过离线合成实验检验相关定义的影响。
AI.motivation: 动态广告插入的对比分析常在算术正确的情况下混淆触发、触达、就绪、播放、可计费与测量等事件，导致比较结论失真。
AI.method: 定义观测事件台账、候选不变的参考截止规则（检验截止时是否存在合法转移状态，而非仅准备工作是否提前完成）以及pod级贡献核算；给出受限单调播放表示以刻画媒体位置摘要何时充分，并用反例说明其在更广路径类上的失效；开展离线合成研究，覆盖9个短生命周期条件与9个长生命周期对照条件，共45,000个共享脚本，两套触发策略共享播放路径、延迟抽样与假设的价值和成本系数；并对缺失记录采用保守界。
AI.result: 播放头摘要会在非单调混合中显著错误分类触达事件，但在此网格中未逆转贡献对比，因共享设计下部分误差相互抵消；将"截止时有效性"替换为"截止前完成"会在9个信息性条件中的3个（均集中于三种延迟设定中的一种）逆转比较；按实际观看到达而非参考截止评估就绪会改变暂停路径就绪性，但不改变贡献符号。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果源于事件定义作用于既有误分类机制，属定义性后果；研究为合成证据，未使用商业遥测数据，也不对服务端或服务端引导式插入进行优劣排序；制品包含代码、随机种子、事件历史与校验流程。

title: A Cross-Lingual Acoustic Disease-Alignment Framework for Respiratory Health Assessment from Spontaneous Speech
summary: Spontaneous speech offers a scalable, noninvasive signal for respiratory health assessment, yet interpretable models that generalize across languages remain challenging because disease-related acoustic changes are confounded by language-specific phonetic variation. We present CL-DAF, a Cross-Lingual Disease-Alignment Framework that identifies acoustic dimensions whose disease effects remain consistent across languages. Using 201 English and 75 newly collected Bangla speakers, we construct a common 272-dimensional acoustic representation and quantify disease alignment using signed rank-biserial effects and the Language Invariance Score. We first show that spontaneous Bangla speech separates COPD from controls (AUC 0.85); however, 133 features reverse their disease direction across languages and the full representation transfers poorly (AUC 0.49 from Bangla to English). CL-DAF isolates 26 disease-aligned features that raise AUCs to 0.825 and 0.722 from English to Bangla and Bangla to English, respectively. These findings provide a foundation for multilingual clinical speech models emphasizing pathology over language-dependent variation.

AI.tldr: 提出跨语言疾病对齐框架CL-DAF，从自发语音中筛选疾病效应跨语言一致的声学特征，用于COPD识别并提升跨语言迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 自发语音可作为可扩展、非侵入性的呼吸健康评估信号，但疾病相关声学变化与语言特有的语音变异相互混淆，导致可解释且跨语言泛化的模型难以构建。
AI.method: 使用201名英语和75名新采集的孟加拉语说话人，构建272维通用声学表征；用带符号秩双序列相关效应量和语言不变性得分量化疾病对齐；CL-DAF筛选出26个疾病对齐特征。
AI.result: 孟加拉语自发语音可区分COPD与对照（AUC 0.85）；但133个特征疾病方向跨语言反转，全表征从孟加拉语迁移到英语表现差（AUC 0.49）；CL-DAF所选26个特征将英语到孟加拉语、孟加拉语到英语的AUC分别提升至0.825和0.722。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言疾病对齐特征可有效缓解语言相关变异干扰，为强调病理信号而非语言依赖变异的多语言临床语音模型奠定基础。

title: Learning Submanifolds for Subsequent Inference on Random Dot Product Graphs, Part 1: Theory
summary: We propose a framework for restricted inference on random dot product graphs whose latent positions lie on an unknown low-dimensional support manifold. For general decision problems, we propose semisupervised decision rules that use auxiliary data to learn the support manifold. Specifically, our rules use the Isomap manifold learning procedure to construct a low-dimensional Euclidean representation of the observed graph, in which space an isometrically invariant function maps configurations of points to actions. We study the behavior of the proposed rules as the quantity of auxiliary data sampled from the unknown support manifold increases. We show that, as the auxiliary sample size increases, the risk of the semisupervised rule converges to the risk of an oracle rule that relies on the maximal amount of low-dimensional Euclidean structure that can be extracted from the support manifold. Examples, applications, and simulation studies are deferred to a sequel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对随机点积图（RDPG）的受限推断框架，其潜在位置位于未知低维支撑流形上；利用Isomap流形学习构建低维欧氏表示，并设计半监督决策规则，证明随辅助样本量增加，其风险收敛至oracle规则的风险。
AI.motivation: 随机点积图的潜在位置通常被假设位于低维空间中，但实际中该低维支撑结构（支撑流形）往往是未知的。在一般决策问题下，如何利用辅助数据学习这一未知流形，并实现逼近最优的推断，是一个有待解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出半监督决策规则框架：使用Isomap流形学习过程对观测图构造低维欧氏表示；在该空间中，用一个等距不变函数将点配置映射为动作（决策）。理论分析关注辅助样本量增大时规则的行为。
AI.result: 证明随辅助样本量增大，半监督规则的风险收敛到oracle规则的风险；该oracle规则依赖从支撑流形中可提取的最大低维欧氏结构。示例、应用与仿真研究留待后续文章。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够利用辅助数据学习未知支撑流形，并在辅助样本充足时达到与oracle规则渐近等价的性能，为随机点积图上的受限推断提供了理论保证。

title: RAUL: Reference-Assisted Ureteroscopy Localization for Skill Assessment
summary: Objective: Incomplete navigation of anatomy during ureteroscopic kidney stone surgeries can contribute to repeat interventions. While skilled surgeons have lower reintervention rates, there are no objective metrics to quantify scope-navigation performance to evaluate when a trainee becomes skilled. This work aims to recover ureteroscope trajectories from endoscopic video and derive navigation metrics to quantify differences in skill. Methods: We propose RAUL, a reference-assisted reconstruction framework for recovering ureteroscope trajectories from ureteroscope videos only in phantoms. For each phantom, we use a slow, high-quality reference exploration video to generate a reference reconstruction. We localize subsequent exploration videos against this reference. We evaluate localization accuracy against electromagnetically tracked scope pose. We compute navigation metrics from phantom exploration trajectories to compare surgical residents across experience levels. Results: The proposed reference-assisted framework achieves a mean translation root mean square error of $0.5 \pm 0.1$ mm across 9 phantoms. Compared to standard Structure-from-Motion (SfM), the proposed pipeline increases frame-wise localization coverage from $50.5 \pm 14.9\%$ to $86.1 \pm 7.2\%$ of all video frames. The reconstructed trajectories revealed significant differences between high- and low-experience trainees in established navigation metrics. Conclusion: RAUL enables substantially more complete recovery of ureteroscope trajectories from videos compared to standard SfM pipelines, enabling trajectory-based skill assessment without additional tracking equipment. Significance: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first use of video-only recovery of ureteroscope trajectories without external tracking sensors for skill assessment, supporting scalable automated assessment of ureteroscopy navigation skill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAUL——一种参考辅助的输尿管镜轨迹重建框架，仅用体模内的内窥镜视频即可恢复器械轨迹，并据此推导导航指标以区分不同经验水平医生的操作技能。
AI.motivation: 输尿管镜碎石术中解剖导航不完整会导致重复手术。高技能医生再干预率较低，但目前缺乏客观指标来量化镜体导航表现，也无法判断受训者何时达到熟练水平。此外，现有轨迹获取依赖外部追踪设备，难以规模化应用。
AI.method: RAUL采用参考辅助重建：对每个体模先用一段缓慢、高质量参考探查视频生成参考重建，再将后续探查视频定位到该参考上；随后从体模探查轨迹计算导航指标，并对照电磁追踪的镜体位姿评估定位精度及比较不同经验住院医师。
AI.result: 在9个体模上实现平均平移均方根误差0.5±0.1 mm；相比标准SfM，逐帧定位覆盖率由50.5±14.9%提升至86.1±7.2%；重建轨迹在既有导航指标上显著区分高、低经验受训者。
AI.conclusion: RAUL相比标准SfM能显著更完整地从视频恢复输尿管镜轨迹，无需额外追踪设备即可实现基于轨迹的技能评估；这是首个不依赖外部追踪传感器、仅用视频恢复输尿管镜轨迹进行技能评估的工作，支持可扩展的自动化输尿管镜导航技能评价。

title: DITTO: Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation
summary: Collecting data for manipulation with high-DOF hands is challenging, as interfaces must capture rich hand motion while rendering the contact interactions essential for precise manipulation. Existing data collection approaches face a trade-off: teleoperation ensures deployment consistency but lacks force feedback, while handheld (in-the-wild) systems provide natural force transparency but introduce a visual embodiment gap at deployment. We present DITTO, a Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation, which resolves this through the anatomically informed co-design of a dexterous 7-DOF robotic hand and a kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton. A 1-to-1 actuator mapping between the exoskeleton and robotic hand enables handheld (in-the-wild) data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback unified in a single platform. We demonstrate that the DITTO exoskeleton spans the operator's natural index-to-thumb workspace, and showcase DITTO's dexterous capabilities via learned policies on contact-rich tasks.

AI.tldr: DITTO 是一种灵巧遥操作接口，通过解剖学协同设计 7-DOF 机械手与运动学等效的电动外骨骼，统一了野外手持数据采集与带关节力反馈的双向遥操作。
AI.motivation: 高自由度手部操作数据采集困难：接口需同时捕捉丰富手部运动并呈现精确操作所需的接触交互。现有方法存在权衡——遥操作保证部署一致性但缺乏力反馈；手持（野外）系统提供自然力透明性但在部署时存在视觉具身差距。
AI.method: 提出 DITTO（Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation），基于解剖学进行协同设计：一个灵巧 7-DOF 机械手与一个运动学等效的电动外骨骼。外骨骼与机械手之间采用 1:1 执行器映射，从而在单一平台上统一支持手持（野外）数据采集与带关节级力反馈的双向遥操作。
AI.result: 证明 DITTO 外骨骼覆盖操作者自然的食指到拇指工作空间，并通过在接触丰富任务上学习策略展示其灵巧能力。
AI.conclusion: DITTO 通过机械手与外骨骼的协同设计及 1:1 执行器映射，弥合了遥操作与手持数据采集之间的权衡，实现了部署一致性与力透明性的统一。

title: BioPhys-Bridge: A Benchmark for Interdisciplinary Scientific Reasoning in Physics-Grounded Biological Research
comment: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2026, 11 pages, 3 figures
summary: Language models face unique challenges in analyzing interdisciplinary scientific research literature. In biophysics research, faithful answers require grounding observed data in source evidence, interpreting it through a quantitative physics model, and linking it to a biological mechanism. To address this challenge, we introduce BioPhys-Bridge, a novel benchmark dataset for evidence-grounded scientific reasoning over biophysical literature. Each case contains evidence blocks, stable evidence IDs, quantitative values, units, equations, assumptions, mechanisms, and next decisions as grounding targets for question answering (QA) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The initial release contains 500 cases, 1,517 agent-facing tasks, and covers six biological domains and nine physical model families, including three sparse families reserved for future expansion. We enforce strict quality gates for all cases in schema, evidence-integrity, quantitative-grounding, source-license, duplicate, unit-normalization, with domain expert review and annotation for 81 cases. Preliminary evaluations show that DeepSeek-V4-Flash obtain the highest evidence-ID $F_1$ score (0.360), followed by Qwen3.7-Max (0.316) and GPT-4o-mini (0.294). BioPhys-Bridge is an interdisciplinary benchmark for evaluating attribution, faithfulness, hallucination reduction, and biological experiment design with complex, multi-step scientific reasoning. Future works will increase the size and complexity of the dataset and perform comprehensive evaluations. Code and data are available in the GitHub repository and on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BioPhys-Bridge——面向生物物理文献证据锚定科学推理的基准数据集，含 500 个案例、1517 个任务，覆盖 6 个生物领域与 9 类物理模型，并提供定量值、单位、方程、假设、机制等锚定标注及严格质量门控。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在跨学科科学文献分析中面临独特挑战：生物物理研究中，忠实回答需将观测数据锚定于源证据、通过定量物理模型加以解释，并关联到生物学机制，现有基准难以覆盖此类多步、跨学科推理需求。
AI.method: 构建 BioPhys-Bridge 基准数据集：每个案例包含证据块、稳定证据 ID、定量值、单位、方程、假设、机制与后续决策作为 QA 和 RAG 的锚定目标；初始版本含 500 案例、1517 个面向智能体的任务，覆盖 6 个生物领域与 9 类物理模型家族（含 3 个稀疏家族留待扩展）；对全部案例设置 schema、证据完整性、定量锚定、来源许可、重复性、单位归一化等严格质量门控，并由领域专家对 81 个案例进行审核与标注。
AI.result: 初步评测显示，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 取得最高证据 ID F1（0.360），其后为 Qwen3.7-Max（0.316）和 GPT-4o-mini（0.294）。
AI.conclusion: BioPhys-Bridge 是用于评估归因性、忠实性、幻觉抑制及生物实验设计的跨学科基准，支持复杂多步科学推理；未来将扩大数据集规模与复杂度并开展全面评测，代码与数据已在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 开源。

title: Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression
comment: Accepted by the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026
summary: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. Consequently, our method exhibits advanced model compression performance, as well as high computational efficiency in terms of minimized memory usage and short training hours. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing GPU memory usage and training hours by more than 50\% on BERT and GPT-2. Moreover, it outperforms the other pruning methods on LLaMA-family and Qwen models under the same training hours, with a lower GPU memory footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向LLM压缩的分层课程学习（layer-wise curriculum learning），通过将模型划分为多层段、结合累积误差理论分析、多线程特征缓存，实现高效知识蒸馏式压缩，在BERT/GPT-2上降低50%以上显存与训练时间，并在LLaMA、Qwen上优于其他剪枝方法。
AI.motivation: LLM压缩中的知识迁移通常计算开销大、显存占用高、训练时间长，且跨层特征难以对齐。作者希望借助课程学习（由易到难）与分层（layer-wise）策略，提升压缩效率与收敛稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 将整体模型切分为由若干层组成的多个段，实现分层课程学习，由易到难进行知识迁移；2) 基于累积误差现象的理论分析，论证分层课程学习可加速收敛并稳定知识迁移；3) 提出多线程特征缓存方法，解决跨层特征错位问题并最大化GPU利用率。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上取得SOTA压缩性能；在BERT与GPT-2上减少50%以上GPU显存与训练时长；在相同训练时长下，于LLaMA系列与Qwen模型上优于其他剪枝方法，且显存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 分层课程学习是一种兼顾压缩性能与计算效率的LLM压缩方案，通过理论支撑、分层知识迁移与特征缓存优化，实现低显存、短训练时长下的领先表现，并具备跨模型家族的通用性。

title: Stop Removing Stopwords: How an Inherited Preprocessing Default Distorts Legal Text-as-Data
summary: Empirical legal scholarship increasingly treats judicial text as data, and much of it still runs on sparse, interpretable pipelines -- TF-IDF features and linear classifiers -- because the textual feature is often the object of study, not merely a means to a prediction. Yet these pipelines inherit a chain of preprocessing defaults from mid-century information retrieval that were never validated against classification accuracy, the most entrenched being stopword removal. This study introduces an exhaustive single-word ablation that measures a preprocessing step's effect directly against the downstream objective, and applies it to stopword removal as the hardest case to dislodge. Matching Supreme Court Database labels to Caselaw Access Project opinion texts, it examines two binary tasks that bracket F1 headroom, ideological direction (no-removal baseline F1 ~ 0.68) and constitutional versus non-constitutional law type (~ 0.92), across 7,668 and 7,001 opinions. For each task the analysis approximates the best stoplist any expert could build, removing each of roughly 18,500 candidate words and measuring the effect directly. Three findings follow: generic stoplists in common use fall below the no-removal baseline in every test; even optimized stoplists are statistically indistinguishable from removing nothing; and meta-models trained on word-level features cannot predict which removals help, so list curation has nothing to target. The method generalizes to any inherited preprocessing default, and the result is a caution specific to interpretable legal text-as-data: a step that silently reshapes which features a model sees can distort the very doctrinal and ideological signal such research exists to recover. Leaving stopwords in place is a question of measurement validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"全词穷举消融"方法，将预处理步骤的效果直接对标下游分类目标，并以停用词移除这一最根深蒂固的默认步骤作为最难推翻的案例加以检验。结果显示：常用通用停用词表在任何测试中都低于不移除的基线，即便优化后的停用词表与"不移除"在统计上也无显著差异，且元模型无法预测哪些词移除有益，因此词表筛选缺乏优化目标。
AI.motivation: 实证法律研究日益将司法文本视为数据，且多采用稀疏、可解释的流水线（TF-IDF 特征 + 线性分类器），因为文本特征本身常是研究对象而非单纯的预测手段。然而这些流水线沿用了上世纪中叶信息检索留下的一系列未针对分类准确率验证过的预处理默认设置，其中最根深蒂固的是停用词移除。作者意在检验：这一默认步骤是否真的有助于下游任务，抑或反而损害了研究本要恢复的教义与意识形态信号。
AI.method: 研究提出"穷举式单词消融"（exhaustive single-word ablation），直接以分类目标度量单个预处理步骤的效果。数据上将 Supreme Court Database 标签与 Caselaw Access Project 意见文本对齐，构造两个二元任务以覆盖 F1 提升空间的两端：意识形态方向（不移除基线 F1 ≈ 0.68，7,668 份意见）与宪法/非宪法法律类型（F1 ≈ 0.92，7,001 份意见）。对每个任务，逐一移除约 18,500 个候选词并直接测量效果，从而逼近任何专家所能构建的最优停用词表；并训练词级特征元模型，检验其能否预测哪些移除有益。
AI.result: 三项发现：其一，常用通用停用词表在所有测试中均低于不移除基线；其二，即便经过优化的停用词表，其表现与"完全不移除"在统计上不可区分；其三，基于词级特征训练的元模型无法预测哪些词的移除会带来增益，说明停用词表的筛选没有可瞄准的目标。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可推广至任何沿袭下来的预处理默认设置。结论对可解释的法律文本即数据研究提出警示：一个悄然重塑模型所见特征的步骤，可能扭曲此类研究本要恢复的教义与意识形态信号。因此，保留停用词并非懒惰的默认，而是测量效度问题。

title: Self-Evolving Search Index
summary: Information retrieval is increasingly important as LLM agents tackle complex tasks involving diverse information needs. Because retrieval relies on an index that represents each document through index keys, retrieval quality depends heavily on how effectively these keys expose the knowledge contained in each document. However, effective index representations vary across retrieval environments, making it difficult for any fixed optimization strategy to perform consistently. Yet evolving an index to its retrieval environment remains largely human-driven, requiring humans to diagnose retrieval failures, refine the optimization strategy, and reprocess the index accordingly. We propose SELF-INDEX, a framework that enables an index to self-evolve without human intervention. Its Optimizer autonomously diagnoses retrieval shortfalls, selectively revises the responsible index keys, and validates each revision before updating the index. Beyond reacting to observed retrieval demands, SELF-INDEX proactively explores additional demands through a Query Simulator, allowing the index to evolve beyond the queries already available for optimization. Across diverse corpora and retrievers, SELF-INDEX consistently improves retrieval performance while outperforming existing index optimization methods. We further show that these benefits extend to downstream applications, improving the effectiveness and efficiency of search agents and helping agent memory systems retrieve useful past interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出 SELF-INDEX 框架，使检索索引无需人工干预即可自我演化，通过自主诊断、选择性修订索引键并验证后更新，同时用查询模拟器主动探索额外检索需求，在多语料多检索器上稳定超越现有索引优化方法并提升下游搜索智能体与记忆系统表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体处理复杂任务时检索愈发重要，而检索质量高度依赖索引键对文档知识的表征效果。有效表征随检索环境变化，固定优化策略难以稳定奏效；而让索引适配检索环境目前仍主要依赖人工：需人工诊断检索失败、改进优化策略并重处理索引。
AI.method: SELF-INDEX 框架，包含两类组件：Optimizer（优化器）自主诊断检索不足，选择性修订应负责的索引键，并在更新索引前对每次修订进行验证；Query Simulator（查询模拟器）在响应已观测检索需求之外，主动探索额外检索需求，使索引能超越现有可用查询持续演化。
AI.result: 在多种语料与检索器上，SELF-INDEX 持续提升检索性能，优于现有索引优化方法；其收益可延伸至下游应用，提升搜索智能体的效果与效率，并帮助智能体记忆系统检索到有用的历史交互。
AI.conclusion: 索引可以无需人工介入实现自我演化，自动化诊断-修订-验证循环加上主动查询模拟，能在多样检索环境下稳定提升检索质量并增益下游智能体任务。

title: Riemannian--Lorentz Fusion of Vision Transformers and State-Space Models
summary: Scaling deep learning faces critical bottlenecks: data exhaustion, exponential training costs, and resource concentration. Model merging combines pre-trained checkpoints without gradient descent, offering orders-of-magnitude savings versus retraining. Combining independently trained vision models is difficult when their architectures and parameter shapes differ. Existing weight-space merging methods generally assume aligned, shape-compatible checkpoints, whereas a Vision Transformer (ViT) and a state-space model (SSM) implement token mixing with different operators. We study a hybrid Heterogeneous merging setting that retains both architectures while aligning parameter groups by semantic role. Our proposed Riemannian--Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF) method projects aligned groups to common coordinates, lifts selected coordinates to the Lorentz hyperboloid model of hyperbolic space, computes a regularized geodesic barycenter, and decodes the result into the two branches. A learned gate then combines branch logits for each input. Component groups use fixed curvature values, with normalization parameters treated as Euclidean. In the results available in this manuscript, the fine-tuned system obtains 82.37\% on CIFAR-10, 75.04\% on Oxford-IIIT Pet, and 78.58\% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K; the corresponding best-parent accuracies are 76.54\%, 71.42\%, and 76.42\%. On ImageNet-1K, the reported pre-fine-tuning initialization reaches 77.80\%. These results support further study of geometry-aware heterogeneous fusion, but not a training-free single-checkpoint merge: RLPF is a two-branch hybrid whose gate and reported final models are trained.

AI.tldr: 提出Riemannian–Lorentz参数融合（RLPF）方法，在异质架构（ViT与SSM）之间按语义角色对齐参数组，并在Lorentz双曲空间上计算正则化测地重心以融合权重，再由学习门控合并分支logits；微调后CIFAR-10达82.37%、Oxford-IIIT Pet达75.04%、ImageNet-1K top-1达78.58%，均高于最佳单亲模型。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的扩展面临数据枯竭、训练成本指数增长与资源集中等瓶颈；模型合并无需梯度下降即可组合预训练检查点，可带来数量级节省。但现有权重空间合并方法通常假设检查点结构对齐、形状兼容，而ViT与SSM使用不同算子实现token混合，跨架构合并困难，因此需要研究异质合并设置。
AI.method: 提出RLPF方法：保留ViT与SSM两种架构，按语义角色对齐参数组；将对齐后的参数组投影到公共坐标，选取部分坐标提升到双曲空间的Lorentz双曲面模型，计算正则化测地重心，再解码回两个分支；随后用学习到的门控按输入组合分支logits。各组件组使用固定曲率，归一化参数按欧氏处理。
AI.result: 微调后系统在CIFAR-10上达82.37%、Oxford-IIIT Pet上达75.04%、ImageNet-1K上top-1达78.58%；对应最佳单亲模型分别为76.54%、71.42%、76.42%。在ImageNet-1K上，报告的微调前初始化达到77.80%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持进一步研究几何感知的异质融合，但并不支持“免训练的单检查点合并”：RLPF是一个双分支混合方法，其门控与所报告的最终模型均经过训练。

title: CoRELoop: Parameter-Efficient Controlled Recurrent Refinement for Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Generalizing to unseen attacks remains challenging for audio deepfake detectors, and collecting training data covering all potential attacks is impractical. We explore recurrent refinement in an already-trained SSL-based detector without additional data or changes to its original parameters. However, directly recycling encoder outputs as inputs degrades detection in our diagnostic. We propose CoReLoop, which makes this reuse effective by adapting recurrent inputs to the frozen encoder, controlling state updates, and aligning refined outputs with the frozen classifier. By training only lightweight refinement modules and loop-specific low-rank adapters on the original data, CoReLoop enables additional refinement while preserving the detector's original first-pass prediction. On 14 cross-domain test sets, the 24-layer model reduces pooled equal error rate (EER) from 4.85% to 3.74% with two passes, with approximately 10M trainable parameters out of 598M. To selectively apply this refinement, an optional halting head chooses the depth for each utterance, achieving 3.73% pooled EER with an average of 1.18 passes.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoReLoop，在冻结的 SSL 音频深度伪造检测器上做循环精炼，仅训练轻量模块与低秩适配器，无需额外数据即可提升跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 音频深度伪造检测器难以泛化到未见攻击，而收集覆盖所有潜在攻击的训练数据不现实，因此研究在不增加数据、不改变原参数的前提下对已训练检测器进行循环精炼。
AI.method: 诊断发现直接复用编码器输出会降低检测性能；CoReLoop 通过适配循环输入以匹配冻结编码器、控制状态更新、并将精炼输出与冻结分类器对齐，仅训练轻量精炼模块和循环特定的低秩适配器；另设可选 halting head 逐句选择精炼深度。
AI.result: 在 14 个跨域测试集上，24 层模型两次迭代将池化 EER 从 4.85% 降至 3.74%，可训练参数约 10M/598M；引入 halting head 后平均 1.18 次迭代达到 3.73% 池化 EER。
AI.conclusion: CoReLoop 使循环复用在不失原始首遍预测的前提下有效，以极少可训练参数显著提升跨域泛化，并可通过 halting head 自适应控制计算开销。

title: Null importance: Disentangling relevance for interpretable machine learning
comment: 29 pages, 9 files. Submitted to Statistical Science
summary: Feature importance is central to interpretable machine learning, but the term "importance" encompasses several fundamentally different notions of relevance. We develop a unified perspective based on null importance: a population-level characterization of when a feature is irrelevant under a specified notion of relevance. We consider standard notions of null importance arising from marginal and conditional statistical relevance, predictive risk, functional invariance, and causal effects, and show how these notions answer different scientific questions. We illustrate the framework in two applications in which the distinction is particularly consequential: algorithmic fairness, where common fairness criteria correspond to different notions of null importance, and genomic perturbation modeling, where different notions of relevance lead to different conclusions about what a prediction model has learned. The framework connects three aspects of feature analysis: the scientific question defining relevance, the data and model assumptions that shape how different null notions relate, and the methods used to assess importance. We establish sufficient conditions under which null notions coincide and give counterexamples showing how they diverge when those conditions fail. We then characterize which nulls different method families target and when their zero-importance statistics identify those targets. Finally, simulations spanning feature dependence, redundancy, nonlinearity, hidden features and other standard phenomena, along with case studies on image and multiomics data, provide empirical evidence for these theoretical distinctions and their practical consequences. Taken together, these results provide a common statistical language for relating scientific questions, data-generating assumptions, and algorithms, and clarify the conclusions that feature-importance analyses can support.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以"零重要性(null importance)"为核心的统一框架，将边际/条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性与因果效应等不同重要性概念纳入同一统计语言，厘清其对应的科学问题、成立条件及方法学后果。
AI.motivation: 特征重要性是可解释机器学习的核心，但"重要性"一词涵盖多种本质不同的相关性概念，学界常混用，导致对同一分析结论的解读产生歧义。作者希望明确不同重要性概念究竟回答了哪些科学问题，并揭示其适用边界。
AI.method: 提出基于零重要性的群体层面刻画：定义在给定相关性概念下特征"无关"的判据，系统梳理来自边际与条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性、因果效应等标准零重要性概念；建立不同零概念重合的充分条件并给出反例说明其分歧；刻画不同方法族所针对的零目标及其零重要性统计量何时能识别该目标；辅以覆盖特征依赖、冗余、非线性、隐藏特征等现象的仿真，以及图像与多组学数据案例。
AI.result: 在该框架下，算法公平性中的常见公平准则对应不同的零重要性概念，基因组扰动建模中不同相关性概念会导向关于预测模型"学到了什么"的不同结论；给出零概念重合的充分条件及失效时的反例；明确各方法族所针对的零目标及其统计量识别目标的条件；仿真与案例为这些理论区分提供了实证支持。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为关联科学问题、数据生成假设与算法提供了共同的统计语言，明确了特征重要性分析所能支持的结论边界，有助于避免对重要性结果的过度解读。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Judge Olympic Diving? From Reasoning to Scores in Zero-Shot Action Quality Assessment
summary: Automated action quality assessment (AQA) in Olympic sports remains a challenging task due to the complexity of human motion and the subjectivity inherent in expert judging. This work evaluates the capability of open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform zero-shot action quality assessment on Olympic diving videos using the AQA-7 benchmark dataset. In this regard, a regression-based framework is pro-posed to leverage both the semantic reasoning and phase-level sub-scores generated by the VLMs, combining TF-IDF vectorization, dimensionality reduction, and ensemble learning to predict final competition scores. Experimental results show that standalone VLMs achieve moderate Spearman correlations below 0.32, while the proposed ensemble regression framework substantially improves performance in the reported evaluation, reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.67 with a four-model configuration. Textual reasoning features con-sistently outperformed raw numerical sub-scores, highlighting the richness of VLM-generated explanations for action quality analysis. These findings suggest that VLMs hold strong potential as assistive tools for explainable and semi-automated sports performance evaluation. The code is publicly available on GitHub https://github.com/hvelesaca/olympic diving judge vlm

AI.tldr: 本文评估开源视觉语言模型（VLM）在奥运跳水动作质量评估中的零样本能力，提出基于回归的集成框架融合VLM语义推理与分阶段子分数，将Spearman相关从单一VLM的0.32以下提升至0.67。
AI.motivation: 奥运体育中的自动化动作质量评估（AQA）因人体运动复杂性和专家评分主观性而极具挑战；作者希望探究开源VLM能否作为可解释、半自动的体育评分辅助工具。
AI.method: 在AQA-7基准数据集的跳水视频上进行零样本评估；提出回归框架，利用VLM生成的语义推理和阶段级子分数，结合TF-IDF向量化、降维与集成学习预测最终比赛得分。
AI.result: 单一VLM仅达到0.32以下的Spearman相关；所提集成回归框架显著提升性能，四模型配置下达0.67；文本推理特征持续优于原始数值子分数。
AI.conclusion: VLM作为可解释、半自动化体育表现评估的辅助工具具有较大潜力。

title: ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning
summary: Underwater visuomotor policy learning has focused primarily on single manipulators, while bimanual imitation learning has been studied largely in air. We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform. We investigate how learning methods and execution strategies developed for manipulation in air perform underwater, examining bubble disturbances, buoyancy-driven object motion, action-execution horizons, and real-time chunking. A separate single-arm study examines policy transfer between air and water and shows that demonstrations spanning both media support execution in both under the tested conditions. ULOHA provides a unified experimental platform for studying underwater bimanual robot learning under the coupled perceptual and physical effects of underwater environments. Additional material: https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/

AI.tldr: 提出水下双臂机器人学习平台 ULOHA，融合定制主从硬件与 LeRobot 软件扩展，支持遥操作、多视角感知、演示采集、策略训练与自主部署，并系统评测 ACT、Diffusion Policy 与 SmolVLA 在水下环境中的表现。
AI.motivation: 水下视觉运动策略学习多集中于单臂，双臂模仿学习则主要在空气中开展，缺乏面向水下双臂协同操作与水下耦合物理效应的统一实验平台。
AI.method: 构建 ULOHA：定制主从（leader-follower）硬件 + LeRobot 软件扩展，集成遥操作、多视角传感、演示数据采集、策略训练与自主部署；在真机上开展双臂协同任务实验，评测 ACT、Diffusion Policy 与 VLA 模型 SmolVLA，并分析气泡扰动、浮力驱动的物体运动、动作执行时域与实时分块（real-time chunking）；另设单臂实验考察空气与水之间的策略迁移。
AI.result: 真机实验实现多种水下双臂协同行为，包括臂间传递、共享物体操作与浮力驱动拦截；揭示了空气中的学习方法与执行策略在水下的性能变化，并发现跨空气—水两种介质的演示可支持两种介质中的执行。
AI.conclusion: ULOHA 为研究水下环境中感知与物理效应耦合条件下的双臂机器人学习提供了统一实验平台，并给出策略跨介质迁移的初步证据。

title: What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/xxcg322/LLM-Bench-Map
summary: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examine changes in target systems and domains, evaluation materials and conditions, and scoring mechanisms. The collection shows growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, while established and newer design elements frequently coexist. Model participation also develops unevenly: LLM-based scoring grows within both agent and non-agent groups, whereas model-generated materials show no comparable sustained increase in recent cohorts. These findings illuminate how public research translates capability expectations into concrete tests and criteria for success. As AI participates in constructing tests, performing tasks, and judging responses, they also raise a question: does expanding evaluation provide more independent evidence, or risk reproducing the preferences and blind spots of its participating models?

AI.tldr: 该文系统梳理2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv上14,767篇评测资源论文，揭示LLM评测需求从静态知识问答转向行动、交互与专业应用，且评测者与评测材料本身日益由模型参与生成与打分。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注模型排名与分数，无法反映"评测需求"本身如何演变；作者希望从基准的多样性出发，反向刻画研究者对LLM的能力预期以及"成功表现"的判定标准如何变化，并追问模型参与评测构建是否会损害评测的独立性。
AI.method: 对2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv上14,767篇引入或更新评测资源的论文进行系统映射；采用分阶段筛选（staged screening）与自动化全文编码（automated full-text coding），考察三类维度的变化：目标系统与领域、评测材料与条件、评分机制；并按"智能体/非智能体"分组比较模型参与程度。
AI.result: 评测重心日益强调行动、交互与专业应用；传统与新近设计要素常并存而非替代。模型参与程度发展不均衡：LLM打分在智能体与非智能体组中均上升，而模型生成评测材料在近期队列中未见持续增长。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了公共研究如何把能力预期转化为具体测试与成功标准。当AI同时参与构造测试、执行任务与评判回答时，评测扩张未必等于更独立的证据，可能复制参与模型的偏好与盲区。

title: Block Parallelism For Efficient Distributed Long-Context Diffusion Language Model Training
summary: Block diffusion language models (BDLMs) combine autoregressive dependencies across blocks with parallel denoising within blocks, but long-context training is constrained by distributed attention communication and activation memory. Conventional context parallelism (CP) shards the combined clean-plus-corrupted sequence by position, communicating shared clean K/V together with block-specific corrupted K/V and their gradients. We observe that the BDLM objective separates over target blocks. We introduce block parallelism (BP), a new distributed parallelism dimension that assigns each corrupted-block computation to one rank. To scale BP to long contexts, we introduce context-sharded block parallelism (CSBP), which also shards the shared clean sequence across those ranks. CSBP keeps corrupted K/V and gradients local, avoids replicated clean prefixes, and preserves BDLM training semantics. On 16 H200 GPUs at 256K context, CSBP improves throughput over the best baseline by 1.18-1.45x for supervised fine-tuning and 1.27-1.33x for conversion of autoregressive models to BDLMs, while matching or reducing peak HBM. Full-model speedup reaches 1.61x at 512K. On eight H100 GPUs, CSBP accelerates DFlash2 speculative-decoder training by 2.48x at 512K and 7.59x at 1M. In matched 12-hour DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT runs, CSBP achieves higher pass rates at every trained checkpoint on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench Lite. Code: https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM

AI.tldr: 该论文提出块并行（BP）及上下文分片块并行（CSBP），一种面向块扩散语言模型（BDLM）长上下文训练的新分布式并行维度，在保持训练语义的同时显著提升吞吐并降低显存。
AI.motivation: BDLM结合块间自回归依赖与块内并行去噪，但长上下文训练受限于分布式注意力通信与激活内存。传统上下文并行（CP）按位置切分“干净序列+损坏序列”，需通信共享的干净K/V及块特定的损坏K/V及其梯度，通信与内存开销大。
AI.method: 作者观察到BDLM目标函数可在目标块上分离，因此提出块并行（BP）：将每个损坏块的计算分配给单一rank。为扩展到长上下文，进一步提出上下文分片块并行（CSBP），在BP基础上将共享的干净序列也分片到各rank，从而保持损坏K/V及梯度本地化、避免干净前缀复制，并保持BDLM训练语义。
AI.result: 在16张H200、256K上下文下，CSBP相较最优基线，监督微调吞吐提升1.18-1.45x，自回归模型转BDLM提升1.27-1.33x，同时峰值HBM持平或下降；512K时全模型加速达1.61x。在8张H100上，CSBP使DFlash2投机解码器训练在512K加速2.48x、1M加速7.59x。在等时长12小时的DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT中，CSBP在每个训练检查点上于SWE-bench Verified和Terminal-Bench Lite均取得更高的通过率。
AI.conclusion: BP与CSBP通过利用BDLM目标在目标块上的可分离性，将损坏块计算本地化并结合干净序列分片，有效解决了长上下文训练的通信与内存瓶颈，在吞吐、显存与下游任务表现上均优于现有基线，并已开源。

title: Neo-Classic: A Benchmark for Evaluating Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning in Classical Chinese Poetry
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), 2026
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high accuracy on established Classical Chinese Poetry benchmarks, it remains challenging to distinguish transferable Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning from reliance on familiar pre-training patterns. To address this issue, we introduce Neo-Classic, an evaluation benchmark that combines a constructionist Out-of-Sample (OOS) dataset with a suite of reverse understanding probes. Unlike traditional benchmarks that rely on verification or generation over historical corpora, Neo-Classic comprises strictly metrical poetry authored by contemporary experts, reducing the possibility of direct retrieval. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, including Qwen3-Max, Gemini-3-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.2, across five behavioral probes designed to test hierarchical constraint satisfaction. Our results reveal two primary limitations. First, a performance gap of 20 to 50 percent emerges when models transition from historical to contemporary texts. Second, models exhibit substantial difficulties in discourse-level ordering tasks, with standard accuracy remaining low (0 to 13 percent). Although expert-level guidance improves the performance of reasoning-enhanced models to 36 percent, a notable gap with human experts persists. These findings suggest that while current LLMs capture local formal patterns, they struggle with global hierarchical planning required for robust Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Neo-Classic基准，用当代专家创作的严格格律诗词（样本外数据）结合反向理解探针，检验大模型是真正具备可迁移的语言审美推理，还是依赖预训练中熟悉的历史语料模式。评测Qwen3-Max、Gemini-3-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2等模型发现：从历史文本转向当代文本时性能下降20%–50%，语篇级排序任务准确率仅0%–13%，专家指导可将推理增强模型提升至36%，但仍与人类专家存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 现有古典诗词基准多为历史语料上的验证或生成任务，模型可能通过预训练记忆取得高分，难以区分真正的语言审美推理能力与对熟悉模式的检索依赖，因此需要一个能降低直接检索可能性的样本外评测方案。
AI.method: 构建Neo-Classic基准：采用建构主义式样本外（OOS）数据集，由当代专家创作严格格律诗词，替代历史语料；并设计一组反向理解探针（五个行为探针），用于测试层次化约束满足能力。对Qwen3-Max、Gemini-3-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2等SOTA模型进行评测，并对比专家级指导条件下的表现。
AI.result: 1）模型从历史文本迁移到当代文本时出现20%–50%的性能落差；2）语篇级排序任务表现困难，标准准确率仅0%–13%；3）在专家级指导提示下，推理增强模型可提升至36%，但相对人类专家仍有显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM能够掌握局部的形式模式，但在稳健的语言审美推理所需的全局层次化规划上仍存在明显不足；Neo-Classic揭示了模型对历史语料模式的依赖，并指明语篇级层次约束是未来改进的关键方向。

title: Dense Feature Representation over Sequence Modeling: A Solution to the KDD Cup 2026 UniRec Challenge
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge Workshop
summary: We describe our 10th-place solution to the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, industrial click-to-conversion (CVR) prediction over 34.82M records, and we ask which mechanisms actually move held-out AUC. Starting from the official PCVRHyFormer baseline, a 15-step single-variable chain raises test AUC from 0.813237 to 0.827816, and our final submission reaches 0.828535. A leave-one-out ablation from the full model attributes the gain: removing the dense-feature representation stack costs 0.0095 AUC and removing the orthogonalized optimizer costs 0.0028, while no sequence-modeling component (merged single-stream backbone, polarity channel, auxiliary head, per-token FFN) costs more than 0.0005, within or adjacent to a $\pm$0.0004 seed band. We also report a generalization hazard: the row-group train/validation split shares one time window, so validation AUC overstates the leaderboard by about 0.014; anti-memorization and high-cardinality-ID changes even invert sign against it, a divergence that traces to dump-to-dump distribution shift and survives a time-ordered re-split. Dense representation and optimization, not finer sequence modeling, drive CVR AUC at this scale, and verdicts must come from the held-out leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 KDD Cup 2026 腾讯 UniRec 挑战赛（工业 CVR 预测，34.82M 记录）的第 10 名方案，通过 15 步单变量链将测试 AUC 从 0.813237 提升至 0.827816，最终提交达 0.828535，并指出稠密特征表征与优化器是主要增益来源。
AI.motivation: 探究在工业级 CVR 预测任务中，究竟是哪些机制真正提升了留出集 AUC，区分稠密表征、优化策略与序列建模各自的贡献。
AI.method: 以官方 PCVRHyFormer 为基线，采用 15 步单变量链式改进；通过留一法消融从完整模型出发逐一移除组件，并对行分组划分的泛化风险进行时间序重划分验证。
AI.result: 测试 AUC 从 0.813237 提升到 0.827816，最终提交 0.828535；移除稠密特征表征栈损失 0.0095 AUC，移除正交化优化器损失 0.0028，而所有序列建模组件（合并单流骨干、极性通道、辅助头、逐 token FFN）损失均不超过 0.0005（处于 ±0.0004 种子带内）。此外，行分组划分使验证 AUC 高估排行榜约 0.014。
AI.conclusion: 在该规模下，驱动 CVR AUC 的是稠密表征与优化，而非更精细的序列建模；结论必须依据留出的排行榜得出，行分组划分存在泛化风险。

title: BinoGen: Scaling egocentric binocular data for embodied visual perception and learning
summary: Embodied visual perception relies on temporally coherent visual experience accumulated through continuous engagement with the environment. However, collecting large-scale egocentric binocular observations together with dense annotations remains costly and difficult. Moreover, visual experience is shaped not only by the environment but also by the embodiment of the observer, including viewing height, field of view, binocular geometry, and motion through the scene. To address these challenges, we present BinoGen, an automated framework for generating large-scale, embodiment-aware egocentric binocular visual experiences in indoor environments. BinoGen jointly models environmental and observer variation through generative scene synthesis, probabilistic object instantiation, appearance randomization, stochastic trajectory generation, and configurable binocular camera setups. The framework produces synchronized binocular videos together with dense multimodal supervision, including depth maps, optical flow, surface normals, semantic maps, object coordinates, and camera poses. Using BinoGen, we construct a dataset comprising more than 20 million annotated images for supervised learning. We demonstrate two complementary utilities of BinoGen. First, incorporating BinoGen data consistently improves real-world visual perception, including depth estimation, object detection, and video object tracking. Second, paired human-inspired and mouse-inspired observations from the same environments enable controlled investigation of how observer embodiment affects perceptual learning. Embodiment-specific adaptation substantially improves performance, while joint training enables a single model to perform competitively across both embodiments. Together, these results demonstrate that large-scale, controllable visual experience can improve embodied perception...

AI.tldr: 本文提出BinoGen框架，自动生成大规模、体现感知者具身特性的室内第一视角双目视觉经验，构建超2000万标注图像数据集，证明其能提升真实世界视觉感知并支持具身对感知学习影响的受控研究。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉感知依赖随时间连贯的视觉经验，但大规模第一视角双目观测及密集标注的采集成本高、难度大；同时视觉经验不仅受环境影响，还受感知者具身因素（视高、视场、双目几何、运动）影响，现有数据难以系统建模这些变化。
AI.method: BinoGen通过生成式场景合成、概率化物体实例生成、外观随机化、随机轨迹生成及可配置双目相机设置，联合建模环境与感知者变化；产出同步双目视频及密集多模态监督（深度图、光流、表面法线、语义图、物体坐标、相机位姿）。
AI.result: 利用BinoGen构建含超2000万标注图像的监督学习数据集。实验显示：加入BinoGen数据可持续提升真实世界深度估计、目标检测和视频目标跟踪；同一环境下配对的人体启发与鼠类启发观测揭示了具身对感知学习的影响——具身特定适配显著提升性能，联合训练使单一模型在两种具身上均具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、可控的视觉经验能改善具身感知；BinoGen既可作数据增强来源，也可作研究具身与环境交互影响的可控实验平台。

title: Robust Workflow Generation via Adversarial Learning for Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of speech synthesis and voice conversion technologies has made audio deepfakes increasingly realistic, posing serious security risks in practical applications. While existing detection methods achieve strong performance under controlled conditions, they often fail to generalize under real-world perturbations and corruptions. In this paper, we propose ROGUE, a framework that dynamically constructs robust detection workflows by orchestrating multiple detection tools. ROGUE formulates workflow generation as a sequential decision-making problem and introduces a dual-agent paradigm, where a perturbation agent generates audio perturbations and a policy agent learns to select and execute detection tools under perturbed conditions. Through adversarial learning, ROGUE enables perturbation-aware tool selection, adaptive execution strategies, and improved robustness to distribution shifts. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and real-world corruptions demonstrate that ROGUE consistently outperforms strong baselines in both robustness and generalization. Our results highlight the effectiveness of adversarially optimized workflow generation for building reliable audio deepfake detection systems in real-world deployment settings.

AI.tldr: ROGUE：通过双智能体对抗学习动态编排检测工具，生成鲁棒的音频深度伪造检测工作流，在真实扰动与分布偏移下显著提升鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 语音合成与语音转换技术快速发展使音频深度伪造愈发逼真，带来严重安全风险。现有检测方法在受控条件下表现良好，但在真实世界的扰动和损坏下往往泛化能力不足，因此需要构建面向真实部署的鲁棒检测方案。
AI.method: 将鲁棒检测工作流的构建建模为序贯决策问题，提出双智能体范式：扰动智能体生成音频扰动，策略智能体在扰动条件下学习选择并执行检测工具；通过对抗学习实现扰动感知的工具选择与自适应执行策略，以应对分布偏移。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种真实损坏条件下开展大量实验，ROGUE 在鲁棒性与泛化性上均持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对抗优化的检测工作流生成方法能有效支撑真实部署场景下可靠的音频深度伪造检测系统建设。

title: Next-token functional estimation
summary: Suppose we observe the first $n$ points of a sequence of random variables having length $n+1$, and wish to estimate a functional of the unobserved final point and the empirical measure of the $n$ observed training points. Such next-token functionals include the probability that the next token is novel (also known as the surprise probability), the tail probability of the minimum distance between the next token and training points, and the test error of a classifier trained on the observed points. All of these quantities are classically estimated by the leave-one-out method, which is inconsistent under temporal dependence. We propose a leave-a-window-out estimator, which deletes a window of length $τ$ after each index before forming the empirical measure and reduces to leave-one-out at $τ= 1$. Under natural assumptions, we show that the error of our estimator decays at a parametric rate for any stationary $β$-mixing process that also admits a Marton coupling. Our results thus cover several natural functionals on a large class of stochastic processes. We complement these upper bounds with a sharp minimax lower bound for estimating the surprise probability on mixing Markov chains. Simulations on Markov chains, moving-average processes, and autoregressive processes show that our estimator succeeds in many scenarios where leave-one-out and add-constant baselines fail.

AI.tldr: 提出 leave-a-window-out 估计量，在平稳 β-mixing 且满足 Marton 耦合的过程上以参数速率估计 next-token 泛函，并给出 minimax 下界与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 经典的 leave-one-out 方法在时间相依（temporal dependence）下不一致，无法可靠估计 next-token 泛函（如 surprise probability、最近邻距离尾概率、分类器测试误差）。作者希望找到在相依序列下仍具一致性与参数收敛速率的估计方法。
AI.method: 提出 leave-a-window-out 估计量：在每个索引后删除长度为 τ 的窗口再构造经验测度，τ=1 时退化为 leave-one-out。在平稳 β-mixing 且存在 Marton 耦合的自然假设下进行理论分析，并对混合 Markov 链上的 surprise probability 建立 sharp minimax 下界。
AI.result: 在平稳 β-mixing 且满足 Marton 耦合的过程上，估计误差以参数速率衰减，覆盖多类自然泛函；对混合 Markov 链上的 surprise probability 给出 sharp minimax 下界。在 Markov 链、移动平均和自回归过程的仿真中，该方法在 leave-one-out 与 add-constant 基线失效的许多场景下仍然成功。
AI.conclusion: leave-a-window-out 是处理时间相依序列上 next-token 泛函估计的有效且理论上最优（在 surprise probability 情形）的方法，优于传统 leave-one-out 和 add-constant 基线。

title: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection with promptable segmentation
summary: Three-dimensional object detection for autonomous driving is dominated by detectors trained on large corpora of human-annotated 3D boxes. Such a detector learns a fixed category list, and everything outside it is invisible. This paper asks whether the task can be solved training-free and open-vocabulary. A promptable segmentation model (SAM3), queried with class names as text prompts, supplies instance masks in the vehicle's six surround-view cameras, and the masks are turned into metric 3D boxes using the geometry of the scene. The core is a controlled three-stage comparison on nuScenes in which 2D detection is held fixed and only the source of 3D geometry changes. Geometry predicted from images alone reaches 0.183 mean average precision (mAP) under the official protocol; fitting boxes from raw LiDAR points inside the same masks with training-free rules reaches 0.298 mAP / 0.348 nuScenes detection score (NDS) at zero labeling cost; borrowing supervised box geometry at inference time lifts the same detections to 0.413 mAP / 0.555 NDS, which locates the pipeline's largest deficit in measurement precision rather than 2D detection, while class confusion and confidence calibration survive that substitution. Reversing the direction, a three-state camera-witness rule built from the same masks improves a supervised LiDAR-only detector from 0.596 to 0.630 mAP, roughly half the gain of fully supervised camera fusion, with no training. A coverage analysis shows that SAM3 finds 84% of in-range objects with a correctly named mask; the classes that fail in the official metric are misnamed or geometrically unforgiving, not unseen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练、开放词汇的3D目标检测流程：用SAM3在六路环视相机上以类别名作文本提示生成实例掩码，再借助场景几何将掩码转为度量3D框，并在nuScenes上通过三阶段受控对比定位性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶3D检测器依赖大规模人工标注3D框，只能学习固定类别列表，类别表之外的目标不可见；作者希望验证该任务能否以免训练、开放词汇的方式完成。
AI.method: 以SAM3作为可提示分割模型，用类别名称作为文本提示，在车辆六路环视相机中输出实例掩码；随后依据场景几何把掩码转换为度量3D框。在nuScenes上设计三阶段受控实验，固定2D检测结果，仅改变3D几何来源：纯图像几何预测、用免训练规则在同一掩码内拟合原始LiDAR点、以及在推理时借用监督式框几何。反向方向则用同一掩码构建三状态相机见证规则，用于增强仅LiDAR的监督检测器。
AI.result: 纯图像几何在官方协议下达到0.183 mAP；同一掩码内用免训练规则拟合原始LiDAR点，以零标注成本达到0.298 mAP / 0.348 NDS；推理时借用监督式框几何将相同检测提升至0.413 mAP / 0.555 NDS，表明最大短板在测量精度而非2D检测，且类别混淆与置信度校准在该替换下仍然成立。反向实验中，基于同一掩码的三状态相机见证规则将仅LiDAR监督检测器从0.596 mAP提升至0.630 mAP，约为全监督相机融合增益的一半，且无需训练。覆盖率分析显示SAM3可找到84%的范围内目标并给出正确命名的掩码；在官方指标中失败的类别属于命名错误或几何上难以处理，而非未见类别。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明3D检测可在免训练、开放词汇设定下取得有竞争力的结果，主要瓶颈是3D测量精度而非2D感知；SAM3的掩码覆盖率高，失败更多源于命名与几何难度。基于掩码的相机见证规则还能在无训练条件下显著增强现有LiDAR检测器。

title: REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception
summary: Robotic systems operating in dynamic environments require visual perception that evolves continuously with the incoming sensory stream. Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, but most learning-based methods accumulate events into frames or temporal bins, introducing an integration delay that can limit fast reaction. Here we propose REACT, a fully spiking state-space model for event-driven temporal perception that processes raw events one by one, without temporal accumulation.
