REACT uses a complex-valued spiking neuron, C-SiLIF, whose continuous-time dynamics are driven by the physical inter-event interval, allowing its internal state to evolve at the temporal resolution of individual events. We evaluate REACT on gesture recognition and time-to-collision (TTC) estimation from full-field event streams, without a target bounding box or localization input. On EvTTC, REACT achieves a 9.59% relative TTC error with 4.6 ms end-to-end inference latency, within 0.15 percentage points of the best learned method while requiring no target prior. At the dataset's mean approach speed, this latency corresponds to only 4 cm of vehicle motion, compared with 1 m for the fastest competing learned method. REACT further supports anytime TTC prediction, zero-shot transfer to a different driving sequence, and INT8 quantization, reducing the estimated energy consumption from 18.5 to 2.8 mJ per 32,768 events. These results show that event-driven spiking state-space dynamics can provide low-latency, continuously updated temporal perception for reactive robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 提出REACT——全脉冲状态空间模型，逐事件处理原始事件流，无需时间累积，实现低延迟连续时间感知。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的机器人视觉感知需随感知流持续演化。事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率与异步感知能力，但多数学习方法将事件累积为帧或时间bin，引入积分延迟，限制快速反应能力。
AI.method: REACT为全脉冲状态空间模型，对原始事件逐一处理，不做时间累积。核心是复数脉冲神经元C-SiLIF，其连续时间动力学由物理事件间隔（inter-event interval）驱动，内部状态以单个事件的时间分辨率演化。在无目标边界框与定位输入条件下，于手势识别与全视场事件流TTC估计任务上评估。
AI.result: 在EvTTC上，REACT相对TTC误差9.59%，端到端推理延迟4.6 ms，与最佳学习方法相差0.15个百分点，且无需目标先验。按数据集平均接近速度，该延迟对应车辆仅移动4 cm，而最快竞争学习方法为1 m。此外支持anytime TTC预测、跨驾驶序列零样本迁移与INT8量化，每32,768事件能耗估计从18.5 mJ降至2.8 mJ。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的脉冲状态空间动力学可为反应式机器人系统提供低延迟、持续更新的时间感知。

title: Position: It is Time to Virtualize Foundation Models with a Self-evolving Operating System Layer
summary: AI applications have shifted from single, monolithic foundation models (FM) to compound agentic systems. Yet today's stacks remain fragmented: even as protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) ease tool/agent connectivity, each framework embeds an implicit runtime for state, memory, budgets, and guardrails, making behavior non-portable and governance brittle. It mirrors computing before operating systems, when every program re-implemented basic services. This position paper argues that the field now needs a Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) -- a system layer that virtualizes FM interactions analogous to how virtual machines abstract physical hardware, giving applications the illusion of dedicated, trustworthy FM instances with effectively unbounded capabilities. Internally, the FMOS orchestrates knowledge across memory tiers, model selection and resource allocation, and verification and policy enforcement. Like the human brain switching between fast intuition and slow deliberation, the FMOS learns when to intervene and when to let inference proceed directly and continuously adapting its policies based on operational experience.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张 AI 领域需要构建"基础模型操作系统"（FMOS），以虚拟化基础模型交互，为应用提供专用、可信且能力近乎无限的模型实例，从而解决当前智能体系统的碎片化问题。
AI.motivation: AI 应用已从单一单体基础模型转向复合式智能体系统，但技术栈仍然碎片化。尽管 MCP、A2A 等协议缓解了工具/智能体连接问题，各框架仍各自内嵌隐式运行时来处理状态、内存、预算与护栏，导致行为不可移植、治理脆弱。这一现状类比于操作系统出现之前的计算机时代——每个程序都重复实现基础服务。因此，领域需要一个统一的系统层来抽象与调度基础模型交互。
AI.method: 作为立场论文，本文提出应建立 FMOS 作为系统层，虚拟化基础模型交互（类似虚拟机抽象物理硬件），使应用获得专用、可信、能力近乎无限的 FM 实例的错觉。其内部机制包括：跨内存层级的知识编排、模型选择与资源分配、验证与策略执行。此外，类比人脑在快速直觉与缓慢深思间的切换，FMOS 能够学习何时介入、何时让推理直接进行，并基于运行经验持续调整其策略。
AI.result: 本文为立场性论述，未提供实验数据或量化结果；其"结果"为提出的 FMOS 概念框架与论证，包括虚拟化抽象、内部编排机制（内存、模型选择、资源分配、验证与策略）以及自适应干预策略等设计主张。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为 AI 领域当前正处在类似"操作系统出现前"的关键节点，亟需 FMOS 这一系统层：它通过虚拟化基础模型交互、统一编排内存/模型/资源/验证等基础服务，解决框架碎片化和治理脆弱问题；同时具备类人双系统式的自适应干预能力，可根据运行经验持续演进策略。这为未来 AI 基础设施的研究与工程方向提出了统一的架构愿景。

title: Randomized SVD Approximations for Spectral Co-Clustering of Word-Document Matrices
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA)
summary: Spectral co-clustering is a useful tool for discovering latent structure in word-document matrices, but its reliance on singular value decomposition (SVD) can make standard formulations expensive on high-dimensional data. This paper presents two randomized approximations for normalized spectral co-clustering of bipartite text data when the numbers of document and word clusters may differ. The first method uses randomized SVD through random projection, while the second combines partial SVD with element-wise random sampling. Across real-world and synthetic datasets, both methods reduce runtime relative to the full-SVD baseline, but their behavior depends on matrix sparsity. The random projection method is the more reliable approximation across the tested settings, whereas the sampling-based method is most useful on denser matrices and provides limited benefit on already sparse text data. These results show that randomized approximations for spectral co-clustering should be selected according to the underlying structure of the data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种用于二部文本数据归一化谱协同聚类的随机近似方法：基于随机投影的随机SVD，以及偏SVD结合逐元素随机采样的方法，并在真实与合成数据集上比较其运行时间与近似效果。
AI.motivation: 标准谱协同聚类依赖奇异值分解（SVD），在高维词-文档矩阵上计算开销大；且当文档簇数与词簇数不一致时，需要适用于该情形的归一化协同聚类及其高效近似。
AI.method: 针对文档簇数与词簇数可不同的二部文本数据归一化谱协同聚类，提出两种随机近似：（1）通过随机投影实现随机SVD；（2）将偏SVD与逐元素随机采样结合。在真实与合成数据集上与全SVD基线对比运行时间和近似表现，并分析其对矩阵稀疏性的依赖。
AI.result: 两种方法相对全SVD基线均降低运行时间，但表现依赖矩阵稀疏性。随机投影方法在测试设置中更可靠；基于采样的方法在较稠密矩阵上最有用，而在已稀疏的文本数据上收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 谱协同聚类的随机近似方法应根据数据底层结构进行选择：随机投影更适合一般/稀疏文本场景，采样方法更适合较稠密矩阵。

title: Towards Proactive Detection of User-Side Implicit Conflicts in Human-LLM Dialogue
summary: In Human-LLM dialogue, follow-up user utterances may implicitly conflict with earlier intents, leading the LLM to misinterpret user needs and generate inappropriate responses. A reliable dialogue system should proactively detect user-side conflicts before generating a response and seek clarification when necessary. However, prior work has largely focused on LLM-side conflicts, leaving user-side conflicts underexplored. To fill this gap, we construct UC-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating user-side conflict detection. Preliminary experiments show that existing LLMs struggle with this task, especially when conflicts arise from implicit incompatibilities grounded in dialogue history. To improve lightweight LLMs with limited training data, we investigate data synthesis for user-side conflict detection. Existing synthesis methods do not explicitly model the implicit incompatibilities between historical and current user utterances, making it difficult to capture the evolution of conflicts and to generate reliably labeled implicit conflict samples. We propose SynUC, a constraint-guided synthesis method that represents user-side conflicts in a constraint space and uses the SPEAKING framework to guide traceable constraint transformations. Applying SynUC to WildChat, we construct UC-Data, a user-side conflict training set containing 2,487 samples. On UC-Bench, Qwen3.5-4B trained on UC-Data outperforms larger general-purpose LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.8, as well as the same backbone trained on data synthesized by existing methods.

AI.tldr: 论文研究人机对话中"用户侧冲突"（后续话语与先前意图隐含冲突）的检测与数据合成问题，构建了人工标注基准UC-Bench，并提出约束引导的数据合成方法SynUC，生成训练集UC-Data，使轻量模型超越更大通用模型。
AI.motivation: 在人机对话中，后续用户话语可能与此前意图隐含冲突，导致LLM误解需求并产生不当回复。可靠系统应主动检测用户侧冲突并在必要时澄清。然而已有工作多关注"LLM侧冲突"，用户侧冲突研究不足；且现有合成方法未显式建模历史与当前话语间的隐含不兼容，难以捕捉冲突演化、难以生成可靠标注的隐式冲突样本。
AI.method: 1) 构建人工标注基准UC-Bench，评估用户侧冲突检测；2) 提出SynUC——约束引导的合成方法：将用户侧冲突表示在约束空间中，并用SPEAKING框架引导可追溯的约束变换；3) 将SynUC应用于WildChat，构建包含2,487条样本的用户侧冲突训练集UC-Data。
AI.result: 初步实验显示现有LLM在该任务上表现不佳，尤其当冲突源于对话历史中隐含的不兼容时。在UC-Bench上，使用UC-Data训练的Qwen3.5-4B超过了更大的通用LLM（如Claude Opus 4.8），也优于用现有方法合成数据训练的相同骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 用户侧冲突检测是一个被忽视但重要的任务，可通过约束引导的数据合成有效提升轻量模型的检测能力，实现小模型超越大模型的效果。

title: Reproducing Transparent and Scrutable Recommendations: Exploring Open-Weight Models via Natural-Language User Profiles
comment: Accepted at BlackBoxNLP@EMNLP'26 (The 9th BlackboxNLP Workshop Special Track: Reproducibility and Reliability in Interpretability Analyses)
summary: In this reproducibility study, we investigate the transparency and scrutability of recommender systems enhanced by incorporating generated natural-language user profiles that represent user preferences. The original paper explores the synthesis of user profiles from raw user-generated review text across domains such as movies and accommodations (Amazon Movies & TV, TripAdvisor). Crucially, these natural-language user profiles enable direct user interaction and intervention, allowing users to customize recommendations by correcting misattributed preferences or addressing cold-start settings. We successfully reproduce the core findings of the original study. Additionally, we extend the evaluation by conducting systematic context ablation experiments, multi-seed stability across five distinct random seeds to establish statistical reliability, and a mechanistic interpretability analysis using the nnsight framework to probe internal model representations under counterfactual profile perturbations. Our findings verify the original paper's claim that User Profile Recommendation (UPR) achieves competitive performance under its test-set reranking protocol and makes recommendations more transparent. Perturbing the natural-language profiles does change predictions, but it shifts predicted ratings uniformly across genres with no detectable genre-selective effect, leaving rankings unchanged even under direct activation steering. We trace this back to the rating-regression objective rather than the profile interface, with ranking-objective models clearly exceeding in this task.

AI.tldr: 该复现研究验证了自然语言用户画像推荐（UPR）的透明性与性能，并通过消融、多种子稳定性及nnsight机制可解释性分析发现：扰动画像虽改变评分预测但无体裁选择性，根源在于评分回归目标而非画像接口。
AI.motivation: 原论文提出用生成的自然语言用户画像表示偏好，以提升推荐系统的透明性与可审查性（用户可直接干预、纠正错误偏好、缓解冷启动），但其可审查性的机制基础尚不明确，需独立复现与深入检验。
AI.method: 复现原研究核心结论；补充三类实验：(1) 系统性上下文消融；(2) 五个不同随机种子的多种子稳定性检验；(3) 基于 nnsight 框架的机制可解释性分析，通过反事实画像扰动探测模型内部表示。
AI.result: 成功复现核心发现：UPR 在其测试集重排序协议下性能具竞争力且推荐更透明。画像扰动确实改变预测，但预测评分在各体裁上呈均匀偏移，未检测到体裁选择性效应；即便直接进行激活引导，排序仍不变。
AI.conclusion: 画像扰动的非选择性源于评分回归目标而非画像接口本身；排序目标模型在该任务上明显更优，提示未来 UPR 设计应采用排序导向目标以真正实现可审查的个性化推荐。

title: SAGG: Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating for Robust Multimodal Learning under Heterogeneous Corruption
summary: Multimodal gradient balancing methods modulate encoder gradients with a shared scalar per modality, implicitly assuming that corruption is uniform across the training batch. In practice, corruption is sample-heterogeneous: within a single mini-batch, different samples may have different modalities corrupted. We prove that under this heterogeneous corruption model, any batch-level sample-agnostic linear estimator with a shared modulation parameter incurs an irreducible bias with respect to the clean-data gradient, and that sample-level all-or-nothing gating is the unique unbiased strategy within a natural distribution-free estimator class. Motivated by this result, we propose Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating (SAGG), which makes a binary retain-or-discard decision per sample via an online feature-norm quality test and incorporates a truncation mechanism for variance control. We prove that SAGG-based SGD converges at the standard O(1/sqrt(T)) rate to stationary points of the clean loss without a corruption-dependent error floor, and derive a certified robustness radius for the independent-encoder architecture that connects per-modality Lipschitz constants to the classification margin. Experiments on Kinetics-Sounds and UCF-101 under Gaussian noise injection, partial modality missing, and natural contribution imbalance show that SAGG consistently outperforms ten existing methods, with the largest gains in high-corruption regimes where batch-level bias is most severe.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了多模态训练中样本异构损坏下的梯度平衡问题，理论证明批级样本无关线性估计器存在不可约偏差，提出样本自适应梯度门控方法SAGG，并验证其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态梯度平衡方法使用每模态共享标量调制编码器梯度，隐含假设整个训练批次内损坏是均匀的；但实际中损坏是样本异构的，同一小批次内不同样本可能损坏不同模态，导致现有方法失效。
AI.method: 作者首先理论证明：在异构损坏模型下，任何具有共享调制参数的批级样本无关线性估计器相对干净数据梯度都存在不可约偏差，且在自然无分布估计器类中样本级全有或全无门控是唯一无偏策略。基于此提出Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating (SAGG)，对每个样本通过在线特征范数质量测试做二元保留或丢弃决策，并引入截断机制控制方差。
AI.result: 理论证明SAGG-based SGD以标准O(1/sqrt(T))速率收敛到干净损失的稳定点，无依赖损坏的误差下限，并推导出独立编码器架构的认证鲁棒半径，将每模态Lipschitz常数与分类间隔联系起来。在Kinetics-Sounds和UCF-101上针对高斯噪声注入、部分模态缺失和自然贡献不平衡的实验表明，SAGG持续优于十种现有方法，在高损坏场景增益最大。
AI.conclusion: SAGG通过样本级门控解决了批级梯度平衡在样本异构损坏下的偏差问题，具有收敛保证和认证鲁棒性，并在多模态实验中表现优越，尤其适用于高损坏情形。

title: CircleMatch: Prototype Matching with Circular Temporal Statistics for Tiny Keyword Spotting
summary: Keyword spotting (KWS), the task of identifying predefined words in speech, is a core capability of voice-enabled devices. Achieving high KWS accuracy under tight parameter budgets across different vocabulary sizes remains challenging. We present CircleMatch, a matching framework enabling KWS with very few parameters. Its encoder independently compresses frequency bands and fuses them into frame features. These features are then matched against learned class-specific prototypes to produce temporal response curves. Parameter-free circular aggregation encodes time as angles and summarizes response distributions and relative timing for classification. We develop four tiny variants, Circle-D4, Circle-D8, Circle-D16, and Circle-D32, ranging from approximately 1k to 7k parameters in the 12-class setting. Experiments with multiple random seeds on Speech Commands v1/v2 and the English and Spanish Micro subsets of the Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus demonstrate competitive accuracy with tiny models. Our qualitative analysis further suggests approximate shift equivariance of prototype responses and adaptation to temporal compression. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/ora942878/CircleMatch.

AI.tldr: 提出CircleMatch，一种极少参数的KWS匹配框架，在多个数据集上用约1k–7k参数取得有竞争力的准确率。
AI.motivation: 在严格参数量预算下，跨不同词汇量实现高KWS准确率仍具挑战。
AI.method: 编码器分别压缩频带并融合为帧特征，与学习到的类别原型匹配生成时间响应曲线；无参数循环聚合将时间编码为角度，汇总响应分布与相对时序进行分类；开发Circle-D4/D8/D16/D32四个微小变体。
AI.result: 在12类设置下参数约1k–7k；在Speech Commands v1/v2及多语言口语语料库英语、西班牙语Micro子集上，多随机种子实验显示与微小模型相比具有竞争力；定性分析表明原型响应近似平移等变并适应时间压缩。
AI.conclusion: CircleMatch以极少参数实现有竞争力的KWS性能，且具平移等变与时间压缩适应性；代码与权重已开源。

title: Error bounds in Sobolev norms for approximations with norm constrained ReLU neural networks
summary: Recent studies have shown that smooth functions can be well approximated by ReLU neural networks with path norm constraint on the weights. We extend these results from uniform approximation to approximation in Sobolev norm. Specifically, we analyze how well Sobolev functions in $W^{n,p}$ can be approximated by neural networks with width $W$, depth $L$ and path norm bounded by $K$, when the approximation error is measured in the $W^{1,p}$-norm. For shallow networks with depth $L=1$, we derive the approximation error bound $\mathcal{O}(\max\{W^{-(n-1)/d}, K^{-(n-1)/(s-n)}\})$, when the smoothness index satisfies $n<s=(d+3)/2$ and the input is $d$-dimensional. For deep networks, we remove the restriction on the smoothness by showing that the approximation bound $\mathcal{O}(K^{-(n-1)/(d+d/p+1)})$ holds if the width $W$ and depth $L$ are sufficiently large.

AI.tldr: 该论文将ReLU网络在路径范数约束下的光滑函数逼近结果，从一致逼近推广到Sobolev范数逼近，分别给出浅层与深层网络的逼近误差界。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明带路径范数约束的ReLU网络能很好逼近光滑函数，但这些结果主要针对一致逼近；本文希望将结论推广到Sobolev范数（特别是W^{1,p}范数）下的逼近。
AI.method: 分析宽度W、深度L、路径范数上界为K的ReLU神经网络对W^{n,p}中Sobolev函数的逼近能力，误差在W^{1,p}范数下度量；分别讨论浅层网络（L=1）与深层网络两种情形，并推导相应的逼近误差上界。
AI.result: 浅层网络（L=1）：当光滑指数满足n<s=(d+3)/2、输入为d维时，逼近误差界为O(max{W^{-(n-1)/d}, K^{-(n-1)/(s-n)}})。深层网络：若宽度W和深度L足够大，可去掉对光滑性的限制，逼近界为O(K^{-(n-1)/(d+d/p+1)})。
AI.conclusion: 带路径范数约束的ReLU网络可在Sobolev范数下有效逼近Sobolev函数；深层网络相比浅层网络能放宽对光滑指数的限制，仅需足够的宽度和深度即可获得相应逼近率。

title: LinePilot Digitizer: Line-Plot Recovery with Manual and Automatic Calibration
summary: Recovering numerical series from line plots requires accurate axis calibration and reliable curve extraction. We present LinePilot Digitizer (LinePilot), which combines continuous color-based curve recovery with three calibration modes: LinePilot (standard), LinePilot (enhanced), and LinePilot (OCR). We also introduce DigitizerBench, the first dedicated benchmark for systematically evaluating digitizer performance, using an orthogonal design spanning signal, rendering, and plot-structure factors with complementary automatic and human-guided evaluations. We evaluate performance using failure-penalized capped normalized root-mean-square error (FPC-NRMSE), which assigns unit loss to missing, unusable, or catastrophically inaccurate outputs. On DigitizerBench-Full, LinePilot (OCR) achieves the lowest mean FPC-NRMSE (0.672) and highest trusted usability (38.2%) among the tested automatic pipelines. On DigitizerBench-Lite, LinePilot (enhanced) achieves the lowest mean FPC-NRMSE (0.081), 100% output success, and highest trusted usability (93.3%). The orthogonal benchmark design further enables factor analysis to identify the factors that most significantly affect digitizer performance. Together, the three calibration modes provide a practical trade-off between automation, user control, and accuracy within a shared curve-recovery workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出LinePilot图像数字化工具与DigitizerBench基准，通过三种标定模式实现轴线校准与曲线提取，并以FPC-NRMSE评估性能。
AI.motivation: 从线图中恢复数值序列需要精确的坐标轴标定与可靠的曲线提取，但缺乏系统评估数字化工具性能的基准。
AI.method: LinePilot结合基于颜色的连续曲线恢复与三种标定模式（标准、增强、OCR）；构建DigitizerBench，采用正交设计覆盖信号、渲染、图表结构因素，结合自动与人工引导评估；使用FPC-NRMSE指标（对缺失、不可用或严重失准输出赋予单位损失）。
AI.result: 在DigitizerBench-Full上，LinePilot(OCR)取得最低平均FPC-NRMSE(0.672)与最高可信可用率(38.2%)；在DigitizerBench-Lite上，LinePilot(enhanced)取得最低平均FPC-NRMSE(0.081)、100%输出成功率与最高可信可用率(93.3%)。正交设计支持因子分析以识别影响性能的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 三种标定模式在共享曲线恢复流程中提供了自动化、用户控制与精度之间的实用权衡。

title: 4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: Research on 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms has flourished in recent years, extending from signal processing and object detection to semantic segmentation, motion estimation, occupancy prediction, and dynamic scene reconstruction. This review organizes the field according to the evolution of perception tasks and algorithms. It first introduces radar fundamentals, data representations, and quality-enhancement methods, and then reviews object-level perception, motion and localization, local and dense spatial perception, and dynamic scene understanding. Across these directions, we compare radar-only learning, multimodal fusion, and cross-modal supervision and knowledge distillation. Particular attention is paid to how elevation, Doppler measurements, and radar physical priors are exploited across tasks. We further summarize the task coverage, input data, annotations, and evaluation protocols of existing datasets, clarifying the empirical support for different research directions. Finally, we discuss the common challenges and future directions of 4D radar perception for autonomous driving. This review provides a task-oriented perspective on the transition from sparse object perception to dynamic spatial understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于4D毫米波雷达感知算法的综述，按感知任务与算法演进组织文献，涵盖从基础信号处理、目标检测到语义分割、占据预测与动态场景重建，并比较纯雷达学习、多模态融合与跨模态监督/知识蒸馏，强调高度、多普勒与雷达物理先验的利用，最后总结数据集与评测协议及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达感知研究近年快速扩展，任务从信号处理、目标检测延伸至语义分割、运动估计、占据预测与动态场景重建，研究脉络分散、缺乏统一梳理。本文旨在以任务演进为线索系统组织该领域，明确不同研究方向的经验支撑与共性挑战。
AI.method: 采用任务导向的综述方法：首先介绍雷达基本原理、数据表示与质量增强方法；随后按目标级感知、运动与定位、局部与稠密空间感知、动态场景理解等方向梳理算法；并在各方向中比较纯雷达学习、多模态融合及跨模态监督与知识蒸馏三类范式，重点分析高度信息、多普勒测量与雷达物理先验在各任务中的利用方式；同时归纳现有数据集的覆盖任务、输入数据、标注与评测协议。
AI.result: 形成了一套按感知任务与算法演进组织的分类体系，系统对比了纯雷达学习、多模态融合与跨模态监督/知识蒸馏的技术路线，总结了高度、多普勒与物理先验的跨任务利用方式，并梳理了现有数据集在任务覆盖、输入、标注与评测协议上的支撑情况，指出各研究方向的经验基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文以任务导向视角刻画了4D雷达感知从稀疏目标感知向动态空间理解的转变，讨论了自动驾驶中4D雷达感知的共性挑战与未来方向，为后续研究提供了统一框架与参考。

title: What Do Current Systematic Generalization Tasks Miss? A Reasoning-Centered Analysis
summary: Systematic generalization, the ability to solve novel problems by recombining known atomic elements, is central to human intelligence but difficult to study rigorously under controlled settings. Existing studies therefore rely on simplifications such as approximately linear action composition, productivity-based tests, and action-explicit goals, which make systematic generalization easier to study but omit some essential aspects of this capability. To characterize what these simplifications miss, we adopt a reasoning-centered lens and introduce TranSGrid, a testbed that brings deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning together within a unified task. Experiments with seven Transformers on 4,800 TranSGrid instances show that all models perform much worse on TranSGrid than on a held-out test set: the largest model solves 79.6% of the test set, but only 55.3% of TranSGrid and 15.8% of the hardest subset. The gap remains within the training length range, showing that productivity alone is not sufficient to evaluate systematic generalization. Additionally, we reintroduce the other two simplifications into TranSGrid: one variant makes actions compose almost linearly (reducing the inductive demand), the other makes goals action-explicit (reducing the abductive one). In both, solve rates return to roughly the test set level, showing that either simplification alone is enough to reduce TranSGrid to an ordinary held-out test set. Together, our results show that existing tasks reduce either or both of the inductive and abductive demands, and that comprehensively measuring systematic generalization requires a task that involves all three forms of reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TranSGrid，一个统一演绎、归纳与溯因推理的系统泛化测试平台；实验表明现有基准的简化（近似线性动作组合、基于生产力的测试、动作显式目标）会显著削弱对系统泛化的测量。
AI.motivation: 系统泛化（通过重组已知原子元素解决新问题）是人类智能的核心，但在受控条件下难以严格研究。现有研究依赖若干简化：近似线性的动作组合、基于生产力的测试、以及动作显式的目标。这些简化虽便于研究，却遗漏了系统泛化的某些本质方面。作者希望刻画这些简化究竟遗漏了什么。
AI.method: 作者采用以推理为中心的视角，提出 TranSGrid 测试平台，将演绎推理、归纳推理与溯因推理融合到同一任务中。随后在 4,800 个 TranSGrid 实例上评测七个 Transformer 模型，并设置两个变体：一个使动作组合近似线性（降低归纳需求），另一个使目标动作显式（降低溯因需求），以验证简化的影响。
AI.result: 所有模型在 TranSGrid 上的表现都远差于留出测试集：最大模型在测试集上解决 79.6%，但在 TranSGrid 上仅 55.3%，在最难子集上仅 15.8%。该差距在训练长度范围内依然存在，说明单靠生产力不足以评估系统泛化。当重新引入两种简化后，解题率均回升至接近测试集水平，表明任一简化都足以把 TranSGrid 退化为普通留出测试集。
AI.conclusion: 现有任务降低或同时降低了归纳与溯因需求；要全面测量系统泛化，需要一个同时涉及演绎、归纳与溯因三种推理形式的任务。TranSGrid 表明生产力式评估不充分，而动作组合与目标设定的简化会掩盖系统泛化的真实难度。

title: Radio-Frequency Convolutional Neural Networks
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary Information: 50 pages, 31 figures, 1 table
summary: Running artificial intelligence (AI) models directly on edge devices such as smartphones, wearables, and drones offers low latency, pervasive scalability, and data privacy, but these devices rarely carry the computing capability that modern neural networks demand. Edge accelerators have been developed in response, yet each adds computing hardware to devices already constrained in size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP-C). An alternative lies in what these devices already carry: the frequency mixer in every wireless radio multiplies signals in time, natively performing convolution in the frequency domain. Here we introduce radio-frequency convolutional neural networks (RF-CNNs), which repurpose existing communication hardware for CNN inference. Multi-channel convolutions are mapped onto frequency tones for a passive mixer to execute in a single pass. We experimentally demonstrate that RF-CNN runs deep CNNs up to 26.4 million parameters and nine layers from classification of wireless signals and images to controllable image generation, close to full-precision performance. Because the weights arrive over the air and the analog hardware is shared with communication, the edge device spends energy only on data preparation and readout-down to 0.72 femtojoules per multiply-accumulate, two orders of magnitude less than it would cost on an added digital processor. These results suggest that deployed wireless infrastructure can bring efficient, state-of-the-art AI inference to the billions of devices it already connects.

AI.tldr: 提出RF-CNN，将多通道卷积映射到频域信号，利用无线射频中已有的频率混频器在单次通过中完成CNN推理，使边缘设备无需额外数字加速器即可高效运行大型神经网络。
AI.motivation: 在智能手机、可穿戴设备和无人机等边缘设备上直接运行AI模型具有低延迟、可扩展和隐私保护优势，但此类设备算力有限。现有边缘加速器会增加本已受尺寸、重量、功耗和成本（SWaP-C）约束的硬件负担。作者希望复用设备已有的无线射频硬件（混频器）来执行CNN推理，从而避免额外算力硬件的开销。
AI.method: 提出射频卷积神经网络（RF-CNN）：利用每个无线射频中已有的频率混频器——其在时间上对信号相乘，本质等价于频域卷积。将多通道卷积映射到不同频率音调上，由无源混频器一次通过（single pass）完成卷积运算；权重通过空中传输获得，模拟硬件与通信共享。
AI.result: 实验表明RF-CNN可运行多达2640万参数、9层的深度CNN，任务涵盖无线信号分类、图像分类和可控图像生成，性能接近全精度水平。能耗低至每次乘累加0.72飞焦，比使用额外数字处理器低两个数量级；边缘设备仅需在数据准备和读出上耗能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，现有无线基础设施可为已连接的数十亿设备带来高效、先进的AI推理能力，为边缘AI提供了一种复用通信硬件、低功耗的新范式。

title: Reflective Recovery: A Self-Supervised Method for Reasoning by Learning from Mistakes
summary: Data-driven fine-tuning is widely adopted to enhance reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its simplicity and efficiency. However, mainstream imitation learning methods that rely exclusively on perfect reasoning trajectories suffer from a Scaling Collapse: when the problem set is limited, increasing positive examples fails to yield continuous improvement. However, during inference, an LLM can not guarantee that every intermediate step is correct and is therefore prone to errors. Once such errors arise, the LLM often struggles to recover and may be further misled by the accumulation of previous mistakes. To address this, we propose Reflective Recovery, a simple yet effective self-supervised approach that transforms failed reasoning attempts into recovery training data. Specifically, we extract initial segments of failed trajectories, concatenate them with prompts, and use them to guide the LLM toward valid solutions. Because these segments from failed trajectories are likely to contain errors, this process teaches models to recognize and correct mistakes during reasoning, enabling recovery from erroneous states without relying on external critics or reward models. Evaluated on extensive benchmarks, Reflective Recovery significantly improves performance. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it boosts accuracy from 30.0% to 37.5% on AIME 2025 and from 37.6% to 47.8% on Minerva. More importantly, analyses demonstrate that it breaks the scaling collapse barrier and enables models to develop emergent self-correction behaviors, representing a paradigm shift from outcome-oriented memorization to process-oriented reflective reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Reflective Recovery自监督方法，将失败推理轨迹转化为恢复训练数据，突破模仿学习的Scaling Collapse，提升LLM推理与自我纠错能力。
AI.motivation: 主流模仿学习仅依赖完美推理轨迹，在问题集有限时出现Scaling Collapse：增加正例无法持续提升。同时推理中LLM难保证每步正确，一旦出错难以恢复，还可能被先前错误累积进一步误导。
AI.method: 提出Reflective Recovery自监督方法：将失败推理尝试转化为恢复训练数据。具体提取失败轨迹的初始片段，与提示拼接，用以引导LLM走向有效解。由于这些片段可能含错，训练过程使模型学会识别并纠正推理中的错误，从而在错误状态中实现恢复，无需外部批评器或奖励模型。
AI.result: 在大量基准上显著提升性能。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上AIME 2025准确率由30.0%升至37.5%，Minerva由37.6%升至47.8%。分析表明其打破Scaling Collapse障碍，并使模型涌现自我纠错行为。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了从结果导向记忆到过程导向反思推理的范式转变，为LLM推理能力的数据驱动微调提供了有效路径。

title: The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures. Benchmark and evaluation resources: https://github.com/LordTARN1SHED/SERBench
summary: A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what a retriever ranks highest. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: a ranker can fill its budget with variants of one required fact and leave the decision unsupported. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination that supplies the support its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen and crediting only sets that cover every fact the current decision was annotated to require. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone reaches 66.6%, placing the gain in the set-level policy, not the computation. From frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool, the lead is 5.0 points. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from an otherwise complete set costs 12.3 and 11.1 points of repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"状态条件下的最小充分证据恢复"任务，并给出MSS-Complement方法：将证据获取建模为集合构建而非排序，通过三次语义调用构造、补全并输出4-8个完整源码单元的充分集。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在解题中途已读过检索器高分内容，但检索按段落打分、充分性属于集合属性：排序器可能用同一必需事实的多个变体填满预算，而决策仍缺乏支撑。因此需要以"决策尚缺什么"为目标恢复紧凑的证据组合。
AI.method: 形式化"状态条件下的最小充分证据恢复"；构建SERBench（45个仓库、500个留存状态，记录智能体已见内容，仅当覆盖决策所需全部标注事实才计分）；MSS-Complement把获取视为集合构建，用三次语义调用分别提出联合充分集、搜索缺失项、返回4-8个完整源单元（≤6,144 token），配置在标定数据上固定。设置相似度单独排序的对照。
AI.result: 五条证据时73.0%、八条时80.6%的状态可恢复完整集，对比Qwen3嵌入加重排的61.4%与72.4%；相似度排序对照为66.6%，增益来自集合级策略而非计算量；在冻结仓库源码、无金标池时领先5.0个百分点；AMA-Bench上答案提示缩小76.2%，准确率高2.08个百分点；从完整集移除一个必需组会使修复定位精度在两个执行器下分别下降12.3和11.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向智能体的检索更应表述为"恢复决策所缺内容"，而非"重排与问题相似的内容"。

title: Multi-Dimensional Prosody Judgment For Live Streaming Speech Synthesis
summary: Evaluating live streaming speech synthesis (TTS) requires assessing fine-grained, highly expressive prosody such as emotion, intonation, and energy which traditional MOS predictors fail to capture. While proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) like Gemini can evaluate these aspects, they are too costly for massive inference and reinforcement learning feedback. To address this, we first introduce Live-ProsodyJudge (LPJ), a cost-effective pairwise evaluator distilled from Gemini into Qwen3-Omni. However, we identify a critical flaw in standard multi-dimensional evaluation: verdict coupling. The judge tends to lazily align all individual dimension scores with its overall preference, collapsing a rich multi-dimensional rubric into a single preference bit. To resolve this, we further propose Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge (D-LPJ). D-LPJ eliminates the overall verdict target to prevent blind following, masks uncertain pair-dimensions during Supervised Fine-Tuning(SFT), and introduces a novel span-local GRPO strategy that applies normalized advantages strictly to their corresponding rationale spans. Evaluated on highly curated human-annotated test sets, 10 sample balanced-order LPJ achieves higher point accuracy than a single Gemini call, while D-LPJ successfully produces independent,decoupled dimension judgments. Furthermore, in a Best-of-8 TTS candidate selection tournament, the LPJ-selected utterance falls within the human top-3 in 85.29% of high-confidence cases, demonstrating its efficacy for fine-grained TTS preference optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对直播流式语音合成（TTS）中细粒度韵律（情感、语调、能量）评估问题，提出从Gemini蒸馏到Qwen3-Omni的低成本成对评估器LPJ，并识别出多维评估中的"判决耦合"缺陷，进而提出解耦式D-LPJ（去除整体判决目标、SFT中掩码不确定配对维度、引入span-local GRPO）。实验表明LPJ在人工标注测试集上点准确率超过单次Gemini调用，D-LPJ能产出独立解耦的维度判断，在Best-of-8候选选择中85.29%的高置信案例落入人类前3。
AI.motivation: 直播流式TTS的韵律表达极具细粒度与表现力，传统MOS预测器无法捕捉情感、语调、能量等维度；而Gemini等专有LLM虽可评估这些方面，但用于大规模推理和强化学习反馈时成本过高，因此需要低成本且细粒度的评估方案。
AI.method: 首先提出Live-ProsodyJudge（LPJ），将Gemini蒸馏到Qwen3-Omni中构建低成本成对评估器；随后识别出标准多维评估的"判决耦合"缺陷——评估器倾向于让各维度分数与整体偏好对齐，使多维评分退化为单一偏好位。为此提出Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge（D-LPJ）：移除整体判决目标以防止盲从，在SFT阶段掩码不确定的配对-维度，并引入span-local GRPO策略，将归一化优势严格应用于对应的推理跨度。
AI.result: 在精心整理的人工标注测试集上，10样本平衡顺序的LPJ点准确率高于单次Gemini调用；D-LPJ成功产出独立、解耦的维度判断。在Best-of-8 TTS候选选择锦标赛中，LPJ所选话语在高置信案例中有85.29%落入人类排名前3。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏式低成本成对评估器LPJ能有效替代专有LLM进行细粒度韵律评估，而D-LPJ通过解耦设计解决了多维评分退化的缺陷，验证了其用于细粒度TTS偏好优化的有效性。

title: Model-based Bootstrap for Offline Policy Evaluation in Tabular Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline policy evaluation (OPE) is crucial in high-stakes reinforcement learning applications, where new policies must be assessed reliably before deployment. In such settings, point estimates alone are insufficient; principled uncertainty quantification, such as confidence intervals and variance estimates, is essential for safe and risk-aware decision-making. A comprehensive way to unify these tasks is to estimate the sampling distribution of the evaluation error. Existing approaches, however, often suffer from limited robustness, scalability, or finite-sample validity. In this paper, we propose a model-based bootstrap framework for uncertainty quantification of OPE in finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous Markov decision processes (MDPs). Unlike classical bootstrap methods that rely on resampling complete episodes, the proposed method regenerates trajectories from an estimated MDP and can therefore accommodate a much broader range of offline data formats, including complete trajectories, transition-level observations, and trajectory fragments. This flexibility further improves finite-sample statistical efficiency. We establish bootstrap distributional consistency, asymptotically valid confidence intervals, and consistent variance estimation for the target policy value. Extensive simulations show that the proposed method accurately captures the sampling distribution of the OPE estimator, yielding tighter confidence intervals and more accurate variance estimates in most settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模型的自助法（model-based bootstrap）框架，用于有限时域、时间非齐次MDP下离线策略评估（OPE）的不确定性量化，可生成误差的抽样分布，并具备分布一致性、渐近有效置信区间与一致方差估计。
AI.motivation: 在医疗、金融等高风险的强化学习应用中，部署新策略前需可靠评估，仅有点估计不够，必须有置信区间和方差等原则性不确定性量化。统一这些任务的途径是估计评估误差的抽样分布，但现有方法在鲁棒性、可扩展性或有限样本有效性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 面向有限时域、时间非齐次MDP，提出模型式自助框架：不同于对完整轨迹重采样的经典自助法，该方法从估计出的MDP中重新生成轨迹，因而支持多种离线数据格式（完整轨迹、转移级观测、轨迹片段），并提升有限样本统计效率。
AI.result: 理论上建立了自助分布的分布一致性、渐近有效的置信区间以及目标策略价值的一致方差估计；大量仿真表明该方法能准确刻画OPE估计量的抽样分布，在多数情形下给出更紧的置信区间和更准确的方差估计。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型的自助法为OPE提供了统一、灵活且有限样本有效的不确定性量化方案，适用于多种离线数据格式，并在仿真中优于现有方法。

title: Grasping by interconnection: robust closing motions from coarse object templates
summary: Dexterous robot hands must often grasp objects whose shape, size, and pose are known only approximately. Grasp planners typically require accurate object models or correct errors with feedback, but how much inaccuracy a closing motion can tolerate on its own remains unclear. To address this question, we designed a motion planner based on four principles: a coarse template of the object, human grasp types, an object-centric interaction, and compliant, sliding contacts instead of prescribed contact points. This paper presents the planner, implemented through virtual model control, and its evaluation on a Shadow Dexterous Hand. Without feedback, the planned closing motions tolerated size errors of about 1cm and pose errors of several centimeters and tens of degrees, a wider range than a state-of-the-art data-driven planner in 25 of 27 tested conditions. They also grasped 82.5% of 80 everyday objects and succeeded within an autonomous pipeline. Robustness can thus be designed into the closing motion itself, rather than left only to feedback. This planner opens a path toward reliable manipulation in uncertain settings, which we will pursue by combining it with adaptive feedback control on the physical hand.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于虚拟模型控制的抓取运动规划器，使灵巧手在无反馈条件下仍能容忍约1cm尺寸误差与数厘米、数十度的位姿误差，并在27种条件中的25种优于现有数据驱动规划器，对80个日常物体抓取成功率达82.5%。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手抓取时物体形状、尺寸和位姿往往仅近似已知，现有抓取规划器通常需要精确物体模型或依赖反馈纠错；而闭合运动本身能容忍多大不准确性尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于四项原则设计运动规划器：物体粗模板、人类抓取类型、以物体为中心的交互、以及采用柔顺滑动接触而非预设接触点；并通过虚拟模型控制实现，在Shadow Dexterous Hand上评估。
AI.result: 无反馈条件下，规划闭合运动可容忍约1cm尺寸误差及数厘米、数十度的位姿误差，在27种测试条件中的25种优于最先进的数据驱动规划器；对80个日常物体抓取成功率为82.5%，并在自主流水线中成功完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性可被设计进闭合运动本身，而非仅依赖反馈；该规划器为不确定环境下的可靠操作提供了路径，后续将结合物理手上的自适应反馈控制继续推进。

title: Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses
summary: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search results they receive, and the choices they make when transforming search results into grounded responses. We find that Web-search decisions vary substantially across platforms and models, while more frequent Web-search invocation does not necessarily yield better response quality. We further show that conversational agents employ different complex querying strategies and that platform specific search engines return search results from their preferred domains. Finally, although responses are largely grounded in search results, some claims rely on uncited search results, raising concerns about attribution and reliability. Our findings have important implications for the design of future AI agents and Web search tools optimized for conversational retrieval.

AI.tldr: 首次对ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四大对话平台的Web搜索全流程进行实证研究，结合真实用户交互（invivo）与API受控实验（invitro），揭示搜索触发决策、查询策略、域名偏好与结果接地的差异与隐患。
AI.motivation: 对话式LLM智能体日益依赖Web搜索，但其端到端搜索生命周期仍缺乏系统理解，缺乏跨平台、跨真实与受控场景的对比证据。
AI.method: 对四个主流对话平台开展研究，将真实世界用户交互（invivo）与通过各平台API调用同款模型进行的受控实验（invitro）相结合，考察四个环节：是否触发搜索的决策、查询构造策略、检索结果的域名偏好、以及将结果转化为有依据回答的生成选择。
AI.result: 搜索触发决策在平台与模型间差异显著，且更频繁调用搜索并不必然带来更高质量回答；对话智能体采用各异的复杂查询策略；平台自有搜索引擎倾向返回其偏好域名的结果；回答虽大体基于搜索结果，但部分论断依赖未被引用的结果，存在归因与可靠性风险。
AI.conclusion: 研究为面向对话式检索优化的未来AI智能体与Web搜索工具设计提供了重要启示，需重点关注搜索决策、查询策略、域名多样性与引用归因的可信性。

title: Learning-Induced Dynamical Transition in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Learning in recurrent neural networks can fundamentally reshape their underlying dynamics, transforming initially chaotic activity into stable task-dependent behavior. We develop a non-equilibrium dynamical mean-field theory(DMFT) to describe this transition during learning. We show that a slow feedback-driven learning process generates an evolving effective feedback strength that drives the network through a transition from chaotic to stable dynamics defined by a bifurcation of the DMFT solution. By deriving the two-time correlation function throughout learning, we identify a critical feedback strength and a corresponding learning rate dependent critical time separating these regimes. The transition arises from the progressive deformation of an effective dynamical landscape by the growing learned feedback structure. Starting from the untrained state, the theory predicts the time evolution of the network output during training and shows quantitative agreement with numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT)，描述循环神经网络在慢速反馈驱动学习过程中，从混沌动力学向稳定任务行为的转变。
AI.motivation: 循环神经网络中学习会从根本上重塑其底层动力学，将初始的混沌活动转变为稳定的任务相关行为，但缺乏对这种学习过程中动力学转变的理论描述。
AI.method: 发展非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT)，推导出贯穿整个学习过程的双时间关联函数，将学习过程视为产生逐渐增长的有效反馈强度，并分析DMFT解的分岔。
AI.result: 识别出临界反馈强度，以及与之对应的依赖学习速率的临界时间，用于区分混沌与稳定两种区域；理论预测的网络输出演化与数值模拟定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 该转变源于由增长的学习反馈结构引起的有效动力学景观的渐进形变；DMFT能够从初始未训练状态出发预测训练过程中网络输出的时间演化。

title: VisKG-LM: Compiling Knowledge Graphs into Visual Memory for Multiple-Choice Question Answering
summary: Knowledge graphs are usually integrated into question answering by encoding a retrieved subgraph with a graph neural network and fusing it with the language model in the online inference path. The same subgraph is therefore re-encoded from scratch every time a pair is scored, across training epochs, seeds, and evaluation runs, even though the knowledge graph never changes. We ask whether the retrieved knowledge graphs can instead be compiled once, offline, and then accessed as read-only memory. VisKG-LM shows that it can, by decoupling graph encoding from language reasoning. It serializes each retrieved candidate-specific subgraph as Relation-Labeled Paths and renders the result as an image whose two-dimensional layout preserves the branching structure of the paths. Each image is encoded once, offline, and cached for reuse. At inference, the language model contextualizes the question and candidate from text alone, and only its final layer consults the cached visual memory, reading both its global layout and its local relational detail. The graph information thus enters only after the text has been understood. On the test sets of CommonsenseQA, OpenBookQA, and MedQA-USMLE, VisKG-LMimproves over GreaseLM by $1.2$, $0.8$, and $4.3$ points, respectively, while matching or surpassing GraphVis, a $7$B vision-language model, with only about $400$M online parameters. Against a matched text-only control that receives the identical Relation-Labeled Paths, it gains $4.2$, $6.5$, and $5.1$ points across the three benchmarks. These gains show that the complete visual-memory interface adds value beyond path textualization alone and support compiled visual memory as an alternative to online graph propagation.

AI.tldr: VisKG-LM将检索到的知识图谱子图离线编译为图像缓存（只读视觉记忆），推理时语言模型仅用文本理解问题与候选，最后层再读取该缓存，从而解耦图编码与语言推理，在多个问答基准上超越GreaseLM并媲美7B视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱问答通常在线用图神经网络编码检索子图并与语言模型融合，导致同一子图在训练轮次、随机种子和评估中反复从零编码，而知识图谱本身并不改变，计算冗余严重。作者希望验证：检索到的知识图谱能否一次性离线编译，并作为只读记忆被访问。
AI.method: 提出VisKG-LM，将图编码与语言推理解耦。把每个候选特定的检索子图序列化为Relation-Labeled Paths，并渲染成图像，其二维布局保留路径的分支结构；每张图像只离线编码一次并缓存复用。推理时语言模型仅凭文本对问题与候选进行上下文化，只有最终层查询缓存的视觉记忆，同时读取其全局布局与局部关系细节，使图信息在文本理解之后才进入。
AI.result: 在CommonsenseQA、OpenBookQA和MedQA-USMLE测试集上，VisKG-LM分别比GreaseLM提升1.2、0.8和4.3个百分点，仅约400M在线参数即可匹配或超越7B的视觉语言模型GraphVis。相比接收相同Relation-Labeled Paths的纯文本对照，在这三个基准上分别提升4.2、6.5和5.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 完整视觉记忆接口带来的增益超过单纯的路径文本化，表明编译式视觉记忆可作为在线图传播的替代方案，验证了离线一次编译、推理只读访问知识图谱的可行性。

title: Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking
summary: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MERIT-Rank 框架，通过多视角证据与推理集成来提升基于大语言模型的文本重排序鲁棒性，并显著超越更大规模的重排序器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 推理的重排序方法主要依赖单一推理轨迹，导致排序结果易受推理错误影响，且难以建模文档相关性背后多面的信号，限制了排序的鲁棒性与表达力。
AI.method: 提出 MERIT-Rank 框架：构建多轨迹推理空间（MTRS），从多个视角评估查询-文档相关性；引入联合重排序器，将多条推理路径整合为统一排序决策；并提出渐进式排序策略优化（PRPO），通过分阶段优化目标稳定推理轨迹并持续提升排序质量。
AI.result: 在推理密集型与传统检索基准上，MERIT-Rank 持续优于强竞争基线；其 4B 模型在 BRIGHT 基准上显著超越多数 7B 甚至 32B 的重排序器。
AI.conclusion: 多视角推理轨迹的集成可有效缓解单轨迹推理错误，提升重排序的鲁棒性与排序质量，并能在更小模型规模下实现超越大规模重排序器的性能。

title: Music Hallucination in Audio-Language Models: A Hierarchical Formulation and Empirical Study
summary: Audio-language models increasingly generate confident music descriptions that are unsupported by the input audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first music-specific, layer-wise, multi-paradigm empirical study of hallucination in audio-language models and formulate it as a hierarchical perceptual grounding failure across five layers: sound events, temporal properties, tonal attributes, style, and emotion. We introduce MuseDiag, a multi-paradigm diagnostic framework with contradiction-based verification, and evaluate nine models (four open-source and five closed-source). We find that (1) vocal misperception is a universal weakness across all nine models, tonal perception is a major axis of architectural differentiation, and Audio-Flamingo-3 remains the stable leader while substantial reordering below it reveals paradigm-specific vulnerability profiles; (2) affirmative bias, generation-mode effects, and layer-specific perceptual limitations are each empirically associated with the observed patterns, with convergent evidence from multiple analyses rather than strict causal attribution; and (3) our two training-free mitigation methods, Audio-Dependency-Aware Decoding for Music (ADD-M) and Taxonomy-Guided Perceptual Anchoring (TPA), can reduce hallucination in probing, but their gains vary by model and often do not carry over to free-form generation, showing that music hallucination mitigation must be evaluated across paradigms.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次针对音频-语言模型的音乐幻觉进行分层、多范式实证研究，提出五层感知接地失败框架与MuseDiag诊断工具，评估九个模型并揭示声乐误感知普遍性、音调感知的架构区分性，以及两种免训练缓解方法的有限泛化性。
AI.motivation: 音频-语言模型日益生成与输入音频不符却自信的音乐描述，即音乐幻觉问题突出，且此前缺乏音乐专用、分层、多范式的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出五层分层感知接地失败框架（声音事件、时间属性、音调属性、风格、情感）；构建多范式诊断框架MuseDiag，采用基于矛盾的验证方法；评估四个开源与五个闭源共九个模型；并提出两种免训练缓解方法ADD-M与TPA。
AI.result: 声乐误感知在九个模型中普遍存在；音调感知是架构区分的主要维度，Audio-Flamingo-3保持稳定领先，其下模型重排显著揭示范式特异性脆弱性；肯定偏差、生成模式效应与层特异感知局限与观察模式经验相关；ADD-M与TPA在探测任务中可降低幻觉，但收益因模型而异且常无法迁移至自由生成。
AI.conclusion: 音乐幻觉缓解必须在多种范式下进行评估；该研究为音频-语言模型音乐幻觉提供了首个系统性诊断框架与实证基准。

title: Online Supervised Dimension Reduction with Random Features: Diagnostics and Computational Trade-offs
comment: 41 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables; includes core supplementary material
summary: Accurate optimization of a supervised spectral objective need not produce an accurate population subspace or a better predictive representation. We investigate these distinctions for Online Kernel Supervised Principal Component Analysis (OKSPCA), which combines a centered cross-moment in finite random-feature coordinates with an Adam-style orthonormal basis update for an established objective. Fixed-map consistency, concentration and perturbation results describe the estimator and its exact subspace; same-target comparisons then assess the practical iterate separately. Across six predictive benchmarks, performance depends on the declared pipeline: replacing the tracker with the exact empirical target leaves the two regression deficits largely unchanged. Direct classification-rank models capture nearly all terminal objective energy on average, but a saved intermediate state exhibits substantial geometric deviation; a controlled sample-size study further separates empirical accuracy from population recovery. In distinct numerical-service workloads, exact on-request computation is faster in the tested classification settings, whereas Adam saves time relative to the tested full thin-SVD service for some dense wider-regression requests, alongside persistent geometric error. These diagnostics limit explanations based solely on terminal optimization accuracy and distinguish numerical cost from quality, rank coverage and freshness; they establish neither practical-tracker convergence nor predictive or deployment benefits from basis availability.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了"目标函数优化精度"与"子空间/预测表示质量"两回事，以OKSPCA（在线核监督主成分分析）为对象，通过定点一致性、集中与扰动分析考察估计量及精确子空间，并借助同目标对比、六个预测基准、分类排序模型、样本量控制研究及数值服务负载实验，表明终态目标能量高并不等价于几何/总体子空间恢复好或预测/部署收益。
AI.motivation: 监督谱目标（spectral objective）的精确优化，未必能得到准确的总体子空间（population subspace），也未必带来更好的预测表示。作者希望厘清"优化精度""子空间几何质量""数值成本""秩覆盖"与"新鲜度（freshness）"这几类常被混同的评价维度，避免仅以终态优化精度解释方法优劣。
AI.method: 针对OKSPCA：在有限随机特征（random-feature）坐标中组合中心化交叉矩（centered cross-moment），并采用Adam式正交基更新来优化既定目标。理论层面给出定点映射一致性、集中与扰动结果，刻画估计量及其精确子空间；实验层面进行同目标（same-target）对比以单独评估实际迭代点，辅以六项预测基准、直接分类秩模型、受控样本量研究与不同数值服务负载的测算。
AI.result: 六个预测基准中，性能取决于所声明的流水线（pipeline）：将跟踪器替换为精确经验目标后，两项回归缺陷基本不变。直接分类秩模型平均可捕获几乎所有终态目标能量，但保存的中间状态存在显著几何偏差；受控样本量研究进一步将经验精度与总体恢复区分开。在数值服务负载中，精确按需计算在所测分类设置下更快；而对某些稠密、更宽的回归请求，Adam相对所测完整薄SVD服务更省时，但同时伴随持续存在的几何误差。
AI.conclusion: 这些诊断限制了仅以终态优化精度为依据的解释，并区分了数值成本与质量、秩覆盖及新鲜度；既未证明实际跟踪器的收敛性，也未证明基可得性（basis availability）能带来预测或部署收益。

title: WZPlanner: Safe End-to-End Path Planning for Autonomous Driving in Work Zones
summary: Work zones alter lane geometry through temporary traffic controls and closures that may be absent from on-board maps, challenging autonomous vehicle (AV) perception and planning. Generalization is also limited by scarce public datasets with structured geometric supervision. We present WorkZonePlan, a dataset comprising 149K+ synthetic and 5K+ real-world multimodal samples with 3D annotations for lane boundaries, work zone boundaries, and driving trajectory options. It also provides 76 closed-loop CARLA scenarios replayed under three weather conditions, yielding 228 Bench2Drive-format evaluation routes. We introduce WAVE (Work-zone-focused AV data generation in Virtual and rEal Environments), a semi-automated pipeline for creating the dataset, and BoundaryFormer (BF), a transformer-based model that jointly predicts lane and work zone boundary polynomials and driving trajectories. BF uses slot attention for boundary prediction. Ablations show that a separate trajectory decoder using boundary slot features substantially improves trajectory prediction over a slot-attention-only approach. Building on this finding, BF++ offers Camera and Camera+LiDAR variants with metric ground-plane encoding, typed boundary/trajectory queries, long-range point anchors, image-space curve refinement, and conservative gated LiDAR fusion. On the 211 routes common to all four models at the evaluation freeze, BF++-Camera and BF++-Camera+LiDAR achieve Driving Scores of 63.0 and 64.4, respectively, compared with 59.3 for SimLingo and 26.1 for TransFuser++ (TF++). BF++ is 40 times smaller than SimLingo and more than 10 times smaller than TF++, while achieving higher Driving Scores. These results support jointly predicting lane boundaries, work zone boundaries, and driving trajectories as a promising direction toward safer AV operation in work zones. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Nishad-Sahu/WZPlanner.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WorkZonePlan数据集与WAVE生成流程，并设计了联合预测车道边界、施工区边界与行驶轨迹的Transformer模型BoundaryFormer/BF++，在闭环评测中实现更高驾驶得分且模型更小。
AI.motivation: 施工区临时交通控制与封闭会改变车道几何，且这些信息常缺失于车载地图，给自动驾驶感知与规划带来挑战；同时缺乏具有结构化几何监督的公开数据集，导致方法泛化受限。
AI.method: 构建WorkZonePlan数据集，包含149K+合成与5K+真实多模态样本，提供车道边界、施工区边界和行驶轨迹选项的3D标注，并给出76个CARLA闭环场景在三种天气下回放得到的228条Bench2Drive格式评测路线；提出WAVE半自动数据生成流程；提出BoundaryFormer（BF），基于Transformer并使用slot attention联合预测车道/施工区边界多项式与轨迹；进一步提出BF++，含Camera与Camera+LiDAR变体，采用度量地平面编码、类型化边界/轨迹查询、远距离点锚、图像空间曲线细化及保守门控LiDAR融合。
AI.result: 消融表明使用边界slot特征的独立轨迹解码器显著优于仅用slot attention的方案。在四模型共有的211条路线上，BF++-Camera与BF++-Camera+LiDAR驾驶得分分别为63.0和64.4，高于SimLingo的59.3与TransFuser++的26.1；同时BF++参数量比SimLingo小40倍、比TF++小10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 联合预测车道边界、施工区边界与行驶轨迹是提升施工区自动驾驶安全性的有前景方向。

title: Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, under review for ICRA 2027
summary: Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length. Project page with videos https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RoM-Nav，通过将人形机器人导航问题分解为降阶动力学导航策略与全阶动力学策略的两阶段学习，结合泊松安全滤波，实现了无地图多层地形导航。
AI.motivation: 现有单阶段强化学习导航流水线难以扩展到多层级、多楼层地形，主要受限于楼梯等复杂人形地形交互的困难。作者希望突破这一瓶颈，实现复杂多层环境中的自主导航。
AI.method: 方法分为两个阶段：首先训练一个基于降阶动力学、但接收完整3D LiDAR观测的策略，用于复杂多楼层地形导航；随后利用该导航知识启动一个基于全阶人形动力学的策略，并在回路中冻结步态（locomotion）策略。此外，对导航策略输出施加泊松安全滤波器，以在分布外障碍物情况下恢复安全性。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了RoM-Nav策略，完成了无地图多楼层导航，测试涵盖超过10米垂直位移和超过100米路径长度的场景。泊松安全滤波在不降低导航成功率的前提下恢复了分布外障碍物下的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 将导航问题分解为降阶与全阶两阶段学习，并引入安全滤波，可有效提升人形机器人在复杂多层地形中的导航可扩展性与安全性。

title: Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?
summary: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. An agent that improves an accelerator may be reasoning about the machine, or may be searching competently over knobs whose meaning it never recovers -- and only the first transfers to the next architecture. Existing evaluations cannot tell the two apart, because they vary the agent while holding the framing of the problem fixed. We do the opposite. AutoTuring hands the same agent the same 15-dimensional accelerator space twice: once as named architectural knobs with simulator counters, once as anonymous variables on [0,1], with the evaluator, the legal space and the reachable optima held identical, so that the only thing that varies is whether the problem means anything. The gap between the two is the measurement. On a nine-kernel FP16 GEMM basket, meaning pays: the architect beats a modeled H200 by 5.4% and its blind counterpart by 12.3% on average, with 70.1% fewer simulator calls. It does not pay uniquely: a critic loop recovers most of that gap for the blind agent and buys the architect nothing, so architectural knowledge and structured critique behave as substitutes rather than as complements. We report these as preliminary findings -- five to six runs per condition on a single modeled accelerator -- and take the comparison itself, not the accelerator, to be the contribution.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoTuring 对照实验：同一智能体、同一 15 维加速器设计空间，仅改变问题是否"有意义"（命名架构旋钮 vs. 匿名 [0,1] 变量），以差值量化"意义"对设计智能体的贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只证明智能体能改进硬件设计，却无法区分其成功源于对机器结构的真实推理，还是对无意义旋钮的有效搜索；只有前者具备跨架构迁移性。而已有评测固定问题框架、仅变动智能体，无法区分这两种机制，因此需要反转变量。
AI.method: AutoTuring 向同一智能体两次呈现同一 15 维加速器空间：一次为带模拟器计数器的命名架构旋钮，一次为 [0,1] 上的匿名变量；评估器、合法空间与可达最优解完全一致，唯一变量是问题是否具有语义。以两种条件下的性能差作为"意义"的度量。在九核 FP16 GEMM 基准上对比架构师智能体、盲搜索智能体及引入 critic 回路后的表现。
AI.result: 意义带来收益：架构师较建模的 H200 平均领先 5.4%，较盲对应体平均领先 12.3%，且模拟器调用减少 70.1%。但意义并非不可替代：critic 回路可为盲智能体挽回大部分差距，而对架构师几乎无增益，说明架构知识与结构化批评是替代关系而非互补关系。
AI.conclusion: 初步结论（每条件 5–6 次运行、单一建模加速器）：论文贡献在于对照比较方法本身而非加速器设计结果；架构语义与结构化批评可相互替代，评估智能体"是否真正理解机器"需通过语义消融对照来实现。

title: Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Privacy-Preserving Modeling of Heterogeneous Distributed Systems
summary: We present Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes (pFedHGP) for probabilistic regression and classification when data are distributed across heterogeneous clients. Each client's latent function decomposes into (i) a shared global component, (ii) a client-specific deviation that shares the global kernel structure, and (iii) a flexible local residual. Sparse inducing-variable approximations and federated variational inference keep raw data local while the server synchronizes only low-dimensional statistics for the shared component. Full predictive distributions support uncertainty-aware decisions. In application studies, pFedHGP attains perfect fault classification in press tonnage monitoring using 13.77% of labeled cycles and recovers geographic zones in federated air-quality modeling without centralizing station-level time series. An Instantaneous Linear Mixing Model viewpoint links the hierarchy to multi-output Gaussian processes for correlated sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化联邦分层高斯过程（pFedHGP），用于异构客户端下的概率回归与分类。模型将每个客户端潜在函数分解为共享全局成分、客户端偏差与局部残差，通过稀疏诱导变量和联邦变分推断实现数据本地化。
AI.motivation: 在数据分布于异构客户端的联邦场景下，需要兼顾共享知识迁移与客户端个性化建模，同时保护原始数据隐私并提供带不确定性的预测。
AI.method: 将客户端潜在函数分解为三部分：共享全局成分、共享核结构的客户端特定偏差、灵活局部残差；采用稀疏诱导变量近似与联邦变分推断，服务器仅同步共享成分的低维统计量；以瞬时线性混合模型视角关联多输出高斯过程。
AI.result: 在压机吨位监测中仅用13.77%的有标注周期即实现完美故障分类；在联邦空气质量建模中恢复出地理分区，且无需集中站点级时间序列。
AI.conclusion: pFedHGP能够在隐私保护与通信受限条件下实现高精度个性化概率建模，并提供完整预测分布以支持不确定性决策。

title: Advantage Scale Calibration Imbalance in Group-Relative Optimization under Low-Variance Rewards: Diagnosis and Bounded Recovery
summary: In verifier-style RLVR, group-relative optimization often treats advantage scale as an implementation detail. This paper separates two low-variance cases: sub-resolution jitter that should not become a preference signal, and credible but small cardinal gaps that should be learned without distorting KL calibration. We propose an advantage-scale three-way calibration interface: the same within-group scale denominator simultaneously determines the reward-branch strength, prompt-level batch weight, and the effective KL calibration induced when the reward branch is re-expressed on the original cardinal scale. This interface explains why RLOO / Dr.GRPO can let credible small gaps become KL dominated, whereas GRPO's standard-deviation denominator can amplify tiny gaps without bound. Based on this interface, we further introduce the Reward-Resolution Protocol and MaxNorm-AC, respectively filtering sub-resolution gaps and providing bounded cardinal recovery on credible nonzero gaps. Across dense / MoE architectures and math / code reasoning, MaxNorm-AC improves over the strongest robust-scale baseline while truncating the low-variance inverse-scale tail.

AI.tldr: 本文将强化学习验证器（RLVR）中的优势缩放从实现细节提升为显式的"三方校准接口"，提出奖励分辨率协议与MaxNorm-AC方法，在保留可信小差距的同时过滤次分辨率抖动。
AI.motivation: 在 verifier 式 RLVR 中，组相对优化通常把优势尺度当作实现细节，忽视了低方差情形下的两类问题：一是本不应成为偏好信号的次分辨率抖动，二是应被学习但需保持 KL 校准的可信小基数差距。现有方法（如 RLOO / Dr.GRPO 与 GRPO）对此处理存在缺陷。
AI.method: 提出优势尺度三方校准接口：同一个组内尺度分母同时决定奖励分支强度、prompt 级批权重，以及将奖励分支还原到原始基数尺度时产生的有效 KL 校准。基于该接口引入奖励分辨率协议（Reward-Resolution Protocol）以过滤次分辨率差距，并设计 MaxNorm-AC 在可信非零差距上提供有界基数恢复。
AI.result: 该接口解释了为何 RLOO / Dr.GRPO 会让可信小差距被 KL 主导，而 GRPO 的标准差分母会无界放大微小差距。在密集/MoE 架构及数学/代码推理任务上，MaxNorm-AC 优于最强的鲁棒尺度基线，同时截断了低方差逆尺度长尾。
AI.conclusion: 将优势尺度视为可校准接口具有理论解释力与实践收益，MaxNorm-AC 在过滤次分辨率抖动的同时实现有界基数恢复，验证了该框架在不同架构与推理任务上的有效性。

title: FacetCRS: Multi-Faceted Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System
summary: The filter bubble is a notorious issue in Recommender Systems (RSs), which describes the phenomenon whereby users are exposed to a limited and narrow range of information or content that reinforces their existing dominant preferences and beliefs. This results in a lack of exposure to diverse and varied content. Many existing works have predominantly examined filter bubbles in static or relatively-static recommendation settings. However, filter bubbles will be continuously intensified over time due to the feedback loop between the user and the system in the real-world online recommendation. To address these issues, we propose a novel paradigm, Multi-Facet Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System (FacetCRS), which aims to burst filter bubbles in the conversational recommender system (CRS) through timely user-item interactions via natural language conversations. By considering diverse user preferences and intentions, FacetCRS automatically model user preference into multi-facets, including entity-, word-, context-, and review-facet, to capture diverse and dynamic user preferences to prick filter bubbles in the CRS. It is an end-to-end CRS framework to adaptively learn representations of various levels of preference facet and diverse types of external knowledge. Extensive experiments on two publicly available benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in mitigating filter bubbles and enhancing recommendation quality in CRS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FacetCRS，一种面向会话推荐系统的多面向偏好学习范式，通过自然语言对话中的及时用户-物品交互来打破过滤气泡。
AI.motivation: 过滤气泡是推荐系统中的一个显著问题，使用户长期暴露于狭窄且同质化的内容中，强化其既有偏好。现有研究多在静态或相对静态的推荐场景中考察过滤气泡，但在真实在线推荐中，用户与系统之间的反馈回路会随时间不断加剧过滤气泡。因此需要一种能够随时间动态缓解过滤气泡的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出FacetCRS范式，利用会话推荐系统中的自然语言对话实现及时的用户-物品交互。该方法将用户偏好自动建模为多个面向，包括实体面向、词语面向、上下文面向和评论面向，以捕捉多样且动态的用户偏好。作为一个端到端CRS框架，它自适应地学习不同层级偏好面向的表示以及多种类型的外部知识。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在缓解过滤气泡和提升会话推荐质量方面均达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: FacetCRS通过多面向偏好学习与会话式交互，有效刺破过滤气泡，为在动态推荐环境中缓解过滤气泡提供了新的范式，并在推荐质量上取得领先效果。

title: Reading Emotions in the Token Space: Discriminative Adaptation of SpeechLLMs for Emotion Recognition
summary: SpeechLLMs have shown strong potential for emotion recognition, yet they read the predicted emotion off a generative decoder not suited for classification: it can emit labels outside the target set and favors frequent classes. We propose a discriminative adaptation that reads the final prompt token's hidden state through a classification head, producing a label in one forward pass without modifying the backbone. Because this readout starts from the hidden state the model would otherwise decode, it gives a controlled comparison of generative and discriminative inference in an otherwise identical speechLLM. We keep the head a single linear layer, trading little accuracy for interpretability: each emotion becomes one direction in the LLM output token space, revealing associated tokens. On IEMOCAP, across two speechLLM architectures, it improves Macro F1 and removes hallucinations, with largest gains on realistic ASR transcripts. Our analysis reveals that these emotion directions encode indirect associations mirroring biases in web-scale text.

AI.tldr: 提出一种判别式适配方法，用分类头读取SpeechLLM最后一个提示词token的隐状态，在单次前向中输出情绪标签，无需改动骨干网络，在IEMOCAP上提升Macro F1并消除幻觉标签。
AI.motivation: SpeechLLM在情绪识别上潜力大，但依赖生成式解码器进行分类存在两个问题：可能生成不在目标集合中的标签（幻觉），且偏向高频类别；同时缺乏在相同模型下比较生成式与判别式推理的受控设置。
AI.method: 在SpeechLLM最后一个提示词token的隐状态之上接一个单层线性分类头，一次前向即可输出标签，不修改骨干网络。由于读出的起点正是模型本会用于解码的隐状态，因此构成生成式与判别式推理的受控对比。头部仅用单层线性层以换取可解释性：每个情绪对应LLM输出token空间中的一个方向，可揭示相关token。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP上，跨两种SpeechLLM架构，Macro F1提升并消除幻觉标签，在更真实的ASR转写文本上增益最大；分析显示这些情绪方向编码了与网络规模文本偏见相似的间接关联。
AI.conclusion: 判别式读出是SpeechLLM情绪识别的有效适配方式，以极小精度代价获得可解释性与鲁棒性；情绪方向揭示了源于预训练文本数据的间接关联。

title: TAP Accuracy Below the Fluctuation Scale and Universal Posterior Geometry in Spherical Linear Models
summary: We study the Bayes-optimal spherical linear model as the ambient dimension and sample size grow proportionally, under a quantitative Marchenko--Pastur spectral-regularity condition on the design. This condition is satisfied by normalized i.i.d. designs with standardized entries of finite fourth moment, but does not require entrywise independence or impose conditions on the singular vectors. Under this condition, we prove a quantitative all-temperature TAP approximation and characterize the posterior geometry. For the natural finite-aspect-ratio TAP functional, the normalized spherical free energy and the TAP optimum differ by $O_P(p^{-1})$. Each is within $O_P(p^{-1/2})$ of its explicit deterministic equivalent, and this fluctuation scale is sharp. Uniformly over all global TAP maximizers, the normalized squared Euclidean distance to the spherical posterior mean is $O_P(p^{-1})$. We also prove that the posterior mass outside a data-dependent band determined by the ridge estimator has sharp exponential order. More precisely, uniformly over sufficiently small band widths $\varepsilon$, the logarithm of this mass is at most $-cp\varepsilon^2+O_P(1)$. For every fixed geometrically admissible width, a spherical-cap construction gives a matching exponential-order lower bound on this mass. For every deterministic sequence of widths $\varepsilon_p\gg p^{-1/2}$, the corresponding bands capture asymptotically all posterior mass.

AI.tldr: 本文在环境维度与样本量成比例增长的框架下研究贝叶斯最优球形线性模型，在仅要求设计满足定量 Marchenko–Pastur 谱正则性条件的假设下，证明了全温度 TAP 近似的定量结果，并刻画了后验几何。
AI.motivation: 克服现有 TAP 近似与后验几何结果对设计矩阵逐元素独立、奇异向量条件或不依赖有限矩假设的依赖，将结论推广到更广的设计类（如仅需有限四阶矩的标准化 i.i.d. 设计）并给出定量误差刻画。
AI.method: 在环境维度与样本量成比例增长的高维极限下，施加定量的 Marchenko–Pastur 谱正则性条件；通过建立全温度 TAP 泛函与后验测度之间的定量控制，结合球面自由能、TAP 最优解、岭估计量以及球冠构造进行分析。
AI.result: 归一化球面自由能与 TAP 最优值相差 O_P(p^{-1})；二者各自与其显式确定性等价量相差 O_P(p^{-1/2}) 且该涨落尺度是紧的。在所有全局 TAP 极大点上一致地，归一化平方欧氏距离到球面后验均值距离为 O_P(p^{-1})。岭估计量确定的数据依赖带外的后验质量，对小带宽 ε 满足对数上界 -cpε²+O_P(1)，且对每个固定几何容许带宽球冠构造给出匹配的指数阶下界；对 ε_p≫p^{-1/2} 的确定性带宽序列，带内渐近捕获全部后验质量。
AI.conclusion: 在较弱的谱正则性条件下即可获得定量全温度 TAP 近似，并完整刻画球形线性模型的后验集中几何，表明后验质量集中在由岭估计量确定、宽度约 p^{-1/2} 的带内，涨落尺度尖锐。

title: RGS: Reflection-aware Gaussian Splatting via Learning Geometry Continuity for Reflective Objects
summary: Gaussian Splatting has significantly improved the quality of novel view synthesis with explicit Gaussian representation. However, we observed that existing 3D Gaussian Splatting methods (3DGS) often suffer from surface collapse issues on reflective regions, and thus produce inferior geometry and low-quality specular. In this work, we propose a physically-based deferred rendering framework, named Reflection-aware Gaussian Splatting (RGS), that can accurately model specular regions and improve novel view synthesis performance. Specifically, we found that a powerful 3D foundation model can provide a strong 3D geometric prior to foster correct geometric modeling. Based on this, we propose a cross-view shape consistency regularization to regularize the geometry surface with the large model prior and cross-view constraints. In this manner, our RGS can produce smoother geometric surfaces on reflective regions while reducing geometric hollows. To further improve rendering results on reflective regions, we present a reflection-aware densification strategy that is designed to capture specular variations across various views. With this strategy, our RGS is able to render novel views of objects in higher quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method consistently renders high-quality reflective objects, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反射感知高斯泼溅（RGS），通过物理延迟渲染框架解决3DGS在反射区域表面塌陷问题，实现高质量新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅方法（3DGS）在反射区域常出现表面塌陷，导致几何质量差、高光质量低，无法准确建模镜面反射区域。
AI.method: 提出基于物理的延迟渲染框架RGS；利用强大3D基础模型提供3D几何先验，设计跨视角形状一致性正则化以规整几何表面并引入跨视角约束；提出反射感知致密化策略，捕捉不同视角下的镜面变化。
AI.result: RGS能在反射区域产生更平滑的几何表面并减少几何空洞；借助反射感知致密化策略，能渲染更高质量的新视角物体图像。大量实验证明其持续渲染高质量反射物体，达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: RGS通过几何先验正则化与反射感知致密化，有效缓解反射区域表面塌陷，提升反射物体新视角合成质量，取得SOTA表现。

title: OHRID-Retail: An Open Multimodal Dataset of Human Activity in Retail Environments
summary: Open datasets describing human behavior in environments shared with mobile robots remain limited, particularly for retail activities that combine locomotion, reaching, object handling, and robot guided movement. This paper introduces OHRID Retail, an open, human centered multimodal dataset collected from 16 healthy adults performing a simulated shelf picking task under three within participant conditions: no robot, low speed robot guidance, and high speed robot guidance. Each participant completed two trials per condition. Whole body kinematics were recorded using 17 Xsens Awinda inertial sensors and muscle activity was measured at 10 locations using Delsys Trigno surface electromyography sensors. Descriptive analyses demonstrate variation in whole body movement intensity and muscle activation across robot interaction conditions and body locations. OHRID Retail provides openly available raw recordings, processed measures, documentation, and reproducible analysis resources. The dataset can support research in human activity recognition, multimodal sensor fusion, occupational biomechanics, ergonomics, human aware robot navigation, and human robot interaction in retail and related shared environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布OHRID Retail——一个面向零售场景的开放式多模态人体数据集，记录16名健康成人在无机器人、低速与高速机器人引导三种条件下执行货架取物任务的全身体运动学与肌电数据。
AI.motivation: 描述人类在与移动机器人共享环境中的行为数据集仍然有限，尤其是融合行走、伸手、物体操作与机器人引导移动的零售活动场景，缺乏公开可用数据资源。
AI.method: 16名健康成年人参与模拟货架取物任务，采用被试内设计，设置无机器人、低速机器人引导、高速机器人引导三种条件，每种条件完成2次试验。使用17个Xsens Awinda惯性传感器采集全身运动学数据，使用Delsys Trigno表面肌电传感器在10个位置测量肌肉活动，并进行描述性分析。
AI.result: 描述性分析显示，全身运动强度和肌肉激活在不同机器人交互条件和身体部位之间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: OHRID Retail公开提供原始记录、处理后指标、文档及可复现分析资源，可支撑人类活动识别、多模态传感器融合、职业生物力学、人因工程、人感知机器人导航及人机交互等研究。

title: MAGS: Multi-agent Auto-formalization Guarantees Safety for Agentic Outputs
summary: LLM coding agents now generate complex programs at a scale that makes thorough human review increasingly difficult, raising the risk of safety and security failures. Common approaches, including fuzz testing, static analysis, and LLM-as-a-Verifier, can detect many failures but struggle to cover all possible edge cases. Formal verification addresses this by providing machine-checkable guarantees over specified properties, but traditionally demands substantial manual specification and proof engineering. We introduce a unified multi-agent framework, MAGS, that generates executable programs with formal safety guarantees, using Dafny as a verification-aware intermediate representation where safety properties can be mechanically checked. MAGS formalizes and freezes human-audited APIs and safety requirements, translates generated code into Dafny, repairs violations using verifier feedback, and compiles verified programs back into executable code. We evaluate MAGS on 100 CUDA kernels, 100 terminal scripts, and 20 robotic-arm tasks. Across all 220 examples, it achieves a 100% success rate in producing programs with non-trivial safety guarantees against frozen specifications. Independent safety and functional evaluations further show strong performance across all three domains, while revealing failures when the auto-formalized semantics do not fully capture the target behavior.

AI.tldr: MAGS是一个多智能体框架，用Dafny作为验证感知的中间表示，将LLM生成的程序转化为可验证代码，在220个任务上实现100%的非平凡安全保证生成成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM编码智能体生成的复杂程序规模庞大，人工审查困难，带来安全与安全隐患。现有方法（模糊测试、静态分析、LLM-as-a-Verifier）难以覆盖所有边界情况；形式化验证虽能提供机器可检验的保证，但传统上依赖大量人工规格与证明工程。
AI.method: 提出统一多智能体框架MAGS：以Dafny作为验证感知的中间表示，形式化并冻结经人工审计的API与安全需求；将生成代码翻译为Dafny；利用验证器反馈修复违规；再将通过验证的程序编译回可执行代码。
AI.result: 在100个CUDA内核、100个终端脚本和20个机械臂任务共220个样例上，MAGS针对冻结规格实现100%的非平凡安全保证生成成功率；独立的安全性与功能性评估在三个领域均表现良好，同时暴露出自动形式化语义未能完全刻画目标行为时的失败情况。
AI.conclusion: MAGS通过多智能体与验证感知中间表示的结合，使LLM生成代码获得机器可检验的形式化安全保证，跨领域验证了其有效性；但其局限在于自动形式化语义与目标行为之间可能存在语义鸿沟，导致验证通过却与真实意图不符。

title: How to Guide Your Language Flow
summary: We introduce a new method to guide flow matching models. Our approach, which we call probe guidance, uses the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct a guidance signal. This works using a similar principle as autoguidance, but eliminates the need for an additional forward pass at inference time and provides a reliable path to ensure that the weak and strong model share similar dynamics. We apply and benchmark this method on continuous diffusion language models, where probe guidance sets a new state-of-the-art performance on unconditional generation. When applied to a 1.7B diffusion language model, probe guidance consistently improves on multiple choice question answering benchmarks. Using our probes, we study the traditional autoguidance setting where the strong model is a weak checkpoint, and find that the weak model must come from a low-entropy region of training. These findings both provide a practical way to improve diffusion language models and shed light on the actual mechanism behind autoguidance, which is currently poorly understood.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"探针引导"(probe guidance)，利用冻结扩散模型内部状态构建引导信号，无需额外前向传播即可实现类似autoguidance的效果，在连续扩散语言模型上取得无条件生成的新SOTA，并揭示了autoguidance的有效机制。
AI.motivation: Autoguidance需要在推理时额外进行一次前向传播，且难以保证弱模型与强模型具有相似的动力学特性；同时autoguidance背后的实际机制目前理解不足。作者希望消除额外计算开销、确保弱强模型的动力学一致性，并厘清autoguidance的运作机理。
AI.method: 提出probe guidance：用已有扩散模型冻结的内部状态（探针）构建引导信号，原理与autoguidance类似，但去掉了推理时的额外前向传播，并提供可靠途径保证弱模型与强模型共享相似动力学。将该方法应用于连续扩散语言模型，并在1.7B扩散语言模型的多选题问答基准上验证。此外借助探针研究传统autoguidance设定（强模型为弱检查点）。
AI.result: Probe guidance在无条件生成上刷新了SOTA；应用于1.7B扩散语言模型时，在多个多选题问答基准上稳定提升。研究发现传统autoguidance中弱模型必须来自训练的低熵区域。
AI.conclusion: Probe guidance为改进扩散语言模型提供了实用方法，同时揭示了autoguidance的真实机制，深化了对该技术的理解。

title: To Memories and Beyond: From Remembering to Knowing You across Long-Term Multimodal Personal Archives
summary: As AI systems evolve into personalized digital companions, a central capability is reasoning over a user's long-term personal history: not merely storing past events, but tracking longitudinal experiences and evolving preferences. Progress here is bottlenecked by evaluation, existing long-term memory benchmarks are largely synthetic and text-only, they overlook the visual records that anchor everyday human memory, lack the authentic and causally connected longitudinal data that real personalization demands, and consequently remain confined to shallow factual recall. We introduce ReaLMem (Real-world Long-term Multimodal Memory), the first benchmark built from authentic multi-year personal visual archives, paired with first-person subjective annotations. ReaLMem evaluates models across three cognitive tiers of increasing difficulty: factual recall, persona inference, and predictive personalization. We further propose ChronoProfiler, a temporal-weighting profiling module that computes temporal stability scores for user attributes and applies them as a salience prior, resolving conflicts among temporally inconsistent preferences and helping models compound multiple co-active preferences in complex personalized decisions. Extensive evaluation of frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and memory systems on ReaLMem reveals predictive personalization as a consistent ceiling, exposes clear performance gaps and bottlenecks between MLLMs and memory systems, and shows that high-quality, temporally informed representations substantially improve personalization. Together, ReaLMem and ChronoProfiler provide an authentic testbed and a simple, effective mechanism for long-term personalization, laying a foundation for future research on lifelong AI companions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReaLMem——首个基于真实多年个人视觉档案构建的长期多模态记忆基准，并设计 ChronoProfiler 时间加权画像模块，以缓解个性化决策中的偏好冲突并提升长期个性化能力。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 系统向个性化数字伴侣演进，核心能力在于对用户长期个人历史的推理，而不仅是存储事件。现有长期记忆基准多为合成、纯文本数据，忽视锚定日常人类记忆的视觉记录，缺乏真实且具因果关联的纵向数据，因而局限于浅层事实回忆，制约了该方向的评测与进展。
AI.method: 1) 构建 ReaLMem 基准：基于真实多年个人视觉档案，配以第一人称主观标注，按三个递增难度的认知层级评测模型——事实回忆、人格推断、预测性个性化；2) 提出 ChronoProfiler：一种时间加权画像模块，计算用户属性的时间稳定性得分并将其作为显著性先验，以化解时间上不一致偏好的冲突，并在复杂个性化决策中融合多个共激活偏好。
AI.result: 在前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与记忆系统上的大量评测表明：预测性个性化是普遍的性能天花板；MLLM 与记忆系统之间存在明显性能差距与瓶颈；高质量、融入时间信息的表征能显著提升个性化效果。
AI.conclusion: ReaLMem 与 ChronoProfiler 共同提供了长期个性化的真实测试平台与简单有效的机制，为面向终身 AI 伴侣的未来研究奠定基础。

title: Reasoning Quality Matters: Combating Reasoning Collapse in LLM-based Embedding Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for producing context-rich text embeddings for retrieval. Most existing methods either treat embedding learning as passive feature extraction or exploit LLM reasoning through instruction following for better embedding optimization. However, specialization toward embedding objectives can suppress useful reasoning generation or produce retrieval-irrelevant text. We refer to these two forms of degradation as reasoning collapse. To address this issue, we propose CoFree (Collapse-Free Reasoning Embedding), a two-stage framework that progressively integrates LLM reasoning into query and document embedding optimization while preserving reasoning quality. At the first stage, CoFree applies reference-guided supervised fine-tuning to restore the reasoning ability and retain representational strength of the foundation embedding model. At the second stage, we introduce dual rewards, an embedding-oriented reward and a reasoning-oriented reward, to guarantee fine-grained reasoning of the relevance toward the embedding goal in reinforcement learning. This endpoint-coupled optimization transforms embedding learning from static alignment into a high-quality reasoning-guided search process for retrieval. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CoFree, with CoFree-4B achieving an average absolute improvement of 2.8 nDCG@10 points over Qwen3-Embedding-4B across 22 datasets from MTEB and BRIGHT. Online experiments in a real-world retrieval system further show consistent gains. Code, RTED, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CoFree两阶段框架，通过参考引导SFT与双奖励强化学习，在优化查询/文档嵌入的同时保持LLM推理质量，避免推理崩溃，并在22个数据集上取得显著检索提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM嵌入方法多为被动特征提取或通过指令跟随利用推理，但面向嵌入目标的专门化会抑制有用推理生成或产生与检索无关的文本，作者将这两种退化称为"推理崩溃"（reasoning collapse），亟需在保持推理质量的同时优化嵌入。
AI.method: CoFree（Collapse-Free Reasoning Embedding）两阶段框架：第一阶段采用参考引导的监督微调（reference-guided SFT），恢复基础嵌入模型的推理能力并保留其表征强度；第二阶段引入双奖励机制——嵌入导向奖励与推理导向奖励，在强化学习中保证针对嵌入目标相关性的细粒度推理，将嵌入学习从静态对齐转化为高质量的推理引导搜索过程。
AI.result: 在MTEB与BRIGHT的22个数据集上，CoFree-4B相较Qwen3-Embedding-4B平均绝对提升2.8个nDCG@10点；真实检索系统的在线实验也显示一致性增益。代码、RTED与模型检查点将公开。
AI.conclusion: CoFree通过渐进式整合LLM推理与嵌入优化，有效缓解推理崩溃，验证了端到端耦合优化在检索嵌入中的有效性，并在离线与在线场景均取得稳定提升。

title: Prediction-Powered Smoothing and Validation for Disaggregated AI Evaluation
comment: 15 pages of main text, 30 pages total, 4 figures
summary: Evaluating an AI system requires disaggregated assessment, as performance varies across domains such as benchmark task types or conversation types in deployed agents. Exhaustive testing is expensive, so evaluation rests on a sample of labeled units. We treat the evaluation set as a finite population and seek accurate point and interval estimates of each domain mean. Direct estimators, including prediction-powered inference (PPI), use only a domain's own labels and are imprecise where labels are few. Small area estimation addresses this problem, and we build on it to develop an integrated workflow for estimation and validation. For estimation, we propose prediction-powered smoothing (PP-S), a Bayesian model fit to each domain's prediction-powered estimate, with an extension that borrows strength across a reporting taxonomy (PP-TS). For validation, we derive a new, approximately unbiased design-based cross-validation score for choosing among direct and smoothed estimators. We study a curated benchmark with verifiable grading and deployed agent traffic graded by humans, each with every outcome observed. In both, the proposed estimators improve on the direct estimators in point and interval estimation, with near-nominal coverage. At the same sampling budget, our score selects as well as an independent validation sample does and estimates the selected estimator's error far more accurately.

AI.tldr: 提出PP-S与PP-TS两种预测驱动平滑估计方法及一个近似无偏的设计型交叉验证评分，在有限标注预算下提升分域均值估计的精度与区间覆盖率。
AI.motivation: AI系统评估需要分域（如基准任务类型、部署代理中的对话类型）的细化评估，但穷尽测试成本高，只能依赖标注单元样本。直接估计器（含预测驱动推断PPI）仅使用本域标签，在标签稀少的域中估计不精确，需要借助小域估计思想跨域借力。
AI.method: 将评估集视为有限总体，目标是各域均值的点估计与区间估计。提出预测驱动平滑（PP-S）：对每个域的PPI估计拟合贝叶斯模型；扩展版PP-TS通过报告分类体系跨域借力。验证方面，推导出新的、近似无偏的设计型交叉验证评分，用于在直接估计器与平滑估计器之间选择。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上验证：一个可验证评分的高质量基准，以及由人工评分的部署代理流量（两者均观测到全部结果）。两种提议估计器在点估计与区间估计上均优于直接估计器，区间覆盖率接近名义水平。在相同抽样预算下，该评分的选择效果与独立验证样本相当，且对所选估计器误差的估计准确得多。
AI.conclusion: 将小域估计与预测驱动推断结合，并配套设计型交叉验证评分，可在不增加标注成本的前提下实现更准确、更可靠的分域评估，形成估计与验证一体化的评估工作流。

title: Seeing Abnormal from Normal: Glomerular Abnormality in Representations of Normal Renal Morphology
summary: Fine-grained evaluation of glomerular pathology must distinguish normal glomeruli from abnormalities such as global and segmental glomerulosclerosis, obsolescent, ischemic, solidified, disappearing, and atubular glomeruli. Supervised classification requires labeled examples of every category, which is impractical when subtypes are rare or absent from the training cohort. One-class anomaly detection offers an alternative by modeling normal data and scoring deviations, allowing previously unseen abnormalities to be detected.
