We use the frozen residual U-Net backbone of Omni-Seg, pretrained to segment structurally normal renal primitives without abnormal-subtype labels. We propose NoRDeC (Normal-Reference Detection and Characterization), a framework combining Mahalanobis normal-reference scoring with layer-wise representation analysis to determine whether and where glomerular pathology is encoded, how spatial aggregation affects detection, and whether abnormalities alter inter-layer relationships differently. Using glomerular images from two institutions, we evaluate backbone layers and aggregation strategies, compare NoRDeC with PaDiM and PatchCore, and analyze representations using centered kernel alignment (CKA). Layer 4 with Center-70 aggregation achieved a pooled AUROC of $0.926\pm0.013$. NoRDeC achieved the highest AUROC in six of seven abnormality categories and in the pooled analysis, while CKA suggested subtype-dependent changes in inter-layer relationships not captured by anomaly scores alone. The normal-reference model is fitted using only normal glomeruli; abnormality labels are used for configuration selection, evaluation, and grouping in the representation analysis. These results show that a frozen renal feature extractor can support both detection and representation-level characterization of glomerular abnormalities without using abnormal examples to fit the detector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoRDeC框架，利用冻结的Omni-Seg残差U-Net骨干，通过马氏距离正常参考评分与逐层表示分析，在仅用正常肾小球拟合检测器的情况下实现对多种肾小球异常的检测与表示级刻画。
AI.motivation: 精细的肾小球病理评估需区分正常与全局性/节段性肾小球硬化、废弃性、缺血性、固化性、消失性及无小管肾小球等多种亚型；监督分类要求每类都有标注样本，当亚型罕见或训练队列中缺失时不可行。单类异常检测通过建模正常数据并对偏离打分，可检测未见过的异常，因此成为替代方案。
AI.method: 使用Omni-Seg中预训练用于分割结构正常肾小球基元、未使用异常亚型标签的冻结残差U-Net骨干；提出NoRDeC框架，结合马氏正常参考评分与逐层表示分析，考察病理信息编码于何处、空间聚合如何影响检测、异常是否以不同方式改变层间关系。基于两家机构的肾小球图像，评估各骨干层与聚合策略，与PaDiM、PatchCore对比，并用中心核对齐（CKA）分析表示。
AI.result: 第4层配合Center-70聚合取得合并AUROC为0.926±0.013；NoRDeC在七类异常中的六类及合并分析中取得最高AUROC；CKA显示亚型依赖的层间关系变化，这些变化无法仅由异常分数捕获。
AI.conclusion: 正常参考模型仅用正常肾小球拟合，异常标签仅用于配置选择、评估及表示分析中的分组。结果表明，冻结的肾脏特征提取器可在不使用异常样本拟合检测器的情况下，同时支持肾小球异常的检测与表示级刻画。

title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: GAVEL 提出以显式图世界模型为核心的 LLM 长时程规划验证与修复框架，在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上将单任务成功率从 41.2% 提升至 91.8%，多任务成功率从 19.9% 提升至 92.6%。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽为长时程机器人规划提供灵活接口，但其生成的计划往往无法满足具身约束、缺乏错误恢复能力，且难以在部分可观测条件下有效推理。
AI.method: 构建显式图世界模型，编码物体关系、动作前置条件与效果，以及未观测物体位置的概率信念；在执行前预测 LLM 动作后果、检测违规并修复可直接由世界模型推导的修正，仅将需语义推理的错误交由 LLM 重新规划；多任务场景下基于物体位置分布重排剩余子任务以最小化期望搜索代价。
AI.result: 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 的 100 个单长时程任务与 500 个多任务指令上评估：使用 Qwen3-8B 时，单任务成功率由 41.2% 提升至 91.8%，多任务成功率由 19.9% 提升至 92.6%；分布信念推理相较静态变体减少约 5.4% 的移动距离。
AI.conclusion: 显式图世界模型支架能显著提升长时程具身规划的可靠性与效率，且对紧凑型与前沿托管 LLM 能力均有效。

title: Closed-World Resolution Against Tool Hallucination in LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents fail in a way no tool-selection or tool-security method addresses: they call tools that do not exist and pass arguments no schema declares. Existing defenses either pick the right tool (selection) or constrain what an agent may do with real tools (gating), both of which presuppose the emitted call refers to a real tool at all. We show this is a structural blind spot: a hallucinated call is by construction not a decision any gate made, so no gate can reject it. This paper is primarily a measurement and benchmark study. We give a five-class taxonomy of tool hallucination (H1-H5) and, as a reference point, the Resolution Rung: a training-free, closed-world resolver (registry membership plus a signature check) whose interest is where it must sit, not what it computes. We prove hallucination defense must precede any causal gate, and characterize the one irreducible residue (borrowed arguments schema-indistinguishable from a valid call). Across ten hosted models under two invocation surfaces we measure 322 genuine hallucinations; fabricated-tool calls concentrate on the unconstrained raw-JSON surface (34 vs. 3), and model scale does not help (a 675B model matches a 7-8B one). We then extend to the Model Context Protocol, where merging several servers into one namespace creates hallucination surfaces a single registry cannot express (a second taxonomy, M1-M5); on the live MCP surface we measure 154 hallucinations, including from frontier models that were clean on the single-registry surface, because collisions and shadowing are structural to the merge. We release the versioned Hallucinated-Tools Benchmark (HTB) so any resolver is comparable across submissions.

AI.tldr: 工具增强LLM智能体存在被工具选择与工具安全方法忽视的结构性盲区：调用不存在的工具并传入无schema声明的参数；本文给出工具幻觉的分类学与基准测量，并提出防御必须前置的论证。
AI.motivation: 现有防御要么做正确工具选择（selection），要么约束智能体对真实工具的行为（gating），二者都预设"发出的调用至少指向真实工具"；而幻觉调用在构造上并非任何门的决策产物，因此任何门都无法拒绝它，形成结构性盲区。
AI.method: 以测量与基准研究为主：(1) 提出五类工具幻觉分类学(H1–H5)；(2) 作为参照实现无训练的闭世界解析器Resolution Rung（注册表成员判定+签名检查），强调其价值在于所处位置而非计算内容；(3) 证明幻觉防御必须前置于任何因果门，并刻画唯一不可约残余（借用参数、与合法调用在schema上不可区分）；(4) 在两种调用表面上评测十个托管模型；(5) 扩展到Model Context Protocol，提出第二套分类学(M1–M5)，刻画多服务器命名空间合并带来的新幻觉面。
AI.result: 在两种调用表面下测得322例真实幻觉；虚构工具调用集中于无约束的raw-JSON表面（34例 vs 3例）；模型规模无帮助（675B模型与7–8B持平）。在实时MCP表面上测得154例幻觉，其中包括在单注册表表面上表现干净的前沿模型，原因是碰撞与遮蔽是命名空间合并的结构性属性。发布版本化的Hallucinated-Tools Benchmark (HTB)，使不同解析器可跨提交比较。
AI.conclusion: 工具幻觉是工具调用流水线中的结构性盲区，无法由后置门控或选择机制消除；防御须置于任何因果门之前，且仍存在一类schema不可区分的不可约残余。MCP命名空间合并引入单注册表无法表达的额外幻觉面，且强模型亦不免疫。HTB为解析器提供统一、可版本化的可比基准。

title: Smart Insole Human Activity Recognition for Continuous Monitoring in Elderly Care
summary: Falls in older adults are often preceded by changes in mobility, balance, and postural transitions. This paper presents a wireless smart insole platform and machine-learning workflow for recognizing sitting, standing, walking, and unstable walking from plantar-pressure and inertial signals. Each insole integrates 16 active pressure-sensing locations and a six-dimensional IMU stream consisting of tri-axial acceleration and angular velocity. Data were collected from 15 healthy adults at 80~Hz and segmented into overlapping windows. Window length and candidate model families were first screened with stratified 10-fold cross-validation; the primary performance estimate was then obtained with participant-independent 5-fold Stratified Group cross-validation, ensuring that all windows from a participant remained in a single fold. Under this protocol, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting (HGB) achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.954 and 0.959 for the left and right feet, respectively, and 0.980 with bilateral sensing. A compact 1D-CNN evaluated with the same participant-independent folds did not significantly outperform HGB ($p=0.0625$). The results show that low-profile footwear sensing can infer activity state from pressure and IMU measurements for participants unseen during training, establishing a basis for activity monitoring and fall prevention in elderly care.

AI.tldr: 提出无线智能鞋垫平台与机器学习流程，用16点足底压力与6维IMU信号识别坐、站、走及不稳行走；在参与者独立5折分组交叉验证下，HGB宏F1达单足0.954/0.959、双足0.980，1D-CNN未显著优于HGB。
AI.motivation: 老年人跌倒常伴随移动能力、平衡与姿势转换的异常变化，需要在训练时未见过的参与者上也能可靠推断活动状态，为老年照护中的活动监测与跌倒预防提供基础。
AI.method: 构建集成16个主动压力感测点与六维IMU（三轴加速度+三轴角速度）的无线智能鞋垫；对15名健康成人以80 Hz采集数据并做重叠窗口切分；先用分层10折交叉验证筛选窗口长度与候选模型族，再用参与者独立的5折分层分组交叉验证（同一参与者所有窗口保持在同一折）作为主性能估计；对比直方图梯度提升（HGB）与紧凑1D-CNN。
AI.result: 在参与者独立验证协议下，HGB宏F1为左脚0.954、右脚0.959，双足融合0.980；同样参与者独立折下评测的紧凑1D-CNN未显著优于HGB（p=0.0625）。
AI.conclusion: 低轮廓鞋内传感可通过足底压力与IMU测量推断活动状态，且在训练未见参与者上依然有效，为老年照护中的活动监测与跌倒预防奠定基础。

title: YNU-HPCC at SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Using Multiple Prediction Headers
summary: This paper describes the participation of the YNU-HPCC team in subtask A of task 11, Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion at SemEval-2025. Our best-performing system employs the RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Approach) model, an improved version of BERT that utilizes the Transformer encoder architecture. We enhanced the output head to allow the model to process one emotion simultaneously. We obtained the official ranking score (0.44), including results from all languages. The entire dataset was translated into English using Google Translate to facilitate subsequent processing. Through probabilistic and attention analyses, we found that (I) a single prediction head performs better than six heads predicting six emotions simultaneously, and (II) training on a uniformly translated English dataset yields better results than using the original dataset. The code is available at: https://github.com/BGWH123/Semeval-2025-task11.

AI.tldr: YNU-HPCC团队在SemEval-2025 Task11子任务A中，采用改进输出头的RoBERTa模型，将数据统一译为英文训练，以单预测头处理单一情感，取得官方排名分数0.44。
AI.motivation: 参与SemEval-2025 Task11子任务A（文本情感桥接）的竞赛任务，探索跨语言文本情感识别中的模型结构设计与数据统一策略的有效性。
AI.method: 基于Transformer编码器架构的RoBERTa模型，改造输出头使模型每次仅处理一种情感；使用Google Translate将全部数据集翻译为英文以统一处理；并通过概率与注意力分析对比不同预测头设计与数据来源的效果。
AI.result: 最佳系统官方排名分数为0.44（包含所有语言结果）。分析发现：(I) 单一预测头优于同时预测六种情感的六个预测头；(II) 在统一翻译的英文数据集上训练优于使用原始数据集。
AI.conclusion: 单预测头结构与统一英文翻译数据的训练策略能提升跨语言文本情感识别性能，验证了模型输出头设计与数据统一处理方式的重要性。代码已开源。

title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) Improves Classification Accuracy of Bacterial Raman Spectral Data Enabling Portable Diagnostics
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the ICLR 2024 Workshop on Practical ML for Low Resource Settings (PML4LRS)
summary: Antimicrobial resistance is expected to claim 10 million lives per year by 2050, and resource-limited regions are most affected. Raman spectroscopy is a novel pathogen diagnostic approach promising rapid and portable antibiotic resistance testing within a few hours, compared to days when using gold standard methods. However, current algorithms for Raman spectra analysis 1) are unable to generalize well on limited datasets across diverse patient populations and 2) require increased complexity due to the necessity of non-trivial pre-processing steps, such as feature extraction, which are essential to mitigate the low-quality nature of Raman spectral data. In this work, we address these limitations using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to enhance model generalization across a diverse array of hyperparameters in clinical bacterial isolate classification tasks. We demonstrate that SAM achieves accuracy improvements of up to 10.5% on a single split, and an increase in average accuracy of 2.7% across all splits in spectral classification tasks over the traditional optimizer, Adam. These results display the capability of SAM to advance the clinical application of AI-powered Raman spectroscopy tools.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Raman光谱病原体耐药性检测中模型泛化差、预处理复杂的问题，引入Sharpness-Aware Minimization（SAM）优化器，在临床菌株分类任务中较Adam最高提升10.5%单次划分准确率、平均提升2.7%。
AI.motivation: 抗菌素耐药性预计2050年每年致死1000万人，资源有限地区受影响最重。Raman光谱可实现数小时内快速便携的耐药性检测，但现有算法在小样本、跨患者群体上泛化能力差，且需依赖特征提取等非平凡预处理以缓解光谱数据低质量问题，导致模型复杂度上升。
AI.method: 采用Sharpness-Aware Minimization（SAM）优化器，在临床细菌分离株的光谱分类任务中提升模型在多样超参数下的泛化能力，并与传统优化器Adam进行对比。
AI.result: SAM在单次数据划分上准确率最高提升10.5%，在所有划分上平均准确率较Adam提升2.7%。
AI.conclusion: SAM能够提升AI驱动的Raman光谱工具的临床适用性，有助于推动其实际落地。

title: Efficient Unified Multimodal Understanding (EUMU): Winning Solution for the MUMU Track at the 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: The Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) Challenge requires a single efficient model to jointly perform multi-concept image tagging, open-vocabulary object detection, and image captioning. We present Efficient Unified Multimodal Understanding (EUMU), the winning solution for the MUMU Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge. EUMU builds on a shared pretrained multimodal model, using its prompt-based capabilities for detection and captioning and training lightweight heads on shared visual features to predict quality, scene, and event tags. Rather than treating the three tasks independently, EUMU applies task-aware inference refinement by reusing task outputs as cross-task cues. For detection, caption cues help recover objects missed by the initial detection. For captioning, detection cues help refine the caption to better reflect the detected objects. For tagging, image statistics refine quality predictions, while caption and detection cues refine scene and event predictions. This design unifies all three tasks within a single model while satisfying the challenge's resource constraints. EUMU contains 239.169M parameters, requires 23.947 GFLOPs, uses 4.5 GB of peak inference memory, and achieves a final challenge score of 17.3409. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Dayoung-Kil/EUMU.

AI.tldr: EUMU 是 MUMU 挑战赛冠军方案，用单一共享多模态模型统一完成图像打标、开放词汇检测与图像描述，并借助跨任务线索进行推理精修，参数量 239.169M，最终得分 17.3409。
AI.motivation: MUMU 挑战赛要求单一高效模型同时完成多概念图像打标、开放词汇目标检测和图像描述，需在资源约束下统一三类任务并提升性能。
AI.method: 基于共享预训练多模态模型：利用其提示能力做检测和描述；在共享视觉特征上训练轻量头预测质量、场景、事件标签；采用任务感知推理精修，将任务输出作为跨任务线索复用——检测用描述线索召回漏检目标，描述用检测线索修正内容，打标用图像统计精修质量预测，并用描述与检测线索精修场景和事件预测。
AI.result: 参数量 239.169M，计算量 23.947 GFLOPs，峰值推理内存 4.5 GB，挑战赛最终得分 17.3409。
AI.conclusion: EUMU 在单一模型内统一三任务并满足资源约束，通过跨任务线索复用提升各任务表现，取得 MUMU 赛道冠军。

title: A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a morphing rotor-distributed aerial robot with flexible continuum links that achieves both high shape adaptability and an expanded wrench space. The flexible continuum links function as soft manipulators, passively conforming to the shape of the environment, while the thrusters distributed along the continuum links expand the feasible thrust wrench space and enable the end-effector to exert large interaction forces. To realize the proposed robot, it is essential to suppress vibrations of the lightweight continuum links. Thus, we develop a composite leaf-spring structure that provides both high torsional and vertical stiffness, and vibration-suppressing control methods. Using these implementations, we demonstrate stable flight and a variety of aerial manipulation tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to realize aerial manipulations using flexible links with an integrated thruster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种带有柔性连续体连杆的变形转子分布式空中机器人，兼具高形状适应性与扩展的力旋量空间，并实现稳定飞行与多种空中操作任务。
AI.motivation: 空中操作是扩展空中机器人应用的关键。实现通用空中操作的两大方向是：用软体机械臂获得高环境适应性，以及沿机械臂分布推进器以扩展可行力旋量空间。然而现有机器人无法同时满足这两项要求。
AI.method: 提出变形转子分布式空中机器人，采用柔性连续体连杆：连杆作为软体机械臂被动顺应环境形状，沿连杆分布的推进器扩展可行推力旋量空间并使末端执行器可施加较大交互力。为抑制轻质连续体连杆的振动，设计了兼具高扭转与垂向刚度的复合板簧结构，并开发了抑振控制方法。
AI.result: 借助上述实现，演示了稳定飞行以及多种空中操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个使用集成推进器的柔性连杆实现空中操作的工作，同时实现了高形状适应性与扩展的力旋量空间。

title: The syntax and semantics of goals
comment: To appear in Topics in Cognitive Science, special issue on Goal-Centric Perspectives in Cognitive Science
summary: In both cognitive science and computer science, goals are conceptualized as cognitive states that flexibly combine with world knowledge to organize and specify purposeful behavior. In this way, goals are compositional representations whose content relates to rational behavior. We here draw attention to goals as representations and their content because it highlights a parallel with other areas in cognitive science - in particular, the syntax-semantics interface in linguistics and logic - while also foregrounding foundational questions about the expressivity, design, and efficiency of different goal representations. For example, goals are typically taken as fixed and imposing constraints on desirable behaviors, but we can also identify constraints on goal representations themselves, such as whether a particular goal language is sufficiently expressive to capture behaviors of interest, or whether different goal representations capture the same behavior. Here, we synthesize work that aims to characterize the properties of different goal representations and suggest these are points of a broader design space. We close by discussing how distinguishing the form and meaning of goals can elucidate the implicit assumptions we make about goals, inform the study of interactions between higher-level cognition and motivation, and isolate axes of variation for different conceptions of goals.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将"目标"视为可组合的表征，其内容与理性行为相关联，并借用语言学与逻辑学中"句法-语义界面"的视角，刻画不同目标表征的可表达性、设计与效率等属性，将其组织为一个广义的设计空间。
AI.motivation: 在认知科学与计算机科学中，目标通常被当作固定不变、对理想行为施加约束的实体，而关于目标表征本身的属性（如表达力、不同表征是否刻画同一行为）这一更基础的问题常被忽视。作者希望通过强调"目标作为表征及其内容"，凸显与认知科学其他领域（尤其是语言学的句法-语义界面及逻辑学）的类比，并引出这些基础性议题。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述/理论性论文。作者综合（synthesize）了旨在刻画不同目标表征属性的既有研究，借鉴语言学与逻辑中"形式与意义"的区分，分析目标表征的可表达性、约束条件及其相互等价性，并将这些属性视为一个更广泛"设计空间"中的不同维度/坐标点。
AI.result: 作者指出对目标表征本身也存在约束（如某种目标语言是否足够表达所关注的行为、不同表征是否刻画相同行为），并将既有研究归纳为该设计空间中的若干关键属性维度。
AI.conclusion: 区分目标的"形式"与"意义"有助于澄清我们对目标所作的隐含假设，促进对高层认知与动机之间交互的研究，并分离出不同目标概念之间的变异维度。

title: Stiefel Attention: When the Geometry of Transformer Projection Matrices Dominates Optimizer Choice---and When It Does Not
summary: The query and key projections $\WQ,\WK$ in attention are almost always trained by Euclidean optimizers with no constraint on their geometry. We constrain them to the Stiefel manifold and optimize them there with a Riemannian Adam that carries one scalar second moment per frame, caps its step by a trust region, and retracts polarly. Four propositions prove this update is steepest descent in the embedded metric, independent of gradient scale, well conditioned, and exactly $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariant, each certified numerically in \texttt{float64}. A fifth supplies the mechanism: weight decay has \emph{identically zero} Riemannian gradient on $\St(d,r)$, since $W = W I_r$ lies in the normal space, so the learned attention geometry survives the collapse cycles that decay drives through the rest of the model. On modular arithmetic grokking, a single run holds $97.0\%$ validation accuracy at epoch 20\,000 against the baseline's $61.1\%$---an unstable endpoint we report as evidence for the mechanism rather than as an effect size. On CIFAR-10 patches the same rule gains $\mathbf{+8.98}$\,pp over 12 paired starts ($t{=}60.6$, $12/12$), and the gap widens with data rather than eroding. The step rule earns this: a fixed-step Riemannian update is degree one in the gradient, so it moves $24$--$40\times$ less per step than an identically shaped AdamW matrix---its frames barely leave their initialization, and freezing them outright costs only $0.28$\,pp. An ablation credits the whole gain to making the step scale free, and nothing measurable to the projector or to equivariance. A negative result sharpens the account: gauge removal cannot motivate the method, because a direction along which the loss is invariant carries no gradient at all.

AI.tldr: 将注意力中的查询/键投影约束到Stiefel流形，用Riemannian Adam（单标量二阶矩、信赖域步长上限、极分解回缩）优化；给出四条更新性质命题与一条权重衰减机制命题，并在模算术grokking与CIFAR-10 patches上验证。
AI.motivation: 注意力中的 \WQ、\WK 通常由欧氏优化器训练且对其几何无约束；作者希望用流形约束获得更稳定、更保几何的注意力结构，并解释权重衰减为何不会破坏该几何。
AI.method: 把 \WQ、\WK 约束在 Stiefel 流形 \St(d,r) 上，使用 Riemannian Adam 优化：每帧仅携带一个标量二阶矩、以信赖域限制步长、采用极分解回缩。用五个命题刻画该更新：四条证明其为嵌入度量下的最速下降、与梯度尺度无关、良条件、且具有精确的 O(d)-等变性（并在 float64 下数值验证）；第五条指出权重衰减在 \St(d,r) 上的 Riemannian 梯度恒为零（因 W=WI_r 位于法空间），故注意力几何可在衰减引起的塌缩循环中幸存。
AI.result: 模算术 grokking：第 20000 轮单次运行验证准确率 97.0%，基线 61.1%（作者将其作为机制证据而非效应量）。CIFAR-10 patches：相对 12 组配对起点提升 +8.98 pp（t=60.6，12/12），且差距随数据量增大而非缩小。固定步长 Riemannian 更新的步长与梯度呈一次关系，每步移动量比同形状的 AdamW 矩阵小 24–40 倍，帧几乎不离开初始化，直接冻结仅损失 0.28 pp。消融显示增益全部来自“步长尺度自由”，投影器与等变性无可测贡献。一个负结果：规范（gauge）消除不能作为方法动机，因为损失不变方向根本不存在梯度。
AI.conclusion: 在 Stiefel 流形上用 Riemannian Adam 约束 \WQ、\WK 可获得稳定的注意力几何，其增益主要由自由的步长尺度带来；权重衰减的零 Riemannian 梯度解释了该几何在训练中的持久性，而投影器与等变性并非增益来源。

title: Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in the processing and modeling of many languages. Yet, unlike human multilinguals, they exhibit surprisingly limited cross-lingual knowledge transfer. While this limitation is well documented, its origins during multilingual training remain unclear. We pretrain 360M- and 7B-parameter LLMs and show that poor cross-lingual knowledge generalization emerges during pretraining and persists under standard interventions. To isolate its cause, we employ a controlled bilingual pretraining setting using two copies of the same language, sharing identical text and token segmentation, but mapped to disjoint token spaces. We find that disjoint tokens alone are enough to induce knowledge compartmentalization, even between identical copies of the same language, establishing disjoint token spaces as a fundamental barrier to cross-lingual knowledge generalization. Guided by this understanding, we suggest mapping languages into a shared token space by simple word-wise translation and find it substantially improves cross-lingual knowledge generalization, recovering up to 12.6\% of native-language learning efficiency --- 14$\times$ the baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多语言大模型中跨语言知识迁移受限的成因，发现分词空间不相交是根本障碍，并提出词级翻译映射到共享分词空间的方法显著提升跨语言知识泛化。
AI.motivation: 人类多语者具备较强的跨语言知识迁移能力，而LLM尽管在多语言处理上进展显著，却表现出出人意料的跨语言知识迁移局限。该现象虽被广泛记录，但其在多语言训练过程中的起源仍不清楚，本文旨在揭示其成因。
AI.method: 预训练360M与7B参数的LLM；采用受控双语预训练设置，使用同一语言的两种副本，共享相同文本与分词切分但映射到不相交的分词空间，以隔离变量；并据此提出通过简单词级翻译将各语言映射到共享分词空间。
AI.result: 差劲的跨语言知识泛化在预训练阶段即出现，且在标准干预下持续存在；仅分词空间不相交即可导致知识区隔化，即使语言是同一语言的相同副本；共享分词空间映射使跨语言知识泛化显著改善，最多恢复12.6%的母语学习效率，为基线的14倍。
AI.conclusion: 分词空间不相交是跨语言知识泛化的根本障碍；将语言映射到共享分词空间是提升多语言模型跨语言知识迁移的有效方向。

title: Compressed Active Subspaces for Scalable Bayesian Inference
summary: Active subspace methods provide a framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty in high-dimensional models by identifying and performing inference along parameter directions that have the greatest influence on the model output. However, the construction of active subspaces requires storing many full-dimensional model gradients, which becomes prohibitive as model size increases. We address this limitation by proposing Compressed Active Subspaces (CAS), a scalable approach that first maps the model parameters to a compressed space using a structured isometric embedding and then constructs the active subspace within this reduced parameterization. Our approach substantially reduces the memory required for active subspace construction and enables Bayesian inference for large models where standard active subspace methods become impractical. We demonstrate the scalability of CAS on neural networks of increasing size while maintaining predictive performance and robust uncertainty estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出压缩活跃子空间（CAS），通过结构化等距嵌入将参数映射到压缩空间后再构造活跃子空间，大幅降低内存需求，实现大模型的可扩展贝叶斯推断。
AI.motivation: 活跃子空间方法可量化高维模型的预测不确定性，但其构造需存储大量全维梯度，随模型规模增大内存开销难以承受，标准方法在大型模型上不再实用。
AI.method: 提出CAS：先用结构化等距嵌入将模型参数映射到压缩空间，再在降维后的参数化中构造活跃子空间，从而减少活跃子空间构造的内存占用。
AI.result: 在规模递增的神经网络上验证了CAS的可扩展性，同时保持预测性能与稳健的不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: CAS使活跃子空间方法可扩展至大型模型，在保持性能与不确定性质量的前提下显著降低内存开销，为大规模贝叶斯推断提供可行途径。

title: ParticleSplat: Self-supervised Object-centric Latent Particle Splatting
summary: We present ParticleSplat, a self-supervised object-centric learning method that decomposes scenes into a set of latent ''particles'' representing semantic entities through feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, which represents images as a set of particles with attributes such as position, scale, and visual appearance, we address a key limitation of DLP: its inherently 2D nature, which prevents explicit 3D spatial and geometric reasoning that are critical for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation. Leveraging the structural similarity between latent particles and 3D Gaussian primitives, we introduce a 3D latent particle space trained with a novel view synthesis objective. Our model jointly encodes multiple views with camera poses into a shared 3D object-centric latent space, then transforms particles into particle-aligned 3D Gaussians whose composition reconstructs the full scene. On simulated and real-world datasets, we show that this formulation inherently learns object masks without supervision and supports controllable 3D scene editing, such as moving objects by modifying particles in the latent space. We further establish that the learned 3D representation improves downstream performance on robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 ParticleSplat，一种自监督物体中心的 3D 表示学习方法，将场景分解为潜在"粒子"，并通过前馈 3D 高斯泼溅实现具有 3D 空间与几何推理能力的物体级表征。
AI.motivation: 现有 Deep Latent Particles (DLP) 框架虽实现了以粒子表示图像的物体中心分解，但其本质为 2D，缺乏显式 3D 空间与几何推理能力，限制了机器人操作等下游任务的表现。
AI.method: 利用潜在粒子与 3D 高斯原语在结构上的相似性，构建 3D 潜在粒子空间，并以新视角合成作为训练目标。模型将多视角图像与相机位姿联合编码至共享的 3D 物体中心潜在空间，再把粒子转换为与粒子对齐的 3D 高斯，其组合重建完整场景。
AI.result: 在模拟与真实数据集上，该方法无需监督即可学习到物体掩码，并支持可控的 3D 场景编辑（如在潜空间修改粒子以移动物体）；所学的 3D 表示还提升了机器人操作等下游任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: ParticleSplat 通过前馈 3D 高斯泼溅将物体中心表示从 2D 扩展到 3D，兼具自监督物体分解、可控 3D 编辑与下游任务增益，为 3D 物体中心学习提供了有效范式。

title: SemSafe-3DGS: Semantic Risk-Aware Active Navigation in Uncertain 3D Gaussian Splatting Maps
comment: Accepted to be presented at the SeMaNa 2026 Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Autonomous robots operating in partially observed environments must navigate safely while acquiring observations that improve future planning. Existing safety formulations generally reason primarily about geometry. Consequently, geometrically similar scene elements may induce comparable control responses despite having different semantic consequences. We present a semantic risk aware safe-active perception framework for navigation in attributed 3D Gaussian maps. Semantic attributes modulate an Average Value-at-Risk collision clearance model through class dependent risk weights, allowing safety-critical Gaussian primitives to receive greater influence in the composite barrier. The resulting weighted clearances are aggregated into a control barrier function, while a trajectory-relevant active perception barrier promotes observations that reduce geometric map uncertainty along the robot's anticipated motion. Both objectives are integrated in a unified CBF-QP that enforces semantic risk-aware collision avoidance as a hard constraint while relaxing information acquisition when it conflicts with safety or task progress. Experiments demonstrate efficient safety constraint, improved navigation through active perception, semantic dependent trajectory adaptation, and real-robot execution under Ackermann dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出语义风险感知的安全主动感知框架，在3D高斯属性地图中通过类别相关风险权重调节AVaR碰撞裕度，并与主动感知障碍统一集成于CBF-QP中实现安全导航。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境中的自主机器人需在安全导航同时获取有助未来规划的观测。现有安全建模多基于几何，导致几何相似但语义后果不同的场景元素产生相近控制响应，忽视语义风险差异。
AI.method: 面向带属性的3D高斯地图构建框架：1) 语义属性通过类别相关风险权重调节Average Value-at-Risk碰撞裕度模型，使安全关键高斯基元在复合障碍中获得更大影响；2) 加权裕度聚合为控制障碍函数；3) 引入轨迹相关的主动感知障碍，鼓励沿机器人预期运动方向降低几何地图不确定性；4) 二者统一于CBF-QP，将语义风险感知避碰作为硬约束，在信息获取与安全或任务进度冲突时对其松弛。
AI.result: 实验表明：安全约束高效，主动感知提升导航效果，轨迹随语义自适应调整，并在Ackermann动力学真机上完成实机验证。
AI.conclusion: 将语义风险引入安全控制与主动感知的统一优化框架，可在保证硬安全约束的同时兼顾信息获取与任务推进，并具备真实平台可执行性。

title: Compositional Reasoning in Language Models under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training
summary: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we instantiate this framework with data-structure tasks, which provide deterministic reward computation and clear compositional structure. We find a consistent decomposed-to-composed asymmetry: decomposed-skill training does not reliably transfer to composed tasks, whereas composed-task training transfers more readily back to decomposed tasks. We provide theoretical explanation for this asymmetry, and further evaluate compositional generalization under length extrapolation, structural distribution shift, and transfer to tasks requiring unseen skills. Finally, we present a pilot study on real-world tool-calling benchmarks, showing preliminary evidence that the decomposed-to-composed asymmetry can extend to practical settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出依赖图框架形式化组合推理，划分为三个复杂度递增的组合层级，并在数据结构任务上实证发现"分解→组合"的不对称性：分解技能训练难以迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更易迁移回分解任务。
AI.motivation: 训练数据必然有限，模型必须通过以新方式组合已学技能来泛化；而RL等后训练方法虽大幅提升语言模型推理能力，但其对组合推理的影响尚不清晰。
AI.method: 提出依赖图（dependency-graph）框架形式化组合推理，定义三个复杂度递增的组合层级；以数据结构任务为实例（具备确定性奖励计算与清晰组合结构），对比分解技能训练与组合任务训练的双向迁移；结合理论分析解释不对称性，并在长度外推、结构分布偏移及需未见技能的任务迁移下评估组合泛化，最后在真实工具调用基准上做试点研究。
AI.result: 发现一致的分解→组合不对称：分解技能训练不能可靠迁移至组合任务，而组合任务训练更易反向迁移至分解任务；理论分析给出解释；在长度外推、结构分布偏移、未见技能迁移等设定下进一步评估；真实工具调用基准上显示该不对称性可能延伸至实际场景的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 组合推理中的分解-组合不对称性在理论上可解释、在多设定下可复现，并初步显现于真实工具调用任务，表明组合任务训练在促进泛化上可能优于单纯的分解技能训练。

title: Machine-Learning Assessment of the Predictive Value of Inflammatory Biomarkers for Cognitive Impairment in an Older Hispanic Adult Cohort
summary: Small clinical tabular datasets require interpretable machine learning because deep learning is often impractical and ensemble models can be difficult to inspect. A key pitfall is that statistical significance does not necessarily imply predictive utility. Using data from the Panama Aging Research Initiative--Health Disparities (PARI-HD) cohort (n=165), we implemented a leakage-safe threshold-likelihood Bernoulli/Categorical Naive Bayes (BNB/CNB) classifier. Within every training fold, each continuous predictor was reduced to a supervised chi-square-derived state, while income entered the model through a categorical likelihood. All data-dependent steps were performed within repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation with 30 repeats. The demographic baseline achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.630 +/- 0.017. I-309 (CCL1) was the dominant incremental feature, increasing AUC by 0.110, with paired DeLong tests yielding p<0.05 in 100% of repeats. In the pre-specified primary analysis, I-309 produced a fixed-partition DeLong p=0.0018, with robustness assessed across 200 random partitions, where the median p-value was 0.0011. Within the exploratory family of 18 candidate markers, I-309 achieved a Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted q=0.032 on the frozen partition and satisfied q<0.05 in 85% of random partitions, whereas no other marker demonstrated reliable incremental predictive value. Because the fitted model is an inspectable table of thresholds and class-conditional probabilities, these results identify I-309/CCL1 as an interpretable candidate feature for tabular prediction of cognitive impairment, pending external validation.

AI.tldr: 在PARI-HD队列(n=165)中,采用防泄漏阈值似然朴素贝叶斯分类器,发现I-309(CCL1)是预测认知障碍的可解释增量特征。
AI.motivation: 小型临床表格数据集需要可解释的机器学习方法,因为深度学习往往不实用,集成模型难以审查。关键陷阱是统计显著性并不必然意味着预测效用。
AI.method: 使用PARI-HD队列(n=165)数据,实现防泄漏的阈值似然伯努利/类别朴素贝叶斯(BNB/CNB)分类器。在每个训练折内,将连续预测变量转化为监督式卡方导出的状态,收入通过类别似然进入模型。所有依赖数据的步骤均在重复分层10折交叉验证(30次重复)内完成。
AI.result: 人口学基线ROC-AUC为0.630±0.017。I-309(CCL1)为最主要增量特征,AUC提升0.110,配对DeLong检验在100%的重复中p<0.05。预定主分析中,I-309的固定划分DeLong p=0.0018,并在200次随机划分中评估稳健性,中位p值为0.0011。在18个候选标志物的探索性分析中,I-309在冻结划分上获得BH校正q=0.032,并在85%的随机划分中满足q<0.05,而其他标志物均未表现出可靠的增量预测价值。
AI.conclusion: 由于拟合模型是可审查的阈值与类条件概率表,这些结果将I-309/CCL1确定为用于认知障碍表格预测的可解释候选特征,有待外部验证。

title: A frontend-backend architecture for tool calls in full-duplex speech models
summary: Full-duplex speech-to-speech (S2S) models provide natural, low-latency conversational interaction and would benefit from the ability to use external tools and complete voice-agent tasks. We propose a frontend-backend architecture where a duplex speech-to-text frontend learns to emit a delegation token and forwards streaming ASR transcripts to a text-based backend LLM for tool calls. Tool-call results from the backend are injected back into the frontend through a lightweight prefill-and-repeat mechanism and then synthesized using streaming TTS to the user. Our approach largely preserves regular duplex turn-taking, interruption handling, and low-latency interaction as it requires minimal modifications to the frontend model. In a single-turn tool-call evaluation, our system achieves 92-97% tool-call recall, competitive tool-call prediction performance, and 81.2% accuracy in rejecting irrelevant calls. When equipped with a larger backend (e.g., Qwen3-235B-A22B), our system achieves competitive results on Full-Duplex-Bench-V3 compared to open and closed source models, and significantly outperforms GPT-realtime-mini and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on EVA-Bench. These results demonstrate that backend delegation is an effective and modular approach for combining natural duplex speech interaction with strong agentic tool-call capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出前后端解耦的全双工语音对话架构：前端双工语音识别学习输出委派令牌并将流式转写转发给文本后端大模型执行工具调用，结果经轻量级预填充-重复机制回注前端并由流式TTS合成语音回复，在保留自然轮次转换与低延迟的同时获得强工具调用能力。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音到语音（S2S）模型可提供自然、低延迟的对话交互，但缺乏使用外部工具、完成语音智能体任务的能力。直接在全双工语音模型中端到端地集成工具调用难度大，且易破坏其原有的轮次转换、打断处理与低延迟特性，因此需要一种模块化方案将强智能体工具调用能力引入双工语音交互。
AI.method: 采用前端-后端架构。前端为双工语音转文本模型，学习在需要时输出委派令牌（delegation token），并将流式ASR转写转发给文本后端LLM以发起工具调用；后端返回的工具调用结果通过轻量级的"预填充-重复"（prefill-and-repeat）机制回注至前端，再由流式TTS合成给用户。该方法对前端模型改动极小，从而基本保持常规双工轮次转换、打断处理与低延迟交互。
AI.result: 单轮工具调用评测中，系统取得92–97%的工具调用召回率、具竞争力的工具调用预测性能，以及81.2%的无关调用拒绝准确率。配备更大后端（如Qwen3-235B-A22B）时，在Full-Duplex-Bench-V3上取得与开源及闭源模型相当的结果，并在EVA-Bench上显著优于GPT-realtime-mini与Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 后端委派是一种有效且模块化的方法，可在保留自然双工语音交互的同时，赋予系统强大的智能体工具调用能力。

title: Learn Your Own Thoughts: Abstract Token Curriculum
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable reasoning capabilities by utilizing chain-of-thought (CoT) as a scratchpad for intermediate stages of thinking. However, CoT techniques require explicit supervision on thinking tokens, which requires rich, task-specific data. In this work, we propose Abstract Token Curriculum (ATC), a novel curriculum learning framework that elicits effective continuous intermediate representations without direct supervision or manual scratchpad design. ATC gradually increases problem complexity through a sequence of distributions, training the model to develop internal abstract ``thoughts'' in the continuous representation space. This paper provides both theoretical and experimental evidence for the benefits of ATC and its advantages over previous methods for training continuous thoughts. Theoretically, we show that for learning parity functions with single-layer softmax attention using ATC, attention naturally focuses on the CoT tokens in the context that provide the ``easiest path'' to predicting the next token. Experimentally, we show ATC's effectiveness on graph reachability and arithmetic learning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出抽象令牌课程（ATC），一种无需显式监督或人工草稿设计的课程学习框架，通过在连续表示空间中逐步增加问题复杂度，引导模型自发形成有效的连续内部"思维"表示。
AI.motivation: CoT 依赖对思维令牌的显式监督，需要大量任务特定数据；本文希望摆脱这种监督依赖与人工草稿设计，自动获得有效的连续中间表示。
AI.method: ATC 课程学习框架：按一系列分布逐步提升问题复杂度进行训练，使模型在连续表示空间中发展出抽象的"思维"；理论上针对单层 softmax 注意力学习奇偶校验函数，分析 ATC 下注意力会自然聚焦于上下文中提供"最易路径"的 CoT 令牌。
AI.result: 提供了理论与实验两方面证据，证明 ATC 的有效性及其相对于以往连续思维训练方法的优势；在图可达性与算术学习任务上验证了效果。
AI.conclusion: ATC 可在无直接监督、无人工草稿设计的情况下诱导有效的连续中间表示，为训练连续思维提供了新的课程学习途径。

title: SCOUT: Sim-to-Real Text-Based Person Retrieval by Embedding-Space Prediction over Frozen Video Features
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI City Challenge (Track 4). Code and annotations: https://github.com/abtraore/SCOUT-ECCV
summary: Text-based person retrieval under a sim-to-real gap (synthetic training data, a real-image gallery) is usually tackled with costly fine-tuned cross-encoders. We ask whether a frozen-encoder system can compete. We present SCOUT, which casts cross-modal retrieval as prediction in embedding space. A trainable predictor maps the patch tokens of a frozen video encoder into the embedding space of a frozen text encoder under a bidirectional InfoNCE objective, and no encoder is fine-tuned in the base model. The video encoder is V-JEPA, the text encoder is EmbeddingGemma, and the predictor is initialized from a Qwen3.5-0.8B decoder. We make three findings. First, the best frozen text encoder is simply the one whose geometry best matches the video features. A training-free alignment score ranks three candidate text encoders in the same order as their retrieval accuracy on our held-out split (Spearman $ρ= 1.0$); a fourth, LLM-based encoder shows the rule is metric-dependent, holding for a neighborhood-overlap score ($ρ= 0.8$) but not for a linear probe ($ρ= -0.2$). Second, two precision-targeted levers, parameter-efficient ExPLoRA adaptation of the video encoder and a training-free attribute-decomposed reranker built on a vision-language model, improve the top-rank precision that otherwise limits the frozen system, adding 2.2 points of leaderboard R@1. Third, a local-versus-public calibration study explains which interventions transfer to the real domain. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 the full retrieve-fuse-rerank system reaches 84.25 mAP@10 on the final leaderboard, while a single frozen model submitted alone reaches 60.63. Our trained components cost about 95 GPU-hours. CMP, the dataset authors' fine-tuned cross-encoder that trains for sixteen GPU-days, is one fusion member of the full system, not an alternative. Code and annotations: https://github.com/abtraore/SCOUT-ECCV

AI.tldr: 提出SCOUT系统，将跨模态检索建模为嵌入空间预测：冻结视频编码器（V-JEPA）与冻结文本编码器（EmbeddingGemma）不微调，仅训练一个由Qwen3.5-0.8B初始化的预测器，用双向InfoNCE将视频patch token映射到文本嵌入空间，在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4上以约95 GPU小时达到84.25 mAP@10。
AI.motivation: 在合成数据训练、真实图像检索的sim-to-real场景下，文本-行人检索通常依赖昂贵微调的交叉编码器；作者希望验证冻结编码器系统能否与之竞争，以降低训练成本并提升可迁移性。
AI.method: SCOUT将跨模态检索转化为嵌入空间预测：可训练预测器把冻结视频编码器（V-JEPA）的patch token映射到冻结文本编码器（EmbeddingGemma）的嵌入空间，目标函数为双向InfoNCE，基座模型不微调任何编码器，预测器由Qwen3.5-0.8B解码器初始化。此外使用两个面向精度的手段：视频编码器的参数高效ExPLoRA适配，以及基于视觉语言模型的免训练属性分解重排器；并进行本地-公开的校准研究以判断哪些干预可迁移到真实域。
AI.result: 一、最佳冻结文本编码器只需其几何结构与视频特征最匹配：免训练对齐分数对三个候选文本编码器的排序与留出集检索精度完全一致（Spearman ρ=1.0），但第四个大模型编码器显示该规律依赖度量（邻域重叠分数 ρ=0.8，线性探针 ρ=-0.2）。二、ExPLoRA适配与属性分解重排器提升首位精度，排行榜R@1增加2.2点。三、在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4排行榜上，完整retrieve-fuse-rerank系统达84.25 mAP@10，单独提交的单一冻结模型为60.63；训练组件约耗95 GPU小时，而数据集作者微调16 GPU天的交叉编码器CMP只是完整系统的一个融合成员。
AI.conclusion: 冻结编码器系统在sim-to-real文本-行人检索中可与微调交叉编码器竞争，甚至把后者作为融合成员之一；关键结论是文本编码器的选择应以其几何与视频特征的对齐度为准，且仅需少量训练成本即可获得高精度，但精度提升主要来自针对top-rank的适配与重排，且干预的可迁移性需通过本地-公开校准来判定。

title: Dynamic-LIVO: A Dynamic-Aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry System Using Spatio-Temporal Normals
summary: This paper proposes Dynamic-LIVO, a dynamic-aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) system for robust state estimation and static colored mapping in dynamic environments. Dynamic-LIVO employs Spatio-Temporal (S-T) normal analysis to identify dynamic LiDAR points and propagates the resulting classification to both LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial updates, preventing dynamic LiDAR measurements and their associated visual observations from affecting state estimation and mapping. However, S-T normal estimation can be unreliable in newly observed and spatially sparse regions due to insufficient spatio-temporal observations. To address this issue, we introduce a time-delayed S-T normal estimation strategy that defers the classification of insufficiently constrained points and re-evaluates them as additional observations become available. This strategy improves dynamic classification reliability while preserving valid static points for map construction. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets with diverse sensor configurations demonstrate that Dynamic-LIVO improves localization accuracy and produces cleaner static colored maps in challenging dynamic environments. The source code and self-collected dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dynamic-LIVO，一种动态感知的 LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry 系统，可在动态环境中实现鲁棒状态估计与静态彩色建图。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的动态物体会污染 LiDAR 和视觉观测，破坏状态估计与建图的一致性，因此需要识别并剔除动态点，同时避免误删有效静态点。
AI.method: 采用时空（S-T）法向分析识别动态 LiDAR 点，并将其分类结果传播到 LiDAR-惯性与视觉-惯性更新中；针对新观测和空间稀疏区域 S-T 法向估计不可靠的问题，引入时间延迟 S-T 法向估计策略，推迟约束不足点的分类并在获得更多观测后重新评估。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和自采数据集（多种传感器配置）上的大量实验表明，该方法提升了定位精度，并在挑战性动态环境中生成更干净的静态彩色地图。
AI.conclusion: Dynamic-LIVO 通过动态感知与延迟重评估策略，在保持静态地图构建的同时提高了动态环境下的定位鲁棒性与建图质量，源码与自采数据集将在录用后公开。

title: Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models
summary: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用轻量MLP探针从LLaMA-3.1-8B的内部激活中检测有害提示，验证模型内部已隐含危害判断信息，F1最高达99%，性能可比千倍大模型防护且延迟和算力开销更低。
AI.motivation: 自主系统日益依赖LLM，但现有外部防护模型带来延迟与算力开销，且无法感知模型内部工作机制，存在根本性的保障缺口。作者由此提出核心问题：模型自身是否已知内容有害？
AI.method: 从LLaMA-3.1-8B提取激活，训练轻量级MLP分类探针（12.6M参数）用于检测有害提示，并在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0三个数据集上评估。
AI.result: 探针在三个数据集上的F1分数分别为99%、83%和84%，性能可与体量大1000倍的防护模型竞争，同时降低延迟与算力成本。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部激活已包含足够的有害性判别信息，无需依赖外部大型防护模型，轻量探针即可实现高效、低开销的安全检测，为资源受限、时间敏感场景提供可行方案。

title: FCx: An algorithm for finding Feasible Counterfactual Explanations
summary: Counterfactual (CF) explanations identify changes that alter an input's classification. While existing methods produce realistic and low-cost CFs, they often fail to ensure feasibility, by suggesting non-constructive modifications or incompatible with future changes (e.g., changing an individual's race to secure a job offer). We introduce a refinement of CF explanations that explicitly enforces feasibility. Our approach is the first to efficiently generate CFs that are realistic, low-cost and feasible. We accommodate both hard feasible constraints, specified by domain knowledge users, and soft feasible constraints, inferred automatically via causal inference from the dataset. Our method, Feasible Counterfactual Explanations (FCx), is based on a modified Variational Autoencoder (VAE) optimized with a multi-factor loss function. We measure the cost of a change based on the absolute change in values (proximity) as well as the number of features changed (sparsity) while realism is measured based on the LOF for density estimation, guaranteeing that CFs reside in densely populated regions. Extensive experiments on four public datasets show that our approach matches state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics while guaranteeing feasibility.

AI.tldr: 提出Feasible Counterfactual Explanations (FCx)，基于改进VAE与多因子损失，在保证可行性的同时兼顾真实性、低代价与稀疏性，并在四个公开数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实解释方法虽能生成真实、低代价的CF，但往往不能保证可行性：会给出非构造性修改，或与后续变化不兼容（如通过改变种族来获得工作机会）。因此需要一个显式强制可行性的CF精化方法。
AI.method: FCx基于改进的变分自编码器（VAE），使用多因子损失函数优化。同时处理两类可行性约束：由领域知识用户指定的硬约束，以及通过因果推断从数据集中自动推断的软约束。代价以数值绝对变化（proximity）和改变特征数量（sparsity）度量，真实性以LOF密度估计度量，确保CF位于高密度区域。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上进行的大量实验表明，该方法在多项指标上匹配SOTA性能，同时保证可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次高效生成兼具真实性、低代价与可行性的反事实解释，通过硬/软可行性约束统一建模，为CF解释的落地可用性提供了新范式。

title: The Role of Fine-grained Harm Signals in LLM Safety
summary: Prior work has shown that internal harmfulness representations in large language models vary across risk categories, while sharing a common general harm representation component. This raises a question about the role of the category-specific component beyond general harm representation in LLM safety. To answer this question, we isolate the category-specific component by removing shared general harmfulness representation from each categorical harmfulness representation, yielding a category residual that is orthogonal to general harmfulness at every layer. Using activation steering with category residuals across 11 risk categories in 3 instruction-tuned LLMs, we find that whether category residuals encode harmfulness varies across categories, and that this category-wise pattern is similar across models. Whether category residuals induce refusal also varies across categories, but this category-wise pattern is more model-dependent. We also find that category residuals increase LLMs' downstream internal alignment with shared general harmfulness representation. Together, these findings demonstrate that more fine-grained category residuals should also be considered beyond shared general harmfulness representation to fully understand LLM safety. More broadly, our findings show that even a direction orthogonal to a concept at one layer can contribute to the concept's downstream amplification.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过从各风险类别危害表征中移除共享的通用危害表征，得到与之正交的"类别残差"，并利用激活引导在3个指令微调LLM、11类风险上分析其在危害编码与拒答行为中的作用。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明LLM内部危害表征在不同风险类别间存在差异，但共享一个通用危害表征成分。这引出问题：除通用危害表征之外，类别特异成分在LLM安全中扮演什么角色？
AI.method: 从每个类别危害表征中去除共享通用危害表征，得到在每一层均与通用危害正交的类别残差；在3个指令微调LLM的11个风险类别上，使用激活引导（activation steering）检验类别残差对危害编码与拒答的因果影响，并分析其与下游内部对齐的关系。
AI.result: 类别残差是否编码危害性因类别而异，且该类别模式在不同模型间相似；类别残差是否诱导拒答也因类别而异，但该模式更依赖模型；此外，类别残差会增强LLM下游与共享通用危害表征的内部对齐。
AI.conclusion: 理解LLM安全不仅需关注共享通用危害表征，还应考虑更细粒度的类别残差；更广泛地，某一层上与某概念正交的方向仍可促进该概念的下游放大。

title: Dual-Axis Policy Optimization for LLM Agents: Bayesian Feedback Attribution and Trajectory Mass Normalization
summary: Reinforcement learning for LLM agents involves two distinct optimization di- mensions: how environment feedback is exploited within a trajectory, and how complete trajectories are aggregated across a batch. We formulate these dimen- sions as Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution and Inter-Trajectory Objec- tive Aggregation, and introduce BATON (Bayesian Attribution and Trajectory Objective Normalization), a dual-axis policy optimization framework. BATON instantiates the first axis with Bayesian Feedback Attribution, which constructs a feedback-conditioned posterior over sampled actions, and the second with Trajec- tory Mass Normalization (TMN), which assigns equal optimization mass to com- plete trajectories. Experiments with GRPO and GiGPO on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA show that both axes provide independent gains and that their combi- nation consistently achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BATON框架，将LLM智能体的强化学习优化分为两条轴：轨迹内反馈归因与轨迹间目标聚合，分别用贝叶斯反馈归因和轨迹质量归一化实现，实验验证两轴独立增益且组合最优。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的强化学习涉及两个不同的优化维度：如何在单条轨迹内利用环境反馈，以及如何在批次中聚合完整轨迹。现有方法往往未对这两个维度进行明确区分和系统研究。
AI.method: 提出BATON（Bayesian Attribution and Trajectory Objective Normalization）双轴策略优化框架。第一轴为贝叶斯反馈归因（Bayesian Feedback Attribution），在采样动作上构建以反馈为条件的后验分布；第二轴为轨迹质量归一化（Trajectory Mass Normalization, TMN），为每条完整轨迹分配相等的优化质量。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA上，结合GRPO与GiGPO进行实验。结果表明两条轴各自带来独立增益，且二者组合在不同模型规模下均一致取得最强的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM智能体强化学习明确分解为轨迹内反馈归因与轨迹间目标聚合两个维度具有理论价值；BATON框架通过双轴协同优化有效提升性能，具备良好的通用性与可扩展性。

title: AMB3R-SLAM: Kilometer-scale SLAM with Hierarchical Backend
summary: We present AMB3R-SLAM, a real-time monocular SLAM system capable of reconstructing kilometer-scale trajectories over 10k frames on a single consumer-grade GPU. Our model couples a lightweight front-end for low-latency online tracking with a hierarchical backend that progressively enforces local, mid-level, and global consistency. By avoiding bundle adjustment that relies on the static world assumption, our system naturally handles complex dynamic scenes out of the box. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method can be extended to leverage stereo, RGB-D, and LiDAR as additional inputs. AMB3R-SLAM achieves strong camera tracking performance across 9 datasets, reducing the absolute trajectory error (ATE) of previous state-of-the-art methods on VBR and Oxford Spires by over 70%. With additional LiDAR input, our model further reduces ATE to sub-meter level on KITTI and VBR datasets.

AI.tldr: AMB3R-SLAM 是一个实时单目 SLAM 系统，可在单张消费级 GPU 上重建超过 1 万帧、千米级轨迹，并通过分层后端避免依赖静态世界假设的捆绑调整，天然支持动态场景。
AI.motivation: 现有 SLAM 方法多依赖静态世界假设的捆绑调整，在复杂动态场景下表现受限，且难以在消费级硬件上实现千米级、上万帧的实时重建，同时缺乏对多种额外传感器输入的灵活扩展能力。
AI.method: 系统采用轻量级前端实现低延迟在线跟踪，配合分层后端逐步施加局部、中层与全局一致性约束；通过避开基于静态世界假设的捆绑调整，自然应对动态场景；并可扩展融合双目、RGB-D 与 LiDAR 等额外输入。
AI.result: 在 9 个数据集上取得强劲的相机跟踪性能，在 VBR 与 Oxford Spires 上将先前最先进方法的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低超过 70%；引入额外 LiDAR 输入后，在 KITTI 与 VBR 数据集上进一步将 ATE 降至亚米级。
AI.conclusion: AMB3R-SLAM 验证了在消费级 GPU 上实现公里级、长序列实时单目 SLAM 的可行性，其分层一致性机制与多传感器扩展能力在动态场景与多数据集上均表现优异。

title: ViLoMan: Learning Visual-Proprioceptive Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Skills for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires adaptive whole-body coordination to seamlessly integrate locomotion and physical interaction. Despite recent advances, learning autonomous loco-manipulation remains challenging due to the scarcity of diverse, physically executable robot-object interaction data and the difficulty of learning unified whole-body control directly from onboard observations. We present ViLoMan, a scalable framework for autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation. ViLoMan first transforms partial kinematic demonstrations of human-object interactions into complete, physically executable robot trajectories. It then leverages these trajectories within a teacher-student distillation framework to learn a unified policy that maps egocentric depth observations and proprioceptive measurements directly to joint-level whole-body actions. During deployment, the policy requires neither reference motions nor intermediate commands. We evaluate ViLoMan on door-closing tasks across diverse door configurations and robot initial conditions in both simulation and the real world. Experimental results demonstrate that a single policy enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to complete the full task using only onboard depth sensing and proprioception, while generalizing robustly across task variations and transferring effectively from simulation to reality. Project page: viloman-anonymous.pages.dev.

AI.tldr: ViLoMan是一个可扩展的自主人形全身移动-操作框架，通过将人类-物体交互的部分运动学演示转化为完整可执行的机器人轨迹，并利用师生蒸馏学习统一策略，仅凭本体感知与自我中心深度观测即可完成全身关节级控制，在开关门任务上实现仿真到真实的泛化与迁移。
AI.motivation: 人形移动-操作需要自适应的全身协调以融合行走与物理交互。现有方法面临两大难题：一是缺乏多样且物理可执行的机器人-物体交互数据；二是难以直接从机载观测学习统一的全身控制策略。因此，实现自主移动-操作仍然困难。
AI.method: ViLoMan框架分两步：首先将人类-物体交互的部分运动学演示转化为完整、物理可执行的机器人轨迹；然后在师生蒸馏框架中利用这些轨迹学习统一策略，该策略将自我中心深度观测与本体感知测量直接映射为关节级全身动作。部署阶段策略不需要参考运动或中间指令。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界中，针对多种门配置和机器人初始条件评估开关门任务。结果表明，单一策略使Unitree G1人形仅依靠机载深度传感与本体感知完成完整任务，并在任务变化下鲁棒泛化，有效实现仿真到现实的迁移。
AI.conclusion: ViLoMan为自主人形移动-操作提供了一种可扩展方案，通过数据转化与师生蒸馏实现无需参考运动与中间命令的统一全身策略，验证了从部分人类演示到真实机器人自主执行的可行性与泛化能力。

title: QVAC Genesis III: A Large-Scale, High-Quality Open Synthetic STEM Corpus for Efficient Language Model Pre-Training
summary: High-quality pre-training data is a critical bottleneck for educational and STEM-specific language models targeting edge AI and on-device deployment where token budgets are tightly constrained. While major organizations train ever-larger models on private corpora, the open ecosystem lacks STEM-focused synthetic datasets that deliver high per-token learning value efficiently for small models. To address this gap, we introduce QVAC Genesis III, a 191.43B-token, STEM-focused multi-domain synthetic corpus covering 19 domains across several difficulty levels and different educational styles. QVAC Genesis III is built via a dual generation strategy that performs targeted teacher distillation using a weak edge-scale student model as signal: the student's failures are converted into corrective explanations, while its successes are expanded into contrastive option-level reasoning over all answer choices. We further introduce an LLM-as-a-parser evaluation protocol that extracts final answers from free-form outputs and tracks both accuracy and answer validity. To validate the effectiveness of our QVAC Genesis III data, we conduct controlled from-scratch ablations with 1.7B-parameter models, showing that models trained with QVAC Genesis III consistently outperform both models trained with the open-source synthetic corpus Cosmopedia-v2 and the publicly released Cosmo-1B model across ARC, GPQA Diamond, and MMLU STEM benchmarks, achieving up to +28.57% on ARC-E and +21.35% on ARC-C, while reaching a Valid Answer Rate of up to 99.45%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QVAC Genesis III，一个面向 STEM 领域的 191.43B token 多域合成语料库，通过双生成策略与小模型失败信号蒸馏构建，并以 1.7B 模型从零训练验证其优于 Cosmopedia-v2 与 Cosmo-1B。
AI.motivation: 边缘 AI 与端侧部署对 token 预算高度受限，而开源生态缺乏面向 STEM、具备高"每 token 学习价值"的合成数据集，高质量预训练数据成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建 191.43B token、覆盖 19 个 STEM 领域、多难度与多教学风格的合成语料；采用双生成策略，以弱小的边缘级学生模型的失败作为信号进行定向教师蒸馏：将失败转为纠错性解释，将成功扩展为覆盖所有选项的对比式选项级推理。同时提出 LLM-as-a-parser 评测协议，从自由形式输出中抽取最终答案，并同时追踪准确率与答案有效性。
AI.result: 在 1.7B 参数模型的受控从零训练消融中，使用 QVAC Genesis III 训练的模型在 ARC、GPQA Diamond 和 MMLU STEM 基准上持续优于使用 Cosmopedia-v2 训练的模型及公开的 Cosmo-1B，ARC-E 最高提升 +28.57%，ARC-C 最高提升 +21.35%，有效答案率最高达 99.45%。
AI.conclusion: QVAC Genesis III 作为一种面向 STEM 的高效合成预训练语料，可在小模型与受限 token 预算场景下显著提升性能与答案有效性，为端侧教育及 STEM 语言模型提供可行数据方案。

title: Improving Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning via Selective Reward Stimulation
summary: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning aims to learn policies that reach specified goals, but remains challenging in offline settings with sparse rewards and long-horizon dependencies. In such settings, goal-completion information can be temporally distant from the early decisions that enable success, while offline value estimation introduces additional error. We study this issue from a reward-propagation perspective and show, in a stylized delayed-goal setting, how goal-directed value separation can become small relative to local estimation error. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning (RSIQL), a simple non-hierarchical method that introduces additional reward signals at progress-making intermediate states in offline trajectories. RSIQL uses an auxiliary goal-conditioned value function to identify intermediate states estimated to make progress toward the goal and applies reward stimulation to provide less-delayed training supervision. Unlike hierarchical methods, RSIQL does not learn a separate high-level subgoal policy. Experiments on D4RL goal-reaching benchmarks and OGBench show that RSIQL improves over goal-conditioned IQL on average and achieves performance competitive with hierarchical offline goal-conditioned methods, while retaining a simple flat policy structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning (RSIQL)，一种简单非分层的离线目标条件强化学习方法，通过在轨迹中间状态注入额外奖励信号来缓解稀疏奖励与长时程依赖带来的价值传播困难，实验表明其优于目标条件 IQL，并与分层方法性能相当。
AI.motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习面临稀疏奖励与长时程依赖的挑战。目标完成信息与早期决策在时间上相距较远，同时离线价值估计会引入额外误差。作者从奖励传播角度研究该问题，并在一种风格化的延迟目标设定中表明：目标导向的价值区分度可能相对于局部估计误差变得很小，从而导致学习困难。
AI.method: 作者提出 RSIQL（Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning）。该方法为非分层的简单方法，在离线轨迹中被判定为"有进展"的中间状态引入额外奖励信号：使用一个辅助的目标条件价值函数来识别估计能朝向目标取得进展的中间状态，并对这些状态施加奖励刺激（reward stimulation），从而提供延迟更小的训练监督。与分层方法不同，RSIQL 不学习单独的高层子目标策略。
AI.result: 在 D4RL 目标达成（goal-reaching）基准和 OGBench 上的实验表明：RSIQL 平均而言优于目标条件 IQL（goal-conditioned IQL），并与分层离线目标条件方法具有竞争力，同时保持简单的扁平策略结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过从奖励传播视角分析延迟目标设定下的价值区分度与估计误差问题，论文提出的 RSIQL 以非分层的简单结构有效缓解了稀疏奖励与长时程依赖问题，在多个基准上取得优于目标条件 IQL、媲美分层方法的性能，说明通过中间状态奖励刺激来缩短监督延迟是一种有效策略。

title: Less Is More: Graph-free Multimodal RAG via Multi-signal Late Fusion
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used for multimodal, cross-document question answering. However, building corpus-level graphs is expensive, slow to query, and difficult to maintain. We present TrioRAG, a graph-free multimodal framework that integrates evidence from three complementary signals: the question, the anchor image, and a VLM-enhanced query generated from both. Each signal retrieves independently over a shared multi-vector index of page text and page images, and the results are combined through late fusion. Further, we introduce AutoQA, a multimodal automotive benchmark whose questions are grounded in noisy, web-sourced images rather than clean document-sourced figures. Its questions require reasoning across manuals. We position it as a model-curated testbed rather than a human-validated gold standard. Across three benchmarks, TrioRAG matches or outperforms graph-based systems while reducing total cost and accelerating per-query inference by 1.6-2.3 times. By construction, AutoQA grounds its questions in out-of-corpus web images. In this setting image retrieval reaches only 19.3% document-level recall, while text-derived signals, especially the VLM-enhanced query, keep retrieval robust.

AI.tldr: 提出无图（graph-free）多模态RAG框架TrioRAG，通过问题、锚点图像、VLM增强查询三路信号在共享多向量索引上独立检索并后期融合，在三个基准上匹配或超越图方法，成本更低、单查询推理加速1.6–2.3倍；同时发布多模态汽车基准AutoQA。
AI.motivation: 基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）虽广泛用于多模态、跨文档问答，但构建语料级图代价高、查询慢、难以维护，需要一种无需建图即可整合多模态证据的替代方案。
AI.method: TrioRAG为无图多模态框架，融合三类互补信号：原始问题、锚点图像、以及由二者生成的VLM增强查询；每个信号在页文本与页面图像的共享多向量索引上独立检索，结果经后期融合（late fusion）合并。另构建AutoQA基准，其问题基于噪声网络图像而非干净文档图表，且需跨手册推理。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，TrioRAG匹配或超越基于图的系统，同时降低总成本，单查询推理加速1.6–2.3倍。AutoQA中问题按构造基于语料外网络图像：此设置下图像检索仅达19.3%文档级召回，而文本派生信号（尤其VLM增强查询）保持检索稳健。
AI.conclusion: 无需语料级图构建，多信号独立检索加后期融合即可在多模态跨文档问答中媲美甚至优于图方法，并显著降低成本与延迟；在图像检索不可靠（语料外图像）时，文本派生尤其是VLM增强查询是维持检索鲁棒性的关键。AutoQA定位为模型策管的测试床，而非人工验证的金标准。

title: When Does Retrieval Help Time-Series Forecasting?
summary: Retrieval plug-ins supply a deep forecaster with information its lookback window cannot carry. Published evaluations report consistent gains, and each credits its own mechanism. We show that the benefit belongs instead to the operating point: the relation between window length $S$ and dominant seasonal period $L$, an axis the standard protocol never varies. Stratifying the evaluation by that relation exposes the regime. At $S{=}12$, a simple control that repeats the last observed period beats the six standard backbones, in aggregate, on four of seven benchmarks by $8\%$ to $44\%$ of MSE. It beats the strongest plug-in we run on ETTm1 and matches it on ECL. It is worse by up to $25\%$ on the three datasets whose training-split spectra lack a concentrated, shared period. A controlled synthetic sweep of horizon, period, and window shows the benefit boundary tracks the period (correlation $+0.71$), not the horizon ($-0.23$). A paired control with no phase to recover nearly erases the effect, consistent with phase starvation. Zero-shot pretraining does not escape it: a foundation model trails trained backbones by $22\%$ to $50\%$ on the periodic benchmarks. Within our instrument, exact lookup matches graph diffusion: the payoff is consulting the record, not the machinery on top. Two interpretable statistics, a trend test and a staleness rate, predict the sign of the per-cell benefit at $0.76$ accuracy under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, a suggestive margin over the $0.69$ majority rule, where a 22-feature stack manages $0.57$. We propose no new plug-in. The contribution is the regime map, the protocol that reveals it, and two statistics that screen it before deployment. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/retrieval-regime.

AI.tldr: 检索插件（retrieval plug-in）带来的预测增益实际来自"窗口长度S与主导季节周期L之比"这一操作点（operating point），而非插件机制本身；论文提出分层评测协议揭示该区间，并给出两个可解释统计量用于部署前筛查。
AI.motivation: 已有评测普遍报告检索插件给深度预测器带来稳定增益，并把功劳归给各自的机制。但标准协议从不变化"回看窗口长度S与主导季节周期L"的关系这一维度。作者怀疑增益其实归属于这个操作点而非机制，因此需要设计能揭示该区间的评测协议。
AI.method: 按S与L的关系对评测进行分层（stratified evaluation），暴露受益区间。设置极端简单对照：重复最后一个观测周期（repeat-last-period）。在七个基准上与六个标准骨干模型、最强插件对比；对horizon、period、window做受控合成扫描；设计与无相位可恢复的配对对照验证"相位饥饿"（phase starvation）假说；评估零样本预训练基础模型；用两个可解释统计量（趋势检验 trend test、陈旧率 staleness rate）在leave-one-dataset-out下预测每个cell增益符号。
AI.result: 在S=12时，简单对照在七个基准中的四个上，相对六个标准骨干模型整体提升8%–44% MSE；在ETTm1上优于所跑最强插件，在ECL上与之持平；在训练集频谱缺乏集中共享周期的三个数据集上差至多25%。合成扫描显示收益边界与周期相关（+0.71），与horizon无关（−0.23）。无相位对照几乎消除该效应，符合相位饥饿解释。零样本基础模型在周期基准上落后训练骨干22%–50%。精确查找与图扩散效果相当。两统计量预测符号准确率0.76，优于多数规则的0.69，22特征堆叠仅0.57。
AI.conclusion: 论文不提出新插件，贡献在于：受益区间图谱（regime map）、揭示它的评测协议，以及两个可在部署前筛查该区间的统计量。核心结论是收益来自"查阅记录"而非插件机制，且属于S与L关系决定的操作点。

title: PerSeM: Persistent Semantic Memory for Long-Horizon Open-Vocabulary UAV Mapping
summary: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables rich semantic perception for UAVs, but frame-wise predictions can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations and changing viewpoints. We present PerSeM, a training-free persistent semantic memory framework for long-horizon open-vocabulary UAV mapping. PerSeM associates frame-wise semantic observations with persistent world-space voxels and constructs a majority-based semantic memory, which is conservatively refined through history-preserving spatial refinement, trust-aware replay, and context-guided verification. Experiments on the Forest and UAVScenes benchmarks show that persistent 3D memory provides substantial gains in semantic correctness and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions. Beyond this strong persistent-memory baseline, PerSeM provides consistent additional improvements, improving both semantic accuracy and temporal stability across all five evaluated UAVScenes sequences. Analysis using regions identified independently of the final PerSeM predictions further shows that these gains are concentrated in semantically difficult and temporally unstable regions, where majority-based memory is most likely to remain uncertain. These results demonstrate that persistent 3D aggregation provides a strong foundation for long-horizon semantic mapping, while conservative refinement of uncertain memory states can provide additional improvements without retraining or additional neural-network inference.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的持久语义记忆框架PerSeM，用于长时程开放词汇无人机建图，通过世界空间体素记忆与保守精炼提升语义正确性和时序稳定性。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇分割可为无人机提供丰富语义感知，但逐帧预测在重复观测和视角变化下时序不一致，难以满足长时程建图需求。
AI.method: PerSeM将逐帧语义观测关联到持久的世界空间体素，构建基于多数投票的语义记忆，并通过保留历史的空间精炼、信任感知重放和上下文引导验证进行保守精炼；无需训练。
AI.result: 在Forest和UAVScenes基准上，持久3D记忆相比逐帧预测显著提升语义正确性和时序稳定性；PerSeM作为基线之上进一步在全部五个UAVScenes序列上取得一致提升，增益集中于语义困难且时序不稳定区域。
AI.conclusion: 持久3D聚合为长时程语义建图提供了坚实基础，对不确定记忆状态的保守精炼可在无需重训练或额外神经网络推理的情况下带来额外改进。

title: Kinematics-Grounded Agentic AI for Robotic Additive Manufacturing Process Planning
summary: Robotic additive manufacturing (AM) extends material-extrusion printing beyond gantry kinematics but makes process planning robot-dependent. A slicer-generated plan that appears favorable in part coordinates can become infeasible or robotically unfavorable on a manipulator because slicer-process decisions and part orientation determine the generated path, while part orientation and workspace placement affect its kinematic realization. Existing AM tools, large language model (LLM)-based decision-support methods, and digital-shadow systems do not provide integrated pre-execution evaluation of these coupled decisions. This paper presents agentic robotic additive manufacturing (A-RAM), an agent-specialist-tool framework that converts user intent and a part file into traceable, execution-ready plans. The LLM interprets manufacturing objectives and constraints, identifies prescribed and searchable planning variables, and encodes this reasoning in a schema-constrained request; a deterministic Planning Agent instantiates the corresponding search workflow, while domain tools compute quantitative evidence for slicing, placement, inverse kinematics, trajectory timing, Joint-6 jerk, and extrusion. The framework is evaluated on a six-axis robotic-arm AM cell through three case studies covering expert-specified planning, goal-only planning, objective-dependent infill screening, and geometry-dependent orientation-placement selection. Across the evaluated candidate sets, selected plans achieve up to 53.5% lower maximum Joint-6 jerk and 48.3% lower mean absolute Joint-6 jerk than the least favorable valid candidates, while objective-specific infill screening yields motion-plan completion times up to 40.1% shorter and extrusion paths up to 12.7% shorter than the corresponding least favorable screened patterns.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出A-RAM（Agentic Robotic Additive Manufacturing）框架，通过LLM智能体、规划智能体与领域工具的协同，将用户意图与零件文件转化为可追溯、可执行的机器人增材制造规划方案，并在六轴机械臂平台上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人增材制造使材料挤出打印突破龙门式运动学限制，但导致工艺规划依赖于具体机器人。切片器生成的方案在零件坐标系下看似有利，却可能因切片决策与零件定向共同决定路径，且零件定向与工作空间放置影响运动学实现，从而在机械臂上不可行或运动学不利。现有增材制造工具、基于LLM的决策支持方法和数字孪生系统均缺乏对上述耦合决策的集成式执行前评估。
AI.method: 提出A-RAM，一种"智能体-专家-工具"（agent-specialist-tool）框架。LLM负责解读制造目标与约束、识别既定与可搜索的规划变量，并将推理编码为受模式约束的请求；确定性规划智能体据此实例化相应的搜索工作流；领域工具则计算切片、放置、逆运动学、轨迹时序、第六关节急动度（Joint-6 jerk）和挤出等的定量证据。
AI.result: 在六轴机械臂增材制造单元上通过三个案例研究进行评估，涵盖专家指定规划、仅目标规划、目标相关填充筛选及几何相关定向-放置选择。在评估的候选集内，所选方案相较最不利的有效候选方案，最大Joint-6 jerk降低达53.5%，平均绝对Joint-6 jerk降低达48.3%；目标特定的填充筛选使运动规划完成时间缩短达40.1%，挤出路径缩短达12.7%。
AI.conclusion: A-RAM能够将用户意图与零件文件转化为可追溯、可执行的规划方案，实现对切片、放置、运动学与挤出等耦合决策的集成式执行前评估，并在运动学质量与加工效率上显著优于最不利的有效候选方案，证明了该智能体-专家-工具框架在机器人增材制造工艺规划中的有效性。

title: LLM-as-an-Improver: Turning Verification into Better Candidates
summary: Verifier-based selection improves LLM performance by generating multiple candidate solutions and using a verifier to select the most promising one. However, existing methods typically treat verification only as a ranking step and discard its feedback once a fixed candidate pool has been evaluated. In this paper, we ask whether verification can also improve the candidate set itself. To this end, we introduce LLM-as-an-Improver and propose Verify--Repair--Reselect (VRR), which uses verification feedback to generate and reselect improved candidates. VRR retains the initial winner while conditionally generating three complementary alternatives: repaired versions of the winner and runner-up, and a solution based on a new approach. It filters invalid and duplicate candidates using only inference-time information and then reselects the final answer under the original evaluation criteria. Across diverse models and code-generation and reasoning benchmarks, VRR improves over fixed-pool verifier-based selection in many settings and can recover correct solutions even when all candidates in the initial pool are incorrect. These results highlight a broader role for LLMs as improvers: verification feedback can not only select among existing solutions but also construct stronger candidates beyond the initial pool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Verify--Repair--Reselect (VRR) 方法，将验证反馈从"仅做排序"扩展为"改进候选集"，通过修复已有解与生成新解提升 LLM 表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于验证器（verifier）的选择方法只把验证当作排序步骤，一旦固定候选池评估完毕，验证反馈即被丢弃，未能用于改进候选集本身。
AI.method: 提出"LLM-as-an-Improver"视角与 VRR 流程：保留初始最优解，条件性地生成三个互补候选（最优解与次优解的修复版本、以及基于新思路的解），仅用推理期信息过滤无效与重复候选，再在原始评价标准下重新选择最终答案。
AI.result: 在多种模型及代码生成与推理基准上，VRR 在多种设置下优于固定候选池的验证器选择方法，且能在初始候选池全部错误的情况下恢复出正确解。
AI.conclusion: 验证反馈不仅可用于在已有解中挑选，还能用于构造超越初始池的更强候选，凸显 LLM 作为"改进者"的更广泛作用。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet many real-world optimization problems contain substantially richer information than function evaluations alone. Examples include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, and prior knowledge about where optima may lie. We show that large language models (LLMs) can effectively leverage such rich auxiliary information to guide optimization. Motivated by these findings, we develop three methods for incorporating auxiliary information into BO using LLMs. Across hyperparameter optimization benchmarks and a real-world nuclear fusion optimization task, our methods consistently outperform both standard BO and existing LLM-based optimization approaches. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLMs for leveraging rich auxiliary information in BO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）将丰富的辅助信息融入贝叶斯优化（BO），并开发了三种方法，在超参数优化基准和核聚变优化任务上均优于标准BO及现有LLM优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现实优化问题往往包含比单纯函数评估更丰富的信息，如超参数优化中的训练曲线、科学实验中的专家笔记与图像，以及关于最优解位置的先验知识。传统BO未能充分利用这些辅助信息，作者希望借助LLM的能力加以利用。
AI.method: 作者首先证明LLM能有效利用此类丰富辅助信息指导优化；随后提出三种将辅助信息通过LLM融入BO的方法。
AI.result: 在超参数优化基准和真实核聚变优化任务上，所提方法一致超越标准BO以及已有的基于LLM的优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了LLM在贝叶斯优化中利用丰富辅助信息的有效性。

title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
summary: As model-generated content is increasingly consumed by other model instances in automated workflows, a practically important question arises: can a model embed a signal in natural language that an independent instance of the same model can detect, relying only on shared pre-training and task instructions, without any shared memory or coordination-specific training? We introduce For Your Eyes Only, a cooperative signalling game designed to evaluate this directly. A Sender produces free-form descriptions for two words, one of which is a hidden target; an isolated Receiver must identify it. We evaluate seven contemporary models from four architectural families on 300 word pairs from established psycholinguistic corpora, using the Double-Pass Success Rate to control for output biases. We find that most models struggle to maintain coordination once they are required to avoid detectable signals, while one frontier model retains near-perfect performance even after such filtering. We further show that models can direct this capability toward deliberate misdirection, and that coordination is consistently weaker across architectures than within them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 cooperative signalling 评测任务"For Your Eyes Only",考察同一模型的不同实例仅依靠共享预训练与任务指令、无共享记忆或专项训练时,能否在自然语言中嵌入可被识别的隐蔽信号。
AI.motivation: 模型生成内容日益被其他模型实例消费,但"模型间能否在自然语言中传递隐蔽信号"这一问题缺乏直接评测,且涉及协调能力与潜在风险。
AI.method: 设计 cooperative signalling game:Sender 为两个词(其一为隐藏目标)生成自由形式描述,隔离的 Receiver 需识别目标;在四个架构族共七个当代模型、300 组来自心理语言学语料的词对上评测,并用 Double-Pass Success Rate 控制输出偏差;进一步测试剔除可检测信号后的表现与故意误导能力。
AI.result: 多数模型在需避免可检测信号时难以维持协调;一个前沿模型经此类过滤后仍保持接近完美的表现;模型可将该能力用于故意误导;跨架构协调一致弱于同架构内协调。
AI.conclusion: 模型间隐蔽信号传递能力存在显著差异,且可被导向误导用途;该能力在同架构内更强,提示需关注多模型自动化流程中的协调与安全风险。

title: CliniCIRCA: A Modular LLM Framework for Constructing Longitudinal Mental Health Patient Journeys from Raw EHR Narratives
summary: In mental health care, reasoning over patient journeys is a key task for clinicians. Yet these journeys, encompassing a longitudinal progression of biological, psychological, and social events, are often spread across disparate unstructured text narratives, making temporal recovery challenging. We present CliniCIRCA, a multi-stage LLM framework for Calendar-anchored, Imprecision-aware Reconstruction of Clinical Annals. To our knowledge, CliniCIRCA is the first to temporally classify clinical events across unstructured discharge summaries without event-level timestamps. From 14,882 MIMIC-III mental health admissions, we first construct a benchmark of 52 discharge summaries on which CliniCIRCA produces 15,891 temporally tagged events. After correcting 629 errors based on a clinician-in-the-loop evaluation, we produce verified gold-standard labels. Finally, the corrected timelines drive a temporally grounded summarization stage that compresses each source 1.52 times into a date-grouped chronological record. We then scale the framework to generate 1,000 silver-standard timelines and evaluate them as training data. Compared with zero- and few-shot prompting, instruction tuning generally improves five open-weight models on event extraction, temporal tagging, and summarization across silver and clinician-verified evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出CliniCIRCA多阶段LLM框架，实现无事件级时间戳的非结构化出院小结临床事件时间分类与重建。
AI.motivation: 临床心理保健中需对患者旅程（生物、心理、社会事件的纵向进程）进行时间推理，但这些信息分散在非结构化文本叙述中，时间信息恢复困难。
AI.method: 从14,882份MIMIC-III心理健康入院记录中构建52份出院小结基准；CliniCIRCA分阶段生成15,891个带时间标签事件；经临床医生在环评估修正629个错误得到验证金标准；修正后时间线驱动时间接地摘要阶段，1.52倍压缩为按日期分组的时序记录；扩展生成1,000条银标准时间线作为训练数据。
AI.result: 较零样本与少样本提示，指令微调在事件抽取、时间标注和摘要任务上普遍提升五个开放权重模型（银标准与临床验证评估）。
AI.conclusion: CliniCIRCA是首个在无事件级时间戳的非结构化出院小结中跨事件进行时间分类的框架，且验证时间线可作为有效的训练数据。

title: Foundations of Stochastic Lexical Calculus: Semantic Descent and Random Dynamics on Probability Simplices
summary: Large language models produce prompt-dependent probabilities over words, whereas scientific systems require uncertainty over meaningful states that can be updated as evidence arrives. We develop an observable framework for determining when language-derived probabilities support such a sequential state representation. Theoretically, we define typed measurable transformations of contextual language, construct a minimal closed representation, and give necessary and sufficient conditions for semantic updates to exist uniquely. We bound irreducible nonclosure and accumulated error, and under average contraction prove existence, uniqueness and stability of an external random recursion on a probability simplex. These results define a stochastic lexical calculus without attributing an internal calculus to the language model. Empirically, frozen experiments test the observable implications. Raw prompt-conditioned probabilities fail the prespecified invariance gate; after prompt-specific calibration, a common three-state representation passes the stability gates and covers 28 of 30 untouched eight-step paths, or 0.933 at nominal level 0.90. Accordingly, language probabilities support a stochastic state only conditionally on verified closure, stability and coverage within a declared operating domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个"可观测框架"，用于判定语言模型导出的概率能否支撑可随证据更新的序列状态表示，并给出闭包、唯一性与稳定性的理论条件及实证验证。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型输出的是依赖提示的词级概率，而科学系统需要对有意义状态的不确定性并能在新证据到来时更新；二者之间存在鸿沟，需明确语言概率在何种条件下才能支持这类序列状态表示，且不诉诸于给模型假定一个内部演算。
AI.method: 理论上，定义上下文语言的类型化可测变换，构造最小闭合表示，给出语义更新唯一存在的充要条件；界定不可约非闭包与累积误差；在平均收缩条件下证明概率单纯形上外部随机递归的存在性、唯一性与稳定性，从而建立一种随机词汇演算。实证上采用冻结实验检验可观测推论：先检测原始提示条件概率是否通过预设的不变性门槛，再做提示特定校准，并检验共同三状态表示的稳定性与覆盖率。
AI.result: 原始提示条件概率未通过预设不变性门槛；经提示特定校准后，共同的三状态表示通过稳定性门槛，并在30条未触碰的八步路径中覆盖28条，名义水平0.90下覆盖率为0.933。
AI.conclusion: 语言概率仅在已验证的闭包、稳定性与覆盖率条件同时满足、且处于明确声明的操作域内时，才能支撑随机状态表示；即这种支持是条件性的，而非普遍成立。

title: A Multi-Modal Generative Model for Tomato Disease Leaves Understanding
comment: In submission to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture Journal
summary: Artificial intelligence for plant disease analysis has advanced from task-specific classifiers to multi-modal models capable of jointly interpreting visual and textual information. However, practical deployment in precision agriculture remains limited because most existing approaches treat disease understanding as isolated prediction tasks, failing to capture the complementary relationships among symptom recognition, severity assessment, and question-driven diagnostic reasoning. In tomato pathology, accurate interpretation of diseased leaves requires more than label prediction; it demands integrating visual symptoms with semantic context to support a comprehensive and explainable understanding. Here, we present SOLAR, a multimodal generative model that understands tomato disease spanning six question-answering tasks. SOLAR learns to align visual features with task-aware language representations by Fusion Expert module based on mixture-of-expert, enabling it to generate contextually relevant answers across diverse diagnostic tasks. By formulating tomato disease analysis as a generative Visual Question Answering (VQA) task, SOLAR provides a flexible framework that supports multi-task inference within a single model while improving performance and cross-task knowledge sharing. We evaluate SOLAR on $41,677$ images, including $216,209$ Question-Answering (QA) pairs to understand tomato leaf disease under both closed and open-ended QA settings. Experimental results show that SOLAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art vision-only, vision-language, and task-specific models across all tasks, demonstrating superior accuracy, robustness, and multimodal reasoning. These findings highlight the potential of generative multimodal modeling as an effective direction for understanding of plant disease. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/EnalisUs/SOLAR.

AI.tldr: 提出SOLAR——基于混合专家融合的多模态生成模型，将番茄病害分析统一为生成式VQA任务，覆盖六类问答任务，在41,677张图像、216,209对QA数据上超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有植物病害AI多为孤立的任务专用分类器，虽已向多模态演进，但未捕捉症状识别、严重度评估与问题驱动诊断推理之间的互补关系；番茄病叶的准确解读需要视觉症状与语义语境融合，以实现全面且可解释的理解，而实际精准农业部署仍受限。
AI.method: 将番茄病害分析重构为生成式视觉问答（VQA）任务，提出多模态生成模型SOLAR；通过基于混合专家（MoE）的Fusion Expert模块，将视觉特征与任务感知的语言表示对齐，从而在六类问答任务上生成语境相关答案，实现单模型多任务推理与跨任务知识共享。在闭集与开放问答设定下评估。
AI.result: 在41,677张图像、216,209对QA数据上评估，SOLAR在全部任务上稳定优于最前沿的纯视觉模型、视觉-语言模型及任务专用模型，展现出更高的准确率、鲁棒性与多模态推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 生成式多模态建模是植物病害理解的有效方向，统一的多任务生成框架兼具性能提升与跨任务知识共享优势；代码已开源于GitHub。

title: Design and Experimental Validation of a 3D Printed Torsional Series Elastic Actuator for Safe Human Robot Interaction
summary: Ensuring intrinsic safety in physical human robot interaction (pHRI) is a critical requirement for social and service robots. While Series Elastic Actuators (SEAs) offer hardware based compliance, traditional metallic designs often require complex, multi part assemblies. This paper presents the design, finite element analysis (FEA), and experimental validation of a low stiffness, torsional spring for SEAs, manufactured via 3D printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU). The compliant element exhibits a highly linear torque deformation response (Ks = 0.066 Nm/degree), matching numerical predictions with under 3% deviation, a variance attributed to FDM structural anisotropy. To accommodate external interactions using standard position limited servomotors, a hybrid position controller with torque threshold switching was implemented. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the system ability to accurately track non stationary trajectories and safely yield to external disturbances. Furthermore, the inherent material damping of the TPU acts as a passive low pass filter, preventing high frequency oscillations during control mode transitions. The proposed architecture offers a cost effective, reliable, and easily manufacturable solution for safe pHRI.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并验证了一种用于串联弹性驱动器（SEA）的3D打印TPU低刚度扭转弹簧，其刚度线性度好、与仿真误差小于3%，配合混合位置控制策略可实现安全柔顺的人机交互。
AI.motivation: 物理人机交互（pHRI）要求本质安全，是社会与服务机器人的关键需求。传统金属串联弹性驱动器虽提供硬件柔顺性，但结构复杂、零件多、成本高，亟需一种易制造、低成本的柔顺元件方案。
AI.method: 采用3D打印热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）制造SEA用低刚度扭转弹簧，进行有限元分析（FEA）与实验验证；并针对标准位置限位伺服电机，设计带力矩阈值切换的混合位置控制器，实现轨迹跟踪与外部扰动顺服。
AI.result: 弹簧力矩—变形响应高度线性，刚度Ks=0.066 Nm/度，与数值预测偏差小于3%（差异归因于FDM结构各向异性）；系统可准确跟踪非平稳轨迹并安全让位于外部扰动；TPU的固有材料阻尼起到被动低通滤波作用，抑制控制模式切换时的高频振荡。
AI.conclusion: 该架构为安全物理人机交互提供了一种成本低、可靠且易于制造的解决方案。

title: An Architecture for Long-Horizon Agents: Levels, Ticks and Cascaded Intelligence
