summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out work spanning days or weeks, such as an operations remediation or a research programme. Such a task outlives any context window, any process and any interval at which a person can attend. In this paper, we argue that a long-horizon agent must run continually without forgetting before it can learn continually. This ability lies in the harness around the model rather than in the model itself. We derive seven bottlenecks from the long-horizon setting and answer them with a hierarchical architecture of three parts: (i) levels indexed by time scale, each keeping a bounded file summarising the level below; (ii) a clocked tick as the unit of autonomous action; and (iii) cascaded intelligence, where work is escalated to a more capable model only after failing review. We report on a ten-day campaign in which an agent built on this architecture reproduced a published reinforcement-learning result with a human attending once a day, and show (1) the agent kept the thread across every context reset and session boundary of the campaign, (2) operating knowledge written early changed later behaviour with no change to model weights, and (3) where learned components would enter such a system. Overall, our experience suggests continual learning for these agents needs a substrate outliving every context and process, and the checks the harness already runs are where a learner belongs.

AI.tldr: 长时程智能体需要"在不遗忘的前提下持续运行"，其能力位于模型外层的harness中，而非模型本身。论文提出三部分层级架构应对七大瓶颈，并通过为期十天的复现实验验证。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体被要求执行跨越数天乃至数周的任务（如运维修复、研究项目），这类任务必然超出任何上下文窗口、任何进程寿命、以及人类可连续关注的间隔。因此需要探讨：如何在上下文与进程不断重置的情况下保持任务连续性，并在此基础上实现持续学习。
AI.method: 作者从长时程设定中推导出七个瓶颈，并以三层级架构予以回应：(i) 按时间尺度分层的层级，每层维护一个对下层的有限长度摘要文件；(ii) 以"时钟tick"作为自主动作的基本单元；(iii) 级联智能，即工作仅在评审失败后才升级到更强模型。据此构建智能体并开展十天实验。
AI.result: 在为期十天的实验中，基于该架构的智能体仅需人类每天关注一次，即复现了一项已发表的强化学习结果。结果显示：(1) 智能体在每次上下文重置与会话边界处都保持了任务主线；(2) 早期写入的运行知识在不改变模型权重的情况下改变了后续行为；(3) 明确了学习组件在此类系统中的接入位置。
AI.conclusion: 对这类智能体而言，持续学习需要一个寿命长于任何上下文与进程的"基底"（substrate），而harness已经在执行的各种检查正是学习器应当嵌入的位置。

title: From Parameters to Behaviors: A Survey of Model Fusion for Large Language Models
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Model fusion integrates the capabilities from source models into a single target model. As of June 2026, Hugging Face hosts more than 2M models. This growing pool provides a rich base for model reuse and capability integration. Yet existing surveys often cover only separate parts of this space, and they do not provide a unified definition or a systematic taxonomy. This survey defines model fusion and organizes prior work into three levels: parameter-level, representation-level, and behavior-level fusion. We also review related metrics, benchmarks, and applications, summarize current challenges, and identify future directions. Our goal is to provide a clear map of this area and support future work on model fusion. A comprehensive list of papers about model fusion is available at https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/Awesome-Model-Fusion-Survey.

AI.tldr: 该综述对模型融合领域进行系统梳理，提出统一定义，并按参数级、表示级、行为级三个层次构建分类体系，同时总结评测指标、基准、应用、挑战与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 截至2026年6月，Hugging Face已托管超过200万个模型，为模型复用与能力整合提供了丰富基础。然而现有综述往往只覆盖该领域的部分内容，缺乏统一定义与系统分类法，因此需要一篇能够提供清晰领域全景图的综述。
AI.method: 本文通过综述形式，首先对"模型融合"给出统一定义，并将已有工作组织为三个层次：参数级融合、表示级融合与行为级融合；随后梳理相关评测指标、基准数据集与应用场景。
AI.result: 论文将模型融合研究归纳为参数级、表示级、行为级三个层次的分类框架，并整理了相应的评测指标、基准与应用，同时总结了当前挑战与未来研究方向，并在GitHub上提供了完整的论文列表资源。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在为模型融合领域提供清晰的研究地图，统一术语与分类体系，从而支持未来模型融合研究的发展。

title: Semantic Layer Induction from Raw Telemetry via Hierarchical LLM and RAG Abstraction
summary: Modern applications generate massive volumes of raw telemetry data, but translating those noisy, heterogeneous event streams into actionable business insights remains a fundamental challenge. Data engineers and analysts expend substantial effort reconciling semantic discrepancies, hand-crafting parsing logics, and maintaining fragile mappings between raw data and business KPIs. In this paper, we present an end-to-end framework that fully automates the construction of a business semantic layer from application raw logs. Our approach introduces a two-stage semantic abstraction: first, high-level business features are identified via LLM inference augmented with domain-specific industry knowledge; second, fine-grained business nodes are derived through a structured pipeline comprising data refinement, hybrid retrieval, multi-stage filtering, semantic clustering, and canonical naming. Evaluation on production-scale telemetry demonstrates that our system improves human-assessed semantic quality from 50 to 80+ on a 100-point scale, reduces maintenance effort by 80%, filters out 74% of noise, and achieves 0.87 Cohen's kappa via an integrated LLM-as-Judge evaluation, enabling continuous, scalable quality assurance. Overall, our work distinguishes itself from prior work by addressing the novel problem of business semantic layer induction from raw telemetry, operating without labeled training data or manual rule engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端框架，从应用原始日志自动构建业务语义层，无需标注数据或人工规则。
AI.motivation: 原始遥测数据规模庞大且噪声、异构严重，工程与分析人员需耗费大量精力处理语义差异、手工编写解析逻辑并维护脆弱的原始数据与业务KPI映射。
AI.method: 两阶段语义抽象：第一阶段通过LLM推理结合行业领域知识识别高层业务特征；第二阶段经数据精炼、混合检索、多级过滤、语义聚类与规范命名组成结构化流水线导出细粒度业务节点。
AI.result: 生产级遥测数据评估显示：语义质量人工评分由50提升至80+（百分制），维护工作量降低80%，过滤74%噪声，集成LLM-as-Judge评估取得0.87 Cohen's kappa。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次针对从原始遥测中归纳业务语义层这一新问题，在无标注训练数据和人工规则工程的条件下实现连续、可扩展的质量保障。

title: The Bias of Nonlinear Two-Time-scale Stochastic Approximation under Constant Step-Sizes
summary: Two-timescale stochastic approximation (TTSA) is a fundamental tool for analyzing coupled iterative algorithms in reinforcement learning, optimization, and stochastic control. However, finite-time guarantees for nonlinear two-timescale schemes remain difficult to obtain, especially under constant step-sizes. In this paper, we study nonlinear TTSA with step-sizes $α\ggβ$. Under standard stability, regularity, and Markovian noise assumptions, we upper bound the mean-squared error and the bias of both iterates around their limiting equilibria. Our bounds scale as $O(α+β^2/α^2)$, which we prove to be tight when $β\leα^{3/2}$. The analysis separates the contributions of initial conditions, fast-timescale tracking error, Markovian dependence, and timescale coupling, thereby clarifying the origin of the $β^2/α^2$ term. Our results reveal qualitative differences from the linear TTSA setting previously studied, showing that nonlinear dynamics introduce additional finite-time effects that are absent in the linear case.

AI.tldr: 本文研究常步长下非线性双时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA）的有限时间误差界，证明均方误差与偏差上界为 $O(\alpha+\beta^2/\alpha^2)$，并在 $\beta\le\alpha^{3/2}$ 时证明其紧致性。
AI.motivation: 双时间尺度随机逼近是分析强化学习、优化与随机控制中耦合迭代算法的基本工具，但非线性双时间尺度方案的有限时间保证（尤其是常步长情形）仍难以获得；已有线性TTSA分析难以刻画非线性动力学的额外有限时间效应。
AI.method: 在标准稳定性、正则性与马尔可夫噪声假设下，研究步长满足 $\alpha\gg\beta$ 的非线性TTSA；对两个迭代序列围绕其极限均衡的均方误差与偏差进行上界分析，并将初始条件、快时间尺度跟踪误差、马尔可夫依赖与时间尺度耦合的贡献进行分解。
AI.result: 得到均方误差与偏差上界均按 $O(\alpha+\beta^2/\alpha^2)$ 缩放；当 $\beta\le\alpha^{3/2}$ 时证明该界是紧的；误差分解明确了 $\beta^2/\alpha^2$ 项的来源，并揭示非线性动力学引入了线性情形中不存在的额外有限时间效应。
AI.conclusion: 非线性TTSA的有限时间行为与线性TTSA存在定性差异，其误差界更复杂且包含由非线性耦合导致的额外项，为常步长非线性双时间尺度算法的收敛性分析提供了更精细的理论刻画。

title: Selective Cotton Boll Localization for Robotic Harvesting: Evaluation of Deep Learning Vision Models Under Field Conditions
summary: This study developed and evaluated a deep-learning-based perception framework for selective robotic cotton picking. The dataset contained 1,008 annotated field images collected using three cameras under varying natural lighting and weather conditions. Object-detection models from the YOLOv8 through YOLOv13 families were evaluated using their default configurations, while segmentation performance was assessed using YOLOv8-seg, YOLOv11-seg, YOLOv12-seg, the Segment Anything Model (SAM), SAMv2.1, FastSAM, and Grounded-SAM with the Recognize Anything Model (RAM). Among the detection models, GELAN-s achieved the most favorable balance between mean average precision (mAP) and inference speed, obtaining an mAP of 86.1%, precision of 81.6%, recall of 76.6%, and an F1-score of 79.0%, with an average inference time of 42.3 ms per image. Among the direct segmentation models, YOLOv12-m-seg provided the most favorable balance between AP@0.5 and FPS, achieving a segmentation AP@0.5 of 83.7% with an inference time of 20.4 ms per image. In the detection-prompted segmentation approach, bounding-box prompts generated by GELAN-s improved the localization of cotton bolls for SAM and SAMv2.1, while SAMv2.1 Tiny consistently outperformed FastSAM and Grounded-SAM with RAM. In the area-based evaluation against manually annotated segmentation masks, YOLOv12-m-seg achieved an $R^2$ value of 0.966, compared with 0.860 for GELAN-s + SAMv2.1 Tiny. Field experiments conducted using a UR5e robotic manipulator, a custom end-effector, and a ZED2i stereo camera further validated the effectiveness of the YOLOv12-m-seg model for real-time cotton boll detection, segmentation, and selective picking under varying confidence levels. These results demonstrate that YOLOv12-m-seg provides an efficient perception model for robotic cotton harvesting and has strong potential for field deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建并评估了面向选择性机器人采棉的深度学习感知框架，系统比较了YOLOv8–YOLOv13系列检测模型与多种分割模型，并在真实机器人平台上验证了YOLOv12-m-seg的性能。
AI.motivation: 选择性机器人采棉需要兼顾检测精度与实时性，且田间自然光照、天气多变，现有研究缺乏对多代YOLO检测模型与多种分割范式的系统比较，也不清楚检测引导分割策略与端到端分割模型在棉铃感知中的实际优劣。
AI.method: 使用三台相机采集的1,008张田间标注图像；检测任务评估YOLOv8至YOLOv13系列默认配置模型，分割任务评估YOLOv8-seg、YOLOv11-seg、YOLOv12-seg、SAM、SAMv2.1、FastSAM以及结合RAM的Grounded-SAM；并采用检测框作为提示驱动SAM类模型进行分割。最后基于UR5e机械臂、定制末端执行器与ZED2i立体相机开展田间采摘实验。
AI.result: 检测模型中GELAN-s在mAP与推理速度间最优，mAP 86.1%、精确率81.6%、召回率76.6%、F1 79.0%，单图推理42.3 ms；直接分割模型中YOLOv12-m-seg在AP@0.5与FPS间最优，分割AP@0.5为83.7%，单图推理20.4 ms；GELAN-s生成的边界框提示提升了SAM与SAMv2.1的棉铃定位，SAMv2.1 Tiny优于FastSAM与Grounded-SAM with RAM；基于面积的评估中YOLOv12-m-seg的R²为0.966，GELAN-s+SAMv2.1 Tiny为0.860；田间实验验证了YOLOv12-m-seg在不同置信度下实时检测、分割与选择性采摘的有效性。
AI.conclusion: YOLOv12-m-seg在精度、速度与分割质量上综合表现最佳，是面向机器人采棉的高效感知模型，具备较强的田间部署潜力。

title: Enhancing the Perception of Safety and Comfort during Physical Human-Robot Handshake Interactions by Integrating Flexible Elements into a Robotic Arm
summary: Safety and comfort in human-robot physical in-teractions are essential aspects in the development of social technologies, where natural gestures, such as handshakes, represent a challenge due to their direct physical contact. The implementation of series elastic actuators (SEA) to absorb impacts is proposed as a design strategy that favors safer interactions. This paper presents an experimental study aimed at evaluating how the incorporation of SEAs in robotic arms influences perceived safety and the interaction experience dur-ing handshaking. The design allows a direct comparison of the effect of rigidity versus the incorporation of elastic elements, in order to identify the advantages of SEAs in improving the physical safety and social acceptance of robotic systems in everyday contexts. The experiment was carried out with 10 volunteers (6 men and 4 women), who performed two interactions with each robotic arm: one with rigid joints and the other with flexible joints using SEA. During testing, objective data on end-effector trajectories were collected, as well as subjective information through a perception survey focused on safety, naturalness, and confidence during the handshake. The survey results show increased perceptions of safety and comfort with the SEA-equipped arm, supporting its potential to facilitate safer and more socially accepted human-robot interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验比较刚性关节与串联弹性驱动器(SEA)关节机械臂在握手交互中对感知安全性与舒适度的影响，发现SEA能提升安全感和交互体验。
AI.motivation: 人机物理交互中的安全与舒适是社交机器人发展的关键问题，握手等自然手势因直接物理接触而具有挑战性；采用串联弹性驱动器(SEA)吸收冲击被视为有利于更安全交互的设计策略，但缺乏对其影响感知安全性与交互体验的实证评估。
AI.method: 设计可直�接对比刚性关节与弹性元件(SEA)效果的实验；10名志愿者(6男4女)分别与两种机械臂各完成一次握手交互(刚性关节与SEA柔性关节)；采�集末端执行器轨迹的客观数据，并通过聚焦安全性、自然性与信心的感知问卷获取主观信息。
AI.result: 问卷结果显示，装配SEA的机械臂在安全性与舒适度方面获得更高的感知评价，支持其在促进更安全、更易被社会接受的人机交互方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 在机械臂中引入SEA有助于提升握手交互中的感知安全性与舒适度，表明弹性驱动器设计能增强机器人系统在日常场景中的物理安全性与社会接受度。

title: EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data
summary: Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether an agent can retain that benefit when selecting from a library. In controlled transfer, matched skills improve success over no-skill prompting and require fewer steps on paired successes, while abstraction is substantially more effective than replaying raw trajectories. At library scale, retrieval is competitive with the no-skill baseline overall and performs best on directly covered tasks; coverage-stratified outcomes show that approximate matches on uncovered tasks offset these gains. Browser trajectories further identify when procedural guidance shortens portal-specific navigation and when semantic verification remains necessary. These results establish that reusable economic web procedures can transfer across task instances and provide a concrete design target for coverage-aware selection and context delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EconSkills——一个将 EconWebArena 验证轨迹蒸馏为参数化标准操作程序（SOP）的技能库与评测框架，验证了经济数据检索技能可跨任务实例迁移，并揭示技能库规模下检索效果受覆盖度制约。
AI.motivation: Web agent 常重复访问相同站点，但现有评测通常丢弃此前成功交互中习得的流程，导致可复用的经验未被沉淀和迁移。作者希望将已验证轨迹转化为可复用的程序性知识，并厘清"已知相关流程能否迁移"与"agent 能否从技能库中筛选并获益"这两个不同问题。
AI.method: 构建 EconSkills 技能库与评测框架：把 EconWebArena 的验证轨迹蒸馏为参数化 SOP，每条技能记录适用范围、导航流程、站点特定指引、验证检查与恢复步骤，并将源实例取值替换为占位符。实验设计分两层：受控迁移（匹配技能 vs. 无技能提示 vs. 原始轨迹回放）与库级规模下的技能检索选择，并做覆盖度分层分析与浏览器轨迹分析。
AI.result: 受控迁移中，匹配技能相比无技能提示提升成功率，且在配对成功案例上所需步骤更少；抽象化显著优于原始轨迹回放。库级规模下，检索整体与无技能基线相当，在直接覆盖任务上表现最佳；覆盖度分层显示未覆盖任务上的近似匹配会抵消部分收益。浏览器轨迹进一步区分了程序性指引何时能缩短门户特定导航，以及语义验证何时仍属必要。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的经济类 Web 操作流程能够跨任务实例迁移，为覆盖度感知的技能选择与上下文投递提供了具体的设计目标。

title: Enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network by Domain Knowledge
summary: Accurate prediction of nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions from agriculture is important for assessing environmental impacts and supporting sustainable farming. However, prediction remains difficult because N2O emissions result from complex interactions among soil properties, climate, biochemical processes, and management practices, while high-quality observations are limited. Deep learning models can capture nonlinear relationships but often lack physical interpretability and may generalize poorly across environmental conditions. We propose the Knowledge-enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network (KAINN), a hybrid neural-mechanistic framework that extends the Agriculture-informed Neural Network by incorporating domain knowledge about fertilizer diffusion, soil respiration, and water-filled porosity. We evaluate KAINN using CNN, LSTM, and Transformer architectures across multiple growing seasons and input-feature configurations. The results show that KAINN generally provides lower root mean square error and mean absolute error and higher R-squared values than purely data-driven models and the original AINN. Analysis of the learned interfaces also shows smoother and more physically consistent parameter trajectories with reduced uncertainty. These findings demonstrate that incorporating environmental knowledge into neural networks can improve the reliability, interpretability, and generalization of agricultural N2O-emission predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识增强型农业信息神经网络（KAINN），通过融合肥料扩散、土壤呼吸与充水孔隙度等领域知识，提升农业N2O排放预测的精度、可解释性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 农业N2O排放预测对评估环境影响和支撑可持续农业至关重要，但其受土壤性质、气候、生化过程和管理措施复杂交互影响，且高质量观测数据有限。纯深度学习虽能捕捉非线性关系，却缺乏物理可解释性，并难以跨环境条件泛化。
AI.method: 提出KAINN混合神经-机理框架，在农业信息神经网络（AINN）基础上引入肥料扩散、土壤呼吸和充水孔隙度等领域知识；并在CNN、LSTM和Transformer架构及多生长季、多输入特征配置下进行评估。
AI.result: KAINN通常具有更低的RMSE和MAE、更高的R²，优于纯数据驱动模型和原始AINN；学习到的接口参数轨迹更平滑、更符合物理规律，且不确定性降低。
AI.conclusion: 将环境知识融入神经网络可提升农业N2O排放预测的可靠性、可解释性和泛化能力。

title: FINSKILLOPS: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for SEC Filing QA
summary: Financial QA systems are typically improved before deployment through better retrieval, prompting, or agent coordination, leaving their reliability behavior fixed thereafter. In practice, new SEC-filing questions repeatedly expose heterogeneous errors in period, entity, evidence use, and calculation. Existing self-improvement methods can turn failures into new behaviors, but offer limited control over where a correction should apply or which previously correct answers it may break. We therefore frame post-deployment improvement as controlled behavioral maintenance: recurring failures should become scoped skill patches, and each patch should earn deployment with- out introducing regressions. We instantiate this view in FINSKILLOPS, a multi-agent system for SEC filing QA. FINSKILLOPS derives reusable skills from evidence-grounded, typed failure diagnoses and governs them through targeted validation, protected-case regression checks, negative controls, and versioned replacement or retirement. Across six financial QA benchmarks, a single frozen skill registry achieves the highest verdict-weighted correctness and reference consistency among the evaluated systems. Evolved skills raise correctness from 3.70 to 4.55 on our enhanced benchmark. In a separate 12-round operational study, only six of 33 proposed skills are promoted, while the monitoring non-correct rate falls from 20.0% to 12.5%. These results establish controlled skill scope, admission, and lifecycle management as the foundation for reliable self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 该文将金融问答系统部署后的改进问题界定为"受控行为维护"：将重复出现的失败转化为有范围的技能补丁，并通过验证、回归检查与生命周期管理决定其是否上线。作者提出的FINSKILLOPS多智能体系统在六个金融问答基准上取得最高正确率与参考一致性，且在12轮运行研究中仅33个候选技能中6个被采纳，监控错误率由20.0%降至12.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有金融问答系统的改进多发生在部署之前（检索、提示或智能体协调），部署后可靠性行为固定不变。而新的SEC文件问题会持续暴露期间、实体、证据使用与计算等异质性错误。已有自改进方法虽能把失败转化为新行为，但难以控制修正的适用范围，也无法避免破坏原本正确的答案。因此需要一个可控的部署后改进框架。
AI.method: 作者将部署后改进重构为"受控行为维护"，要求重复失败转化为有范围限制的技能补丁，且每个补丁需在不引入回归的前提下获得部署资格。据此构建FINSKILLOPS多智能体SEC文件问答系统：从基于证据、带类型标注的失败诊断中提炼可复用技能，并通过定向验证、保护案例回归检查、负对照以及版本化替换或退役机制对技能进行治理。
AI.result: 在六个金融问答基准上，单一冻结的技能注册表在所评估系统中取得最高的判定加权正确率与参考一致性；演化技能在增强基准上把正确率从3.70提升到4.55。在另一项12轮运行研究中，33个候选技能仅6个被正式采纳，监控非正确率从20.0%降至12.5%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，受控的技能范围、准入与生命周期管理是可靠自改进的基础，为金融问答系统部署后的持续可靠性维护提供了可行范式。

title: Parallelism, critical windows, and separations among diffusion language models
summary:
A popular selling point of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is their capacity for parallelism: the ability to generate sequences of text far more efficiently than autoregressive models, which require one forward pass per token. Yet among the many competing paradigms for dLLMs, from masked to uniform to Gaussian diffusion, principled understanding of how these different proposals compare in parallelism remains limited. In this work, we initiate a fine-grained comparison of the capacity for parallelism among these three leading approaches and prove the following:
  - Uniform and Gaussian diffusion can sample in a number of forward passes which scales with the dual total correlation of the underlying distribution, a measure of intrinsic complexity which can be much smaller than the context length. Previously, it was only known how to achieve this using masked diffusion.
  - For a certain family of random empirical measures, we show that $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{d})$ forward passes are necessary and sufficient to sample using uniform or Gaussian diffusion, yet there exist approximate score oracles for which $\widetildeΩ(d)$ forward passes are needed for masked diffusion. This establishes the first provable separation in parallelism between the three prevailing dLLM paradigms.
  Contrary to popular intuition that masked diffusions are harder to parallelize because they must commit to token values, the latter separation instead comes from the fact that the critical windows in masked diffusion sampling are asymptotically narrower than those in uniform and Gaussian diffusion sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对掩码、均匀、高斯三种主流扩散大语言模型的并行能力进行了细粒度理论比较，证明了均匀/高斯扩散的采样前向次数可随分布的内在复杂度（对偶总相关）缩放，并在特定随机经验测度族上建立了三者间首个可证明的并行性分离。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的核心卖点是并行生成，比需逐token前向的自回归模型更高效。然而在掩码、均匀、高斯扩散等多种范式之间，尚缺乏关于并行能力的原理性理解与比较。
AI.method: 对三种主流dLLM范式（掩码、均匀、高斯扩散）的并行能力进行细粒度理论比较，通过采样所需前向传播次数的复杂度分析给出证明，并构造特定随机经验测度族与近似score oracle进行下界与上界刻画。
AI.result: 证明均匀与高斯扩散可在与对偶总相关（内在复杂度度量，可远小于上下文长度）成比例的前向次数内完成采样，此前仅有掩码扩散已知可达到这一效果；对某类随机经验测度，均匀/高斯扩散需且仅需Õ(√d)次前向，而掩码扩散在某些近似score oracle下需要Õ(d)次，首次建立了三者可证明的并行性分离。
AI.conclusion: 与"掩码扩散因必须确定token取值而更难并行"的流行直觉相反，该分离实际源于掩码扩散采样的关键窗口渐近地比均匀与高斯扩散采样更窄。

title: VGGT-GS SLAM: Uncalibrated Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Feed-Forward Priors
summary: We present VGGT-GS SLAM, a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system designed for uncalibrated videos. Starting from feed-forward VGGT pose and depth priors, our system performs submap differentiable bundle adjustment that jointly refines camera poses and a 3D Gaussian map, while optimizing submap-shared intrinsics and radial--tangential distortion through analytic calibration Jacobians. To improve global consistency, we introduce Gaussian-native alignment (GNA) for camera-anchored scale refinement between sequential submaps and verification of loop-closure candidates. Extensive experiments on standard indoor benchmarks show consistent improvements in localization accuracy and strong rendering quality under uncalibrated settings, establishing a strong baseline for uncalibrated Gaussian SLAM.

AI.tldr: VGGT-GS SLAM：面向未标定视频的单目3DGS SLAM，用VGGT前馈位姿/深度先验做子图可微BA，联合优化相机位姿、3D高斯地图与内参+径向切向畸变，并引入高斯原生对齐(GNA)提升全局一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯SLAM多依赖已标定相机，未标定视频下内参与畸变未知，导致定位与建图退化；需一个可直接处理未标定单目视频的高斯SLAM基线。
AI.method: 1) 以VGGT前馈位姿与深度作为先验初始化；2) 子图可微光束法平差，联合精化相机位姿与3D高斯地图；3) 通过解析标定雅可比优化子图共享内参与径向-切向畸变；4) 提出高斯原生对齐(GNA)，用于序列子图间的相机锚定尺度细化及回环候选验证。
AI.result: 在标准室内基准上，未标定设定下定位精度持续提升，并保持较强渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未标定高斯SLAM建立了强基线，验证了前馈几何先验+可微子图优化+标定联合估计的有效性。

title: Task-Oriented Active Learning of Residual Dynamics for Model Predictive Path Integral Control
summary: Online residual learning can reduce model mismatch in predictive control, but passive data collection may fail to adequately cover states that become important later in the task. Task-agnostic active learning targets uncertain or informative regions, but information acquired in such regions does not necessarily improve task performance. This paper introduces Task-Oriented Information Acquisition (ToIA), an active-learning criterion for model predictive path integral control (MPPI) with online Gaussian process (GP) residual learning. For each sampled control sequence, ToIA estimates how much an observation obtained early in the rollout would reduce predictive uncertainty at later states on the same rollout, and weights this reduction by the rollout's relevance to the task. The score is evaluated over the existing MPPI rollout batch without sampling future observations or re-optimizing control under hypothetical posterior updates. In simulated off-road navigation across held-out maps with heterogeneous terrain, ToIA improved the goal-reaching success rate over passive GP learning by 19.3 and 27.4 percentage points and outperformed task-agnostic active-learning baselines across dense and sparse online-learning intervals. An ablation study indicates that task relevance is particularly important under sparse model updates. The implementation supports online control at 20 Hz on an NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向任务的主动学习准则ToIA，用于MPPI控制中的在线GP残差学习，通过评估早期观测对未来状态预测不确定性的削减并以任务相关性加权，提升越野导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 在线残差学习可缓解预测控制中的模型失配，但被动数据采集难以覆盖任务后期才变得重要的状态；而任务无关的主动学习虽关注不确定或信息量大的区域，却不一定能提升任务性能。
AI.method: 提出Task-Oriented Information Acquisition（ToIA）准则，结合在线高斯过程残差学习与模型预测路径积分控制（MPPI）。对每个采样的控制序列，估计rollout早期获得的观测能在多大程度上降低同一rollout后期状态的预测不确定性，并以该rollout与任务的相关性进行加权。评分直接在现有MPPI rollout批次上计算，无需采样未来观测，也无需在假设后验更新下重新优化控制。
AI.result: 在异构地形、留出地图的仿真越野导航中，ToIA相比被动GP学习将到达目标成功率提升19.3和27.4个百分点，并在密集与稀疏在线学习间隔下均优于任务无关主动学习基线。消融实验表明任务相关性在稀疏模型更新时尤为重要。实现可在NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti上以20 Hz支持在线控制。
AI.conclusion: 将信息获取与任务相关性耦合的主动学习准则能有效提升在线残差学习预测控制的任务性能，尤其在稀疏更新场景下，且计算开销满足实时控制需求。

title: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Trustworthy Large Language Models, Agentic AI, and Multimodal Systems
summary: Benchmark scores alone provide an incomplete basis for assessing the trustworthiness of modern artificial intelligence systems. Large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, and multimodal models (MLLMs) require different forms of assessment, yet their evaluation evidence must remain interpretable for development and oversight. We propose a unified framework that connects output-level, trajectory-level, and cross-modal assessment through eight trustworthiness dimensions: capability, robustness, safety, fairness, transparency, governance, oversight, and efficiency. The framework preserves system-specific metrics while mapping native measurements to common performance bands, accompanied by uncertainty estimates and traceable evidence. A meta-evaluation layer examines the validity, reliability, and reproducibility of the evaluation itself. Multidimensional profiles expose strengths and weaknesses, while safety-critical overrides prevent aggregate scores from masking critical failures. Mappings to governance frameworks, international standards, and European Union regulatory requirements connect technical assessment with oversight needs. The framework provides a structured basis for assessing both system performance and the credibility of the evidence supporting it, with empirical validation across deployment contexts remaining an essential next step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的AI可信度评估框架，通过八个可信度维度连接输出级、轨迹级与跨模态评估，并加入元评估层以检验评估本身的有效性、可靠性与可复现性。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖基准分数不足以评估现代AI系统（如大语言模型、智能体系统、多模态模型）的可信度。不同系统需要不同形式的评估，但其评估证据必须对开发与监管保持可解释性。同时，技术评估还需与治理框架、国际标准及欧盟监管要求衔接。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：设定能力、鲁棒性、安全性、公平性、透明度、治理、监督、效率八个可信度维度；保留系统特定指标，同时将原生测量映射到统一性能区间，并附加不确定性估计与可追溯证据；引入元评估层检验评估的有效性、可靠性与可复现性；通过多维画像展示优劣，并设置安全关键覆盖机制防止总分掩盖关键失效。
AI.result: 框架可生成多维可信度画像、暴露系统优势与弱点，并通过安全关键覆盖机制避免聚合分数掩盖关键失效；同时提供与治理框架、国际标准及欧盟监管要求的映射，将技术评估与监督需求相连接。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为评估系统性能及其证据可信度提供了结构化基础，但跨部署情境的实证验证仍是下一步的必要工作。

title: Search at the Cost of Sampling: Nearly-Instant Latent Space Bayesian Optimization
summary: Generative models are increasingly central to many de novo discovery pipelines, in which designs are generated at scale and filtered through virtual screens to determine a set of candidates to experimentally validate. While Bayesian optimization (BO) is a natural fit for this setting, as it uses past evaluations to guide future proposals, the computational overhead required for its sequential decision-making becomes a bottleneck when virtual screens are relatively cheap. We make BO practical in this regime by exploiting the unique combination of a linear model constrained to a spherical domain where high-dimensional latents concentrate. We build off recent work justifying the use of linear surrogates, while deriving nearly closed-form solutions to the surrogate modelling and acquisition problems that exploit spherical symmetry. The result is at least a 100x speedup over state-of-the art baselines, with matching or improved performance across molecular and image generation benchmarks. Altogether, our method makes BO a practical drop-in for de novo pipelines where it was previously too slow to consider.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种利用球面几何特性的线性代理贝叶斯优化方法，实现至少100倍加速，使BO可实用地嵌入de novo设计流程。
AI.motivation: 生成模型越来越多地用于de novo发现流程，生成大规模设计并通过虚拟筛选确定候选。贝叶斯优化虽适合利用历史评估指导后续提议，但其顺序决策的计算开销在虚拟筛选较廉价时成为瓶颈，此前因太慢而难以采用。
AI.method: 利用线性模型约束于球面域、且高维隐变量在球面上集中的独特组合。基于近期关于使用线性代理的工作，利用球面对称性推导代理建模与采集函数的近乎闭式解。
AI.result: 相比最先进基线实现至少100倍加速，在分子与图像生成基准上性能持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使贝叶斯优化成为de novo流程中可即插即用的实用组件，适用于此前因过慢而不予考虑的场景。

title: Form Over Content In Gradient-Based Data Attribution Methods
summary: Data attribution methods using gradient similarity are widely used to analyze and select training data for large language models, but what gradient similarity actually measures is debated. Some interpret it as identifying task-relevant skills, while other work reports that surface form is the main factor. We resolve this debate for supervised fine-tuning examples by varying task and answer format independently. Specifically, we render benchmarks in different answer formats, such that datasets can share a task without a format or a format without a task. We find that gradient alignment follows the answer format, as benchmark pairs sharing an answer format align strongly (disattenuated cosine near 0.4), while same benchmarks rendered with different answer format classes show no alignment (near 0.0). We demonstrate that this ordering holds from the earliest pretraining checkpoints through post-training, and across model scales and families. We then analyze the released selections of LESS, a gradient-based data selection method for instruction tuning, and find that each target's selections over-represent the target's own answer format. Hence, we demonstrate that gradient-based attribution methods track format similarity more than task semantics, meaning that such methods, as well as the semantic interpretation of the gradient, should be tested on data where answer format and task vary independently for greater robustness and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过独立变化任务与答案格式，证明基于梯度相似度的数据归因方法主要追踪答案格式相似性而非任务语义，并建议在格式与任务正交的数据上测试此类方法。
AI.motivation: 梯度相似度被广泛用于大语言模型的训练数据分析和选择，但其真正度量什么存在争议：一派认为是任务相关技能，另一派认为表层形式才是主导因素。作者希望解决这一争议。
AI.method: 对监督微调样本进行解耦实验：独立变化任务与答案格式，用不同答案格式渲染基准，构造可共享任务而不共享格式、或共享格式而不共享任务的数据集；测量梯度对齐度（去衰减余弦相似度），并跨预训练检查点、训练后阶段、模型规模与家族验证；进一步分析LESS方法的选取结果。
AI.result: 共享答案格式的基准对梯度对齐很强（去衰减余弦约0.4），而同一基准采用不同答案格式类别则几乎不对齐（约0.0）；该排序从最早预训练检查点到训练后阶段、跨模型规模与家族均成立；LESS对每个目标的选取都过度偏向目标自身的答案格式。
AI.conclusion: 梯度归因方法追踪的是格式相似性而非任务语义，因此这类方法及对梯度的语义解释应在答案格式与任务独立变化的数据上测试，以提高鲁棒性与可靠性。

title: Intrinsic Sequence-Likelihood Confidence in Retrieval-Dominated Extractive QA: Two Pre-Specified Negatives, and What They Do and Do Not Attribute
comment: 26 pages main text + 26 pages supplementary (Online Resource 3). Submitted to Applied Intelligence. Code and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22710121, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22721044
summary: In extractive document question answering whose questions were generated from the passages that contain their answers -- so that retrieval recovers 92-99.8% of what any mode combination could reach, whatever its absolute accuracy -- confidence-driven mechanisms have little to gain. Fine-tuning an open language model on a specialized domain corpus yields a model whose own confidence is a tempting control signal: it could decide which queries warrant further adaptation, and which answers to trust. We evaluate both uses under criteria fixed before the runs were executed, across four 7-9B model families whose adaptation moved closed-book F1 by at most +0.03, and both fail: a distillation trigger on all four families, under its pre-specified three-step transfer budget, and a routing-and-abstention policy in its single-model pilot. Retrieval alone recovers 92-99.8% of best-case combined accuracy under every correctness criterion we test, leaving routers no meaningful gain. The sequence-likelihood signal is insufficient relative to that mode -- area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.65-0.81 under the registered criterion -- before adaptation as well as after, unchanged by scalar recalibration and not consistently improved by token-level temperature rescaling. And the finer diagnostics depend on the correctness criterion and on answer length; on the three adapted combinations where we could test it, selector ablations show no statistically detectable downstream benefit from the confidence term on any seed; on Gemma, removing it changes the selector from failing to passing both registered criteria. The usable product is a set of pre-specified negatives with their dependencies made explicit.

AI.tldr: 在抽取式文档问答（问题由含答案的段落生成，检索本身已能恢复92-99.8%的收益上限）设定下，作者预先固定评估标准，测试微调后开源模型的自置信度能否用于蒸馏触发与路由/弃答，四个7-9B模型族全部失败：序列似然信号AUC仅0.65-0.81，检索增益几近为零，置信项无下游收益甚至有害。产物是一组有明确依赖关系的预注册负面结果。
AI.motivation: 微调专用语料后的开源模型，其自身置信度看似是诱人的控制信号，可用于决定哪些查询需要进一步适配、哪些答案可信。但本文指出：在抽取式文档问答中，问题由含答案的段落生成、检索已能覆盖92-99.8%的组合上限，此时置信驱动机制本身缺乏收益空间，因此需要对该信号的两种用途做严格检验。
AI.method: 作者在运行前即固定评估标准，覆盖四个7-9B模型族（其适配仅使闭卷F1最多提升+0.03），检验两种用途：(1) 蒸馏触发，使用预定的三步迁移预算；(2) 单模型试点中的路由与弃答策略。评估指标包括序列似然信号的AUC、标量重校准、token级温度重缩放，以及选择器消融（selector ablation）以考察置信项的下游贡献。
AI.result: 两种用途均失败。四种模型族的蒸馏触发在预定三步预算下失败，路由与弃答策略在单模型试点中失败。检索在全部正确性标准下均能恢复92-99.8%的最佳组合准确率，路由无实质增益。序列似然信号相对该模式不足，注册标准下AUC为0.65-0.81，适配前后均如此，标量重校准无法改变，token级温度重缩放也未带来一致提升。更细的诊断依赖正确性标准与答案长度；在可测试的三个适配组合中，选择器消融显示置信项在任何随机种子上均无可统计检测的下游收益，而在Gemma上移除置信项反而使选择器从两个注册标准均失败转为均通过。
AI.conclusion: 微调开源模型的置信度不适宜作为蒸馏触发或路由/弃答的控制信号，因为在检索已接近上限的抽取式文档问答中缺乏可用增益空间。论文的可用产物是一组预注册的负面结果，并明确刻画了各结果之间的依赖关系，为后续置信驱动机制研究提供了可复用的边界。

title: Epidemiological Causal Graph Identification: Challenges, Identifiability and Algorithms
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, accepted at the 60th Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers 2026
summary: Causal discovery from observational data is fundamental to statistics and machine learning, yet determining causal direction without interventions necessitates structural assumptions. Existing identifiability research primarily focuses on continuous variables under additive noise models, often neglecting mixed datasets containing ordinal scales, counts, and continuous measurements. This paper investigates causal discovery in Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) where nodes follow either an ordinal distribution (via an ordered logit model) or a regular one-parameter exponential family distribution. We prove that the edge direction between an ordinal and an exponential family node is distributionally identifiable for generic parameter values. Our findings generalize previous Ordinal-Poisson results to the broader exponential family. Computationally, we introduce a score-based exhaustive search and a masked continuous optimization framework using DAGMA for larger graphs. Numerical results validate the theory, recovering edge orientations within a Markov equivalence class that are unidentifiable under classical structural equation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合数据类型（序数变量与单参数指数族变量）下DAG的因果发现，证明序数节点与指数族节点间的边方向在一般参数值下可分布识别，并给出基于评分搜索与DAGMA掩码优化的计算方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果可识别性研究主要关注加性噪声模型下的连续变量，忽视了同时包含序数尺度、计数和连续测量的混合数据集，导致此类实际数据的因果方向判定缺乏理论保障。
AI.method: 将序数节点建模为有序logit模型，其余节点服从正则的单参数指数族分布；证明序数节点与指数族节点之间的边方向在一般参数值下具有分布可识别性；计算上提出基于评分的穷举搜索以及基于DAGMA的掩码连续优化框架以处理较大图。
AI.result: 理论证明将已有Ordinal-Poisson结果推广至更广的指数族；数值实验验证了理论，能够在Markov等价类内恢复出经典结构方程模型下不可识别的边方向。
AI.conclusion: 序数与指数族混合数据的因果方向在广泛条件下可识别，突破了传统结构方程模型的可识别性局限，为混合类型观测数据的因果发现提供了理论与算法支持。

title: Instance Segmentation and Fine-grained Classification for Urban Buildings with Adaptive Region Dividing and Spatially-Supervised Contrastive Learning
summary: Accurate instance-level and functional understanding of urban buildings in large-scale point clouds is essential for digital city modeling and urban analysis. However, the extensive spatial coverage of urban scenes leads most existing methods to rely on predefined blocks for training and evaluation, although such partitions are rarely available in real-world applications and introduce additional preprocessing while fragmenting complete building structures. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive region-dividing strategy with unified scene-level evaluation. Specifically, the 3D point cloud is projected onto a bird's-eye-view (BEV) plane, where a pretrained segmentation model is used to detect building regions. The detected bounding boxes are then back-projected to the original point cloud to construct structure-aligned adaptive training blocks, enabling semantically guided dynamic partitioning without manual design. Furthermore, beyond instance-level understanding, few methods have explored fine-grained classification for urban buildings, and thus we also put forward a fine-grained classification model for urban buildings with a spatially-supervised contrastive loss. First, for each segmented building, a point transformer classifier jointly encodes its body and local context using geometric, color, and core-context information. Then, the class-balanced weighted cross-entropy is used to alleviate severe class imbalance. The proposed spatially-supervised contrastive loss further enhances inter-class discriminability by assigning greater weight to spatially proximate, same-category buildings, encouraging compact functional representations while separating easily confused categories. Extensive experiments on UrbanBIS and STPLS3D demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method in building instance segmentation and fine-grained classification compared to existing SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应区域划分策略与统一场景级评估，并结合细粒度分类模型，提升大规模城市点云中建筑的实例分割与功能分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有城市点云方法多依赖预定义分块进行训练与评估，但真实应用中此类划分往往不可得，且会引入额外预处理并割裂完整建筑结构；同时对城市建筑的细粒度功能分类研究不足，类别不平衡问题严重。
AI.method: 将3D点云投影至BEV平面，用预训练分割模型检测建筑区域，再反投影回原始点云构建结构对齐的自适应训练块，实现语义引导的动态划分；针对细粒度分类，提出点Transformer分类器联合编码建筑主体与局部上下文（几何、颜色、核心上下文信息），采用类别平衡加权交叉熵缓解类别不平衡，并提出空间监督对比损失，对空间邻近同类建筑赋予更大权重以增强类间判别性。
AI.result: 在UrbanBIS和STPLS3D数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在建筑实例分割和细粒度分类任务上均优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过自适应区域划分与统一场景级评估克服了预定义分块的局限，并将细粒度建筑功能分类与实例分割相结合，为大规模城市点云的建筑理解提供了有效方案。

title: From Rollout to Reset: A Graph-Based Harness for Autonomous Long-Horizon Manipulation Evaluation
summary: Robot manipulation policies are improving quickly, and real-robot evaluation remains the standard evidence for that progress. It still relies on a human to reset the scene between rollouts, which consumes operator time and leaves the initial state distribution unspecified, so results reproduce poorly. A recent system, AutoEval, automates both reset and scoring, but only for single-step tasks, because a long-horizon rollout can terminate in combinatorially many configurations that no single learned reset policy covers. We present HALTER, a Harness for Autonomous Long-horizon Task Evaluation and Reset, which restores the scene by planning over a library of learned atomic reset skills, so demonstration cost scales with the size of that library rather than with the number of terminal states. HALTER builds a spatial scene graph online from point clouds and vision foundation models, and an LLM reasons over this graph to score the rollout, plan the reset, and verify that the reset succeeded, without collecting labeled success images for any task. On four long-horizon tasks on a Franka arm, HALTER restores the scene in 76% of episodes, against 52% for AutoEval and 65% for a motion-planning reset, and it estimates the completed-skill fraction correctly in 90% of episodes, against 76%. Its reset-verification verdict is correct in 91% of episodes, compared with 78% for AutoEval. It also cuts the operator time of an evaluation campaign by 72% relative to manual reset. We further measure compositional generalization on three held-out tasks, where HALTER resets 74.7% of episodes against 1.3% for a per-task reset policy, and we ablate the scene representation and the graph update rate.

AI.tldr: HALTER 是一个面向长时程机器人操作任务的自主评估与复位系统，通过规划一组已学习的原子复位技能来恢复场景，实现无需人工介入的自动化评估与复位。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人评估仍需人工复位场景，耗费操作者时间，且初始状态分布未明确，导致结果可复现性差。现有自动化系统 AutoEval 仅适用于单步任务，因为长时程 rollout 的终止配置组合爆炸，单一学习的复位策略无法覆盖。
AI.method: HALTER 在已学习的原子复位技能库上进行规划，使演示成本随技能库规模而非终止状态数量扩展。它在线从点云和视觉基础模型构建空间场景图，并利用 LLM 在该图上推理，以完成 rollout 评分、复位规划及复位成功性验证，且无需收集任何任务的成功标注图像。
AI.result: 在 Franka 机械臂的四项长时程任务上，HALTER 在 76% 的回合中恢复场景，优于 AutoEval 的 52% 和运动规划复位的 65%；完成技能比例的估计准确率为 90%（对比 76%）；复位验证判定在 91% 的回合中正确（对比 78%）；相比人工复位，评估活动的操作者时间减少 72%。在三项留出任务上，HALTER 复位 74.7% 的回合，而逐任务复位策略仅为 1.3%。
AI.conclusion: HALTER 通过原子复位技能库规划、空间场景图与 LLM 推理，有效解决了长时程任务自动化评估与复位的难题，兼具高效率、无需成功标注和良好的组合泛化能力，并通过对场景表示与图更新速率的消融验证了各组件贡献。

title: Self Improvement via Fast Tree-search
summary: Coding agents can recursively modify their own implementations, forming a loop of self-improvement. While prior work shows this can boost performance on coding benchmarks, existing approaches are costly and compute-intensive. We introduce a simple, sample-efficient self-improvement framework that significantly improves coding performance under strict budget constraints. We identify evaluation of candidate self-modifications as the main runtime bottleneck since prior approaches estimate their effectiveness by re-running a subset of benchmark tasks with the modified agent, which is time-consuming. We introduce Recursive Self Improvement via Fast Tree-search (SIFT), which augments these downstream task evaluations with an LLM-as-a-judge signal that performs pairwise comparisons between candidate patches, where the win-loss record is aggregated with a regularized Bradley-Terry model, and the resulting strength scores drive rank-based parent sampling inside a lightweight disaggregated tree search. Expensive downstream task evaluations are reserved only for the most promising nodes. Using a fully disaggregated tree search pipeline, the judge scores provide intermediate signal to guide exploration on promising candidate patches without being bottlenecked by slow evaluation runs. SIFT outperforms existing tree-search based self-evolution frameworks on the full Polyglot benchmark with significantly lower resource requirements in terms of CPU hours, wall clock time, and API cost.

AI.tldr: 提出SIFT框架，用LLM-as-a-judge与正则化Bradley-Terry模型替代昂贵的下游任务评测，在轻量级解耦树搜索中高效实现编码代理的递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 编码代理可通过递归修改自身实现自我提升，但现有方法依赖用修改后代理重跑基准任务子集来评估候选自修改的有效性，导致资源与算力开销大、评测成为运行时瓶颈。
AI.method: SIFT在树搜索中用LLM-as-a-judge对候选补丁做两两比较，将胜负记录以正则化Bradley-Terry模型聚合为强度分数，用于基于排名的父节点采样；采用完全解耦的树搜索流程，将昂贵的下游任务评测仅保留给最有前景的节点。
AI.result: 在完整Polyglot基准上，SIFT优于现有基于树搜索的自我进化框架，且在CPU小时、墙钟时间与API成本上资源需求显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 以廉价判别信号引导探索可突破评测瓶颈，实现样本高效、低成本的编码代理递归自我改进。

title: Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Experiments evaluate Phi-3-mini and Qwen2.5-1.5B on GSM8K and SciQ using NVIDIA A100 and V100 GPUs. Studies LLM test-time scaling, candidate-generation scheduling, latency, throughput, GPU-hours, and GPU-device energy
summary: Test-time scaling can improve large language model reasoning by generating and combining multiple candidate responses. In sampling-based methods, the inference budget is often described by the number of generated candidates, N. However, N tells us how many candidates are generated, not how they are executed. The same candidate budget can be produced in one batched generation call or split across several sequential calls with smaller batch sizes. We first study the effect of increasing N on reasoning accuracy using Phi-3-mini and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 500 GSM8K prompts. As expected, increasing N from 1 to 8 improves accuracy by 8.4 percentage points for Phi-3-mini and 18.4 points for Qwen2.5-1.5B. However, accuracy alone does not show the systems cost of using a larger candidate budget. We therefore fix N = 8 and compare four generation schedules: 1x8, 2x4, 4x2, and 8x1, where axb denotes a generation calls with b candidates per call. We measure latency, throughput, GPU-hours, and gross GPU-device energy while keeping the total candidate count fixed. On A100 GPUs, eight serial calls use 4.64-4.86x as much gross GPU-device energy and have 5.77-6.12x the P95 latency of one batched call with eight candidates. The same pattern appears across three independently scheduled A100 nodes per model and in short-output SciQ/V100 experiments. These results show that candidate count alone is not enough to describe the systems cost of multi-candidate test-time scaling. When candidates are independent and memory allows it, fewer generation calls with larger batch sizes are more efficient. Evaluations should therefore report not only candidate count and accuracy, but also generation schedule and GPU-level systems metrics.

AI.tldr: 固定候选数N=8时，生成调度方式（批大小与调用次数）显著影响系统成本：8次串行调用比1次批量调用的GPU设备能耗高4.64-4.86倍，P95延迟高5.77-6.12倍。
AI.motivation: 采样类test-time scaling常用候选数N描述推理预算，但N只说明生成多少候选，未说明如何执行；相同的N可一次批量生成，也可拆成多次小批量串行调用，二者系统成本可能差异巨大，而现有评估通常只报告N和准确率。
AI.method: 在500条GSM8K提示上，用Phi-3-mini和Qwen2.5-1.5B先验证N从1增至8的准确率增益；随后固定N=8，在A100上比较1x8、2x4、4x2、8x1四种生成调度（a×b表示a次调用、每次b个候选），测量延迟、吞吐、GPU小时和GPU设备总能耗，并在每模型三个独立调度的A100节点及短输出SciQ/V100实验上复现。
AI.result: N从1增至8使Phi-3-mini准确率提升8.4个百分点、Qwen2.5-1.5B提升18.4个百分点；固定N=8时，A100上8次串行调用的GPU设备总能耗为1次批量调用的4.64-4.86倍，P95延迟为5.77-6.12倍，该规律在三个独立A100节点及SciQ/V100短输出实验中一致出现。
AI.conclusion: 候选数本身不足以刻画多候选test-time scaling的系统成本；当候选相互独立且显存允许时，减少调用次数、增大批大小更高效。评估应同时报告候选数、准确率、生成调度及GPU级系统指标。

title: Full-Duplex Speech Models Take the Floor When Asked, Not When Needed
summary: Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at once, promising always-on assistants. Yet they must also decide when they should speak. Human listeners speak when addressed or when the speaker stops, but also self-select to correct a false claim, supply a missing word, or warn of danger. We ask whether full-duplex models do the same. To separate the reason to speak from the opportunity, we construct context-matched English monologues in which only the trigger utterance varies within a topic, define 10 conditions from turn-allocation rules, and compress inter-word pauses to limit opportunities created by silence. Across five model families, being addressed and silence are far more reliable triggers than false facts or hazards. Frame-level text-token probabilities in Moshi and PersonaPlex are lower for false facts than for Neutral when averaged over the first 2\,s after trigger end. Pauses or permission to interrupt do not close this gap either. Given the floor, Moshi and PersonaPlex answer most direct questions, yet the proportion of non-empty false-fact replies that challenge the claim is only .14--.15, and the proportion of hazard replies that warn of danger is .04--.07. This paper thus identifies a gap in both speech initiation and response content. Closing it requires genuine content understanding and intervention decisions grounded in it.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了语境匹配的英语独白语料与10种触发条件，系统评估五类全双工语音模型，发现"被点名"与"沉默"远比"虚假事实"或"危险警告"更能可靠触发发言；即使获得发言权，模型纠正虚假陈述与发出危险警告的比例也极低，暴露出语音启动与响应内容两方面的双重缺口。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型可同时听与说，是实现常驻助手的关键，但"何时该说"这一核心问题尚未被充分研究。人类不仅在被点名或对方停顿时发言，还会主动自我选择，去纠正错误主张、补充遗漏词语或警示危险。论文追问：全双工模型是否具备同样的能力。为此需将"发言的动机"与"发言的机会"解耦，现有研究缺乏可控的实验设置。
AI.method: 在英语独白中控制同一话题内仅触发句变化，构造语境匹配的语料；依据话轮分配规则定义10种条件；压缩词间停顿以削弱由静默带来的发言机会。在五个模型家族上测试，并分析 Moshi 与 PersonaPlex 在触发句结束后的前2秒内、逐帧文本 token 概率表现；同时检验停顿与"可打断许可"是否可缩小差距。
AI.result: 被点名与沉默的触发可靠性显著高于虚假事实与危险场景。Moshi 与 PersonaPlex 在触发句结束后前2秒的平均帧级 token 概率，对虚假事实低于对中性内容的概率。停顿或打断许可均无法弥合这一差距。在获得发言权的情况下，两模型能回答大多数直接提问，但针对虚假事实的非空回复中真正提出质疑的比例仅0.14–0.15，针对危险场景的回复中发出警告的比例仅0.04–0.07。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了全双工语音模型在"发言启动"与"响应内容"两方面的双重缺口。弥补该缺口需要真正的内容理解，以及建立在此理解之上的干预决策机制，而非仅依赖话轮规则与静默线索。

title: Viveka-Insight: a cross-lingual concept graph and citation-grounded retrieval resource over the complete works of Swami Vivekananda in English and Bengali
summary: Classical philosophical corpora pose three compounding challenges for language resources: they exist in several languages without parallel alignment, their vocabulary is remote from that of contemporary readers, and generated text over culturally sensitive material must be verifiably grounded. We present Viveka-Insight, a bilingual resource and open-source pipeline for the works of Swami Vivekananda (1863-1902): the nine-volume English Complete Works and the ten-volume Bengali Vani o Rachana, two related but non-parallel corpora of about 15 million characters. Four layers are released: (i) a structure-preserving parse (32,694 paragraphs, 168,842 sentences) with per-paragraph anchors deep-linking into the published editions; (ii) a cross-lingual concept graph of 8,362 language-agnostic concepts with 87,518 relation-typed paragraph-concept and 55,872 concept-concept edges, in which canonical English labels act as a string-equality key linking Bengali and English passages with no parallel data; (iii) a bilingual alias inventory of 60,850 surface forms (30,053 English, 30,797 Bengali); and (iv) a human-annotated set of 200 paragraph-concept edges judged by three annotators, released with all per-annotator judgments. We report known-item cross-lingual retrieval over 194 verified rendered lecture pairs (Recall@10 0.86 in both directions), a 30-question audit of citation integrity and modern-question bridging, and a human study placing concept-extraction precision at 0.60 under strict two-annotator consensus (Cohen's kappa = 0.61). The extractor's confidence weight is calibrated: restricting to weight >= 0.8 raises precision to 0.71 while retaining 98% of concept-bearing paragraphs. Precision is markedly lower in Bengali than English (0.54 vs 0.68), locating the weakness in exactly the half that cross-lingual access depends on. The design transfers to other multilingual classical corpora.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了Viveka-Insight——面向辨喜（Swami Vivekananda）著作的双语资源与开源流水线，包含结构保留解析、跨语言概念图、双语别名表与人工标注集，并给出跨语言检索、引用完整性与概念抽取精度的评估结果。
AI.motivation: 经典哲学语料对语言资源构成三重挑战：多语言但无平行对齐、词汇与当代读者距离远、且涉及文化敏感材料时生成文本必须可验证地有据可依。
AI.method: 发布四层资源：(i) 结构保留解析（32,694段、168,842句），带每段锚点深链至已出版版本；(ii) 跨语言概念图，含8,362个语言无关概念、87,518条关系类型的段落—概念边与55,872条概念—概念边，以规范英语标签作为字符串相等键，在无平行数据下连接孟加拉语与英语段落；(iii) 双语别名清单60,850个表层形式（英语30,053、孟加拉语30,797）；(iv) 由三名标注者判定的200条段落—概念边人工标注集，含全部逐标注者判断。
AI.result: 在194对已验证渲染讲稿上做已知项跨语言检索，双向Recall@10均为0.86；完成30问的引用完整性与现代问题桥接审计；人体研究中严格双标注者一致下概念抽取精度为0.60（Cohen's kappa=0.61）。抽取器置信权重经校准：限定权重≥0.8可将精度提升至0.71，同时保留98%含概念段落。孟加拉语精度显著低于英语（0.54 vs 0.68），弱点恰位于跨语言访问所依赖的那一半。
AI.conclusion: 该设计可迁移至其他多语言经典语料。

title: Scientific Image Quality Assessment via Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for scientific image quality assessment, designed to simultaneously address both the understanding track (SIQA-U) and the scoring track (SIQA-S) of the SIQA challenge. We construct a multimodal index that integrates textual semantics with fine-grained visual features, and develop a multi-route retrieval and fusion mechanism to provide large language models with highly relevant reference cases, thereby enhancing their capability to evaluate complex scientific images. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively aligns with the judgment criteria of human experts. Ultimately, our method achieves 1st place in the SIQA-U track of the SIQA challenge at the ICME 2026 Grand Challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向科学图像质量评估的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，同时覆盖SIQA挑战的理解赛道（SIQA-U）与评分赛道（SIQA-S），在ICME 2026 Grand Challenges的SIQA-U赛道中获得第1名。
AI.motivation: 科学图像质量评估任务复杂，需要同时兼顾理解与打分，且大语言模型缺乏相关参考依据，难以对齐人类专家的评判标准。
AI.method: 构建融合文本语义与细粒度视觉特征的多模态索引，并设计多路检索与融合机制，为大语言模型提供高度相关的参考案例以增强其评估复杂科学图像的能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该框架能有效对齐人类专家的评判标准，并在ICME 2026 Grand Challenges的SIQA挑战SIQA-U赛道中取得第1名。
AI.conclusion: RAG框架结合多模态索引与多路检索融合，可有效提升科学图像质量评估性能，验证了检索增强方法在该任务上的有效性。

title: Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) rely on video-generation backbones, requiring substantial memory and compute for deployment. Post-training quantization reduces memory and can accelerate inference, but bit width, grouping, and quantizer choice define a large configuration space. Identifying configurations that preserve task performance through exhaustive closed-loop evaluation is costly. We propose PreDE (Predict Before You Deploy), a policy-calibrated framework for predicting quantization-induced task degradation from offline action deviations. Using closed-loop outcomes from a small development set, PreDE calibrates two thresholds and accepts, rejects, or defers new configurations using a fixed observation log. Under a within-setting label-ordering hypothesis, the rule issues decisions where all thresholds consistent with the development labels agree. Across five WAMs and four benchmark settings, quantization produces configuration-dependent task losses that cannot be explained by bit width alone or a shared deviation threshold. Across 28 held-out configurations from two policies, PreDE issued 21 decisions before observing closed-loop outcomes (75% coverage), all matching the observed acceptable or degraded labels. Deferred candidates included both acceptable outcomes and a 33-percentage-point loss. In 450 Franka Research 3 trials across two independently fine-tuned policies, all configurations assigned to high-deviation groups before testing showed significant degradation, while low-deviation comparisons showed no statistically significant degradation. On the real robot, W4A4 achieved a 1.37x action-query speedup and approximately 44% lower peak memory. These results support policy-specific behavioral calibration for quantization configuration selection while identifying candidates that require closed-loop evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreDE 框架，通过离线动作偏差预测量化配置在 WAM 任务上的性能退化，在 28 个配置中 75% 可在闭环评估前给出与观测一致的接受/拒绝判定。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）基于视频生成主干，部署时显存与算力开销大；训练后量化可降低内存并加速推理，但位宽、分组粒度与量化器选择构成庞大配置空间，穷举闭环评估代价高昂。
AI.method: PreDE（Predict Before You Deploy）是一种策略校准框架：利用小规模开发集上的闭环结果校准两个阈值，在固定观测日志下对新配置给出接受、拒绝或暂缓决策；在"标签有序"假设下，凡与开发集标签一致的阈值均给出一致决策，据此进行规则判定。
AI.result: 在 5 个 WAM、4 种基准设置中，量化导致的任务损失依赖配置，无法仅由位宽或统一偏差阈值解释。28 个留出配置中，PreDE 在观测闭环结果前给出 21 项决策（覆盖率 75%），全部与观测标签一致；暂缓项包含可接受结果及 33 个百分点的损失案例。Franka Research 3 上 450 次试验中，高偏差组配置均出现显著退化，低偏差组无统计显著退化；实机 W4A4 获得 1.37× 动作查询加速与约 44% 峰值内存降低。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持以策略特定的行为校准进行量化配置选择，同时可识别出仍需闭环评估的候选配置，兼顾部署效率与可靠性。

title: When Hiring Becomes Agent-Mediated: Evaluating Access and Recurrence in Two-Agent Résumé Screening
comment: 9 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure. Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Hiring is bilateral: employers assess fit, while candidates present and defend evidence of their qualifications. Yet résumé screening, the first gate, is commonly automated as a static, one-call judgment over a résumé-job pair. We study a two-agent alternative in which employer-side and candidate-side agents represent these roles, exchange evidence, and update their judgments before deciding who advances. We compare procedures on 600 constructed résumé-job pairs using GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Two-agent screening advances more applications (33.3% to 39.3% for GPT-5.5; 34.0% to 35.5% for Opus 4.7). Across three runs on the common 191-pair borderline pool, pass-instance rates rise from 4.5% to 26.2% and from 6.5% to 16.1%, respectively. This is not a uniform relaxation: two-agent screening rejects applications one-call advances, changing decisions in both directions. At similar pass volumes, the procedures advance different applications, and no one-call threshold recovers applications consistently selected by two-agent screening. Among discovery-selected cases re-executed in fresh runs, two-agent-only selections recur less often than shared selections, clearly under GPT-5.5 and less certainly under Opus 4.7, while a separate one-call follow-up shows no comparable decline. As hiring becomes agent-mediated on both sides, the screening procedure, not only the model behind it, shapes who reaches human review and how reliably that access recurs.

AI.tldr: 将简历筛选建模为雇主侧与候选侧双智能体的证据交换与判断更新过程，并在600对构建数据上用GPT-5.5和Opus 4.7比较其与一次性单次判断的差异。
AI.motivation: 招聘本质是双向过程，但作为第一道关口的简历筛选常被自动化处理为对"简历-岗位"配对的静态一次性判断，忽略了候选人的举证与辩护角色，因此需要研究双智能体替代方案。
AI.method: 构建雇主侧与候选侧两个智能体，分别代表评估与举证辩护角色，二者交换证据并在决定谁进入下一轮前更新判断；在600对构建的简历-岗位配对上，以GPT-5.5与Opus 4.7比较双智能体筛选与一次性判断。
AI.result: 双智能体筛选推进更多申请（GPT-5.5由33.3%升至39.3%，Opus 4.7由34.0%升至35.5%）；在共同191对边缘池三次运行中，单例通过率分别由4.5%升至26.2%、由6.5%升至16.1%；它并非一致放宽，而是双向改变决策，会拒绝一次性判断所推进的申请；在相近通过量下两者推进不同申请，且无任何一次性阈值能稳定复现双智能体所选的申请；在重执行案例中，双智能体独有选择的重现率低于共同选择，GPT-5.5下明显、Opus 4.7下较不确定，而单独的一次性跟进未出现类似下降。
AI.conclusion: 当招聘双向均由智能体介导时，决定谁能进入人工审核、以及这种机会能否稳定重现的，不仅取决于背后的模型，更取决于筛选程序本身。

title: LSTM-UT and Recurrent-Depth Transformers on Cellular Automata
summary: Recurrent-depth Transformers apply shared computation repeatedly, but differ in how they retain information across steps. We compare a Block Universal Transformer (BUT), which carries only its current hidden state; CoTFormer, which also retains an expanding attention cache; and a new LSTM Universal Transformer (LSTM-UT) with bounded gated memory. On Rule 30 cellular automata, BUT extrapolates to unseen recurrent depths more reliably than CoTFormer, although its accuracy eventually degrades. State and cache interventions show that CoTFormer's failure depends on their interaction: correcting the current state can temporarily restore accuracy, while retained history can undermine that correction. In a delayed-recall task, BUT also outperforms CoTFormer despite lacking direct access to past states; CoTFormer does not reliably select the requested cached representation. LSTM-UT improves both depth extrapolation and delayed recall over these baselines. The results support bounded gated memory as an effective inductive bias for repeated computation and later retrieval in these tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了三种循环深度Transformer在信息保留方式上的差异：仅保留当前隐状态的BUT、保留扩展注意力缓存的CoTFormer，以及带有界门控记忆的LSTM-UT，结果表明有界门控记忆是重复计算与后续检索的有效归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 循环深度Transformer重复应用共享计算，但各模型在跨步骤信息保留机制上存在差异，这种差异对深度外推和后续检索能力的影响尚不明确，因此需要系统比较不同记忆/缓存机制的优劣。
AI.method: 在Rule 30元胞自动机任务上比较BUT、CoTFormer与LSTM-UT，并进行状态与缓存干预实验；另在延迟回忆任务上测试三者表现。
AI.result: BUT在未见循环深度上的外推比CoTFormer更可靠，但准确率最终会下降；CoTFormer的失败依赖于状态与缓存的交互，纠正当前状态可暂时恢复准确率，而保留的历史会削弱这种纠正；延迟回忆任务中BUT仍优于CoTFormer，CoTFormer无法可靠选取所请求的缓存表示；LSTM-UT在深度外推与延迟回忆两方面均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 有界门控记忆在此类任务的重复计算与后续检索中是有效的归纳偏置。

title: Chain-of-Thought Entropy as a Reliability Signal: A Preregistered Reproduction
summary: This empirical study is an independent reproduction of the dissociation Zhao reported in 2026. The shape of a large language model's chain-of-thought entropy trajectory predicts whether the final answer is correct, while the magnitude of its total entropy drop does not. The dissociation merits reproduction because the magnitude half rests on a single 300-problem run with one model at one seed, while the shape half was reported at full scale on both benchmarks and on a second model family. Registered at OSF before any confirmatory run, the reproduction crosses the complete GSM8K and MATH-500 benchmark test sets with four open-weight models including one reasoning-distilled model of a kind the original did not test. The shape signal replicates. The magnitude signal divides by setting. On the anchor model the accuracy gap between monotone and non-monotone chains is +9.6 percentage points on GSM8K and +27.5 on MATH-500, while the rank correlation of the total entropy drop with correctness is -0.018 on GSM8K and +0.414 on MATH-500. On the reasoning-distilled model the binary form of the shape signal fires on about one chain in a hundred, too few to estimate the registered contrast, while the graded violation count remains predictive there. In an exploratory comparison the final-step entropy alone outperforms the binary shape flag in all eight model-by-benchmark cells by ROC area, and in six or seven by the risk-coverage area the original reports, depending on an integration range the original does not state. The study contributes a reproduction of the shape signal at full test-set scale under seven documented protocol differences, a map of the settings where the magnitude signal holds and fails, and measurements of four protocol dependencies the original does not report.

AI.tldr: 对Zhao(2026)关于思维链熵轨迹"形状预测正确性、幅度不预测"的解离现象进行独立重复研究，形状信号在全测试集规模上复现，幅度信号则依设定而分裂。
AI.motivation: 原研究的解离中，幅度一半仅基于单一模型、单一种子、300题的单次运行，证据薄弱；而形状一半已在两个基准和第二个模型家族上以全规模报告。因此有必要独立重复，检验两者的稳健性。
AI.method: 在任何确证性运行前于OSF预注册；在GSM8K与MATH-500的完整测试集上，交叉四个开放权重模型，其中包括一个原研究未测试过的推理蒸馏模型；采用二元形状标志与分级违规计数两种形式度量形状信号，并测量总熵降与正确性的秩相关以度量幅度信号。
AI.result: 形状信号复现。幅度信号依设定分裂：锚点模型上，单调与非单调链的准确率差在GSM8K为+9.6个百分点、MATH-500为+27.5个百分点；而总熵降与正确性的秩相关在GSM8K为-0.018、MATH-500为+0.414。推理蒸馏模型上二元形状标志约百链一次触发，样本过少无法估计预注册对比，但分级违规计数仍具预测性。探索性比较中，末步熵单独在全部八个模型×基准单元中按ROC面积优于二元形状标志，按风险-覆盖率面积则在六或七个单元中优于，取决于原研究未说明的积分区间。
AI.conclusion: 本研究在七个已记录协议差异下全测试集规模复现了形状信号，绘制了幅度信号成立与失效的设定图谱，并测量了原研究未报告的四项协议依赖性。

title: Towards Active Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) typically assumes a fixed query image, overlooking the ability of mobile agents to actively acquire more informative observations. To address this limitation, we introduce Active Cross-View Object Geo-Localization (ActiveGeo), where an agent sequentially selects new viewpoints and determines when to stop, aiming to improve localization with minimal observations. We further propose ActiveMoPT, an ActiveGeo framework with three-stage training. First, Multi-View Prompt-Preserving Adaptation enables the model to aggregate multiple query views while reusing the initial prompt. Second, Trajectory-Guided Policy Initialization uses supervised agent trajectories to learn viewpoint selection and initial stopping behavior. Third, Cost-Aware Policy Refinement employs GRPO with a gain-cost reward to jointly optimize localization accuracy and observation efficiency. We also construct ActiveGeo-858, a zero-shot test set containing 858 scenes and 1,716 target annotations. Experiments show that ActiveMoPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on MoP-UAV using only 1.45 query views on average, and substantially outperforms previous CVOGL approaches under zero-shot evaluation on ActiveGeo-858.

AI.tldr: 本文提出主动跨视角物体地理定位任务ActiveGeo及方法ActiveMoPT，让智能体主动选择新视角并在合适时机停止，以最少观测提升定位精度，在MoP-UAV上以平均1.45个查询视角取得SOTA，并在零样本测试集ActiveGeo-858上大幅超越已有CVOGL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角物体地理定位（CVOGL）通常假设查询图像固定，忽略了移动智能体主动获取更具信息量观测的能力，限制了定位性能与效率。
AI.method: 提出ActiveMoPT框架，采用三阶段训练：（1）多视角提示保持适配，聚合多个查询视角并复用初始提示；（2）轨迹引导策略初始化，利用监督智能体轨迹学习视角选择与初始停止行为；（3）代价感知策略精化，采用GRPO与增益-代价奖励联合优化定位精度与观测效率。
AI.result: 构建了包含858个场景、1716个目标标注的零样本测试集ActiveGeo-858；实验显示ActiveMoPT在MoP-UAV上平均仅用1.45个查询视角即达SOTA，并在ActiveGeo-858零样本评估中显著优于以往CVOGL方法。
AI.conclusion: 主动视角选择与自适应停止机制能有效提升跨视角物体地理定位的精度与观测效率，三阶段训练与增益-代价奖励设计是性能提升的关键。

title: From Wizard-of-Oz Human-Robot Dialogue Collection to a Taxonomy of Robot Response Decisions: A Retrospective Analysis of Assistive Pilot Interactions
comment: Accepted at the Human-Robot Dialogue (HRD) Workshop, held by the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Robots that follow natural-language instructions in everyday indoor environments must act on incomplete human utterances. Instructions often omit essential information, such as the identity of an out-of-view object, an intended destination, or the user's goal. Existing datasets contain little real-world situated dialogue and provide few practice-grounded criteria for deciding when a robot should act, confirm, clarify, or refuse. We retrospectively analyze a pilot Wizard-of-Oz study in which five participants performed everyday indoor tasks, including door opening, drawer opening, feeding, drinking, and cleaning, with a wheelchair-mounted mobile manipulator while the wizard responded without a formal communication policy. This preserved authentic user behavior but produced inconsistent robot-side decisions, motivating an explicit decision scheme. From 40 episodes, we derived a hierarchical taxonomy of six response modes (ANSWER, REPORT_DONE, REFUSE, CONFIRM, CLARIFY, ACT) and four ambiguity types (intent, referential, spatial, intelligibility). Two human annotators and an AI annotator applied the scheme to the pilot data. Clean-label rates were 91% and 89%, and Cohen's ranged from 0.72 to 0.95 across decision-point, mode, and ambiguity levels for both human-human and human-AI comparisons. Fine-tuning LLaVA-1.6-7B on taxonomy-derived labels for ACT and CLARIFY indicates the feasibility of training vision-language models using annotations from our taxonomy. Remaining boundary cases in decision-point identification and REPORT_DONE motivate a constrained protocol for more consistent dialogue collection.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾性分析一项轮椅机械臂的绿野仙踪研究，从40个日常室内任务片段中提炼出6种响应模式与4类歧义的层次化分类体系，并验证其标注一致性与用于训练视觉语言模型的可行性。
AI.motivation: 日常室内环境中机器人需应对不完整的人类指令，但现有数据集缺乏真实场景对话，也缺少基于实践的标准来判定机器人应行动、确认、澄清还是拒绝，因此需要一套明确的决策方案。
AI.method: 回顾性分析5名参与者使用轮椅搭载移动机械臂执行开门、开抽屉、喂食、饮水、清洁等任务的绿野仙踪研究；基于40个片段归纳出6种响应模式（ANSWER、REPORT_DONE、REFUSE、CONFIRM、CLARIFY、ACT）和4类歧义（意图、指代、空间、可理解性）；由两名人类标注者和一名AI标注者应用该体系，并微调LLaVA-1.6-7B进行验证。
AI.result: 干净标签率分别为91%和89%，在决策点、响应模式和歧义层级上，人-人及人-AI比较的Cohen's kappa介于0.72至0.95；基于分类体系标签微调LLaVA-1.6-7B可支持ACT与CLARIFY任务。
AI.conclusion: 该分类体系具备较好的标注一致性和训练视觉语言模型的可行性；决策点识别与REPORT_DONE仍存在边界案例，需采用受约束协议以实现更一致的对话数据采集。

title: Agentic AI Networking for Heterogeneous Unmanned Aerial Systems in Low-Altitude Wireless Networks
summary: Low-altitude wireless networks (LAWNs) are emerging as a key infrastructure for heterogeneous unmanned aerial systems that support concurrent services within a shared three-dimensional airspace. Their coexistence creates strong coupling among mobility, connectivity, and shared network resources, while heterogeneous services impose distinct and time-varying requirements. These interactions naturally form a dynamic non-cooperative game in which both operating conditions and coordination objectives evolve over time. Conventional optimization and learning-based controllers typically rely on predefined objectives, limiting their ability to adapt autonomously to changing service requirements and resource priorities. To address this challenge, we propose a hierarchical hybrid large language model (LLM)- multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) architecture organized as a dual-loop structure. Specifically, an outer adaptation loop employs LLM-assisted game orchestration to interpret service requirements and operator intent, and reconfigure objectives and resource priorities, while an inner loop executes decentralized, parameter-conditioned MARL policies under the configured game. A logistics-monitoring case study illustrates how the proposed framework facilitates coordinated coexistence among heterogeneous services, adapting to evolving operating conditions without retraining the underlying MARL policies. Finally, we discuss key challenges and research directions toward scalable, trustworthy, and adaptive agentic LAWNs.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种分层混合LLM-MARL双环架构，用于低空无线网络（LAWNs）中异构业务共存下的动态非合作博弈求解。
AI.motivation: LAWNs中异构无人系统共存使移动性、连通性与共享资源高度耦合，且异构业务需求随时间变化，形成动态非合作博弈；传统优化与学习型控制器依赖预设目标，难以自主适应变化的业务需求与资源优先级。
AI.method: 提出分层混合LLM-MARL架构，采用双环结构：外环以LLM辅助的博弈编排解释业务需求与运营意图，重构目标与资源优先级；内环在配置好的博弈下执行分散式、参数条件化的MARL策略。
AI.result: 以物流监控案例研究说明该框架可促进异构业务的协同共存，并在无需重训练底层MARL策略的情况下适应演化中的运行条件。
AI.conclusion: 该架构实现了无需重训练的自适应协调，并讨论了面向可扩展、可信、自适应智能体化LAWNs的关键挑战与研究方向。

title: VideoResearcher: Self-Improving Tool Design for Long-Video Understanding
summary: Video agents have made substantial progress in long-video understanding. Yet effective video-agent systems require costly, time-consuming manual design and trial and error. Current self-improvement methods either refine low-impact prompts, recombine predefined micro-tools, or struggle with convergence in harness optimization. To bridge this gap, we target high-impact video-tool with VideoResearcher, a training-free multi-agent framework that autonomously designs, tests, and refines tools for video understanding, like a human researcher. VideoResearcher operates through dual Solving and Evolving loops: it analyzes tool-use trajectories to identify capability gaps, coordinates specialized agents to develop and validate executable tools, and reuses evolved tools to strengthen evidence acquisition in subsequent video reasoning. Through iterative tool refinement and validation, it progressively strengthens evidence acquisition without updating model parameters. VideoResearcher achieves state-of-the-art performance among self-improving agents and approaches the human-designed upper bound, demonstrating a training-free paradigm for long-video understanding that expands agent capabilities through autonomous tool development while reducing costly manual engineering.

AI.tldr: VideoResearcher：免训练多智能体框架，通过"求解+进化"双循环自主设计、测试和精炼视频工具，实现长视频理解的最优自我改进性能，接近人工设计上限。
AI.motivation: 现有视频智能体系统依赖昂贵耗时的人工设计与试错；当前自我改进方法要么只优化低影响提示、重组预定义微工具，要么在工具链优化中难以收敛，缺乏对高影响视频工具的自主开发能力。
AI.method: 提出VideoResearcher，一个免训练多智能体框架，像人类研究者一样自主设计、测试与精炼工具。其包含求解循环与进化循环：分析工具使用轨迹以识别能力缺口，协调专门化智能体开发并验证可执行工具，并在后续视频推理中复用已进化工具以增强证据获取；通过迭代工具精炼与验证，在不更新模型参数的情况下逐步强化证据获取。
AI.result: 在自我改进智能体中达到最先进（state-of-the-art）性能，并接近人工设计工具的上限。
AI.conclusion: 展示了面向长视频理解的免训练范式：通过自主工具开发扩展智能体能力，同时减少昂贵的人工工程投入。

title: Winning a Won Game: Strict Reach-Avoid-Stay Control Barrier Functions for High-Dimensional Black-Box Systems
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Robots must complete their tasks and maintain the achieved outcomes while avoiding safety failures at all times. Strict reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) formalizes this requirement: safely reaching a target and remaining there indefinitely after first entry. We propose an sRAS Q-control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for high-dimensional black-box systems under bounded uncertainty. Our construction combines a stay value encoding safe permanent residence in a target subset with a reach-avoid value encoding safe reachability of this subset while avoiding target states from which safe permanent residence cannot be guaranteed. We prove that these values jointly yield a valid robust discrete-time CBF and lift them to state-action Q-functions for runtime intervention. For exact values and under a measure-zero condition, our filter preserves sRAS feasibility from almost every winnable initial state and keeps the system safely within the target after first entry, against all admissible uncertainty realizations. We adopt reachability-based adversarial reinforcement learning for scalable value approximation using only black-box interactions. Notably, neither synthesis nor deployment of our filter requires known dynamics, affine structure, value derivatives, or hand-designed barriers. We validate our framework in quadruped gap jumping in simulation and hardware, where the robot crosses the gap, lands safely, and remains safe afterward. Simulated F1TENTH races further demonstrate safe overtaking and lead retention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于高维黑箱系统、在有限不确定性下的严格可达-回避-驻留（sRAS）Q-control barrier function安全滤波器，通过将驻留价值与可达-回避价值结合构造鲁棒的离散时间CBF，并在四足跳跃与F1TENTH赛车上验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人需在完成任务并保持成果的同时始终避免安全失效，而现有的严格可达-回避-驻留（sRAS）要求（安全到达目标并首次进入后永久驻留）缺乏针对高维黑箱系统、有限不确定性下可扩展的安全滤波方法；此外现有方法常依赖已知动力学、仿射结构、价值导数或手工设计障碍函数。
AI.method: 提出sRAS Q-control barrier function安全滤波器：将编码目标子集内安全永久驻留的"驻留价值"与编码安全可达性、同时回避无法保证安全永久驻留的目标状态的"可达-回避价值"结合；证明二者联合构成有效的鲁棒离散时间CBF，并提升为状态-动作Q函数用于运行时干预；采用基于可达性的对抗强化学习，仅用黑箱交互进行可扩展的价值近似。
AI.result: 在精确价值与测度零条件下，滤波器从几乎所有可获胜初始状态保持sRAS可行性，并在首次进入后对所有可容许不确定性实现将系统安全保持在目标内；在仿真与硬件的四足机器人跨间隙任务中成功跨越、安全着陆并后续保持安全；仿真F1TENTH竞速中实现安全超车与保持领先。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在无需已知动力学、仿射结构、价值导数或手工设计障碍函数的条件下，实现了高维黑箱系统在有限不确定性下的sRAS安全滤波，具备可扩展性与实际部署能力。

title: Continual Enterprise World Model Discovery in Dynamic Systems
summary: In an enterprise system, updating one field can set another, create a record, or start an approval. These effects are produced by business rules that are not built into the platform but written by each organization and revised over time. An agent working in such a system cannot predict the result of its own actions without knowing these rules. We study continual enterprise world model discovery, where an agent starts without knowledge of these business rules and discovers them by interacting with records and observing the outcomes. From those observations it builds a world model, which it revises as the rules change. To evaluate this, we introduce EnterpriseWorldShift, built on a live ServiceNow environment with nine tables, 25 hidden rules and 600 evaluation actions. It presents four versions of the same enterprise world, with the tables and records held fixed while a rule is modified, then added, then removed, so that discovery, revision, extension and retirement are each tested in turn. Our Continual Discovery Agent (CDA) builds such a model and carries it from one world to the next. It predicts the effects of the hidden rules more accurately than looking them up for each question, the approach taken by prior work, by up to 8.98 IoU points, and it answers from its own model without querying the running system.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究企业系统中的持续世界模型发现：智能体在不知业务规则的情况下通过交互观测结果，构建并随规则变化持续修订世界模型。作者提出EnterpriseWorldShift基准（基于ServiceNow，9表、25条隐藏规则、600个评估动作、4个世界版本）与持续发现智能体（CDA）。CDA对隐藏规则效果的预测比逐题查询的先前方法最高优8.98 IoU点，且无需查询运行中的系统即可作答。
AI.motivation: 企业系统的字段更新可能触发其他字段变化、记录创建或审批流程，这些效果由各组织自写且随时间修订的业务规则产生，规则未内置于平台。智能体若不掌握这些规则就无法预测自身动作的后果。现有方法（逐题查询）缺乏对规则的持续建模能力，因此需要研究持续性的企业世界模型发现。
AI.method: 提出持续发现智能体（CDA）：智能体初始不掌握业务规则，通过与记录交互并观察结果来发现规则，据此构建世界模型，并在规则变化时进行修订。评估基准EnterpriseWorldShift构建于真实ServiceNow环境，含9张表、25条隐藏规则、600个评估动作，并给出同一企业世界的4个版本——表与记录保持不变，规则依次被修改、新增、移除，分别测试发现、修订、扩展与退役能力。
AI.result: CDA对隐藏规则效果的预测准确度较逐题查询的先前方法最高提升8.98 IoU点；且其答案来自自身构建的世界模型，无需查询运行中的系统。
AI.conclusion: 企业智能体可在无先验规则知识下通过交互持续发现、修订、扩展和退役业务规则世界模型，并基于自建模型进行预测，优于逐题查询方式，且避免了运行系统查询的开销。

title: FedFIbOS: Fisher Importance based Optimal Submodelling for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
summary: Heterogeneous federated learning requires clients with diverse computational capacities to collaboratively train a global model, where each client trains a capacity-constrained submodel. Existing methods select submodel parameters using heuristic importance measures---most prominently parameter magnitude---without theoretical justification for why these measures support convergence. We identify a fundamental gap: existing parameter selection criteria lack theoretical grounding in the convergence framework, partial client participation introduces additional estimation effects in the Fisher scores. We propose \textbf{FedFIbOS}: Fisher Importance-based Optimal Submodelling for heterogeneous federated learning, using Fisher Information in a principled criterion derived from minimizing submodel masking error. %We formally establish when magnitude selection is equivalent to Fisher selection fail under non-IID heterogeneous federated learning. We theoretically formulate submodel selection through a Fisher-weighted quadratic masking surrogate and show that the raw Fisher top-$k$ rule implemented by FedFIbOS solves this surrogate under a Fisher-dominant ranking condition. The resulting method retains the convergence structure of the underlying masked federated optimization bound. Fisher scores are efficiently estimated from empirical diagonal Fisher information using squared gradients, enabling stable and adaptive parameter selection without additional optimization overhead. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and AGNews under pathological and Dirichlet non-IID settings show FedFIbOS achieves ${\approx}10\%$ higher accuracy than the state of the art, with improvements becoming more pronounced under stronger heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedFIbOS，用Fisher信息作为子模型参数选择准则，为异构联邦学习中的参数选择提供理论依据，并在多个数据集上取得约10%的精度提升。
AI.motivation: 异构联邦学习中客户端计算能力不同，需训练容量受限的子模型。现有方法多采用启发式重要性度量（尤以参数幅值为主）选择子模型参数，但缺乏收敛性理论支撑；同时部分客户端参与会在Fisher分数中引入额外的估计效应，形成理论空白。
AI.method: 提出FedFIbOS，基于最小化子模型掩码误差推导出以Fisher信息为核心的原则性选择准则；将子模型选择形式化为Fisher加权的二次掩码代理问题，并证明在Fisher主导排序条件下，FedFIbOS采用的原始Fisher top-k规则可求解该代理问题。Fisher分数由经验对角Fisher信息（平方梯度）高效估计，无需额外优化开销。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和AGNews上，于病态与Dirichlet非IID设置下，FedFIbOS比当前最优方法精度高约10%，且异质性越强提升越明显。
AI.conclusion: Fisher信息为异构联邦学习的子模型参数选择提供了有理论支撑的准则，FedFIbOS在保持底层掩码联邦优化收敛结构的同时，实现了稳定、自适应且高效的参数选择，并显著优于现有方法。

title: Improving Cross-Lingual Transfer for Sequential Sentence Classification in Research Papers via Structural Similarity
comment: Accepted at JCDL 2026 (ACM/IEEE Joint Conference on Digital Libraries), Frisco, TX, USA, October 13-16, 2026. 12 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. DOI: 10.1145/3805696.3846040
summary: Sequential sentence classification (SSC) is an essential task for structuring scientific publications, and extending SSC research to languages other than English can improve accessibility to scientific knowledge in multilingual digital libraries. Cross-lingual transfer is a promising approach to address the scarcity of training data in non-English languages. Prior work on other natural language processing tasks has shown the benefits of capturing linguistic similarity between source and target languages. However, SSC inherently depends on patterns at the discourse level, such as label sequences and positional regularities, which appear consistently across languages regardless of linguistic differences. To examine the factors that determine transfer success in SSC, we constructed a multilingual SSC dataset covering 13 non-English languages collected from five academic databases. Our cross-lingual transfer experiments, using both encoder-based and generative models, show that linguistic proximity has no consistent predictive power for transfer performance, whereas structural similarity in rhetorical organization shows a weak but consistent positive correlation across models. After controlling for source-language performance, the similarity of label distributions is the most consistent predictor. Building on this finding, we propose a set of three methods that explicitly leverage structural information using generative models. In the in-domain evaluation, the best combination reaches parity with the strongest encoder baselines, and in transfer to languages unseen during training, it outperforms the strongest encoder baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了涵盖13种非英语语言的多语言SSC数据集，发现语言接近度对跨语言迁移无稳定预测力，而修辞结构相似性与标签分布相似度（控制源语言性能后）具有稳定预测力；据此提出三种显式利用结构信息的生成式方法，域内达最强编码器基线水平，未见语言迁移上超越最强编码器基线。
AI.motivation: 顺序句子分类（SSC）是科学出版物结构化的关键任务，将其研究扩展到非英语语言有助于提升多语言数字图书馆中科学知识的可及性。非英语语言训练数据稀缺，跨语言迁移是可行方案。已有NLP任务研究表明源语言与目标语言的语言相似性有益，但SSC依赖篇章层面的模式（标签序列、位置规律性），这些模式在不同语言间保持一致，因此需要重新考察决定SSC迁移成功的因素。
AI.method: 构建了覆盖13种非英语语言、来自5个学术数据库的多语言SSC数据集；使用基于编码器（encoder-based）与生成式（generative）两类模型开展跨语言迁移实验，考察语言接近度、修辞组织结构性相似度、标签分布相似度等因素与迁移性能的关系；在此基础上提出三种显式利用结构信息的生成式方法。
AI.result: 语言接近度对迁移性能无一致预测力；修辞组织的结构性相似度在各模型上呈弱但一致的正相关；控制源语言性能后，标签分布相似度是最一致的预测因子。域内评价中，最佳组合方法达到最强编码器基线的水平；在迁移到训练中未见的语言时，超过最强编码器基线。
AI.conclusion: SSC跨语言迁移的成功主要取决于篇章层面的结构相似性（修辞组织与标签分布）而非语言谱系接近度；显式建模结构信息的生成式方法可行且有效，为低资源语言SSC及多语言数字图书馆应用提供了新路径。

title: Beyond Patch Removal: Persistent Adversarial Effects in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Adversarial patches to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies can cause both immediate action corruption and persistent state effects that remain after the patch is removed. Existing evaluations largely focus on continuous attacks and do not separate these two effects. We introduce a state-restoration protocol that removes the patch at matched action-chunk boundaries and measures subsequent recoverability under the same remaining step budget. Clean, random-patch, deviation-matched, and fixed-direction controls distinguish adversarial effects from occlusion, action-error magnitude, and directional persistence. We also evaluate a recovery adapter trained on attack-induced states under controlled intervention latency. On OpenVLA-OFT with EDPA attacks, only 36.2% of LIBERO-Long episodes remain recoverable after five chunks, compared with 89.9% and 87.0% for the deviation-matched and fixed-direction controls. Similar persistent effects are observed on autoregressive OpenVLA. The recovery adapter improves recovery from 7.7% to 47.4% at one-chunk latency, but its benefit decreases substantially with delayed intervention. These results show that adversarial effects can persist after patch removal and that timely intervention is critical for recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态恢复协议，在动作块边界移除对抗补丁，区分VLA策略的即时动作破坏与持续性状态效应，并验证恢复适配器效果。
