AI.motivation: 现有对VLA策略的对抗补丁评估多聚焦于持续性攻击，未能分离"即时动作破坏"与"补丁移除后仍残留的持久状态效应"，缺乏对可恢复性的量化考察。
AI.method: 引入状态恢复协议：在匹配的动作块边界移除补丁，在相同剩余步数预算下测量后续可恢复性。设置干净、随机补丁、偏差匹配、固定方向四类对照，以区分对抗效应与遮挡、动作误差幅度、方向持续性。另评估在攻击诱导状态上训练的恢复适配器，并控制干预延迟。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA-OFT配合EDPA攻击下，LIBERO-Long任务五个块后仅36.2%的回合仍可恢复，而偏差匹配与固定方向对照分别为89.9%和87.0%；自回归OpenVLA上观察到类似持久效应。恢复适配器在一块延迟下将恢复率从7.7%提升至47.4%，但延迟干预时收益显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 对抗效应可在补丁移除后持续存在，即时干预对恢复至关重要。状态恢复协议能有效解耦即时而与持续性效应，为VLA鲁棒性评估提供新范式。

title: GLAMDRING: Gait Learning And Morphology co-Design via Reinforcement LearnING of CPGs
summary: Robots are moving out of the structured factory floor and into unstructured environments such as disaster sites, planetary surfaces, and agricultural fields, for which the right robot often does not yet exist. We present GLAMDRING, a framework that synthesizes the optimal robot for a locomotion task and, jointly, learns the controller that drives it. For the given specifications of forward-velocity bounds, a per-actuator power budget, an actuator library, and a payload requirement, GLAMDRING returns a matched quadruped morphology (link geometry and per-joint actuators) and a Hopf-oscillator Central Pattern Generator (CPG) gait policy. We rank feasible designs against a target design objective, viz., maximum speed, minimum Cost of Transport (CoT), or max Payload Margin. Because body and locomotion are coupled, the optimal morphology dictates how a robot is driven, while optimal gait depends on the physical body. We train a small number of CPG policies by reinforcement learning across the space of candidate morphologies, co-learning the gait with the underlying robot hardware. Link lengths and actuators are then resolved post-hoc from the policy's logged operating envelope, reducing synthesis cost to a small, fixed number of reinforcement-learning runs instead of one per candidate. Our experiments show three key findings: co-designing body and gait is necessary to satisfy locomotion constraints; actuator-envelope feasibility, rather than locomotion success alone, determines realizable payload capacity; and canonical animal gaits emerge naturally in most designs from morphology and constraints alone. A real-world demonstration further highlights the efficacy of our work.

AI.tldr: GLAMDRING是一个联合综合最优机器人形态与控制器的框架，面向非结构化环境中的运动任务，可在有限计算成本下同时优化硬件与步态。
AI.motivation: 机器人正从结构化工厂走向灾难现场、行星表面、农田等非结构化环境，而适配这些场景的机器人往往尚不存在，因此需要能针对任务自动综合机器人本体与运动控制的方法。
AI.method: 给定前进速度上下界、单执行器功率预算、执行器库与负载需求等规格，GLAMDRING输出匹配的四足形态（连杆几何与各关节执行器）及基于Hopf振子的中枢模式发生器（CPG）步态策略；按目标函数（最大速度、最小运输成本CoT或最大负载余量）对可行设计排序；在候选形态空间中用强化学习训练少量CPG策略，实现步态与硬件的协同学习，随后从策略记录的运行包络事后反解连杆长度与执行器，将综合成本降至固定的小规模RL次数而非每个候选一次。
AI.result: 实验得到三点关键结论：本体与步态的协同设计是满足运动约束的必要条件；决定可实现负载能力的是执行器包络可行性而非单纯运动成功；多数设计仅由形态与约束即可自然涌现典型动物步态；并通过真实世界演示验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本体与运动控制强耦合，必须协同优化；GLAMDRING以低成本实现形态-步态联合综合，并能在真实平台上取得良好效果。

title: SIMLIFE: Pattern Understanding for Long-Horizon Human-Agent Partnership
comment: COLM 2026 Learning from Situated and Embodied Interaction Workshop
summary: Understanding humans over long horizons requires agents to infer not only what people need in the moment, but also how routines form, why they repeat, and when they change. We introduce SimLife, a scalable platform for simulating long-term household life with rich visual observations, ground-truth action logs, and synthetic dialogues with audio. Built on SimLife, SimLife-BP evaluates long-context pattern understanding: the ability to infer latent behavioral rules from weeks or months of everyday observations. The benchmark contains 106 episodes averaging 15.49 hours and 38.57 in-game days, and 1,439 question-answer pairs. Each task probes direct, counterfactual, noisy, and inverse reasoning under different levels of rule hints. Evaluating frontier models and architectures, we find that current models often achieve surface-level prediction without comprehensive rule understanding, rely on frequency-based heuristics rather than if-then reasoning over evidence, and struggle to adapt when behavioral patterns change. These findings suggest that long-context pattern understanding remains a major bottleneck for future embodied agents, while SimLife opens a broader space for studying memory, personalization, adaptation, and long-horizon planning in everyday human-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SimLife，一个具有丰富视觉观测、动作日志和合成对话的可扩展长期家庭生活模拟平台，并基于此构建了评估长上下文模式理解的基准 SimLife-BP，揭示了当前模型在隐式行为规则理解上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 理解人类的长时段行为，要求智能体不仅推断人们当下的需求，还要理解日常规律如何形成、为何重复以及何时发生改变。然而现有研究缺乏能够提供长期、多模态、带有真实行为规则标注的评估环境，导致长上下文模式理解能力难以被系统测量。
AI.method: 作者构建了 SimLife 模拟平台，提供长期家庭生活的视觉观测、真实动作日志以及带音频的合成对话。基于该平台设计基准 SimLife-BP，用于评估长上下文模式理解能力，即从数周或数月的日常观测中推断潜在行为规则。基准包含 106 个 episode（平均 15.49 小时、38.57 个游戏日）和 1,439 个问答对，任务涵盖直接、反事实、噪声和逆向推理，并设置不同级别的规则提示。随后对前沿模型与架构进行评测。
AI.result: 评测发现：当前模型往往只能实现表层预测而缺乏全面的规则理解；倾向于依赖基于频率的启发式，而非对证据进行 if-then 式推理；当行为模式发生变化时适应困难。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文模式理解仍是未来具身智能体的主要瓶颈。SimLife 为研究日常人机交互中的记忆、个性化、适应与长时程规划提供了更广阔的研究空间。

title: The Complexity Kink: A Prompt-Side Structural Complexity Index for Code-Generation Reliability
summary: Complexity measured from generated code is failure-dependent: a difficult prompt can yield a short failing program and be assigned low output complexity. We introduce a six-dimension prompt-side structural-complexity index scored before generation and kept separate from correctness. We select 5,000 Python prompts across six bands of a preliminary single-rater rubric. Four out-of-panel LLM raters rescore the locked prompts, giving 19,997 score rows; composite inter-rater reliability is ICC = 0.872 on the 4,998 prompts with all four ratings. We evaluate 21 models per prompt, yielding 105,000 generations. In the unadjusted mean-pooled analysis, pass rate has a nonmonotone breakpoint at composite 13.75, with 79.9% at or below and 87.6% above. This is not a universal failure cutoff. Task-type fixed effects shift the breakpoint to 10.75 and cut the regime gap from 7.6 to 2.1 points. A construction-frame control shifts it to 8.50 with a raw gap of -3.5 points, and neither frame alone reproduces the pooled +7.6-point change. Model-specific fits include 16 upward and five downward changes. A 365-prompt audit-clean extension matches the original five-model estimates at bins 15 and 16 but adds only 14 prompts above bin 16. Among zero-pass generations with computable Lizard complexity, 28.5% pair a prompt composite above 8 with output complexity at most 10. Human agreement is moderate and rater-dependent on a disagreement-enriched calibration set; paraphrase and cross-language rescoring preserve score ordering. Overidentification tests reject the joint restrictions on the six dimensions, so we treat the composite as an index and make no causal interpretation of the 2SLS estimates. The contribution is a pre-generation measurement framework and a bounded observational analysis of reliability regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成前、独立于正确性的提示词侧六维结构复杂度指数量表，经四名面板外LLM评分认可（ICC=0.872），并在21个模型×105,000次生成上做有界观察性分析，发现通过率断点随任务类型与构式框架控制而发生位移，故将该合成分数视为"指数"而非因果变量。
AI.motivation: 从生成代码衡量的复杂度依赖失败结果：困难提示可能只产出简短的失败程序而被判为低输出复杂度。作者希望建立一种在生成之前即可打分、且与正确性相分离的提示词侧复杂度度量，以规避这种"失败依赖"的度量偏差。
AI.method: 构建六维提示词侧结构复杂度指数，在生成前评分并与正确性分离；从初步单评分者量表六个区间中选取5,000条Python提示，由四名面板外LLM重新评分，得到19,997行评分（4,998条提示具全部四个评分，合成ICC=0.872）；对每条提示评估21个模型，共105,000次生成；采用均值池化分析、任务类型固定效应、构式框架控制及模型特异性拟合，并加做365条审计干净扩展集、零通过生成分析、以及分歧增强校准集上的人工一致性、复述与跨语言重评、过度识别检验。
AI.result: 未调整均值池化下通过率在合成分13.75处出现非单调断点（≤13.75为79.9%，>13.75为87.6%），但非普遍失败阈值；任务类型固定效应使断点移至10.75并令区间差从7.6降至2.1个百分点；构式框架控制使断点移至8.50、原始差为-3.5个百分点，任一框架均无法单独复现池化的+7.6点变化；模型特异性拟合含16个上移、5个下移；365条审计干净扩展在bin 15、16与原五模型估计一致，但bin 16以上仅增14条；可计算Lizard复杂度的零通过生成中，28.5%对应提示合成分>8且输出复杂度≤10；人工一致性中等且依赖评分者；复述与跨语言重评保持评分序；过度识别检验拒绝六维联合约束。
AI.conclusion: 该合成分数不应作因果解读，而应视为一个指数；本文贡献在于一个生成前测量框架以及对可靠性区间的有界观察性分析。

title: A Phonemically Comprehensive, ASCII-Only Romanization Scheme for Thai and Lao: Systematic Cross-Lingual Correspondence and Chinese-User-Friendly Design
summary: This paper proposes a phonemically comprehensive, ASCII-only romanization scheme for Thai and Lao, treating the two closely related languages as a unified cross-lingual design problem. The scheme represents segmental contrasts, vowel length, and lexical tone while maintaining one-symbol-one-phoneme transparency and systematic correspondence between Thai and Lao. The scheme prioritizes synchronic phonetic correspondence, including correspondence with Pinyin and Jyutping where applicable, while preserving historical-phonological correspondence where it does not conflict with phonetic transparency. Tone uses a compact single-digit default notation, supplemented by optional tone-value and historical tone-category representations. The resulting scheme provides a readable, keyboard-friendly, and machine-processable phonemic representation for language learning and cross-lingual speech processing.

AI.tldr: 提出一套仅用 ASCII 的泰语—老挝语统一音位罗马字方案，兼顾音段、元音长短与声调，并保持符号—音位一一对应及两语系统对应。
AI.motivation: 泰语与老挝语关系密切，但现有罗马字方案多分别设计，缺乏统一的跨语言视角，且在音位完整性、声调标注与机器可处理性之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将泰语与老挝语视为统一设计问题，构建仅用 ASCII 的音位罗马字方案：显式编码音段对立、元音长短和词汇声调；坚持一符一音位原则，并建立两语间的系统对应；优先采用共时语音对应关系，在适用处与汉语拼音及粤拼对应，在不损害语音透明度的前提下保留历史音韵对应；声调采用紧凑的单数字默认记法，辅以可选的调值表示和历史调类表示。
AI.result: 形成一套可读、键盘友好且可机器处理的音位转写方案，可同时表示泰语与老挝语的音位和声调信息。
AI.conclusion: 该统一罗马字方案可作为语言学习与跨语言语音处理的实用转写工具，兼顾共时透明度、跨语对应与计算可用性。

title: IMFD: End-to-end Multi-Face Forgery Detection through Instruction-based Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: The rapid increase of deepfakes has raised significant concerns due to their spread on social media. Traditional multi-face forgery detectors crop and verify each face independently, ignoring background context and inter-face relationships, which often yields suboptimal performance. To overcome these limitations, we leverage instruction-based Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), which can interpret entire images and follow complex textual instructions. We propose a simple yet effective single-stage multi-face forgery detector, called IMFD (Instruction-based Multi-face Forgery Detector), which is trained end-to-end to jointly localize faces and predict per-face forgery labels. Rather than treating face box prediction only as a joint objective, IMFD explicitly integrates predicted face bounding boxes into the instruction as visual cues that enhance instruction grounding and forgery detection. To support the training and evaluation of IMFD, we convert existing multi-face forgery datasets into an instruction-based format. Experimental results and analyses show that IMFD improves multi-face forgery detection by integrating face bounding boxes into the instruction, and consistently outperforms various state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出IMFD，一种基于指令的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的单阶段多人脸伪造检测器，端到端联合定位人脸并预测逐人脸伪造标签，将预测的人脸边界框作为视觉线索融入指令中以增强指令接地与伪造检测。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造在社交媒体上快速扩散引发关注。传统多人脸伪造检测器裁剪并独立验证每张人脸，忽略背景上下文与人脸间关系，性能往往欠佳。
AI.method: 利用基于指令的LVLM理解整图并遵循复杂文本指令，提出简单有效的单阶段多人脸伪造检测器IMFD，端到端训练以联合定位人脸与预测逐人脸伪造标签；不将人脸框预测仅作为联合目标，而是显式把预测的人脸边界框作为视觉线索整合进指令，增强指令接地和伪造检测；并将现有多人脸伪造数据集转换为指令格式以支持训练与评估。
AI.result: 实验与分析表明，将人脸边界框整合进指令可提升多人脸伪造检测性能，IMFD持续优于多种最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: IMFD通过指令驱动的单阶段框架整合人脸边界框作为视觉线索，有效提升多人脸伪造检测，并超越多种现有先进方法。

title: Pose-aware Legged Robot Semantic Exploration with Omnidirectional Perception in Confined Unknown Environments
summary: Semantic exploration in confined environments requires both environment mapping and detailed observation of target objects. For ground robots, limited sensor vertical fields of view and restricted standoff distances can leave upper object surfaces unobserved from planar viewpoints. Body tilting can improve coverage, but additional observations and posture transitions increase mission time. To address this trade-off, we present POSE, a pose-aware semantic exploration system that exploits a legged robot's intrinsic body pitch and roll with omnidirectional camera-LiDAR perception. The proposed pose-aware viewpoint sampling module selects body postures from partial object maps according to expected coverage gain, while aim-aligned execution reduces unnecessary body reorientation. Further, we introduce an object-centric viewpoint pruning strategy assisted by a vision-language model (VLM), which uses persistent observation history and bird's-eye-view (BEV) maps to reduce redundant inspection visits. The resulting semantic viewpoints are combined with geometric exploration viewpoints in a global exploration planner. Simulations show that POSE improves final target-surface coverage by 8-10 percentage points over the planar planning baseline while reducing exploration time by 17-32%, and achieves the highest mean object coverage AUC among the evaluated baselines. Real-world experiments with a legged robot carrying an omnidirectional camera-LiDAR suite in a machine shop further demonstrate the system's applicability. These results support adaptive body-posture planning for improving the coverage-efficiency trade-off in legged robot semantic exploration. We plan to release the code for community benefit in the future.

AI.tldr: POSE：结合腿式机器人本体俯仰/横滚与全向相机-LiDAR感知的姿态感知语义探索系统，通过姿态感知视点采样、对准执行与VLM辅助的以物体为中心的视点剪枝，联合几何探索规划，提升受限环境下的目标表面覆盖并缩短探索时间。
AI.motivation: 受限环境中语义探索需同时完成建图与目标物体细致观测。地面机器人受限于垂直视场与有限距离，平面视角下目标物体上表面易缺失观测；单纯倾斜机身虽可提升覆盖，却带来额外观测与姿态转换开销，导致任务时间增加。因此需要解决覆盖与效率之间的权衡。
AI.method: 1) 采用腿式机器人本体俯仰与横滚能力，配合全向相机-LiDAR感知；2) 姿态感知视点采样模块：基于部分物体地图，按预期覆盖增益选择机身姿态，并通过对准执行减少不必要的机身重定向；3) 以物体为中心的视点剪枝：借助视觉语言模型（VLM），利用持续观测历史与鸟瞰（BEV）地图降低冗余巡检；4) 将语义视点与几何探索视点统一纳入全局探索规划器。
AI.result: 仿真显示：相比平面规划基线，最终目标表面覆盖率提高8–10个百分点，探索时间减少17–32%，并在所评估基线中取得最高平均物体覆盖AUC。实机实验：在机械车间环境中，腿式机器人搭载全向相机-LiDAR套件验证了系统适用性。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持通过自适应机身姿态规划改善腿式机器人语义探索中覆盖与效率的权衡；作者计划未来开源代码。

title: From Intent to Action: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Vehicle Voice Command Authorization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into vehicle voice assistants. But linking natural-language requests to vehicle functions creates a safety-critical authorization problem. Before executing a command, the system must choose whether to execute, refuse, clarify, require confirmation, defer to manual control, trigger an emergency response, or make no tool call. To our knowledge, prior evaluations do not isolate this pre-action decision across speaker role, authentication status, vehicle state, and tool availability. We introduce a 202-scenario benchmark with Reference Decisions under a seven-class taxonomy. We evaluate two local open-weight models and three API-based LLMs using Decision Alignment and safety-specific error metrics. Alignment ranges from 40.1% for Llama 3.2 3B to 89.1% for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. The API-based models score between 83.2% and 89.1%, with no statistically significant differences among them. Even these models produce two to three False Executes among 161 non-execution scenarios, and persistent errors remain in confirmation and manual-control decisions. A controlled Llama 3.2 3B ablation increases alignment to 40.1% under the structured authorization policy, versus 28.2-29.2% under schema-only and generic-safety baselines, but it does not eliminate False Executes. Structured LLM decisions are therefore insufficient as a standalone safety mechanism, and deployment requires an independent enforcement layer that verifies tool permissions and vehicle-state constraints before invoking any vehicle function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出含202个场景、七类参考决策的车载语音助手授权基准，评测5个LLM：对齐率40.1%–89.1%，即使最佳模型仍出现假执行；结论是结构化LLM决策不能作为独立安全机制，需独立执行层校验。
AI.motivation: LLM正被集成到车载语音助手中，将自然语言请求映射为车辆功能属于安全攸关的授权问题。执行前系统需判断是执行、拒绝、澄清、要求确认、转手动控制、触发紧急响应还是不做工具调用。已有评测未孤立考察这一"行动前决策"在说话人角色、认证状态、车辆状态与工具可用性下的表现。
AI.method: 构建含202个场景、以七类分类法给出参考决策的基准；用决策对齐度（Decision Alignment）与安全专用错误指标，评测2个本地开源权重模型与3个API模型；并对Llama 3.2 3B做受控消融，比较结构化授权策略与仅模式（schema-only）、通用安全基线。
AI.result: 对齐率从Llama 3.2 3B的40.1%到Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的89.1%；三个API模型为83.2%–89.1%，彼此无统计显著差异。即使在161个非执行场景中，这些模型仍产生2–3次假执行，且在确认与手动控制决策上存在持续性错误。Llama 3.2 3B消融显示结构化授权策略下对齐率40.1%，高于仅模式与通用安全基线的28.2%–29.2%，但未能消除假执行。
AI.conclusion: 结构化LLM决策作为独立安全机制并不充分；部署时需引入独立执行层，在调用任何车辆功能前校验工具权限与车辆状态约束。

title: A Policy Profile for Croissant: Refusal as a Property of the Dataset
comment: 23 pages. Reference implementation and conformance corpus archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22018156 and doi:10.5281/zenodo.22016112
summary: Croissant is the de facto machine-readable descriptor for ML datasets: JSON-LD over schema.org. Since version 1.1 it also carries data use conditions, recommending DUO and ODRL for them. What no version specifies is how any of them is evaluated: no decision procedure, no bound on evaluation cost, no outcome for a condition an implementation cannot evaluate, no record of what was checked, and nothing on composition with caller-side authority. We supply that half. An additive profile lets a dataset declare the operations it admits and the conditions under which it admits them, over a closed set of five operators whose decision procedure is given in full, so a gate decides from the descriptor alone and records what it checked. Two corpora evaluate it and their evidence is kept apart. Three descriptors that gated a real nf-core pipeline give the deployment result: decisions from a profile document match the gate's native descriptor record for record, stripping the layer leaves a valid Croissant document, and the added cost is 11.7 $μ$s against a 119 $μ$s decision. A corpus generated from the profile's grammar gives the breadth, covering every operator, refusal class and conformance clause. Across its valid cases, 552 complete decision records agree three ways -- native descriptor, profile terms, and the same policy as ODRL in usageInfo. The carrier is therefore not the contribution; the evaluation semantics is. Finally, caller-bound and data-bound policies range over non-overlapping state spaces, so neither permit set contains the other.

AI.tldr: Croissant（基于schema.org的JSON-LD）是ML数据集的事实标准机器可读描述符，自1.1版起携带数据使用条件（推荐DUO与ODRL），但从未规定如何评估这些条件。本文补充了这一半：提出一个加性profile，使数据集可声明其允许的操作及条件，基于五个算子并给出完整决策过程，从而仅凭描述符即可判定并记录检查内容。用两个语料库和三个真实nf-core流水线描述符验证：决策逐条匹配、剥离后仍为合法Croissant文档、附加开销11.7μs（决策本身119μs）；生成语料覆盖全部算子、拒绝类别与一致性条款，552条完整决策记录三方一致。核心贡献是评估语义而非载体；调用方绑定与数据绑定策略状态空间不重叠，互不包含。
AI.motivation: Croissant已是ML数据集的事实标准描述符并携带DUO/ODRL数据使用条件，但现有一切版本都缺乏评估语义：没有决策过程、没有评估成本上界、没有对无法评估条件的处理、没有检查记录，也没有与调用方权限的组合规则。作者旨在补齐这缺失的对偶面——即评估语义。
AI.method: 提出一个加性（additive）profile：数据集声明其允许的操作及允许条件，基于一个封闭的五算子集合，并给出完整的决策过程。门控（gate）仅依据描述符即可决策并记录检查内容。采用两个独立语料库评估：一是三个为真实nf-core流水线 门控的描述符（部署结果）；二是由profile语法生成的语料库（广度覆盖）。
AI.result: 部署结果：来自profile文档的决策与门控原生描述符记录逐条一致；剥离该层后仍是合法Croissant文档；附加成本为11.7μs（相比119μs的决策）。生成语料覆盖每一算子、拒绝类别与一致性条款；在其有效用例中，552条完整决策记录实现三方一致——原生描述符、profile条款、以及与usageInfo中ODRL相同策略。
AI.conclusion: 该描述符的载体（Croissant/JSON-LD）并非贡献所在，真正的贡献是评估语义。此外，调用方绑定与数据绑定策略作用于互不重叠的状态空间，因此任一方的许可集都不包含另一方。

title: Learn Before You Judge: Progressive Knowledge-to-Decision Alignment for Explainable Hateful Meme Detection
summary: Hateful memes spread abusive content through implicit interactions between images and text, posing serious threats to the safety of online communities. In recent years, multimodal large language models have been widely used for hateful meme detection and are increasingly adopted to generate explainable detection results. However, we find that existing explain-then-detect methods often couple explanation generation and label prediction within the same training process. This coupling causes interference between task objectives, leading to limited detection performance and even worse results than simple SFT baselines. To address these challenges, we propose ProKDA, a progressive knowledge-to-decision alignment method for explainable hateful meme detection. Inspired by the human annotation training process, ProKDA first uses an agentic background knowledge construction pipeline to obtain external knowledge related to meme understanding. It then adopts a three-stage training strategy that sequentially performs background knowledge learning, hatefulness detection learning, and hatefulness boundary alignment. Unlike prior explain-then-detect methods that jointly optimize both tasks, ProKDA focuses on a single training objective at each stage. This design reduces interference between the two tasks and progressively transforms background knowledge into robust detection decisions. Experiments on three public hateful meme benchmarks show that ProKDA achieves state-of-the-art detection performance and provides accurate, explainable, and evidence-supported decisions for hateful meme moderation. Project page: https://meizhiyuan88666.github.io/prokda.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ProKDA，一种渐进式知识到决策对齐方法，用于可解释的仇恨表情包检测，通过解耦解释生成与标签预测来避免任务干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有"先解释后检测"方法将解释生成与标签预测耦合于同一训练过程，造成任务目标间的干扰，导致检测性能受限，甚至不如简单的SFT基线。
AI.method: ProKDA受人类标注训练过程启发，首先使用智能体背景知识构建流水线获取与表情包理解相关的外部知识；随后采用三阶段训练策略，依次进行背景知识学习、仇恨性检测学习和仇恨性边界对齐，每阶段只关注单一训练目标。
AI.result: 在三个公开仇恨表情包基准上，ProKDA取得了最先进的检测性能，并为仇恨表情包审核提供准确、可解释且有证据支持的决策。
AI.conclusion: 通过阶段化解耦训练目标，ProKDA有效减少了解释与检测任务间的干扰，将背景知识逐步转化为稳健的检测决策，优于联合优化的现有方法。

title: Understanding and Exploiting Diagonal Attention Sparsity in Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive image generation has emerged as a paradigm for multimodal AI systems due to its compatibility with transformer-based LLM serving infrastructures. However, generating thousands of visual tokens per request makes decoding increasingly bottlenecked by KV cache accesses during attention computation. Sparse attention is particularly attractive for this workload because many visual generation applications tolerate moderate quality degradation in exchange for improved performance and efficiency. While sparse attention has been extensively explored for text-based LLM inference, it remains unclear whether its sparsity assumptions generalize effectively to autoregressive image generation. We present the first systematic characterization of attention sparsity in autoregressive image generation across diverse workloads and representative open-source models. Our analysis reveals several distinguishing properties, including a pronounced prefill-decode asymmetry, strong attention concentration on prompt and local tokens, and a unique diagonal attention sparsity pattern arising from the spatial locality of visual tokens. Motivated by these observations, we propose a diagonal-aware sparse attention mechanism that selectively skips KV entries along the diagonal attention direction within a recent window. Implemented on top of a GPU-based serving system using FlexGen, FlashAttention-2, and custom kernels, our approach achieves up to 3.1x throughput and 1.19x latency improvements with less than 2% quality degradation compared to dense inference.

AI.tldr: 首次系统刻画自回归图像生成中的注意力稀疏性，发现预填充-解码不对称、提示词与局部token集中、对角稀疏模式，提出对角感知稀疏注意力，吞吐提升至3.1倍、延迟改善1.19倍，质量损失<2%。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成与Transformer类LLM服务基础设施兼容，但每请求需生成数千视觉token，注意力计算中的KV缓存访问成为解码瓶颈。视觉生成应用可容忍适度质量下降以换取性能与效率，因此稀疏注意力很有吸引力；然而文本LLM的稀疏性假设是否适用于自回归图像生成尚不明确。
AI.method: 对多种工作负载与代表性开源模型进行自回归图像生成注意力稀疏性的首个系统性刻画。基于观察提出对角感知稀疏注意力机制：在近期窗口内沿对角注意力方向选择性跳过KV条目。在基于GPU的服务系统上实现，结合FlexGen、FlashAttention-2与自定义kernel。
AI.result: 相较稠密推理，吞吐最高提升3.1倍，延迟改善1.19倍，质量下降小于2%。
AI.conclusion: 自回归图像生成的注意力稀疏性具有独特性质，文本LLM的稀疏性假设不能直接泛化；对角感知稀疏注意力可在极小质量损失下显著提升服务性能与效率。

title: FASA: Feedback-Aware Sampling Adaptation for Efficient Diffusion-Based VLA Models
comment: Accepted by the 18th International Conference on Networking, Architecture, and Storage (NAS 2026)
summary: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in embodied tasks, but their iterative sampling imposes heavy computational and memory-access cost, blocking real-time deployment on edge platforms. Existing acceleration methods either require expensive training (e.g., distillation, flow matching) or degrade perception via statically scheduled pruning and caching, ignoring the dynamic workload variance of robotic interactions. This paper presents FASA (Feedback-Aware Sampling Adaptation), a training-free runtime framework that treats real-time multimodal feedback as a control signal for the denoising pipeline: an interaction-driven range adaptor modulates the global sampling-step budget based on visual and gripper-force feedback, and a proprioception-aware step adaptor pinpoints the optimized step within the adapted range. This co-designed framework allows the underlying hardware architecture to adaptively match the workload demands of different execution phases. Comparative evaluations across several benchmarks show that the inference speed can be increased by up to 1.45$\times$ while maintaining competitive success rates, providing a novel dynamic runtime architecture paradigm for deploying heavy generative embodied AI workloads onto resource-constrained computing platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练运行时框架FASA，利用多模态反馈动态调节扩散式VLA模型的去噪采样步数与区间，在多个基准上实现最高1.45倍推理加速且成功率保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身任务中表现优异，但迭代采样带来高昂的计算与访存开销，难以在边缘平台实时部署；现有加速方法需昂贵训练（蒸馏、流匹配）或依赖静态剪枝与缓存而损害感知能力，忽略了机器人交互负载的动态变化。
AI.method: 提出FASA（Feedback-Aware Sampling Adaptation）免训练运行时框架，将实时多模态反馈作为去噪流程的控制信号：交互驱动的范围适配器依据视觉与夹爪力反馈调制全局采样步预算；本体感知感知的步适配器在调整后的区间内定位最优步。二者协同使底层硬件架构自适应匹配不同执行阶段的负载需求。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的对比评估显示，推理速度最高提升1.45倍，同时保持具有竞争力的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: FASA为将重型生成式具身AI工作负载部署到资源受限计算平台提供了一种新的动态运行时架构范式，无需训练即可实现感知与效率的平衡。

title: Reach or Solve? Attributing Agentic RL Gains with Checkpoint Handoffs
summary: Reinforcement learning now trains language-model agents that act over dozens of steps in live environments. The gains are large, and they are read as better decision-making. An agent in a closed loop writes its own inputs. Each observation follows from its own earlier actions, so the states it meets late in an episode are partly of its own making. An SFT checkpoint and an RL checkpoint are then scored from different states, even on identical tasks. Endpoint success mixes two changes: where the agent arrives, and what it does once it is there. Restricting the comparison to states both policies reach does not separate them. That restriction selects on an outcome, and in our data it flips the sign of the effect. We introduce checkpoint handoff, an evaluation protocol that clones a state one released checkpoint reached and hands it to another, with no retraining. Crossing a reacher role and a solver role over SFT and RL splits an endpoint gain into REACH and SOLVE. REACH is how often a policy arrives at a state the environment confirms is a fixed number of actions from success. SOLVE is how often it finishes from an identical cloned state. Across two benchmarks and two independently released pipelines, the reacher by solver interaction is positive in all five conditions. An RL history is worth more to an RL solver than the same history is to an SFT solver. On ALFWorld, RL improves both terms, and the SFT solver never succeeds where the RL solver fails. Independent REACH and SOLVE gaps predict the aggregate interaction. Handoff asks only that one checkpoint's history can be replayed under another, so long-horizon evaluation can report arrival and completion beside endpoint success.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 checkpoint handoff 评估协议，将闭环强化学习智能体的终点成功率分解为 REACH（到达距成功固定步数的状态）与 SOLVE（从克隆状态完成任务）两项，跨两个基准与两套独立发布的流水线验证该分解。
AI.motivation: 闭环 RL 智能体自主生成输入，后期状态部分由自身动作造成，导致 SFT 与 RL 检查点在相同任务上被从不同状态评估。终点成功率混合了"到达何处"与"到达后如何行动"两种变化，而仅限制在双方都可达状态的比较属于对结果的选择偏差，在作者数据中甚至使效应符号反转，因此需要能分离这两项变化的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出 checkpoint handoff 协议：克隆某一已发布检查点所到达的状态，在无需重新训练的情况下交给另一检查点执行。通过将 reacher 角色与 solver 角色在 SFT 与 RL 上交叉配对，把终点增益拆分为 REACH（策略到达被环境确认为距成功固定动作数状态的频率）与 SOLVE（在相同克隆状态下完成任务的频率）。
AI.result: 在两个基准与两套独立发布的流水线上，reacher×solver 交互在全部五种条件下均为正：RL 历史对 RL solver 的价值高于同一历史对 SFT solver。在 ALFWorld 上，RL 同时提升 REACH 与 SOLVE，且 SFT solver 从未在 RL solver 失败之处成功。独立的 REACH 与 SOLVE 差距可预测总体交互效应。
AI.conclusion: Handoff 仅要求一个检查点的历史能在另一检查点下被重放，因此长时程评估可在终点成功率之外同时报告到达与完成情况，为闭环 RL 提供更可分解、更稳健的评估信号。

title: CoRe: Coherence and Relational Alignment for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
summary: Direct forecasting has become a standard paradigm for multivariate time-series forecasting because it predicts the full future horizon in a single pass. However, its training objective is often still decomposed into pointwise errors such as MSE. Such objectives provide stable supervision, but they do not explicitly preserve the structure of the future trajectory: temporal coherence within each variable and relational consistency across variables can both be weakened. We propose CoRe, a model-agnostic learning objective for direct multivariate forecasting. CoRe replaces pointwise supervision with two output-space constraints: a frequency coherence loss that aligns predicted and target spectra, and a low-rank relational graph loss that matches sampled pairwise differences in a target-derived PCA subspace. The resulting objective introduces no trainable parameters and can be applied to existing forecasting backbones by changing only the loss. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that CoRe improves strong baselines, compares favorably with recent forecasting objectives, and remains effective across different backbones, datasets, and hyperparameter settings overall consistently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRe，一种用于直接多变量时间序列预测的模型无关学习目标。它用频域一致性损失和低秩关系图损失替代逐点误差监督，无需新增可训练参数，仅修改损失即可提升现有骨干模型性能。
AI.motivation: 直接预测范式一次性输出完整未来序列，但其训练目标多仍采用MSE等逐点误差。这类目标虽提供稳定监督，却未显式保持未来轨迹结构：各变量内部的时间连贯性与变量间的关系一致性均可能被削弱。
AI.method: CoRe将逐点监督替换为两个输出空间约束：(1)频率一致性损失，对齐预测谱与目标谱；(2)低秩关系图损失，在由目标导出的PCA子空间中匹配采样的成对差分。该目标不引入可训练参数，可仅通过更换损失函数应用于现有预测骨干。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，CoRe提升了强基线模型，与近期预测目标相比具有竞争力，并在不同骨干、数据集和超参数设置下整体保持稳定有效。
AI.conclusion: CoRe作为一种模型无关的直接多变量预测学习目标，通过频域与低秩关系约束显式保持未来轨迹结构，无需额外参数，具备良好的通用性与有效性。

title: Evolution or Illusion? Rethinking Evaluation in LLM Evolutionary Search
summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search finds programs by launching seeds and iterating each one. Papers report a single budget setting, usually one seed run for a fixed number of iterations, and rank methods from that one point. We show this is not enough. We evaluate three evolutionary search strategies on five optimization tasks, commonly used by papers in the genre to report results. We run the analysis over a full grid of seeds and iterations. Our findings suggest that the best way to split a fixed budget between more seeds (width) and more iterations (depth) changes with the strategy, the task, and the total budget. Furthermore, we observe that the ranking of strategies also changes with the budget. On one task the strategy that looks worst at one seed is best at forty seeds. On another the best number of iterations is well below the value common in practice, so extra depth wastes budget that more seeds would turn into score. We provide a measurement protocol that reports the seeds-by-iterations frontier and practical guidance for using it.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLM驱动演化搜索领域普遍只报告单一"种子数×迭代数"预算设定下的结果并据此排名方法，这一做法不充分。作者在3种演化搜索策略、5个优化任务上遍历完整的种子–迭代网格，发现最优的"宽度（更多种子）vs深度（更多迭代）"预算分配随策略、任务和总预算而变，策略排名也随预算变化，并提出测量协议与实用指南。
AI.motivation: 该领域论文通常只报告单一预算设定（一般是一个种子运行固定迭代次数），并基于这一单点对方法进行排名。这种评估范式忽略了预算分配（种子数vs迭代数）对结果和排名的影响，可能导致结论不稳健、甚至误导，因此需要系统性地检验预算设定是否影响方法评价。
AI.method: 在3种LLM驱动的演化搜索策略、5个该领域常用优化任务上进行实验，覆盖种子数与迭代数的完整网格（seeds-by-iterations frontier），在固定总预算下分析宽度（种子数）与深度（迭代数）的分配效果，并考察策略排名随预算的变化，据此提出测量协议。
AI.result: 最优的预算切分方式随策略、任务和总预算而变化；策略排名亦随预算改变。例如某任务上在1个种子时表现最差的策略在40个种子时表现最好；另一任务上最优迭代数远低于实践中常用值，多余的深度浪费预算，而这些预算若用于更多种子可转化为更高分数。
AI.conclusion: 单一预算设定下的评估与排名不足以支撑可靠结论，应报告种子数×迭代数的前沿（测量协议），并依据任务、策略与总预算动态选择宽度与深度的分配，从而避免预算浪费与错误的方法排名。

title: GAPrompt++: Multi-Granular Geometry-Aware Point Cloud Prompt for 3D Vision Model
summary: Pre-trained 3D vision models have substantially advanced point cloud analysis, yet adapting them to downstream tasks via full fine-tuning is computationally expensive and storage-intensive. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) offers a promising alternative by reducing both adaptation cost and storage burden. However, existing prompting-based approaches ignore the intrinsic geometric structures of point clouds, thereby limiting their adaptation capability. This limitation stems from their inability to encode both fine-grained geometric cues and coarse-grained structural semantics, as well as failing to propagate such information effectively through the model hierarchy. To address these challenges, we propose GAPrompt++, a multi-granular geometry-aware prompting method that provides richer geometric guidance for efficient 3D task adaptation. Specifically, we introduce a Point Shift Prompter that extracts multi-granular geometric features across different scales, enabling instance-specific geometric adjustments during adaptation. Next, a Keypoint Prompter adaptively generates point-level prompts to highlight local geometric saliency and fine-grained structural details. Furthermore, a Prompt Propagation mechanism injects these multi-granular geometric cues throughout the feature extraction hierarchy, strengthening the ability to capture essential geometric characteristics. Extensive experiments show that GAPrompt++ achieves state-of-the-art performance among prompting-based PEFT methods and even surpasses full fine-tuning across diverse benchmarks, while requiring less than 2\% trainable parameters. In addition, to address the saturation of existing evaluation datasets, we construct two more challenging benchmarks derived from 3D Gaussian Splatting and Multi-View Stereo reconstruction, offering diverse and realistic point cloud scenarios to promote future research.

AI.tldr: 提出多粒度几何感知提示方法GAPrompt++，以不到2%可训练参数实现点云下游任务适配，性能超越全量微调，并构建两个更具挑战的新基准。
AI.motivation: 预训练3D视觉模型全量微调计算与存储成本高，而现有基于提示的PEFT方法忽略点云内在几何结构，无法编码细粒度几何线索与粗粒度结构语义，也未能在模型层级间有效传播这些信息，限制了适配能力。
AI.method: GAPrompt++包含三个组件：Point Shift Prompter在不同尺度提取多粒度几何特征以进行实例特定的几何调整；Keypoint Prompter自适应生成点级提示，突出局部几何显著性与细粒度结构细节；Prompt Propagation机制将多粒度几何线索注入整个特征提取层级。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，GAPrompt++在基于提示的PEFT方法中达到SOTA，甚至超越全量微调，且可训练参数不足2%。此外，构建了基于3D高斯泼溅与多视图立体重建的两个更具挑战性的基准。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度几何感知提示可有效提升3D点云PEFT适配性能，兼顾效率与精度；新构建的多样化真实场景基准有助于推动后续研究。

title: Self-excited actuation enables adaptive and resilient flapping-wing flight
summary: The muscles that power insect flight fall into one of two categories: 1) synchronous muscles that contract under direct control from the nervous system, and 2) asynchronous muscles which have an intrinsic stretch activation response that spontaneously generates wingbeats without the need for signaling from the brain. It is thought that the emergent nature of asynchronous wingbeats provides both adaptive and responsive capabilities for flight control. To date, most flying robots use synchronous actuation. In this paper we develop the first flight-capable flapping wing robot that uses asynchronous actuation. We demonstrate that asynchronous actuation allows wings to respond to changes in the resonant mechanics of the body without control input, and wings can react instantaneously to collisions with obstacles with no extrinsic sensing needed. Flight tests within cluttered environments demonstrate that asynchronous actuation significantly improves stability and performance when compared to synchronous actuation. In total this work demonstrates that a flapping wing robot actuation strategy that emulates the asynchronous muscles of flying insects can provide fast, reactive actuation responses before a control system would need to intervene. This partitioning of embodied control to both the low-level actuation dynamics and and high-level sensorimotor system provides a compelling blueprint for new flying robots.

AI.tldr: 本文研制了首个具备飞行能力的异步驱动扑翼机器人，利用本征拉伸激活响应实现无需控制输入的瞬时响应，显著提升复杂环境下的飞行稳定性。
AI.motivation: 昆虫飞行肌分为同步肌与异步肌，后者具有本征拉伸激活特性，可在无神经信号条件下自发产生振翅，被认为赋予飞行控制更强的适应性与响应能力；而现有飞行机器人多采用同步驱动，缺乏这种低层级的具身控制机制。
AI.method: 研制首个采用异步驱动的可飞行扑翼机器人，使翅膀能够在不依赖控制输入的情况下响应机体共振力学变化，并在无需外部传感的条件下瞬时响应障碍物碰撞；在杂乱环境中开展飞行测试，并与同步驱动方案进行对比。
AI.result: 异步驱动使翅膀可自发响应机体共振力学变化且无需控制输入，可无 extrinsic 传感瞬时响应碰撞；在杂乱环境飞行测试中，异步驱动相比同步驱动显著提升了稳定性与性能。
AI.conclusion: 模拟飞行昆虫异步肌的扑翼驱动策略可在控制系统介入之前提供快速、反应式的驱动响应；将具身控制分配至低层驱动动力学与高层感觉运动系统，为新型飞行机器人提供了有价值的蓝图。

title: ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI
summary: Scientific discovery is defined by the ability to identify the boundaries of existing knowledge and venture into unexplored territory. The ultimate vision for AI in science is problem-driven autonomous research: given a fundamental challenge by a human expert, the AI independently navigates the scientific landscape, uncovers theoretical and empirical bottlenecks, and systematically expands the frontier of knowledge. In this paper, we introduce ScientistTwo, a fully autonomous multi-agent framework designed to realize this vision. Specifically, ScientistTwo takes an initial problem as input, establishes state-of-the-art baselines, formulates novel hypotheses, and coordinates specialized agents to orchestrate an end-to-end discovery cycle without human intervention. Moreover, the framework rigorously conducts experiments using diverse datasets and metrics, refines methodologies through automated ablation studies, and validates research findings via a closed-loop simulated peer-review rebuttal engine. To evaluate ScientistTwo's capabilities against the highest standards of human scientific achievement, we benchmark it across papers accepted at top-tier conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. As a result, ScientistTwo autonomously generates expert-level, publishable papers and fully verified, executable codebases. Its solutions consistently outperform human state-of-the-art models, and achieve higher average review ratings than human-authored papers under automated AI review agents. These results show that ScientistTwo is not merely an assistive tool but an autonomous scientific pioneer capable of pushing the frontiers of human discovery. Project website: https://scientist-two.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ScientistTwo，一个全自主多智能体框架，实现从问题输入到可发表论文与可执行代码库的端到端自主科研闭环。
AI.motivation: 科学发现的本质在于识别现有知识边界并进入未知领域。AI for Science 的终极愿景是"问题驱动的自主研究"：人类专家提出根本性挑战，AI 自主探索科学空间、识别理论与实证瓶颈并系统性地拓展知识前沿。然而现有工作多停留在辅助工具层面，缺乏端到端自主发现能力。
AI.method: ScientistTwo 以初始问题为输入，建立 SOTA 基线，提出新假设，并协调多个专用智能体编排端到端发现循环，全程无人工干预。框架使用多样化数据集与指标开展实验，通过自动化消融研究迭代改进方法，并借助闭环模拟同行评审—反驳（rebuttal）引擎验证研究发现。
AI.result: 以 ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS 等顶级会议录用论文为基准进行评测，ScientistTwo 可自主生成专家级可发表论文与完整可验证的可执行代码库；其方案持续超越人类 SOTA 模型，并在自动化 AI 评审智能体下取得高于人类撰写论文的平均评审评分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 ScientistTwo 不仅是辅助工具，而是具备推动人类发现前沿能力的自主科学探索者。项目网站：https://scientist-two.github.io/

title: Conservation Buys Stability and Factoring Buys Counterfactuals in Physical World Models
summary: A learned simulator can reproduce its training conditions accurately yet fail in two distinct ways once those conditions change. Over long rollouts, small errors accumulate until the trajectory drifts away from physically plausible behavior; under an intervention on a physical parameter, the model may continue to follow the law seen during training rather than the intervened one. We show that these two failures require different structural remedies. Evolving a learned energy with a symplectic integrator preserves the geometry of the conservative dynamics and keeps rollouts bounded and physically meaningful for up to $100\times$ the training horizon, while equal-capacity predictors, an energy-regularized predictor, and a tuned neural ODE diverge. By contrast, encoding the physical coupling through an explicit linear factorization enables the model to follow a never-seen sign of that coupling, whereas an unrestricted parameterization remains locked to the training law. Crucially, the two mechanisms are separable: removing the structure responsible for long-horizon stability leaves counterfactual transfer intact, while removing the factorized coupling destroys counterfactual transfer without eliminating stability. This double dissociation, established with matched controls that remove or replace one structural component at a time, persists beyond the headline three-body system and remains visible when the physical state must be inferred from pixels rather than provided directly. The result is a concrete design principle for physical world models: long-horizon stability and changed-law generalization arise from distinct structural commitments, and each can be imposed deliberately without requiring the other.

AI.tldr: 学习型模拟器在训练条件之外会出现两类不同失效：长时程漂移和干预下规律泛化失败；前者需辛积分器演化学习能量，后者需显式线性因子化编码物理耦合，二者机制可分离且存在双重解离。
AI.motivation: 学习型模拟器虽能在训练条件下准确复现，但条件改变后存在两类不同失效：长时程中误差累积导致轨迹偏离物理合理性；物理参数受干预时模型仍沿用训练规律。论文旨在揭示这两类失效需要不同的结构性补救措施，并检验其是否可分离。
AI.method: 采用受控实验，逐一移除或替换单一结构组件：以辛积分器演化学习能量以保持守恒动力学几何；以显式线性因子化编码物理耦合；对照相同容量预测器、能量正则化预测器、调参神经ODE。在三体系统之外扩展验证，并在需从像素推断物理状态的条件下检验。
AI.result: 辛积分器演化学习能量使rollout在长达100倍训练时程内保持有界且物理合理，而等容量预测器、能量正则化预测器与调参神经ODE均发散。显式线性因子化使模型能遵循从未见过的耦合符号，而无约束参数化仍锁定训练规律。移除长时程稳定性结构不影响反事实迁移，移除因子化耦合破坏反事实迁移但不消除稳定性，形成双重解离。
AI.conclusion: 长时程稳定性与变规律泛化源于不同的结构性承诺，可分别独立施加而无需依赖另一方；这为物理世界模型提供了具体设计原则：两类能力需各自对应的结构设计。

title: Dictionary-Constrained Grapheme-to-Phoneme for Unsegmented Languages from LLM-Annotated Data
summary: Grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion turns raw text into its phonemic form and is an essential part of both text-to-speech (TTS) and automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. It is required to be fast, stable and context-aware. For unsegmented languages such as Japanese, G2P additionally couples word segmentation with highly context-dependent polyphone disambiguation, and the scarcity of accurately annotated data remains a bottleneck. In this paper, we present a context-aware neural G2P method that scores paths of a discriminative conditional random field (CRF) over a word lattice constructed from dictionaries. To tackle data scarcity, we utilize large language models (LLMs) to generate more than 2 million sentences. Experimental results demonstrate that our method strongly outperforms conventional morphological analyzer-based methods and neural sequence models. On the Joyo-Kanji-Yomi benchmark, our method reaches 99.62% target word reading accuracy, 0.32% target word phoneme error rate (PER) and 0.14% sentence PER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种上下文感知的神经G2P方法，在词典构建的词格上对判别式CRF路径打分，并利用LLM生成超200万句数据缓解标注稀缺；在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准上达到99.62%目标词读音准确率、0.32%目标词PER和0.14%句子PER，显著优于传统形态分析器与神经序列模型。
AI.motivation: G2P是TTS与ASR的关键环节，需兼具快速、稳定与上下文感知能力。对日语等未分词语言，G2P还需与分词及高度依赖上下文的多音字消歧耦合，而高质量标注数据稀缺成为主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 在基于词典构造的词格上，使用判别式条件随机场（CRF）对路径进行打分，实现上下文感知的神经G2P；同时借助大语言模型（LLM）生成超过200万条句子以缓解数据稀缺。
AI.result: 方法显著优于基于传统形态分析器的方法与神经序列模型。在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准上，目标词读音准确率达99.62%，目标词音素错误率（PER）为0.32%，句子PER为0.14%。
AI.conclusion: 将词格上的判别式CRF打分与LLM生成的大规模数据相结合，可有效提升未分词语言G2P的准确性与鲁棒性，为数据稀缺场景下的上下文相关读音预测提供了可行方案。

title: SeetaPsych v1.0: An Open-source Computer Vision Toolkit for Behavior-based Psychological Measurement
summary: Automated visual analysis opens new avenues for behavior--based psychological measurement. Nevertheless, existing technological modules are typically scattered across task specific systems with heterogeneous interfaces and disparate deployment requirements. In this work, we present SeetaPsych v1.0, an open source, unified and extensible computer vision toolkit designed to extract psychologically relevant signals from facial images and/or face based videos. The current release encompasses four major core modules aiming at behavior--based physiological perception: unified face based emotion analysis (simultaneous facial expression recognition, facial action unit detection, and valence--arousal estimation), camera based heart rate estimation, screen point--of--gaze estimation, and scene gaze following. A suite of auxiliary preprocessing modules for human centric visual analysis is also included, comprising face detection, facial landmark detection, and head detection. These functionalities are encapsulated within a modular Pipeline/Runner architecture that automatically resolves attribute dependencies, constructs computation graphs, and support intermediate result sharing among modules. SeetaPsych provides standardized Python APIs to facilitate reproducible, large scale analyses, alongside an interactive WebUI for rapid, code--free method evaluation. Overall, SeetaPsych offers an integrated and accessible visual measurement platform for research in psychology, behavioral science, human computer interaction, and related fields.

AI.tldr: SeetaPsych v1.0 是一个开源、统一、可扩展的计算机视觉工具包，用于从面部图像/视频中提取心理学相关信号，集成表情识别、动作单元检测、效价-唤醒估计、心率估计、视线估计与注视跟随等模块，并提供统一 API 与 WebUI。
AI.motivation: 自动化视觉分析为基于行为的心理测量开辟了新途径，但现有技术模块分散在任务特定系统中，接口异构、部署要求不一，缺乏统一、可复用的集成平台。
AI.method: 提出 SeetaPsych v1.0 工具包，包含四大核心模块（统一面部情感分析，含表情识别、面部动作单元检测与效价-唤醒估计；摄像头心率估计；屏幕注视点估计；场景注视跟随）及辅助预处理模块（人脸检测、面部关键点检测、头部检测）；采用模块化 Pipeline/Runner 架构，自动解析属性依赖、构建计算图并支持中间结果共享；提供标准化 Python API 与交互式 WebUI。
AI.result: 实现了一个集成化视觉测量平台，可支持可复现、大规模的行为心理分析，并通过 WebUI 实现无需编程的快速方法评估。
AI.conclusion: SeetaPsych 为心理学、行为科学、人机交互及相关领域研究提供了一个集成且易用的视觉测量平台。

title: PIVOT: Perception-aware Independent Viewpoint Online Optimization
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Yuyang Chen and Shekoufeh Sadeghi contributed equally to this work. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: A fundamental assumption in robotic perception is that the sensor's field of view (FoV) is fixed relative to the robot body. Motion-decoupled sensors, such as gimbal-mounted cameras and MEMS-based LiDARs, instead allow sensing direction to be controlled independently at runtime. This freedom creates a computational challenge: efficiently selecting useful viewing directions online in feature-dense environments. We propose PIVOT, a lightweight iterative method that optimizes sensor viewing direction along a fixed translation trajectory to maximize feature visibility. Under a conical FoV model, visibility depends only on the optical axis, yielding a two-degree-of-freedom optimization on the viewing sphere $S^2$. Coordinate-free $SO(3)$ exponential-map updates enable efficient continuous optimization without explicit angular parameterizations or exhaustive viewing-sphere search. Monte Carlo evaluations retain 98.1--99.6% of brute-force visibility with a 76--85x speedup. Photorealistic simulation and real-world experiments further demonstrate improved visual localization robustness and practical viewpoint control on a quadruped robot.

AI.tldr: 提出PIVOT方法，在线优化运动解耦传感器的观测方向以最大化特征可见性，双目优化于S^2且用SO(3)指数映射更新，速度提升76-85倍。
AI.motivation: 机器人感知通常假设传感器视场相对机体固定，而云台相机、MEMS激光雷达等运动解耦传感器允许运行时独立控制观测方向，由此带来在特征密集环境中在线高效选择有用观测方向的计算难题。
AI.method: PIVOT是一种轻量级迭代方法，在固定平移轨迹下优化传感器观测方向以最大化特征可见性。采用锥形视场模型，可见性仅依赖光轴，因此问题化为观测球面S^2上的二自由度优化；使用无坐标的SO(3)指数映射更新，实现高效连续优化，无需显式角度参数化或遍历式观测球搜索。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛评估保留暴力搜索可见性的98.1–99.6%，加速76–85倍。逼真仿真与真实世界实验进一步验证了视觉定位鲁棒性的提升以及四足机器人上实用的视点控制效果。
AI.conclusion: PIVOT以轻量迭代方式高效求解运动解耦传感器的视点选择问题，在精度接近暴力搜索的同时大幅提速，并在仿真与实物上验证了其对视觉定位与视点控制的有效性。

title: Replan, Repair, or Edit? A Unified Empirical Evaluation of Travel Agents for Itinerary Revision under Resource Disruptions
summary: Travel-planning agents generate itineraries that may become infeasible after acceptance because of flight cancellations, hotel unavailability, or attraction closures. Revising these itineraries involves full replanning, classical plan repair, and LLM-based travel-agent revision, whose differing task formulations and evaluation protocols hinder comparison. We conduct a systematic empirical study using two TREK-derived benchmark sets: 500 single-disruption cases, including feasible and infeasible instances, and 200 feasible simultaneous compound-disruption cases. We compare LLM-Z3 full replanning, IPyHOPPER hierarchical repair, and an iTIMO local-revision adapter across effectiveness, plan stability, and computational cost. LLM-Z3 with Gemini achieved the highest observed compound-disruption success. IPyHOPPER nearly matched that configuration's single-disruption overall success, while preserving substantially more of the accepted itinerary on successful repairs. Successful hierarchical and local repairs made fewer edits and retained more accepted commitments than full replanning. Computational profiles differed: IPyHOPPER used no LLM inference, the evaluated LLM-Z3 adapter used compact one-call inference, and the iTIMO adapter consumed substantially more tokens. The study provides practical guidelines for balancing feasibility recovery, commitment preservation, and computational cost within evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 本文对旅行规划智能体在突发事件后行程修订的三类方法（LLM-Z3全量重规划、IPyHOPPER分层修复、iTIMO局部修订）进行系统性实证对比。
AI.motivation: 已接受的行程会因航班取消、酒店无房或景点关闭而变得不可行。现有修订方法（全量重规划、经典规划修复、基于LLM的智能体修订）任务形式化与评估协议不统一，难以横向比较。
AI.method: 基于TREK衍生的两个基准集开展系统实证研究：500个单中断案例（含可行与不可行实例）和200个可行的同时复合中断案例；在有效性、计划稳定性和计算成本三个维度上对比LLM-Z3全量重规划、IPyHOPPER分层修复与iTIMO局部修订适配器。
AI.result: 使用Gemini的LLM-Z3在复合中断上成功率最高；IPyHOPPER在单中断总体成功率上接近该配置，同时在成功修复中保留了更多已接受行程内容；成功的分层与局部修复比全量重规划编辑更少、保留更多已接受承诺。计算特征不同：IPyHOPPER不使用LLM推理，所评估的LLM-Z3适配器采用紧凑的单次调用推理，iTIMO适配器消耗的token明显更多。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在既定实验设置下平衡可行性恢复、承诺保留与计算成本提供了实践指导。

title: Opinion Dynamics-based Coalition Formation for Federated Learning in Heterogeneous IoT Systems
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving, on-device training across heterogeneous Internet-of-Things (IoT) deployments such as smart-city water-metering networks, where each smart meter observes a household-specific consumption time series. Under such statistical heterogeneity, the standard Federated Averaging (FedAvg) aggregation averages dissimilar local models into a single global model that may fail to capture client-specific patterns. We address this by forming client coalitions directly in the local-weight space and aggregating at the coalition level. Extending a prior weight-driven coalition-formation scheme, we model coalition formation as a Hegselmann-Krause (HK) bounded-confidence opinion-dynamics process acting on the local weights, and develop variants of the HK interaction based on Euclidean-distance and cosine-similarity confidence criteria. The framework is applied to short-term water-consumption forecasting with local Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models and evaluated against FedAvg, Per-FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAvg with Euclidean-distance or cosine-similarity coalition formation. Experiments on a real smart-metering dataset of water consumption show that the proposed HK-based coalition formation produces stable, endogenous coalition structures within at most ten inner iterations, incurs no additional client-side computation or communication compared to FedAvg, and reduces the average MAE by up to 54% relative to FedAvg, 39% relative to FedProx, and 24% relative to Per-FedAvg, while achieving the highest global accuracy (83-85%).

AI.tldr: 该论文针对联邦学习在IoT智能水表场景下的统计异质性，提出基于Hegselmann-Krause（HK）有界置信意见动力学在本地权重空间形成客户端联盟并进行联盟级聚合，在短期用水量预测任务上显著优于FedAvg等基线。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习（FL）支持隐私保护的在设备端训练，适用于智慧城市水计量网络等异构IoT部署，每个智能水表观测家庭特有的用水时间序列。在统计异质性下，标准FedAvg将差异较大的本地模型平均为单一全局模型，难以捕捉客户端特有模式，因此需要新的聚合机制。
AI.method: 直接在本地权重空间形成客户端联盟，并在联盟层面进行聚合。扩展此前的权重驱动联盟形成方案，将联盟形成建模为作用于本地权重的Hegselmann-Krause（HK）有界置信意见动力学过程，并基于欧氏距离与余弦相似度置信准则提出HK交互的多种变体。以本地LSTM模型应用于短期用水量预测，并与FedAvg、Per-FedAvg、FedProx以及采用欧氏距离或余弦相似度联盟形成的FedAvg进行对比。
AI.result: 在真实智能水表用水数据集上，所提HK联盟形成在至多十次内部迭代内产生稳定的内生联盟结构；相比FedAvg不增加额外的客户端计算或通信开销；平均MAE相对FedAvg最多降低54%，相对FedProx降低39%，相对Per-FedAvg降低24%，同时取得最高的全局准确率（83–85%）。
AI.conclusion: 基于HK有界置信动力学的联盟形成能有效应对联邦学习中的统计异质性，在不增加客户端开销的前提下形成稳定联盟结构并大幅提升预测精度与全局准确率，优于主流个性化与正则化联邦学习基线。

title: F$^{2}$DR: A Fine-Grained Full-Pipeline Reward Framework for DeepSearch Workflows
summary: With the widespread industrial deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), DeepSearch has emerged as the dominant paradigm for resolving complex user queries. It typically operates through an iterative closed-loop workflow consisting of planning and reflection, information retrieval, and answer generation. However, existing reward models (RMs) and evaluation benchmarks are primarily designed for static single-turn tasks, failing to capture the full-pipeline complexity of DeepSearch workflows. To address this limitation, we propose F2DR, a fine-grained full-pipeline DeepSearch reward framework. F2DR evaluates DeepSearch workflows across three dimensions: Content, Trajectory, and Answer, enabling comprehensive process-level assessment. We further construct DeepSearch RM-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating RMs in DeepSearch scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F2DR achieves significantly higher evaluation consistency than self-evaluation-based baselines, while DeepSearch RM-Bench exhibits strong discriminative capability across existing open-source RMs. We will publicly release the complete DeepSearch RM-Bench dataset soon.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对DeepSearch工作流缺乏专门奖励模型（RM）与评测基准的问题，提出细粒度全流程奖励框架F2DR及评测基准DeepSearch RM-Bench。
AI.motivation: LLM的工业部署使DeepSearch成为解决复杂用户查询的主流范式，其采用"规划与反思—信息检索—答案生成"的迭代闭环流程。然而现有奖励模型与评测基准主要面向静态单轮任务，无法刻画DeepSearch全流程的复杂性，因此需要专门的全流程奖励与评测方案。
AI.method: 提出F2DR细粒度全流程DeepSearch奖励框架，从Content（内容）、Trajectory（轨迹）、Answer（答案）三个维度对DeepSearch工作流进行过程级综合评估；并构建DeepSearch RM-Bench，用于在DeepSearch场景下评测奖励模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，F2DR的评估一致性显著高于基于自评估的基线方法；DeepSearch RM-Bench在现有开源奖励模型上展现出较强的判别能力。
AI.conclusion: F2DR与DeepSearch RM-Bench有效弥补了DeepSearch工作流在奖励建模与评测基准方面的空白，作者将很快公开完整的DeepSearch RM-Bench数据集。

title: Recency Forcing: Bridging the Long-Horizon Gap in Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video generation degrades over long horizons due to an overlooked train-inference discrepancy we term KV eviction mismatch: models train on short clips where all context frames reside in the KV cache, but at inference, memory constraints force distant frames to be evicted from the KV cache - removing context the model was conditioned on. Rather than simulating eviction via context truncation - which discards temporal information the model still needs and degrades motion coherence - we keep the context but while progressively reducing the influence of distant frames, making their eventual eviction negligible. To guide this design, we introduce the positional response $R( Δ, \, t_{\text{denoise}})$, a perturbation-based sensitivity measure revealing that context influence decays steeply with temporal distance and varies systematically across denoising steps. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Recency Forcing, which applies a non-positive, timestep-dependent bias, termed Temporal Response Bias (TRB), on pre-softmax attention logits derived directly from $R$, closing the train-inference gap without modifying context length or training objectives. We further introduce Biased Attention Reparameterization (BAR), an exact reformulation that moves the bias outside the softmax, making TRB a standard FlashAttention call at zero overhead. Recency Forcing operates in both training-free mode and training-based mode. Experiments on VBench and VBench-Long demonstrate state-of-the-art long-horizon generation quality at no additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Recency Forcing，通过Timestep-dependent Temporal Response Bias在attention logits上施加非正偏置，弥合KV cache驱逐造成的训练-推理不一致，实现无需额外推理成本的长时序视频生成质量提升。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成在长时序上性能退化，根源是被忽视的训练-推理不一致（KV eviction mismatch）：训练时短片段所有上下文帧都在KV cache中，而推理时受内存限制，远端帧被驱逐，移除了模型曾依赖的上下文。常见的上下文截断模拟驱逐会丢弃模型仍需的时间信息并损害运动连贯性，因此需要一种保留上下文但渐进削弱远端帧影响的方法。
AI.method: 作者首先提出位置响应R(Δ, t_denoise)，即基于扰动的敏感度度量，揭示上下文影响随经验时间距离急剧衰减且随去噪步族系统性变化。据此提出Recency Forcing：在pre-softmax attention logits上施加非正、随timestep变化的偏置（Temporal Response Bias, TRB），偏置直接由R导出，不改变上下文长度或训练目标。进一步提出Biased Attention Reparameterization (BAR)，将偏置移到softmax外部的精确重参数化，使TRB成为标准FlashAttention调用且零开销。方法同时支持training-free与training-based两种模式。
AI.result: 在VBench和VBench-Long上的实验表明，该方法在长时序生成质量上达到state-of-the-art，且不增加额外推理成本。
AI.conclusion: Recency Forcing通过量化上下文影响并施加渐进的、timestep相关的注意力偏置，有效弥合了KV cache驱逐带来的训练-推理差异，在不牺牲效率的前提下提升了自回归视频生成的长时序质量。

title: CoreSense: Traceable Failure Recall and Conflict-Aware Belief Gating for Auditable Robot Decisions
summary: Robots can recall prior failures without knowing whether recalled evidence remains valid, conflicts with current observations, or is sufficient to guide a decision. We present CoreSense, a robot-system integration architecture that combines traceable episodic evidence with a conflict-aware belief gate and bounded, auditable recommendations. The gate checks scope, provenance, time, contradiction, and support before it permits PROCEED, requests re-observation, abstains, or escalates. Evaluation follows three complementary layers without commanding a physical robot: offline public real-robot data, a frozen signal-level simulation, and a live cloud deployment path. On CableTrace-120 and BotFails-200, belief gating reduces protocol-defined unsafe proceeds from 20% and 40% to 0%. A disjointly calibrated raw-video policy also reaches 0% unsafe proceed, but overblocks every nominal episode. On public data, a ViFailback-BotFails visual detector reaches 0.778 AUROC yet remains all-blocking, whereas cycle-disjoint UR3 telemetry for protective stops yields 0% unsafe proceed, 36.1% overblocking, and 61.9% coverage; grip-loss transfer remains a negative result. Controlled physical corroboration yields 3.3%, 0%, and 42.0%, while conflict-aware fusion yields 4.7%, 0%, and 42.8%. Finally, 20/20 cloud recalls validate a CockroachDB Cloud-Amazon Bedrock deployment path. The evidence supports an auditable integration pattern, not autonomous recovery or certified safety.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoreSense 机器人系统集成架构，将可溯源情景证据与冲突感知信念门控结合，实现可审计的有限建议，并在多层级评测中显著降低不安全继续执行率。
AI.motivation: 机器人可召回先前失败经验，但无法判断这些经验是否仍有效、是否与当前观测冲突、或是否足以支撑决策，因此需要一种冲突感知的证据校验与门控机制。
AI.method: CoreSense 架构：将可溯源的情景证据与冲突感知信念门控（检查范围、来源、时间、矛盾与支持度）相结合，输出 PROCEED、请求重新观测、弃权或升级四类有限且可审计的建议；评测分三层：离线公开真实机器人数据、冻结的信号级仿真、以及实时云端部署路径。
AI.result: 在 CableTrace-120 与 BotFails-200 上，信念门控将协议定义的不安全继续执行率从 20% 和 40% 降至 0%；原始视频策略虽也达 0% 但过度阻断全部正常回合。ViFailback-BotFails 视觉检测器 AUROC 达 0.778 但仍全阻断；UR3 遥测保护停机实现 0% 不安全执行、36.1% 过度阻断、61.9% 覆盖率，抓取丢失迁移为负结果。物理验证为 3.3%/0%/42.0%，冲突感知融合为 4.7%/0%/42.8%；20/20 云端召回验证 CockroachDB Cloud-Amazon Bedrock 部署路径可行。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持一种可审计的集成模式，而非自主恢复能力或经认证的安全性。

title: When2Think: Learning Difficulty-Aware Length Control for Efficient Hybrid Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks but exhibit systematic inefficiency: they often overthink easy problems and underthink hard ones. Existing approaches based on uniform length penalties or rigid routing incur an efficiency tax, trading reduced computation on easy instances for accuracy loss on hard instances. We formulate efficient reasoning as an instance-adaptive computation allocation problem and propose When2Think, a post-training framework for hybrid reasoning that dynamically allocates computation based on problem difficulty. Our method introduces Instance-level Difficulty-Aware Control (IDAC), a reward-shaping mechanism that leverages pre-computed reference statistics (accuracy and token usage) to regulate reasoning depth. Combined with verifier-based rewards and batch-wise standardized advantages, IDAC enables stable critic-free optimization without learned reward models or online reference-model queries. When2Think encourages direct answering on easy instances while preserving extended reasoning on hard instances, thereby learning when to use System 1 (NoThink) versus System 2 (Think). Experiments on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: on AIME24, Pass@3 increases by 10.0% while token usage is reduced by 27.9% relative to the base model, and on AIME25, When2Think achieves 40.0% Pass@3, outperforming compression and routing-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出When2Think，将高效推理建模为实例自适应计算分配问题，通过难度感知奖励塑造实现系统1/系统2的动态切换，在数学基准上改善精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型存在系统性低效：对简单问题过度思考、对困难问题思考不足。现有的统一长度惩罚或刚性路由方法会产生"效率税"，即在简单实例上节省的计算量以困难实例的精度损失为代价。
AI.method: 提出When2Think后训练框架，核心是实例级难度感知控制（IDAC）：一种奖励塑造机制，利用预先计算的参考统计量（准确率与token使用量）来调节推理深度；结合基于验证器的奖励和批次标准化优势，实现无需学习奖励模型、无需在线参考模型查询的稳定无评论家优化。由此学习何时使用系统1（NoThink）与系统2（Think）。
AI.result: 在数学基准实验中：AIME24上Pass@3相对基座模型提升10.0%，同时token使用量减少27.9%；AIME25上达到40.0% Pass@3，优于纯压缩和仅路由的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将高效推理表述为实例自适应计算分配问题，并通过难度感知奖励塑造实现该系统，可在不牺牲困难实例精度的前提下显著改善精度-效率权衡。

title: Odds-Ratio Thompson Sampling: A Specification and Design Guide for Contrast-Based Multi-Armed Bandits
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables in the main text; 2 figures and 3 tables in the supplement. Reference implementation at https://github.com/sulgik/orts
summary: Batched multi-armed bandits update on a service's own schedule, and the usual implementation carries each arm's absolute reward rate from one update to the next. When the shared level moves between batches, that memory goes stale even though the comparisons between arms may not have. Odds-Ratio Thompson Sampling (OR-TS) instead carries the joint posterior over log-odds contrasts and fits the common level afresh in every batch, marginalizing it out. This paper specifies that update, places it inside a Bayesian bandit agent with two controls, decay for how much past evidence survives an update and aggressiveness for how sharply belief becomes allocation, and evaluates it against absolute-rate memory. Across 86 public A/B series the level varies about twenty-five times more than the contrast. In prespecified synthetic environments a moving level costs absolute-rate memory five times the regret and leaves the best arm below a majority of traffic in 7 of 20 runs, against none for OR-TS. In a policy simulation built from 71 real experiments, where the contrasts are too small to resolve, expected-click differences stay within 0.1% for 58 of them, yet contrast memory still ends on the better arm more than twice as often. Where the contrasts themselves move, the bet fails, and that case is reported too.

title: Zarya: A Hybrid Autoregressive--Masked Diffusion Language Model with Flexible Training and Dual-Mode Inference
comment: Preprint. Work in progress. Please cite peer-reviewed version when published
summary: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) are constrained by sequential, left-to-right generation, while masked diffusion models (MDMs) enable parallel decoding but suffer from high computational overhead due to the inability to reuse Key-Value (KV) cache and from incoherent generation arising from learning dependencies over an intractable space of token combinations. We introduce Zarya, a family of hybrid language models that jointly optimizes an autoregressive (AR) objective and a masked-diffusion objective within a single architecture. Zarya structures training data into variable-size slots and employs a curriculum that gradually increases slot granularity, enabling a smooth transition from fine-grained AR learning to coarse-grained diffusion learning. At inference, Zarya provides two distinct decoding paradigms through a unified interface: (i) MDM sampling with first-hitting denoising, and (ii) slotted speculative decoding that interleaves inter-slot diffusion-based selection with intra-slot autoregressive infilling, achieving full KV cache reuse. The training and inference regimes are fully decoupled, allowing a model trained with any configuration to be deployed in either mode. Extensive configurability --- including grouped noise patterns (Prefix Completion, Fill-In-the-Prefix, Fill-In-the-Middle), ordered sampling schedules, and noise-level permutation strategies --- enables flexible research exploration. We release Zarya models publicly in sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, demonstrating performance on standard benchmarks while offering a principled integration of autoregressive and diffusion paradigms.

AI.tldr: Zarya 是一种混合语言模型，在单一架构内联合优化自回归与掩码扩散目标，通过可变大小槽位与课程式训练实现两种范式的平滑过渡，并在推理时提供 MDM 采样与槽位投机解码两种模式，兼顾 KV 缓存复用。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型受限于从左到右的顺序生成；掩码扩散模型虽支持并行解码，但因无法复用 KV 缓存导致计算开销高，且在不透明的 token 组合空间上学习依赖关系会造成生成不连贯。论文旨在结合两者优势，在单一架构中兼顾顺序建模质量与并行解码效率。
AI.method: 提出 Zarya 混合语言模型族，在同一架构中联合优化 AR 目标与掩码扩散目标。训练时将数据组织为可变大小的槽位（slots），并采用逐步提升槽位粒度的课程学习，实现从细粒度 AR 学习到粗粒度扩散学习的平滑过渡。推理时通过统一接口提供两种解码范式：(i) 首次命中去噪的 MDM 采样；(ii) 槽位投机解码，将槽间基于扩散的选择与槽内自回归填充交错进行，从而实现完整的 KV 缓存复用。训练与推理机制完全解耦，任意配置训练的模型均可在两种模式下部署。此外支持分组噪声模式（前缀补全、前缀填充、中间填充）、有序采样调度与噪声级置换策略等可配置项。
AI.result: 公开释放了 0.6B、1.7B 和 4B 三种规模的 Zarya 模型，在标准基准上展示了性能表现，并验证了自回归与扩散范式的原则性融合。
AI.conclusion: Zarya 通过联合训练目标、槽位课程学习与解耦的推理机制，为自回归与掩码扩散范式的整合提供了有原则的方案，在保持 KV 缓存复用的同时兼顾生成质量与并行效率，并为后续研究提供了灵活的可配置探索空间。

title: Federated Learning Framework for Privacy-Preserving Kidney Stone Detection
summary: Recent innovations in deep learning have significantly enhanced the diagnosis of medical images, although they are based on the use of centralized data storage that pose severe threats to patient privacy and medical data security. To address this issue, this research proposes a Federated Learning (FL) model that is coupled with an optimized YOLOv8 network to detect the kidney stones on a computed tomography (CT) image and at the same time, protect privacy of the patients. The suggested system can help various medical organizations to jointly train a common model without exchanging the information about the patients. This is to ensure that data protection laws like GDPR and HIPAA are adhered to. The residual feature fusion and DropBlock regularization among other architectural improvements are also included in YOLOv8 to enhance detection robustness and minimize overfitting. Experimental analysis carried out on a distributed CT dataset demonstrated that the federated YOLOv8 model has a mAP at 50 of 0.733 and is able to keep the data confidential. Moreover, its lean design facilitates fast edge deployment and real-time inference across a clinical setting. Altogether, these findings indicate that Federated Learning is a safe and efficient solution to AI-assisted diagnosis in contemporary healthcare when combined with the use of sophisticated object detection models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种结合优化YOLOv8网络的联邦学习模型，用于在CT图像中检测肾结石，在不共享患者数据的前提下实现多机构联合训练，实验mAP@50达0.733。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在医学影像诊断中表现优异，但依赖集中式数据存储，对患者隐私与医疗数据安全构成严重威胁；同时需满足GDPR、HIPAA等数据保护法规。
AI.method: 构建联邦学习框架，使多家医疗机构在不交换患者信息的情况下协同训练统一模型；在YOLOv8中引入残差特征融合（residual feature fusion）与DropBlock正则化等架构改进，以提升检测鲁棒性并抑制过拟合。
AI.result: 在分布式CT数据集上，联邦YOLOv8模型的mAP@50为0.733，并保持数据机密性；模型结构轻量，支持快速边缘部署与临床场景下的实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习与先进目标检测模型相结合，是当代医疗AI辅助诊断中安全且高效的解决方案。

title: AURORA: A Natural Language-Driven Agentic Framework for Understanding, Reasoning, and Orchestrating Reliable Air-Ground Co-Simulation
summary: Air-ground transportation research increasingly relies on co-simulation, yet constructing scenarios remains labor-intensive and difficult to validate. More importantly, a generated scenario may execute successfully while failing to realize the spatial, temporal, communication, or behavioral relationships requested by the user. This paper presents AURORA, a natural-language-driven agentic framework that treats air-ground scenario generation as a process of compilation with verification. Central to AURORA is the Air-Ground Scenario Graph (AGSG), a typed intermediate representation that explicitly connects agents, aerial missions, events, communication links, success conditions, and their cross-domain dependencies. This shared representation enables simulator-grounded parsing, joint road-airspace grounding, temporal planning, pre-execution feasibility checking, trace-based runtime verification, failure localization, and bounded repair within a unified workflow. We further introduce AURORA-Bench to evaluate not only whether generated scenarios execute, but whether they faithfully realize the requested interactions. Experiments across multiple language models show that structured execution substantially improves reliability, while runtime verification exposes silent failures that completion-based evaluation overlooks. Localized repair further resolves many violations without regenerating the entire scenario. The results show that reliable scenario generation requires verifying realized behavior, not merely executable code, and demonstrate the value of explicit intermediate representations for verifiable and repairable language-driven co-simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AURORA，一个自然语言驱动的智能体框架，将空地协同仿真场景生成视为"带验证的编译"过程，核心是类型化中间表示AGSG，并配套AURORA-Bench评估场景是否忠实实现用户请求的交互关系。
AI.motivation: 空地交通研究日益依赖联合仿真，但场景构建人工成本高且难以验证。更关键的是，生成的场景可能"可执行却错误"——即运行成功但未实现用户要求的时间、空间、通信或行为关系，现有基于完成度的评估无法发现这类静默失败。
AI.method: 提出AURORA框架，将空地场景生成建模为"带验证的编译"流程。其核心是Air-Ground Scenario Graph (AGSG)，一种类型化中间表示，显式连接智能体、空中任务、事件、通信链路、成功条件及其跨域依赖。基于该共享表示，统一实现仿真器支撑的解析、道路-空域联合接地、时间规划、执行前可行性检查、基于轨迹的运行时验证、失败定位与有界修复。
AI.result: 在多种语言模型上的实验表明：结构化执行显著提升可靠性；运行时验证揭示了基于完成度评估所忽视的静默失败；局部化修复可在不重新生成整个场景的情况下解决大量违规。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的场景生成需要验证"实际实现的行为"而非仅验证"可执行代码"；显式中间表示对可验证、可修复的语言驱动联合仿真具有重要价值。

title: JustMem: Just-Enough Memory Access for Long-Term Conversations
summary: Efficient long-term conversational memory requires retrieving sufficient evidence without indiscriminately expanding the context presented to the language model. This is challenging because relevant evidence may be distributed across multiple sessions, while compression may discard details needed for answering. Different queries therefore require different forms of memory access. To capture these demands, we formulate memory access along two dimensions: discovery breadth, which controls how broadly evidence is searched, and reading fidelity, which controls whether evidence is read in compact form or recovered from the original conversation. Based on this formulation, we introduce JustMem, which stores conversation history as compact atomic memories and adapts memory access along these two dimensions to each query. Specifically, LOOKUP handles local evidence, COMPOSE broadens discovery for distributed evidence, and REPLAY increases reading fidelity for fidelity-sensitive evidence. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, JustMem achieves the highest mean accuracy and retrieval recall among the compared memory systems while using substantially fewer generative-model tokens for memory construction and inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JustMem，将长期对话记忆访问形式化为“发现广度”与“读取保真度”两个维度，并据此自适应地选择LOOKUP、COMPOSE、REPLAY三种记忆访问方式。在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上，JustMem在平均准确率和检索召回率上均优于对比记忆系统，同时显著减少生成模型token消耗。
AI.motivation: 有效的长期对话记忆需要在避免无差别扩展上下文的前提下检索到足够证据，但相关证据可能分散于多个会话，压缩又可能丢失回答所需的细节，且不同查询对记忆访问方式的需求不同。因此需要一个能按查询需求自适应控制检索广度与读取保真度的记忆机制。
AI.method: 作者将记忆访问刻画为两个维度：发现广度（控制证据搜索范围）与读取保真度（控制以压缩形式读取证据还是从原始对话中恢复证据）。在此基础上提出JustMem，将对话历史存储为紧凑的原子记忆，并针对每个查询沿上述两维度自适应调整访问：LOOKUP处理局部证据，COMPOSE扩大发现范围以应对分布式证据，REPLAY提升对保真度敏感证据的读取保真度。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上，JustMem在参与比较的记忆系统中取得了最高的平均准确率与检索召回率，同时在记忆构建与推理阶段消耗的生成模型token显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 以“发现广度”和“读取保真度”两维度形式化记忆访问，并据此对查询自适应地选择LOOKUP、COMPOSE、REPLAY策略，能够在提升长期对话记忆检索与回答效果的同时降低生成模型token开销，说明按需分配记忆访问形式是有效且高效的方案。

title: Region-Level Policy Optimization for Fine-grained MLLM Perception
summary: Fine-grained visual perception in MLLMs is commonly improved by raising the resolution, but the added visual tokens inflate vision-encoding and language-model prefilling costs. We show that the two operations underlying fine-grained perception, localizing the region of interest (RoI) and recognizing its content, have different resolution requirements. In a controlled diagnostic, localization tolerates roughly 3 to 4 times stronger token compression than recognition, which motivates localizing from a coarse view and concentrating resolution on the selected evidence. Decoding coordinates with the MLLM can be trained end-to-end from answers, but costs a full model pass per query and depends on grounding ability. A lightweight proposal network distilled from the model's attention is fast, but inherits the noise of its attention targets. The RoI from the proposal network reaches the answer through a discrete region choice, so its faithfulness to the answer cannot supervise the network. We therefore optimize the proposal network with region-level reinforcement learning, which we call Vision-RL2. It treats coherent regions as actions, and a frozen MLLM reader scores each one by how its removal changes the answer likelihood. Complementary subtractive and additive objectives suppress distracting proposals and recover missing evidence, updating only the predictor without region annotations, response sampling, or reasoning trajectories. The refined proposal further enables a sparse encoding that magnifies evidence and excludes background tokens. Across six fine-grained benchmarks and four MLLM backbones, Vision-RL2 improves accuracy over the base model at every token budget and surpasses its largest-budget accuracy with about 4 times fewer visual tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/YuHengsss/VisionRL2 .

AI.tldr: 视觉细粒度感知中定位与识别对分辨率需求不同：定位可承受约3-4倍更强压缩，故提出Vision-RL2，用区域级强化学习优化轻量提议网络，实现粗视图定位+分辨率集中于证据，仅更新预测器，无需区域标注，在六基准四骨干上全面超越基线且约4倍更少token达到最大预算精度。
AI.motivation: 提升MLLM细粒度视觉感知通常靠提高分辨率，但会增加视觉token带来的视觉编码与语言模型预填充开销。作者发现细粒度感知的两个子操作——定位感兴趣区域（RoI）与识别其内容——对分辨率需求不同，且现有定位方式存在缺陷：直接用MLLM解码坐标需每查询全模型前向且依赖grounding能力；从注意力蒸馏的轻量提议网络虽快但继承注意力噪声；且离散区域选择使答案无法监督提议网络。
AI.method: 在对照诊断中证明定位可承受约3-4倍于识别的token压缩，据此采用"粗视图定位、分辨率集中于所选证据"的策略。提出Vision-RL2：将连贯区域视为动作，用冻结的MLLM reader根据移除该区域对答案似然的影响打分，通过区域级强化学习优化提议网络；采用互补的减法与加法目标分别抑制干扰提议与找回缺失证据，仅更新预测器，无需区域标注、响应采样或推理轨迹。
AI.result: 精炼后的提议进一步支持稀疏编码，放大证据并排除背景token。在六个细粒度基准与四个MLLM骨干上，Vision-RL2在每个token预算下均提升准确率，并以约4倍更少的视觉token超越基线最大预算时的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分定位与识别的分辨率需求并用区域级强化学习训练轻量提议网络，Vision-RL2在无需区域标注与额外采样的条件下显著提升MLLM细粒度感知效率与精度。代码已开源。

title: SLAMSqueezeBench: Comparing SLAM Systems under Resource Constraints
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is one of the services running on an autonomous robot. It is typically run to assist other tasks such as planning, manipulation, etc. All these tasks are run on edge hardware and are subject to severe resource constraints. However, most SLAM systems are built and tested in isolation, and their performance is reported as if they are the only task running on a system. We observe that existing benchmarks lack a common mechanism for comparing SLAM systems under realistic resource constraints. To address this limitation, we have developed SLAMSqueezeBench, a framework that allows testing of SLAM systems under realistic workloads on edge hardware. It does so by imposing constraints on compute and memory resources available for the SLAM system during execution. It also simulates realistic camera frame acquisition with frame drops when a finite buffer is full. Using SLAMSqueezeBench, we compare nine SLAM systems spanning classical systems, learning-based systems, and approaches for Gaussian splatting. Our testing framework will be available for use by the community upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SLAMSqueezeBench框架，用于在边缘硬件上以资源约束（计算、内存、丢帧）测试SLAM系统，并对比了九种SLAM系统。
AI.motivation: 现有SLAM系统大多孤立构建和测试，性能报告仿佛其是系统上唯一运行的任务，缺乏在真实资源约束下比较SLAM系统的通用机制。
AI.method: 开发SLAMSqueezeBench，在SLAM执行期间施加计算与内存资源约束，并通过有限缓冲区满时丢帧来模拟真实相机帧采集；据此对九种SLAM系统进行对比。
AI.result: 对九种SLAM系统进行了对比，涵盖经典方法、基于学习的方法以及高斯泼溅（Gaussian splatting）方法。
AI.conclusion: SLAMSqueezeBench为社区提供了在现实资源约束下比较SLAM系统的通用框架，将在论文发表后开放使用。

title: LearnActCoder: Role-Aware Error Memory for Adaptive Clinical Coding Agents
summary: Clinical coding agents repeatedly encounter the same failure modes, including unsupported codes, missed documented conditions, specificity errors, and procedure-coding convention mismatches. We introduce Learn-Then-Act, an inference-time adaptation framework that converts errors from a small labeled LEARN batch into a structured Mistake Knowledge Database (MistakeKDB). False-negative lessons are routed to a recall-oriented Coder, while false-positive lessons are routed to a precision-oriented Judge. We instantiate the framework in LearnActCoder, a Coder-Judge clinical coding pipeline with lookup-table grounding where available. On 150 matched MIMIC-III notes, structured MistakeKDB improves CPT F1 by 5.9 percentage points, while raw-example and reflection-style memories remain near the no-memory baseline; the ICD-9 improvement is not significant. On a matched MIMIC-IV cohort, memory shifts ICD-10 coding toward higher precision at a recall cost, leaving F1 statistically unchanged. Applying the same memory to 1,000 held-out MIMIC-III notes maintains a stable ICD operating point, providing scale/stability evidence. Overall, the results are consistent with structured, feedback-derived error memory being useful for adapting clinical coding behavior across cases without weight updates or changes to the underlying workflow. Absolute CPT/HCPCS performance remains low, and the system is evaluated retrospectively rather than in clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出推理期自适应框架 Learn-Then-Act，将少量标注样本的错误转为结构化错误知识库（MistakeKDB），并按错误类型分别路由给侧重召回的 Coder 与侧重精确率的 Judge；在 LearnActCoder 上验证其在临床编码任务中的效果。
AI.motivation: 临床编码智能体反复出现同类失败模式（不支持的编码、漏编已记录病症、特异性错误、操作编码惯例不匹配），需要一种无需更新权重、不改变原有工作流的自适应方式来纠正这些系统性错误。
AI.method: Learn-Then-Act 为推理期自适应框架：用小型标注 LEARN 批次中的错误构建结构化 Mistake Knowledge Database；假阴性经验路由至召回导向的 Coder，假阳性经验路由至精确率导向的 Judge。实例化为 LearnActCoder（Coder-Judge 流水线，条件允许时使用查找表 grounding），并与原始样例记忆、反思式记忆及无记忆基线对比。
AI.result: 在 150 条匹配的 MIMIC-III 病历上，结构化 MistakeKDB 使 CPT F1 提升 5.9 个百分点，而原始样例与反思式记忆接近无记忆基线；ICD-9 提升不显著。在匹配的 MIMIC-IV 队列上，记忆使 ICD-10 编码偏向更高精确率但召回下降，F1 统计上无变化。将同一记忆应用于 1,000 条留出 MIMIC-III 病历，ICD 工作点保持稳定，提供规模/稳定性证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持结构化、由反馈导出的错误记忆可在不更新权重、不改变底层工作流的情况下跨病例适配临床编码行为。局限在于 CPT/HCPCS 绝对性能仍偏低，且为回顾性评估而非临床部署。

title: Alliance Beats Isolation: Unifying Heterogeneous Allied Datasets Improves Classifier Performance
summary: In many application domains, such as student dropout, insurance fraud, loan approval, and machine failures, several labelled public datasets are available where (i) data is about the same type of objects but the set of actual underlying objects are disjoint; and (ii) the class labels are same; and (iii) the feature spaces of the datasets are largely distinct (heterogeneous), with a few shared features. We call such datasets as allied. A single classifier cannot be trained on both datasets together, and one classifier trained on one dataset cannot be tested on the other. In this paper, we propose a method to merge the feature-spaces into a single feature-space for a pair of given allied heterogeneous datasets. We then use a matrix completion method to create a unified dataset based on the merged feature-space. The hypothesis is that the merged representation facilitates the transfer of classification knowledge from one dataset to another. We conduct experiments on several pairs of allied, heterogeneous datasets and several classifiers to demonstrate that any classifier trained on the unified representation always outperforms classifiers separately trained on the constituent allied datasets on several pairs of allied datasets. This work provides an easy way to substantially improve classifier performance by unifying and using multiple allied datasets together.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"联盟数据集"（同一对象类型、标签一致、特征空间异构且仅有少量共享特征的多个数据集）提出一种特征空间合并方法，并用矩阵补全构建统一数据集，从而在数据集间迁移分类知识，使分类器性能显著优于分别在单个数据集上训练的结果。
AI.motivation: 许多应用领域（如学生辍学、保险欺诈、贷款审批、机器故障）存在多个公开标注数据集，它们描述同一类对象、标签相同，但底层对象互不重叠，且特征空间大部分不同（异构），仅有少量共享特征，这类数据集称为"联盟数据集"。由于特征空间不一致，单一分类器无法在两个数据集上联合训练，也无法跨数据集测试，导致数据资源难以整合利用。
AI.method: 1) 针对一对联盟异构数据集，提出将两个特征空间合并为单一特征空间的方法；2) 基于合并后的特征空间，采用矩阵补全方法构造统一数据集；3) 核心假设是合并表示能够促进分类知识从一个数据集向另一个数据集迁移；4) 在若干对联盟异构数据集上，使用多种分类器进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在若干对联盟异构数据集上，使用多种分类器的实验表明：在统一表示上训练的分类器，其性能始终优于分别在各个联盟数据集上单独训练的分类器。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种简便途径，通过统一并联合使用多个联盟数据集，显著提升分类器性能。

title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
comment: Paper is accepted in IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings. Spoken question answering (SQA) benchmark for Telugu remains unexplored, and the reliability of automatic evaluation in this setting remains unquantified. We introduce VākQA, a Telugu SQA benchmark of 2,001 factoid question-answer pairs across six domains, with 2.53 hours of speech audio, bilingual transcriptions, and human-verified reference answers.
