We first validate evaluation methods against human judgements: Gemini-as-a-judge best approximates human ratings but is non-uniformly strict, while open-weight judges systematically penalize correct Telugu answers that differ in surface form from the reference. Using this validated setup, we benchmark proprietary and open-weight models across input modality, language, and domain. We observe that Telugu phrasing retains cultural specificity that is lost in translation, speech input introduces phonetic confusions that alter question meaning, and cascaded ASR-MT errors compound progressively. VākQA is publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VākQA，一个泰卢固语口语问答（SQA）基准，含 2,001 个事实型问答对、2.53 小时语音及双语转写，并验证了自动评测的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推动问答进步，但主要集中在高资源语言；泰卢固语的 SQA 基准尚属空白，且该场景下自动评测的可靠性未被量化。
AI.method: 构建 VākQA 基准（六领域、2,001 事实型问答对、2.53 小时语音、双语转写、人工核验参考答案）；以人工评分为参照验证评测方法；在该设置下对专有与开源模型按输入模态、语言、领域进行基准测试。
AI.result: Gemini-as-a-judge 最接近人工评分但严格程度不均；开源评测模型会系统性惩罚表面形式与参考不同但正确的泰卢固语答案。泰卢固语表述保留翻译中丢失的文化特异性；语音输入引入改变问题含义的语音混淆；级联 ASR-MT 错误逐步累积。
AI.conclusion: VākQA 填补泰卢固语 SQA 基准空白并量化自动评测可靠性，已公开释放。

title: STAR: Structure-aware Test-time Adaptation for diffusion-based light field Reconstruction
summary: Light field (LF) reconstruction from limited and noisy focal stack (FS) measurements is a highly ill-posed inverse problem. Although the LF-to-FS imaging geometry is fixed for a given optical setup, LF spatial-angular structure---including within-view spatial details, cross-view angular dependencies, and disparity across views---varies across scenes. Consequently, a fixed pre-trained prior may not optimally capture the spatial-angular structure of each test LF. We propose Structure-aware Test-time Adaptation for diffusion-based light field Reconstruction (STAR), the first test-time adaptation framework for reconstructing an LF from FS. For each test LF, STAR freezes a pre-trained diffusion prior and fits three lightweight adapters to the observed FS to jointly adapt the three components of the LF's spatial-angular structure. STAR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both two- and three-focal-sheet settings, with shorter inference times than those with test-time parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向光场重建的测试时自适应框架STAR，通过为每个测试光场冻结预训练扩散先验并拟合三个轻量适配器，联合适配光场空间-角度结构，在双焦面和三焦面设置下均超越现有最优方法，且推理时间更短。
AI.motivation: 从有限且带噪的焦栈测量重建光场是高度病态的逆问题。尽管对给定光学装置而言光场-焦栈成像几何固定，但光场的空间-角度结构（视图内空间细节、跨视图角度依赖、跨视图视差）因场景而异，因此单一固定的预训练先验可能无法最优地捕捉每个测试光场的空间-角度结构。
AI.method: 提出STAR框架：对每个测试光场，冻结预训练的扩散先验，并针对观测到的焦栈拟合三个轻量适配器，以联合适配光场空间-角度结构的三个组成部分。
AI.result: 在双焦面和三焦面两种设置下，STAR均优于现有最先进方法，且相比带有测试时参数更新的方法具有更短的推理时间。
AI.conclusion: STAR是首个用于从焦栈重建光场的测试时自适应框架，通过结构感知的轻量适配器在保持高效推理的同时提升了重建性能。

title: Navigate or Relocate? Planning Among Movable Obstacles in Unknown Environments
summary: Conventional robot planning methods seek collision-free paths to a goal but fail when all paths are blocked. In these cases, the robot must determine which objects to relocate, in what order, and where to place them to clear a path---a problem known as Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO). Most NAMO planners assume a known environment, while existing approaches for unknown environments typically reason locally about relocations and cannot plan interdependent relocation sequences. We consider NAMO in unknown environments revealed through onboard sensing, where the robot must decide whether a blocked route requires relocation or a feasible path may exist through unexplored space. We propose an online framework that addresses this ambiguity by selecting between navigation and relocation using shortest paths that treat discovered movable objects as obstacles or as removable. Navigation relies on existing motion planners, while relocation uses a sampling-based approach that, unlike existing approaches for unknown environments, searches over \textit{interdependent} relocation sequences and uses an LLM to bias sampling. Numerical experiments demonstrate scalability to cluttered environments requiring interdependent relocations and improved plan quality over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出在线NAMO框架，在未知环境中通过比较“可移动物体视为障碍/可移除”的最短路径，决定导航还是搬迁，并用LLM偏置的采样方法搜索相互依赖的搬迁序列。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人规划在目标路径全被阻塞时失效，此时需决定搬哪些物体、按什么顺序搬、搬到哪，即NAMO问题。现有NAMO规划器多假设环境已知；面向未知环境的方法通常只做局部搬迁推理，无法规划相互依赖的搬迁序列。此外，在未知环境中存在歧义：被阻塞路线究竟需要搬迁，还是通过未探索空间仍存在可行路径。
AI.method: 提出一个在线框架解决上述歧义：利用分别将已发现可移动物体视为障碍、视为可移除的两类最短路径，在导航与搬迁之间进行选择。导航复用现有运动规划器；搬迁采用基于采样的方法，该方法不同于既有未知环境方法，能够搜索相互依赖的搬迁序列，并利用LLM对采样进行偏置。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法可扩展到需要相互依赖搬迁的杂乱环境，并且相比现有基线提升了规划质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将NAMO扩展到未知环境，通过导航/搬迁的在线决策与LLM引导的采样搜索相互依赖搬迁序列，在杂乱场景中实现更好的可扩展性与规划质量。

title: AutoData: Agentic Search for Pre-training Data Selection
summary: LLM agents have recently shown promise in automating machine learning engineering by editing model and training code under execution feedback. Data, however, remains largely outside this agentic optimisation loop. We frame pre-training data selection as heuristic engineering over per-document features, i.e., lexical statistics, categorical labels, and perplexity. We introduce AutoData, an agent that searches directly over executable selection algorithms. Unlike prior data mixture methods that optimise weights over a fixed set of domains, AutoData searches a richer program space of scoring, stratification, and stochastic selection rules, discovering feature interactions automatically by iteratively refining algorithms with validation feedback from a proxy model. Within an overnight search, AutoData discovers a selection algorithm that outperforms existing human-designed curation pipelines. Despite being searched only on this small proxy, the discovered recipe transfers to larger scales and improves the downstream metric CORE. These results suggest that data engineering can be treated as an agentic machine learning problem, extending autonomous research from model and training-code optimization to the data.

AI.tldr: AutoData 将预训练数据选择建模为可执行算法的智能体搜索问题，自动发现优于人工设计的数据筛选策略。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体已能通过执行反馈自动编辑模型与训练代码，但数据仍处于智能体优化循环之外。已有数据配比方法仅优化固定域集合上的权重，搜索空间受限，无法自动挖掘特征交互与更丰富的选择规则。
AI.method: 将预训练数据选择定义为基于单文档特征（词法统计、类别标签、困惑度）的启发式工程，提出 AutoData 智能体，直接在可执行的选择算法程序空间上搜索，该空间涵盖评分、分层与随机选择规则；通过代理模型提供的验证反馈迭代精炼算法，自动发现特征交互。
AI.result: 在一次夜间搜索内，AutoData 发现的筛选算法优于现有人工设计的数据管理流水线；尽管仅在小规模代理模型上搜索，所获配方仍可迁移到更大规模，并提升下游 CORE 指标。
AI.conclusion: 数据工程可被视为一种智能体式机器学习问题，从而将自主研究从模型与训练代码优化扩展到数据层面。

title: OceanMoE: Structured Conditional Sparse Computation for Long-Horizon Multivariate Ocean Forecasting
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Yishun Zhu and Jian Wang contributed equally to this research
summary: Multivariate ocean forecasting must exploit shared evolution in a coupled ocean system while adapting to the heterogeneous statistical and dynamical characteristics of different prediction variables and locations. Fully shared models may lack the flexibility to handle this heterogeneity, whereas fully independent models discard the common ocean context shared across variables. The key question is how to retain shared context in a unified model while allowing computation to specialize according to the prediction target and local state. We propose OceanMoE, a structured conditional sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework that combines sharing and specialization for multivariate ocean forecasting. OceanMoE fuses cross-variable information to construct target-specific local representations and uses them to perform content-conditioned sparse routing at each spatial location, with the number of active experts adapted to router confidence. In the decoder, routing is augmented with a learned geographic bias parameterized by spherical-harmonic spatial bases, while shared residual and seasonal pathways provide common cross-variable and month-dependent context. Experiments on long-horizon autoregressive ORAS5 forecasting show that OceanMoE lowers aggregate forecasting error in both evaluated settings and maintains lower geometric-mean normalized RMSE than the corresponding baselines over most later rollout months. Routing analyses further show that expert allocation varies with prediction targets and spatial locations. These results support structured conditional computation as a modeling strategy for balancing shared ocean context with adaptive specialization.

AI.tldr: 提出OceanMoE，一种结构化条件稀疏专家混合框架，通过内容条件路由与地理偏置实现多变量海洋预测中共享与特化的平衡。
AI.motivation: 多变量海洋预测需同时利用耦合海洋系统的共享演化信息，并适应不同预测变量与空间位置在统计和动力特征上的异质性。完全共享模型缺乏处理异质性的灵活性，完全独立模型则丢失跨变量共享的海洋背景，因此核心问题是如何在统一模型中保留共享上下文并允许计算按预测目标和局部状态特化。
AI.method: OceanMoE融合跨变量信息构建目标特定的局部表示，在每个空间位置进行内容条件稀疏路由，活跃专家数量随路由器置信度自适应调整；解码器中路由通过球谐空间基参数化的可学习地理偏置增强，并设置共享残差与季节通路提供跨变量与月份相关的公共上下文。
AI.result: 在长时程自回归ORAS5预测实验中，OceanMoE在两种评估设置下均降低总体预测误差，并在大多数后期滚动月份保持低于对应基线的几何平均归一化RMSE；路由分析显示专家分配随预测目标和空间位置变化。
AI.conclusion: 结构化条件计算可作为平衡共享海洋上下文与自适应特化的有效建模策略。

title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
summary: The KV cache has become a major bottleneck in deploying LLMs, as its memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and batch size, imposing substantial pressure on both memory capacity and bandwidth. Among various KV cache compression techniques, quantization is particularly attractive due to its effectiveness and ease of deployment. However, most existing methods rely on fixed-width quantization, where a $b$ bit representation is inherently limited to $2^b$ quantization levels. As the bit width decreases, the number of available levels shrinks exponentially, leading to severe information loss and rapid performance degradation. We further observe that fixed-width quantization fails to exploit the highly non-uniform distribution of KV cache. After rotation and normalization, KV values approximately follow a normal distribution, with most values concentrated near the center and only a small fraction appearing in the tails. Nevertheless, fixed-width coding allocates the same number of bits to frequent and rare symbols. Entropy coding naturally exploits such non-uniformity by assigning shorter codewords to frequent symbols and longer ones to rare symbols, substantially reducing the average number of bits required for representation. However, its variable-length output is not suited to highly parallel attention kernels, where efficient dequantization and computation rely on regular memory layouts and fixed-stride accesses. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{D-Quant}, a flexible KV cache quantization framework that introduces a \textbf{drift} mechanism to convert entropy-coded representations of each token into fixed-size bitstreams, enabling regular memory access and parallel dequantization within attention kernels.

AI.tldr: 提出 D-Quant，一种通过"漂移"机制将熵编码的变长表示转换为定长比特流的 KV cache 量化框架，兼顾熵编码的高压缩率与注意力核的规则访存需求。
AI.motivation: KV cache 显存占用随序列长度和批量线性增长，成为 LLM 部署瓶颈。量化虽有效，但现有定宽量化在低比特下仅有 2^b 个量化级，且无法利用 KV 值近似正态分布的高度非均匀性，导致性能急剧下降。熵编码可利用该非均匀性降低平均比特数，但其变长输出与高并行注意力核所需的规则内存布局和定长步长访存不兼容。
AI.method: 提出 D-Quant 框架。观察到经旋转与归一化后 KV 值近似服从正态分布，多数值集中于中心、少数位于尾部。框架引入 drift（漂移）机制，将每个 token 的熵编码表示转换为固定大小的比特流，从而实现规则内存访问与注意力核内的并行反量化。
AI.result: 摘要中未给出具体实验数据；所述结果为通过 drift 机制在保持熵编码压缩收益的同时实现定长比特流表示，支持并行反量化。
AI.conclusion: D-Quant 弥合了熵编码高压缩率与注意力核并行计算需求之间的鸿沟，为 KV cache 量化提供了兼顾压缩效率与部署可行性的新思路。

title: Benchmarking MLLMs via Cognitive Expected Scene Graph for Safety-Critical Visual Negation Understanding
summary: True machine intelligence requires transcending passive pixel registration to master top-down functional reasoning over absent information via visual negation understanding. However, unconstrained visual negation paradigms remain overly open-ended, and pervasive affirmation bias causes both existing Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and evaluation metrics to fail under negative semantics. To solve these intertwined challenges systematically, we first anchor the boundaries of negation reasoning within specific cognitive goals. Specifically, by focusing on safety as a highly pragmatic and critical cognitive dimension, we define the task of \textbf{S}cene \textbf{N}egation \textbf{U}nderstanding under \textbf{S}afety Cognition (\textbf{SNUS}). Under this framework, we construct a high-fidelity negative caption dataset mapping dense assertions of localized hazards. Concurrently, we propose the Cognitive Expected Scene Graph (CESG) Score, a structure-grounded, polarity-aware evaluation metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current models struggle on the task, traditional metrics completely collapse under semantic reversals. Conversely, our framework delivers a solid benchmark for SNUS, providing a rigorous foundation to advance risk-aware situational comprehension and counterfactual cognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SNUS任务（安全认知下的场景否定理解）及CESG Score评估指标，并构建高保真否定描述数据集，系统刻画多模态大模型的否定推理能力。
AI.motivation: 真正的机器智能需要超越被动的像素登记，掌握对缺失信息的自上而下功能推理，即视觉否定理解。但当前无约束的视觉否定范式过于开放，且普遍存在的肯定偏置（affirmation bias）使现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与评估指标在否定语义下均失效。作者旨在系统性地解决这些交织的挑战，将否定推理边界锚定在具体认知目标上。
AI.method: 以安全作为高度实用且关键的认知维度，定义"安全认知下的场景否定理解"（SNUS）任务；在此框架下构建一个高保真否定描述数据集，映射局部危险的稠密断言；同时提出认知期望场景图（CESG）Score——一种基于结构、具有极性感知能力的评估指标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明：当前模型在该任务上表现挣扎，而传统指标在语义反转情况下完全崩溃；相反，所提框架为SNUS提供了坚实的基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为推进风险感知的情境理解与反事实认知提供了严格基础，并为SNUS建立了系统化基准。

title: VABench: Measuring Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Visual Demonstrations, Active Perception, and Metric Control
summary: Spatial intelligence requires more than describing object locations. Under incomplete observation, models must identify and acquire missing evidence, interpret it in a common spatial frame, and act on it. We introduce VA-Bench to evaluate the complete observe-reason-act-revise loop. General-purpose MLLMs learn procedural context from RGB-only demonstrations, actively select camera viewpoints, issue metric Cartesian commands, and revise them from execution feedback. Models receive no privileged object poses, oracle trajectories, or learned action heads. A fixed model-agnostic controller executes only model-specified targets. VA-Bench contains 14 base task families (11 single-arm and three dual-arm), seven held-out geometry/layout variants, and a long-horizon five-object composition track. We evaluate 12 primary model conditions in three independent runs over the same 20 physically verified seeds per base task, reporting terminal success, nine trajectory-level behavioral diagnostics, and subtask progress. First, the best-performing model scores 100.0% on target localization and 78.9% on spatial relations in the annotated run. Its three-run macro-average task success is only 53.93+/-3.17%. Second, active camera control significantly improves task success over passive multi-view observation. In one matched comparison, success rises from 27.86% to 57.50%. Third, held-out geometric transfer can reduce task success by over 30 percentage points. No model completes a strict long-horizon episode, despite substantial partial progress. VA-Bench thus tests whether general-purpose MLLMs can turn visual demonstrations and actively acquired evidence into successful embodied action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VA-Bench 基准，用于评估通用多模态大模型在"观察-推理-行动-修正"完整闭环中的空间智能，涵盖14类基础任务、7种留出几何变体与五物体长时程组合任务，并报告了12种模型条件下的成功率与轨迹级诊断结果。
AI.motivation: 现有空间智能评测多停留在描述物体位置层面。在观测不完整的情况下，模型需要主动识别并获取缺失证据、在统一空间坐标系中解读证据并据此行动。作者认为缺少能够评测完整闭环（观察-推理-行动-修正）的基准，且现有评测往往给予模型特权信息（如真实物体位姿、专家轨迹、学习好的动作头）。
AI.method: 构建 VA-Bench：模型仅从 RGB 演示中学习程序性上下文，主动选择相机视角，发出度量制笛卡尔指令，并依据执行反馈修正指令。模型不获得特权物体位姿、专家轨迹或学习好的动作头；由固定的、与模型无关的控制器仅执行模型指定的目标。基准包含 14 类基础任务（11 个单臂、3 个双臂）、7 个留出的几何/布局变体，以及一个长时程五物体组合赛道。对 12 种主要模型条件在每类基础任务相同的 20 个物理验证种子上进行三次独立运行，报告最终成功率、九项轨迹级行为诊断指标和子任务进度。
AI.result: 第一，表现最好的模型在标注运行中目标定位得分 100.0%、空间关系得分 78.9%，但其三次运行的宏平均任务成功率仅为 53.93±3.17%。第二，主动相机控制相较被动多视角观察显著提升任务成功率：在某一配对比较中，成功率从 27.86% 升至 57.50%。第三，留出几何迁移可使任务成功率下降超过 30 个百分点。第四，没有任何模型能完成严格的长时程回合，尽管存在大量部分进展。
AI.conclusion: VA-Bench 用于检验通用多模态大模型能否将视觉演示与主动获取的证据转化为成功的具身行动。结果显示，尽管模型在定位与部分空间关系上表现良好，但在完整闭环、主动感知利用、几何泛化以及长时程组合方面仍存在显著差距，表明以描述为中心的能力并不等同于可执行的空间智能。

title: Rethinking Multi-Agent Collaboration: When More Is Less
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models and single-agent harnesses has reshaped the landscape of autonomous systems, raising a critical question of when multi-agent collaboration offers genuine value. As individual agent capabilities continue to scale, multi-agent collaboration faces diminishing returns while incurring growing context overhead. Through systematic analysis, we delineate the capability boundaries of multi-agent collaboration relative to single-agent alternatives, showing that it confers systematic benefits specifically in long-horizon tasks with sparse dependencies, while single-agent harnesses remain superior in tightly coupled, sequential workflows. Building on these insights, we propose SAIGE, a lightweight multi-agent collaboration mechanism based on Semantic-Aware Incremental Graph Evolution. SAIGE models collaboration as a dynamically evolving graph, where nodes are agent instances spawned on demand and edges encode semantic dependencies established through content-based information retrieval. Experiments on long-horizon, complex task benchmarks show that SAIGE achieves a favorable trade-off between context efficiency and task performance, and that scaling the agent pool or deepening the recursion level does not consistently improve outcomes. Our findings suggest that multi-agent superiority is bounded by task structure rather than universal, and that more agents do not necessarily make a system more intelligent.

AI.tldr: 本文界定多智能体协作的能力边界，提出基于语义感知增量图演化的轻量协作机制 SAIGE，并验证其效率与性能的权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型与单智能体框架能力快速提升，多智能体协作的边际收益递减且上下文开销上升，亟需明确多智能体协作何时才具有真正价值。
AI.method: 通过系统性分析刻画多智能体协作相对单智能体的能力边界；提出 SAIGE 机制，将协作建模为动态演化图，节点为按需生成的智能体实例，边通过基于内容的信息检索建立语义依赖。
AI.result: 在长程复杂任务基准上，SAIGE 在上下文效率与任务性能之间取得良好权衡；扩大智能体池或加深递归层次并不能持续提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作的优势受任务结构限制而非普适：在依赖稀疏的长程任务中系统受益，在紧耦合顺序流程中单智能体更优；更多智能体不必然带来更强智能。

title: PhyRestore: Physics-Structured Latent-Factor Restoration
summary: Estimating temporal soil-loss change is challenging when physically meaningful input factors are noisy or corrupted, particularly because substantial changes are rare relative to the large number of locations exhibiting little change. We study this problem through the Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation (RUSLE) and introduce PhyRestore, a physics-structured latent-factor restoration framework. Rather than directly predicting soil-loss change or correcting a degraded physical estimate, PhyRestore restores corrupted physical factors and reconstructs temporal change through the known physical relationship. We evaluate PhyRestore in a watershed-scale bitemporal raster setting under isolated and simultaneous corruption of rainfall erosivity and cover management, comparing it with the degraded RUSLE estimate and Direct RF, XGBoost, MLP, and CNN models. Factor restoration improves high-magnitude recovery when the corrupted factors remain identifiable, but its advantage weakens under joint corruption, sparse positive extremes, and factor values outside the training support.

AI.tldr: 提出PhyRestore框架，通过恢复受损的物理因子并借助已知物理关系重建土壤流失时序变化。
AI.motivation: 在物理输入因子存在噪声或损坏时，估计土壤流失的时序变化十分困难，且显著变化相对于大量几乎不变的位置而言极为稀少，导致直接预测或校正退化估计面临挑战。
AI.method: 基于修正通用土壤流失方程（RUSLE），构建物理结构化的潜因子恢复框架PhyRestore：不直接预测土壤流失变化，也不校正退化的物理估计，而是恢复受损的物理因子，再通过已知物理关系重建时序变化。在流域尺度双时相栅格场景下，对降雨侵蚀力和覆盖管理因子进行单独及同时损坏的评估，并与退化RUSLE估计及Direct RF、XGBoost、MLP、CNN模型对比。
AI.result: 当受损因子仍可识别时，因子恢复能改善高幅度变化的恢复效果；但在联合损坏、正极端值稀疏以及因子值超出训练支撑范围的情况下，其优势减弱。
AI.conclusion: 物理结构化的因子恢复思路在可识别条件下有效，但在联合损坏与分布外取值等情形下存在明显局限，其优势依赖于因子的可识别性与训练数据对极端值的覆盖程度。

title: PetriBench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning over Dynamic State Spaces
summary: Characterizing LLM reasoning remains an open challenge, as many existing benchmarks isolate specific reasoning skills, rely on external knowledge, or are costly to extend. We introduce PetriBench, a compact, fully self-contained, and scalable benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over dynamic state spaces using Petri nets, a mature formalism for modeling real-world concurrent and distributed systems. PetriBench organizes reasoning into four task families varying by scope and temporal horizon, with Easy, Medium, and Hard levels generated by increasing structural complexity and evaluated against exact ground truth. Across a diverse set of proprietary and open-weight models, accuracy decreases consistently with difficulty, while harder instances expose increasingly distinct task-specific capability profiles. Additional analyses show that test-time compute improves performance but interacts differently with different reasoning tasks, and that procedural generation yields smooth scaling with structural complexity. Together, these results show that PetriBench provides a unified and extensible setting for probing the strengths, limits, and scaling behavior of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PetriBench，一个基于Petri网、完全自包含且可扩展的LLM推理基准，覆盖动态状态空间下的四类推理任务，并按结构复杂度分为三个难度等级，配合精确真值进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理基准存在明显局限：多数仅孤立考察特定推理技能、依赖外部知识，或扩展成本高昂，难以系统刻画LLM在动态状态空间上的推理能力。
AI.method: 采用Petri网这一成熟的并发与分布式系统建模形式，构建四类在推理范围与时间跨度上不同的任务族；通过程序化生成提升结构复杂度，形成Easy、Medium、Hard三级难度，并以精确真值作为评测标准；在多种闭源与开源权重模型上进行测试，并开展测试时计算量与结构复杂度的附加分析。
AI.result: 各类模型准确率随难度提升而一致下降；较难实例暴露出愈发明显的任务特化能力差异；测试时计算能提升性能但对不同推理任务的交互作用不同；程序化生成使性能随结构复杂度呈现平滑缩放。
AI.conclusion: PetriBench为探测LLM推理的优势、局限与缩放行为提供了一个统一且可扩展的评测框架。

title: AI Smart Glasses for Wearable Intelligence: From Egocentric Sensing to Agentic Personalization
summary: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping smart glasses from egocentric capture and display devices into platforms for wearable intelligence. Smart glasses increasingly serve as wearable AI systems that connect first-person observation with real-time assistance under strict form-factor constraints. We frame this transition through the lens of \emph{AI smart glasses} and define them as a system-level concept in which egocentric sensing, resource-aware computing, intelligent reasoning, multimodal interaction, and real-world application constraints are co-designed for personalized assistance in the physical world. To systematically study this perspective, we organize the survey around four connected dimensions. First, we examine the hardware foundation that bounds sensing, computation, feedback delivery, and sustained deployment. Second, we study wearable intelligence, where egocentric signals are transformed into perceptual, contextual, and agentic capabilities. Third, we discuss interaction design, through which users request, receive, correct, and regulate assistance during ongoing activity. Fourth, we analyze application scenarios across healthcare, accessibility, situated learning, daily life assistance, cultural tourism, and industrial support, showing how domain requirements reshape system design and evaluation. We further identify five cross-cutting research challenges for future AI smart glasses: next-generation hardware, trustworthy egocentric intelligence, lifelong personalized memory, proactive intelligence, and embodied foundation models. By centering smart glasses as wearable-intelligence platforms, this survey provides a unified framework for organizing technologies, applications, and open challenges in this emerging area.

AI.tldr: 该综述将智能眼镜定位为"AI智能眼镜"这一系统级概念，围绕硬件基础、可穿戴智能、交互设计与应用场景四个维度组织技术全景，并提出五大跨领域研究挑战。
AI.motivation: AI进步正推动智能眼镜从单纯的第一人称采集与显示设备，转变为可穿戴智能平台，需在严苛形态约束下连接第一视角感知与实时辅助，但该领域缺乏统一的系统级研究框架。
AI.method: 以"AI智能眼镜"为系统级概念，强调第一视角感知、资源感知计算、智能推理、多模态交互与真实应用约束的协同设计；从硬件基础、可穿戴智能、交互设计、应用场景四个相互关联的维度展开综述。
AI.result: 梳理了各维度技术脉络：硬件界定感知、计算、反馈与持续部署的边界；可穿戴智能将第一视角信号转化为感知、情境与智能体能力；交互设计涵盖用户请求、接收、纠正与调节辅助；应用覆盖医疗、无障碍、情境学习、日常生活、文化旅游与工业支持。
AI.conclusion: 提出五个交叉研究挑战：新一代硬件、可信第一视角智能、终身个性化记忆、主动式智能与具身基础模型；为AI智能眼镜的技术、应用与开放问题提供统一组织框架。

title: Tele-Traversability: Rethinking Traversability for Teleoperated Ground Robots in Terrain Navigation
summary: Teleoperation, a human-in-the-loop control scheme, allows a human operator to remotely command and guide a mobile robot to navigate in off-road environments, yet fluent and user-friendly tele-navigation requires an alignment of traversability evaluation between human and robot. In the teleoperation system, the human operator typically utilizes off-site incomplete and delayed feedback via a human-machine interface to make a judgment of traversability, while the robot makes such an evaluation based on in situ onboard sensory information, which could cause divergent traversability estimation and thus generate mismatched decisions and actions. Existing approaches for traversability modeling, estimation, and prediction are mainly derived from the view of robots, i.e., robot-centric, and are practically suitable for fully autonomous mobile robots, but neglect the influence of human operators. To address this problem, this paper extends the concept of traversability from robot-centric to human-centric by accounting for the operator's cognitive states, such as attention, workload, and risk tolerance or awareness, termed tele-traversability. We first revisit the definitions and roles of traversability in robotics and then extend them to teleoperation settings. Finally, we highlight future trends and open challenges of tele-traversability toward human-centric teleoperation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将"可通行性"概念从机器人中心扩展到以人为中心，提出"遥操作可通行性"（tele-traversability），纳入操作员的注意力、工作负荷与风险容忍度等认知状态，以解决遥操作中人机通行性评估不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 遥操作中，人类操作员依赖现场外不完整且有延迟的反馈通过人机界面对通行性进行判断，而机器人则基于现场车载传感信息评估通行性，二者标准不一致，导致通行性估计分歧，进而产生不匹配的决策与动作。现有通行性建模、估计与预测方法主要从机器人视角（robot-centric）出发，适用于全自主移动机器人，却忽视了人类操作员的影响。
AI.method: 概念性/综述性工作：首先回顾机器人学中可通行性的定义与作用，明确其在遥操作场景中的适用性差异；随后将可通行性从机器人中心扩展到以人为中心，引入操作员认知状态（注意力、工作负荷、风险容忍度或风险意识），提出"tele-traversability"（遥操作可通行性）概念；最后指出面向以人为中心遥操作系统的未来趋势与开放挑战。
AI.result: 论文并未给出实验数据或定量结果，属于观点/展望类工作。其核心"结果"是提出并定义了tele-traversability这一新概念框架，指出人机通行性评估对齐是实现流畅、易用遥导航的关键，并梳理了相应的开放问题与研究挑战。
AI.conclusion: 为实现流畅且用户友好的遥导航，需要将通行性评估从机器人中心转向以人为中心，把操作员的认知状态纳入通行性建模，从而弥合人机之间的通行性评估分歧。tele-traversability为以人为中心的遥操作系统提供了新的研究方向，并明确了若干未来趋势与开放挑战。

title: TorchCraft: Unified binder design by inverting an all-atom structure predictor
summary: All-atom structure predictors model diverse molecular interactions, but using their learned structural priors for binder design remains challenging. Here we present TorchCraft, a unified binder-design framework that optimizes sequence logits through a frozen all-atom predictor. Implemented in TorchFold, TorchCraft combines confidence, contact, geometric, and sequence-prior objectives within a shared optimization procedure for minibinders, framework-conditioned VHHs, cyclic peptides, and ligand-binding proteins. Using pretrained AlphaFold 3 weights, TorchCraft generated representative minibinders and VHHs with experimentally measured binding across four targets in each format, without post hoc sequence redesign. Computational benchmarks further demonstrated the framework's applicability to cyclic peptides and ligand-conditioned pocket design. TorchCraft extends predictor inversion to multiple binder formats and molecular contexts, providing a common framework for reusing all-atom structural priors in design.

AI.tldr: TorchCraft是一个统一结合剂设计框架，通过冻结的全原子结构预测器（AlphaFold 3）反向优化序列logits，支持多种结合剂形式的设计并获实验验证。
AI.motivation: 全原子结构预测器能建模多样的分子相互作用，但将其学习到的结构先验用于结合剂设计仍具挑战性，缺乏统一的设计框架。
AI.method: 提出TorchCraft框架，在TorchFold中实现，通过冻结的全原子预测器优化序列logits；将置信度、接触、几何与序列先验目标整合到共享优化流程中，适用于minibinders、框架条件化VHH、环肽及配体结合蛋白。
AI.result: 使用预训练AlphaFold 3权重，无需事后序列重设计，即生成代表性minibinders和VHH，在每种形式四个靶点上实验测定到结合；计算基准进一步证明框架适用于环肽和配体条件化口袋设计。
AI.conclusion: TorchCraft将预测器反演扩展到多种结合剂形式和分子语境，为复用全原子结构先验进行设计提供了通用框架。

title: Learning-Based Reconstruction of Optical Properties in Bilayered Media from Single-distance Time-Resolved Reflectance Measurements
summary: The inverse problem of reconstructing optical properties, specifically absorption and scattering coefficients, in layered biological media from time-domain reflectance measurements remains a significant challenge for traditional analytical models. Inverse solvers based on the diffusion equation often struggle with structural heterogeneity, frequently yielding poor accuracy for superficial absorption and deep-layers scattering. In this work, we propose a machine learning framework as an alternative approach to reconstruct the optical properties of a bilayered medium, benchmarking its efficiency and accuracy against model-based algorithms. To overcome the intrinsic approximations of diffusion theory and inverse reconstruction, we generated a robust synthetic dataset of forward DTOF using exact Monte Carlo simulations at multiple source-detector distances. A machine learning pipeline was then trained on this dataset and validated against state-of-the-art model-based reconstruction methods. Besides the significant reconstruction speed-up, the machine learning approach achieves higher accuracy than model-based inverse solvers, further providing an estimate of the parameter space dimensionality without requiring any a priori information about the number of layers in the investigated geometry. Further enhancements in the reconstruction accuracy can be expected in future extensions of this work, by training the pipeline over multiple DTOF curves from the same medium, in a joint multi-distance reconstruction approach.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于机器学习的框架，利用多源探测距离的蒙特卡洛仿真DTOF数据集，重建双层生物介质的光学吸收与散射系数，在速度与精度上均优于传统基于模型的逆求解器。
AI.motivation: 从时域反射测量（DTOF）中重建层状生物介质的吸收与散射系数是一个难题。基于扩散方程的逆求解器难以处理结构异质性，对表层吸收和深层散射的重建精度差。作者希望寻找一种替代方法以克服扩散理论的固有近似。
AI.method: 构建基于精确蒙特卡洛仿真的前向DTOF合成数据集，覆盖多个源-探测器距离；在该数据集上训练机器学习流水线，并与当前最先进的基于模型的逆重建算法进行对比基准测试。
AI.result: 机器学习方法在重建速度上显著提升，且重建精度高于基于模型的逆求解器；同时无需关于层数的先验信息即可估计参数空间的维度。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习可作为层状介质光学性质重建的有效替代方案。未来可通过在同一介质的多条DTOF曲线上联合训练，实现多距离联合重建，进一步提升精度。

title: Evaluating Communicative Success in Machine-Translated Conversation
summary: Interpreter agents built on machine translation (MT) increasingly mediate live conversation between people who do not share a language, yet we still evaluate them with metrics built for isolated sentences, which measure fidelity rather than whether communication succeeds. We introduce a reusable three-layer checklist-and-judge framework that evaluates interpreter-mediated conversation across semantic, pragmatic, and cultural-social dimensions, covering the naturalness, intent, and social appropriateness that fidelity metrics leave unmeasured. It runs in both single-turn and interactive multi-turn settings, where simulated users reply to translated messages as the conversation unfolds and each turn is scored alongside the conversation as a whole. We extensively validate it through controlled perturbations, cross-judge comparisons, and human annotations. Our main single-turn benchmark evaluates 10 interpreter setups across Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian, and Korean from 5,624 OpenSubtitles-derived scenarios spanning 12 translation directions, and our multi-turn study covers all 6 language pairs in scripted and live modes. Results show a consistent decline from semantic to pragmatic and cultural-social success, while conventional MT metrics overlook failures among stronger interpreters, and prompt ablations show that scenario context, structured instructions, and cultural context improve communicative success, although gains vary across setups. Our work thus provides an evaluation framework and benchmark for interpreter agents in conversation, and highlights the importance of communicative success alongside existing translation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复用的三层（语义、语用、文化-社会）checklist-and-judge框架，用于评估口译智能体在真实对话中的沟通成功度，支持单轮与交互式多轮设置，并构建了覆盖4种语言、12个翻译方向的大规模基准。
AI.motivation: 现有口译智能体评估仍沿用为孤立句子设计的机器翻译指标，只衡量保真度（fidelity），无法判断跨语言交流是否真正成功，忽略了自然度、意图传达与社会得体性等维度。
AI.method: 提出三层清单式评判框架（checklist-and-judge），覆盖语义、语用、文化-社会维度；支持单轮与交互式多轮（模拟用户实时回复，逐轮打分并整体评分）；通过受控扰动、跨评判者比较与人工标注进行验证。单轮基准评估10种口译设置，基于OpenSubtitles的5,624个场景、12个翻译方向（阿拉伯语、孟加拉语、印尼语、韩语）；多轮研究覆盖全部6个语言对，含脚本与实时两种模式。
AI.result: 结果显示沟通成功率从语义到语用再到文化-社会维度持续下降；传统MT指标在较强口译系统上会漏检失败；提示词消融表明场景上下文、结构化指令与文化上下文能提升沟通成功率，但增益因设置而异。
AI.conclusion: 本文为对话中的口译智能体提供了评估框架与基准，强调在现有翻译指标之外应重视沟通成功率。

title: Absence is Presence: Understanding Visual Scene Negative Events Under Safety Cognitive Constraint
summary: Traditional scene understanding focuses on affirmative information objectively present in images. However, in safety-critical domains, comprehending key information that should exist but is actually absent is vital for risk mitigation. To bridge this gap, we focus on visual scene negative captioning with safety as the cognitive constraint. The core challenge is to convert physical absence into semantic negative events. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with this process because affirmation bias suppresses negative reasoning, while limited mental filling capability and representation bias further hinder the inference of absent information. To address these challenges, we propose a negative captioning framework based on counterfactual reconstruction and contrastive decoding (CRCD). Inspired by human cognition, CRCD reformulates the task as counterfactual latent change captioning to bypass affirmation bias. It contrasts a synthesized safe expectation with reality to identify semantic omissions. To address limited mental filling, we design a dual-branch counterfactual reconstruction architecture. The amodal completion branch restores defective objects, while the functional association branch infers completely absent safety objects. Concurrently, a multi-condition representation learning mechanism is integrated to mitigate representation bias by projecting universal features onto predefined safety criteria subspaces, thereby capturing information across more dimensions. By decoding feature-level semantic residuals between the reconstructed scene prototype and raw input, CRCD bounds the non-existence search space and activates the decoder's negative logic. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of CRCD, establishing a high-performance baseline for this pioneering task.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实重构与对比解码框架CRCD，实现以安全为约束的视觉场景负向描述生成，将物理缺失转化为语义负事件。
AI.motivation: 传统场景理解只关注图像中客观存在的肯定信息，但在安全关键领域，识别"本应存在却实际缺失"的关键信息对风险规避至关重要。现有视觉语言模型因肯定偏差抑制负向推理，且心智填充能力有限、表征偏差严重，难以推断缺失信息。
AI.method: CRCD将任务重构为反事实潜在变化描述以绕过肯定偏差，通过对比合成的安全期望与现实识别语义遗漏；设计双分支反事实重构架构：非模态补全分支修复残缺物体，功能关联分支推断完全缺失的安全物体；引入多条件表征学习机制，将通用特征投影到预定义安全准则子空间以缓解表征偏差；通过解码重构场景原型与原始输入间的特征级语义残差，约束不存在性搜索空间并激活解码器负向逻辑。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了CRCD的有效性，为该开创性任务建立了高性能基线。
AI.conclusion: CRCD通过反事实重构与对比解码有效解决负向描述生成中的肯定偏差、心智填充受限和表征偏差问题，为安全导向的场景理解提供了新范式与基线。

title: Recovering Aggressively Pruned Vision-Language-Action Models with Offline Hidden-State Distillation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models let robots follow language instructions, but their language backbones of several billion parameters are the main obstacle to running them on robot hardware. Structured pruning reduces that backbone, and removing 63% of it from OpenVLA-OFT drops LIBERO-Long success from 93.2% to 0.8%. A recent approach restores such a model with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, which needs online rollouts and hundreds of GPU-hours. We recover most of the lost success entirely offline. Width pruning narrows the blocks but keeps the residual stream at its original size, so teacher and student hidden states have the same shape and are matched directly, without a projector. Training against a cache built in one teacher pass lifts the 63%-reduced student to within 3.5 points of the teacher in about 8 GPU-hours. A sweep over nine ratios locates where the recovery objective starts to matter. Up to 45% reduction the two do not differ significantly on OpenVLA-OFT. Hidden-state distillation then adds +2.1 to +4.5 points there between 63% and 87%, and +9.4 to +22.1 points on CogACT from 63% onward. At 81% on CogACT, a tripled recovery budget narrows the distilled student's gap to the teacher to 3.9 points on average, while supervised recovery stays more than 20 points below. At matched compression, width pruning yields higher success and depth pruning lower latency. On a 6-DoF manipulator, the distilled student at 72% reduction reaches 77.5% success against 59.5% for supervised recovery, runs 2.23x faster on-board than the teacher, and uses 62% less memory.

AI.tldr: 通过宽度剪枝与离线隐藏状态蒸馏，可在约8 GPU小时内将剪枝63%的VLA模型恢复至接近教师水平，避免在线强化学习的高昂成本。
AI.motivation: VLA模型的语言主干参数达数十亿，是部署到机器人硬件的主要障碍。结构化剪枝可压缩主干，但从OpenVLA-OFT移除63%参数会使LIBERO-Long成功率从93.2%骤降至0.8%。现有恢复方法需监督微调加强化学习，依赖在线rollout和数百GPU小时，成本过高。因此需要一种完全离线、低成本的恢复方案。
AI.method: 提出宽度剪枝：缩小各块宽度但保持残差流原始尺寸，使教师与学生隐藏状态形状一致，可直接匹配、无需投影器。训练时仅需一次教师前向pass构建缓存，学生针对该缓存进行离线蒸馏训练。并在九个压缩比例上进行扫描，比较监督恢复与隐藏状态蒸馏的差异。
AI.result: 63%压缩学生约8 GPU小时即恢复至距教师3.5个点以内。45%以内两种目标无显著差异。63%–87%区间隐藏状态蒸馏带来+2.1至+4.5点提升；CogACT上63%起带来+9.4至+22.1点。CogACT 81%时，三倍恢复预算使蒸馏学生平均差距缩至3.9点，而监督恢复仍低20点以上。相同压缩下宽度剪枝成功率更高、深度剪枝延迟更低。6-DoF机械臂上，72%压缩的蒸馏学生成功率77.5%（监督为59.5%），机载运行比教师快2.23倍，内存少62%。
AI.conclusion: 宽度剪枝配合离线隐藏状态蒸馏能高效恢复大幅剪枝的VLA模型，显著优于监督恢复，且在成功率和推理效率上均具优势，为机器人端部署提供了可行路径。

title: Integrating knowledge from case reports: a medical ontology based multimodal information system with structured summary
summary: Published medical case reports serve as a crucial medical information carrier, documenting discoveries in rare diseases, diagnostic methods, and innovative treatments. Despite the wealth of clinical knowledge in millions of case reports in the public medicine literature database (PubMed), accessing relevant information efficiently is hindered by the limitations of traditional keyword-based retrieval tools on unstructured and diverse case reports. To address the above issues, we introduce a comprehensive multimodal information system for case reports integrating structured clinical summaries of patients including medical images and biomedical named entities from 52949 open-access case reports published from 2000 to 2021. The multimodal essential information is organized in a well-structured medical ontology. Also, a powerful interface for searching and browsing case reports is designed to assist junior clinicians in retrieving cases effectively and improving the identification and diagnosis of rare diseases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向医学病例报告的多模态信息系统，整合了2000—2021年52949篇开放获取病例报告中的结构化临床摘要、医学图像与生物医学命名实体，并以医学本体组织，配套高效检索与浏览界面，辅助低年资临床医生检索病例、提升罕见病识别与诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 病例报告是记录罕见病发现、诊断方法与创新治疗的重要医学信息载体，PubMed中已积累数百万篇；但其结构非结构化、内容异质，传统基于关键词的检索工具难以高效获取相关信息，导致临床知识可利用性低。
AI.method: 构建面向病例报告的综合多模态信息系统：采集2000—2021年发表的52949篇开放获取病例报告，提取患者结构化临床摘要、医学图像和生物医学命名实体等多模态核心信息，并依据结构良好的医学本体进行组织；同时设计功能强大的检索与浏览界面。
AI.result: 系统整合了52949篇开放获取病例报告的多模态核心信息，实现了基于医学本体的结构化组织，并提供支持高效检索与浏览的交互界面。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态病例报告信息系统可帮助低年资临床医生更有效地检索病例，改善罕见病的识别与诊断，为挖掘和利用海量病例报告中的临床知识提供了可行方案。

title: DeliveryGym: An RL Environment for Long-Horizon Embodied Agent Planning with Adaptive Curriculum
summary: Executable environments enable LLM agents to learn from the consequences of their actions. For embodied agents, those consequences extend beyond whether the current task succeeds: completing a delivery can consume the time, energy, or money needed for later work. Learning to plan therefore requires environments that preserve these dependencies and turn them into feedback across a complete trajectory. We introduce DeliveryGym, a 3D environment for evaluating and training agents on continuous courier shifts. It couples multimodal tool interaction with persistent world dynamics and computes trajectory rewards from simulator events, making the costs of an agent's decisions available for reinforcement learning (RL). The environment also adapts future training shifts to the policy's observed weaknesses while keeping evaluation fixed. Across six models and 13 city maps, evaluation exposes a gap between reliably executing assigned deliveries and choosing and sequencing work over a shift. On the fixed test suite, RL improves Qwen3-VL-4B's net income by 54.3%, showing that learning from complete shifts improves performance under these coupled constraints. Adapting the training environment improves test income by 16.5% over uniform sampling at the same rollout budget, indicating that which situations an agent practices also matters. DeliveryGym provides an executable setting for studying how agents learn to coordinate deliveries and preserve resources for later orders within an episode.

AI.tldr: 提出DeliveryGym——面向3D快递员连续班次的具身智能体训练与评估环境，支持多模态工具交互、持久世界动态与轨迹级奖励，并自适应调整训练任务。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的行动后果超出当前任务成败：完成一次配送会消耗后续工作所需的时间、精力或金钱。学习规划需要能保留这些跨步依赖、并将其转化为整条轨迹反馈的环境。
AI.method: 构建DeliveryGym三维环境，模拟连续快递班次；耦合多模态工具交互与持久世界动态；由模拟器事件计算轨迹奖励以供强化学习；训练阶段依据策略弱点自适应调整未来班次，评估集保持固定。
AI.result: 在6个模型、13张城市地图上评估，揭示"可靠执行指派配送"与"整班次中选择并排序任务"之间存在能力差距。在固定测试集上，RL将Qwen3-VL-4B净收入提升54.3%；自适应训练环境在相同rollout预算下比均匀采样提升测试收入16.5%。
AI.conclusion: DeliveryGym为研究智能体如何在单回合内协调配送、为后续订单保留资源提供了可执行设置，表明从完整班次学习及训练情境的选择均对性能有显著影响。

title: Generalization through Lexical Abstraction in Transformer Models: The Case of Functional Words
summary:
Pronouns, adverbs and other functional words (such as they, her, somewhere, there) are often used in language to replace concrete nouns or phrases, when their properties - such as gender, grammatical number - provide sufficient information for the given context. Do pretrained transformer models encode such functional words in a manner that allows them to be used like humans do? Can language models recognize the syntactic and semantic parallelism of sentences such as "The researchers wrote the paper" and "They wrote it", which relies on such lexical abstraction?
  We map these linguistic questions into the embedding space of a pretrained transformer model, and compare representations of nouns, with the representations of the pronouns and adverbs that can replace these nouns, in isolation and in parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We then probe for shared syntactic and semantic structure in the embeddings of parallel lexicalized and functional sentences.
  We find that functional words are located centrally compared to nouns, but are also distinct, which is congruent with their behaviour as place-holders in a wide variety of contexts.
  The analysis of the embeddings of parallel (lexicalized and functional) sentences show them inhabiting different subspaces of the embedding space. Experiments that distil the structural information of the sentence show that training on either type of data does not reveal the shared structure - because of the over-consistency of the vocabulary (in case of the functional data), and the too much variety (in case of the lexicalized versions). However, training with a mix of functional and lexicalized sentences, the shared structure emerges.

AI.tldr: 该研究将语言学问题映射到预训练Transformer的嵌入空间，考察功能词（代词、副词）的表示及其与实词名词的关系，并探究平行词汇化/功能化句子是否共享句法与语义结构。
AI.motivation: 功能词（they、her、somewhere等）在语言中用于替代具体名词，其替代前提是性别、语法数等属性在语境中足够明确。作者想探究预训练Transformer模型是否以类似人类的方式编码这类功能词，以及语言模型能否识别"The researchers wrote the paper"与"They wrote it"这类依赖词汇抽象化的句子的句法、语义平行性。
AI.method: 将上述语言学问题映射到预训练Transformer的嵌入空间；比较名词与其可被替代的代词、副词在孤立形式及平行词汇化/功能化句子中的表示；通过探针（probing）分析平行句子的嵌入中共享的句法与语义结构；并进行蒸馏句子结构信息的实验，比较不同数据（功能化、词汇化、混合）训练下的表现。
AI.result: 功能词在嵌入空间中比名词更靠中心，但同时又具有区分性，这与其作为多语境占位符的行为一致。平行（词汇化与功能化）句子的嵌入处于不同的子空间。蒸馏实验显示：仅用功能化数据或仅用词汇化数据训练都无法揭示共享结构——前者因词汇过度一致，后者因变化过多；而混合功能化与词汇化句子训练时，共享结构得以显现。
AI.conclusion: 预训练Transformer对功能词的编码符合其作为语境占位符的功能：位置居中但可区分；词汇化与功能化句子嵌入位于不同子空间，单一类型数据不足以揭示二者共享结构，需混合两种数据才能显现共享的句法与语义结构。

title: SnapPhysics: A Physics-Aware Scene Graph from a Single View for Interactive Mixed Reality Scenes
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE ISMAR, 2026
summary: We propose SnapPhysics, a training-free framework that reconstructs 3D objects and estimates their physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of gravity from a single image. For physically coherent interactions in mixed reality (MR), such properties are as important as geometry. Prior approaches infer them by analyzing object dynamics in video, which is computationally costly, or by querying vision-language models (VLMs) on single images, which lacks geometric grounding and inter-object relationships. We address these limitations by combining instance-level 3D reconstruction and spatial alignment with a physics-aware scene graph that encodes these relationships and per-object metric geometry as structured context for VLM-based property reasoning. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that SnapPhysics improves scene-level F-Score by 18.6% over the best learning-based method, and on real captured scenes with ground-truth mass, it reduces the mean absolute log difference error (mALDE) by up to 20.5% and improves log-scale correlation ($r^2_{\mathrm{ls}}$) by up to 19.6% over VLM-only estimation. SnapPhysics enables physically interactive MR experiences without manual parameter tuning. Project page: https://snapphysics-ismar2026.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SnapPhysics：免训练框架，从单张图像重建3D物体并估计质量、摩擦、重心等物理属性，通过实例级重建、空间对齐与物理感知场景图结合VLM推理，在3D-FRONT和真实场景上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 混合现实中实现物理一致的交互，物理属性与几何同等重要。现有方法或依赖视频中的物体动态分析（计算代价高），或直接用VLM查询单图像（缺乏几何基础与物体间关系），均存在不足。
AI.method: 提出SnapPhysics免训练框架：将实例级3D重建与空间对齐，与编码物体间关系和逐物体度量几何的“物理感知场景图”相结合，作为结构化上下文供VLM进行物理属性推理。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT上，场景级F-Score较最佳学习方法提升18.6%；在带真实质量标注的实拍场景中，mALDE最多降低20.5%，log尺度相关性r²_ls最多提升19.6%（对比仅用VLM的估计）。
AI.conclusion: SnapPhysics无需手动调参即可支持物理可交互的MR体验，证明结合几何重建与结构化场景图可有效提升单图像物理属性估计的精度与一致性。

title: OmniCalib: Target-Free, Task-Structured Self-Calibration for Humanoid Robots
summary: Assembly, wear, and component replacement perturb the sensor extrinsics and joint zeros encoded by a humanoid CAD model. Existing procedures calibrate one sensor pair or require external fiducials. Using only robot-native motion and onboard sensing, we present OmniCalib, a target-free workflow that calibrates the full upper limbs---all 14 arm joint zeros and the extrinsics of both wrist and chest cameras---as well as lower limbs and the multi-camera head rig. Each module matches a robot-native task to a parameter block, checks observability, and writes only supported corrections to the CAD model. Our depth ICP method recovers all 14 arm joint zeros and calibrates all RGB-D camera extrinsics without any calibration target. Relative to CAD, the estimated extrinsic corrections are 10.56 mm and 1.74 degrees for the left wrist, 6.33 mm and 1.25 degrees for the right wrist, and 9.81 mm and 0.929 degrees for the chest RGB-D camera. ICP point-to-plane residual is 2.09 mm. On the same injected offsets, ICP and ArUco recover all 14 joint zeros below the 0.1-degree encoder-resolution reference. On an AGIBOT A3 Ultra humanoid, four static double-support stances recover all 12 lower-limb joint-zero offsets injected with an RMS error of 0.063 degrees. The head module combines multi-camera visual odometry with legged odometry and dynamic compensation through the live ROS transform tree. Using only planar walking, it attains a mean SO(3) error of 1.061 degrees across three sequences. The best sequence reaches 0.775 degrees, competitive with iKalibr at 0.902 degrees from rich 6-DOF excitation. Rig-relative angles repeat within 0.140 degrees. Injection recovery and held-out tests validate each observable block.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniCalib——一种无需标定靶标、仅依靠机器人自身运动与机载传感的全上肢（14个臂关节零点+双腕及胸部相机外参）、下肢（12个关节零点）及多相机头部装置标定流程，通过"机器人原生任务匹配参数块+可观测性检验+仅写入受支持修正"实现。
AI.motivation: 装配、磨损与部件更换会扰动人形CAD模型中的传感器外参与关节零点；现有标定流程仅能标定单一传感器对或依赖外部基准靶标（fiducials），无法覆盖全肢体多部件。
AI.method: OmniCalib按模块将机器人原生任务映射到参数块，进行可观测性检验，仅将受支持的修正写回CAD模型；核心为深度ICP方法，无标定靶情况下恢复全部14个臂关节零点并标定所有RGB-D相机外参；下肢模块用四个静态双支撑站姿恢复12个关节零点偏移；头部模块融合多相机视觉里程计、腿式里程计与动态补偿（经实时ROS变换树）。
AI.result: 相对CAD外参修正：左腕10.56 mm/1.74°，右腕6.33 mm/1.25°，胸部RGB-D 9.81 mm/0.929°；ICP点到面残差2.09 mm。相同注入偏移下，ICP与ArUco均将14个关节零点恢复至0.1°编码器分辨率参考以下。AGIBOT A3 Ultra上12个下肢关节零点注入偏移的RMS误差0.063°。头部仅用平面行走，三条序列平均SO(3)误差1.061°，最优0.775°，与iKalibr在丰富6-DOF激励下的0.902°相当；装置相对角度重复性0.140°。
AI.conclusion: 注入恢复实验与留出测试验证了每个可观测参数块的有效性，表明无靶标、仅用机器人原生运动的标定可覆盖上肢、下肢与头部多相机装置的完整标定需求。

title: Contagion on the Trading Floor: How Adversarial Signals Spread in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
comment: Published in ECML PKDD 2026. 25 pages, including 7 pages of supplementary material
summary: Multi-agent trading systems built on large language models (LLMs) are beginning to appear in quantitative finance, yet their robustness to adversarial inputs is largely unknown. We study the vulnerability of LLM trading stacks to black-box, input-only attacks that enter solely via admissible social-media feeds. We introduce the Generic Multi-Agent Trading System (GMATS), a framework that captures modern multiagent trading architectures and instantiate a class of black-box poisoning attackers that treat an LLM as a post generator and inject budget-constrained, plausibly benign social-media content into the analyst's evidence stream. We define contagion metrics that trace how adversarial content propagates through the stack, including belief-shift scores at analyst and coordinator layers and attack-clean deltas on standard backtest metrics. Experiments on a safe offline benchmark with historical market and social data show that even simple input-only attackers can materially degrade risk-return profiles, sharply reducing Sharpe ratios. At the same time, we find that suitably designed multi-agent topologies and coordinator prompts can dampen adversarial shocks and improve average robustness under identical poisoning budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GMATS框架，研究基于LLM的多智能体交易系统在仅通过社交媒体输入的黑盒投毒攻击下的脆弱性，并发现合理设计的多智能体拓扑与协调者提示可提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的多智能体交易系统正进入量化金融领域，但其对抗性输入的鲁棒性尚不清楚，尤其是仅通过合法的社交媒体渠道进行的黑盒攻击风险未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出通用多智能体交易系统（GMATS）框架，刻画现代多智能体交易架构；构造一类黑盒投毒攻击者，将LLM作为帖子生成器，在预算约束下向分析师证据流注入貌似良性的社交媒体内容；并定义传染指标，包括分析师与协调者层的信念偏移分数，以及标准回测指标上的攻击-干净增量。
AI.result: 在包含历史市场与社交数据的安全离线基准上，即使简单的仅输入型攻击者也能显著劣化风险-收益特征，大幅降低夏普比率；同时，精心设计的多智能体拓扑与协调者提示能缓和对抗冲击，在相同投毒预算下提升平均鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体交易栈对社交媒体输入投毒具有实质脆弱性，但通过合理设计多智能体拓扑与协调者提示，可有效提升系统鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Flattened Tokens: Structure-Preserving EEG Decoding with Reusable TriDim Blocks
summary: Effective EEG decoding requires representations that preserve organization among channels, local waveform dynamics, and long-range temporal context. Existing EEG architectures often capture these structures using separate specialized modules or collapse them into a single token sequence, making it difficult to maintain their distinct roles and coordinate their interactions throughout the backbone. We propose TriDim, a reusable block that preserves the representation shape and keeps three EEG axes explicit: channel, sample position within each patch, and patch position across the recording. These axes correspond to spatial, short-term temporal, and long-term temporal information, respectively. Each TriDim block applies feed-forward transformations along individual axes and cross-axis attention to coordinate information exchange among them. By stacking TriDim blocks with a multi-level tri-axis readout, we construct TriDimEEG, a standalone EEG decoder. Under strict cross-subject evaluation on eight datasets spanning clinical diagnosis, sleep staging, motor imagery, and emotion recognition, TriDimEEG achieves the best overall performance among fifteen evaluated models, with a 4.3% relative improvement in average accuracy over the second-best model. Replacing Transformer blocks in three EEG foundation models with TriDim blocks yields an average relative improvement of 7.4% in downstream accuracy while reducing parameter counts by 17.0% to 47.3%. These results establish TriDim as an effective and reusable building block and TriDimEEG as a strong standalone EEG decoder. Code and parameters of TriDimEEG are available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/TriDim_model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriDim模块与TriDimEEG解码器，将EEG表示显式分解为通道、patch内采样位置和patch位置三轴，兼顾空间、短时与长时时间信息，跨被试实验取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG架构多通过分离的专用模块捕获通道组织、局部波形动态与长程时间上下文，或将其压缩为单一token序列，难以在主干网络中保持三者的独立角色并协调其交互。
AI.method: 提出可复用TriDim块，保持表示形状并显式保留三条EEG轴：通道轴、每个patch内的采样位置轴、整个记录中的patch位置轴，分别对应空间、短期时间和长期时间信息。每个TriDim块沿单一轴进行前馈变换，并通过跨轴注意力协调轴间信息交换；堆叠TriDim块并配合多层级三轴读出，构成独立EEG解码器TriDimEEG。
AI.result: 在涵盖临床诊断、睡眠分期、运动想象和情绪识别的八个数据集上，严格跨被试评估下TriDimEEG在十五个评估模型中总体性能最佳，平均准确率较次优模型相对提升4.3%。用TriDim块替换三个EEG基础模型中的Transformer块，下游准确率平均相对提升7.4%，参数量减少17.0%至47.3%。
AI.conclusion: TriDim是有效且可复用的基础构件，TriDimEEG是强力的独立EEG解码器，代码与参数已开源。

title: KoNeoBench: A Curated Evaluation Dataset for LLM Understanding of Korean Neologisms
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code and data are available at the project repository
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on static benchmarks, even though natural language constantly evolves through newly emerging words and meanings. Existing Korean benchmarks are centered on established vocabulary and therefore provide limited coverage of such recent lexical change, and their English-oriented design makes it difficult to assess the typological properties of Korean, in which content words combine productively with functional morphemes. In this paper, we introduce KoNeoBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' understanding of Korean neologisms. KoNeoBench is built on 1,785 Korean neologisms attested in online news since 2020 and curated through expert lexicographic review. Each entry provides usage examples, word-formation analyses, and dictionary-style definitions. Based on this resource, we define four tasks and report results on recent models, together with a human baseline. Our experiments show that current LLMs exhibit clear limitations in recovering source components, distinguishing semantic categories, and generating accurate definitions. These results reveal specific aspects of recent Korean lexical change that remain challenging for current LLMs. KoNeoBench is available at https://github.com/bcmilab/ko-neobench/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KoNeoBench，一个评估大语言模型理解韩语新词能力的基准。该基准基于 2020 年以来网络新闻中出现的 1,785 个韩语新词，经词典学专家审校，为每条词目提供用法示例、构词分析和词典式释义，并定义四项任务，对近期模型与人类基线进行评测。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型评测多依赖静态基准，而自然语言持续演变，新词新义不断涌现。已有韩语基准聚焦既有词汇，对近期词汇变化覆盖不足；同时其英语导向的设计难以评估韩语的类型学特征，即实词与功能语素的高产组合。因此需要一个专门针对韩语新词的评测资源。
AI.method: 构建 KoNeoBench：以 2020 年以来在线新闻中实证出现的 1,785 个韩语新词为语料基础，经专家词典学审校筛选；每条词目包含用法示例、构词分析与词典式释义。基于该资源定义四项任务，并对近期模型开展实验，同时设置人类基线进行对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前大语言模型在还原源构成成分、区分语义类别以及生成准确释义方面均存在明显局限，显示出近期韩语词汇变化中若干具体方面对现有模型仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: KoNeoBench 填补了韩语新词评测的空白，揭示了当前大语言模型在韩语词汇演变理解上的具体不足。该基准已开源，可供后续研究使用。

title: KoUniTalk: A Lightweight Articulation-Centered Korean-English 3D Talking Face Benchmark
summary: High-quality 3D talking face datasets remain largely English- centric, and Korean 3D facial motion data are difficult to combine with standard English benchmarks because of differences in mesh topology, spatial scale, coordinate system, and temporal sampling. We present KoUniTalk, a lightweight articulation-centered Korean-English 3D talk- ing face benchmark that retargets VOCASET and the released Korean speech-based 3D talking face data to a shared mesh topology using de- formation transfer. Rather than proposing a new deformation-transfer algorithm or a full-head identity-preserving avatar dataset, KoUniTalk provides an identity-neutral canonical output space for controlled speech- driven facial articulation training and evaluation across English and Ko- rean. The unified template contains 1,176 vertices and focuses on the mouth and adjacent lower- and mid-face regions, reducing the output dimensionality from 15,069 and 72,147 dimensions to 3,528 dimensions, corresponding to 4.27-fold and 20.45-fold reductions compared with VO- CASET/FLAME and the original Korean mesh, respectively. To exam- ine whether retargeting preserves speech-relevant motion, we evaluate semantic mouth-landmark trajectories, including mouth opening, mouth width, aperture ratio, and mouth-opening dynamics. Since the official test set of the Korean dataset is not publicly released, we additionally define a subject-disjoint Korean benchmark split. The processed matched benchmark contains 22 speakers, 4,978 sequences, and 642,781 frames, enabling Korean-English cross-dataset evaluation of speech-driven 3D fa- cial animation models in a single compact articulation-template space. Source-reported inventory counts are listed separately from these pro- cessed counts

AI.tldr: KoUniTalk是一个以发音动作为中心的韩英双语3D说话人脸基准，通过变形迁移将VOCASET与韩语3D人脸数据重定向到统一的1,176顶点网格模板，输出维度降至3,528，包含22位说话人、4,978个序列、642,781帧，支持跨数据集评估。
AI.motivation: 高质量3D说话人脸数据集以英语为主，韩语3D面部运动数据因网格拓扑、空间尺度、坐标系和时间采样差异，难以与标准英语基准结合，导致韩英跨语言、跨数据集评估缺乏统一平台。
AI.method: 采用变形迁移（deformation transfer）将VOCASET与韩语语音驱动3D说话人脸数据重定向到共享网格拓扑；构建1,176顶点的统一模板，聚焦嘴部及相邻中下面部区域；由于韩语数据集官方测试集未公开，额外定义说话人互斥（subject-disjoint）的韩语基准划分。
AI.result: 输出维度由15,069（VOCASET/FLAME）和72,147（原始韩语网格）降至3,528维，分别实现4.27倍与20.45倍降维；通过嘴部开合度、嘴宽、开口比和开合动态等语义嘴部关键点轨迹评估重定向对语音相关运动的保持；匹配基准含22位说话人、4,978个序列、642,781帧。
AI.conclusion: KoUniTalk提供了一个身份中性的规范化输出空间，可在单一紧凑发音模板空间中开展韩英跨数据集的语音驱动3D面部动画模型的训练与评估；该工作定位为基准构建，而非提出新的变形迁移算法或完整头部身份保持的虚拟人数据集。

title: Quantifying Mechanical Intelligence in Legged Robots with Information Theory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 for publication
summary: Mechanical intelligence, loosely defined as the reduction in control burden afforded by a robot's physical form, has become a prominent concept in robotics, with instantiations in bioinspired robotics, soft robotics, robotic swarms, and many other areas. However, rigorous theoretical understanding and quantitative measures of mechanical intelligence have lagged behind the engineering systems that the community has developed. In this work, using modern legged robots as a benchmark and exemplar, we propose several information-theoretic metrics for quantifying mechanical intelligence. By viewing body dynamics as both a computational process and a communication channel, we show that several prior insights in legged-robot engineering can be described using information theory, and we quantify how bits are processed by mechanical modes and across robot coordinates. Specifically, we examine the trade-off between explicitly incorporating compliance through series-elastic actuation and using so-called proprioceptive, low-gear-ratio transmissions, and we explore how these mechanisms interact with control policies during locomotion. We develop these results on systems of increasing complexity: a simplified linear model of a robot-leg transmission, a nonlinear single-leg simulation, and simulated quadruped robots controlled by a learned policy while navigating challenging terrain. These results lay the groundwork for broader study of robot mechanisms and their role in embodied computation.

AI.tldr: 本文以足式机器人为例，提出基于信息论的机械智能度量方法，将机体动力学同时视为计算过程与通信信道，量化机械模态与机器人坐标间的信息比特处理，并研究柔顺驱动与低减速比本体感知传动在运动控制中的权衡。
AI.motivation: 机械智能（即机器人物理形态降低控制负担的能力）已成为机器人学重要概念，广泛应用于仿生、软体、集群机器人等；但其严格理论理解与定量度量滞后于工程系统的发展，缺乏统一的信息论刻画。
AI.method: 以现代足式机器人为基准与范例，将机体动力学视为计算过程与通信信道，提出若干信息论度量来量化机械智能；分析通过串联弹性驱动显式引入柔顺与采用本体感知低减速比传动之间的权衡，并考察这些机制在运动过程中与控制策略的交互；在复杂度递增的系统上验证：简化的机器人腿部传动线性模型、非线性单腿仿真、以及由学习策略控制并在复杂地形上行走的仿真四足机器人。
AI.result: 表明若干既有足式机器人工程直觉可用信息论描述，并量化了信息比特如何被机械模态处理以及如何在机器人各坐标间传递；揭示了柔顺驱动与低减速比传动在运动控制中的权衡及其与控制策略的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为更广泛地研究机器人机构及其在具身计算中的作用奠定了基础，推动了机械智能的理论化与定量化。

title: Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Companion to arXiv:2606.28308 and arXiv:2607.17543. Fully reproducible: a single self-contained notebook regenerates every number, table, and figure
summary: Regularized self-play -- the family behind DeepNash's Stratego play -- drives a two-player zero-sum policy to a Nash equilibrium by best-responding to a slowly moving, entropy-regularized reference policy $ρ$. When the game has a polytope of value-equivalent equilibria, the regularizer silently breaks the tie: with a uniform reference it selects the maximum-entropy member, the I-projection of $ρ$ onto the Nash set. Can the reference be used to choose the equilibrium on purpose? On five exactly solvable games plus a 2-D polytope, with exact best responses and equivalence tests over independent seeds, anchoring the reference at a target member and refining steers self-play to that member with mean coordinate error 0.007 at median exploitability $5\times10^{-5}$, TOST-equivalent to the request within $\pm0.05$; the anchoring persists through refinement and follows the reference, not the initialization. Selection follows the reach-weighted I-projection (slope 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]). We report with equal emphasis where the story breaks: fixed off-manifold references cost 0.08-0.25 exploitability; stiff or flat families require a smaller mirror step, set by a pre-registered rule; boundary targets undershoot; curvature predicts where boundary saturation bites (rank correlation 0.90, p=0.037) while interior precision is curvature-independent. Table and MLP steering maps are equivalent within $\pm0.03$ at every target (30 seeds); matched control arms show attention's robust signature is excess seed variance, any systematic shift bounded at 0.018 and not significant. Against a best response the selection-robustness trade-off is degenerate: steering matters only against fixed, non-equilibrium opponents. The recipe -- anchor the reference at the desired member and refine -- reinterprets the KL anchor of RLHF-style RL as a selection knob, not only a stability leash.

AI.tldr: 正则化自博弈中，将参考策略锚定在目标均衡点并细化，可主动选择价值等价均衡的一个特定成员，且该选择由参考策略而非初始化决定。
AI.motivation: 正则化自博弈（DeepNash 的 Stratego 玩法背后的方法）通过向缓慢移动的熵正则化参考策略 ρ 做最优反应，使两人零和策略收敛到纳什均衡。当博弈存在价值等价均衡的多面体时，正则项会隐性打破平局：均匀参考会选择最大熵成员，即 ρ 在纳什集上的 I-投影。作者希望探究参考策略能否被有意用于选择均衡，即把参考锚定到目标成员。
AI.method: 在五个可精确求解的博弈加一个二维多面体上，使用精确最优反应与跨独立种子的等价性检验；将参考策略锚定在目标成员并进行细化。记录选择是否遵循 reach-weighted I-投影；检验 off-manifold 固定参考、刚性或平坦家族、边界目标、曲率预测；对比 table 与 MLP steering map 以及 matched control 对照臂。
AI.result: 将参考锚定在目标成员并细化可将自博弈转向该成员：平均坐标误差 0.007，中位可利用度 5×10⁻⁵，TOST 等价于请求且在 ±0.05 内；锚定效应贯穿细化过程，且跟随参考而非初始化。选择遵循 reach-weighted I-投影（斜率 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]）。失效情形：固定 off-manifold 参考的可利用度代价 0.08–0.25；刚性或平坦家族需更小的 mirror step，由预注册规则设定；边界目标会欠冲；曲率可预测边界饱和（秩相关 0.90, p=0.037），而内部精度与曲率无关。Table 与 MLP steering map 在每个目标上等价（±0.03，30 种子）；matched control 表明 attention 的稳健特征是种子方差过大，系统性偏移上限 0.018 且不显著。面对最优反应时选择-稳健性权衡退化：steering 仅在面对固定的非均衡对手时重要。
AI.conclusion: "锚定参考于目标成员并细化"这一配方把 RLHF 式 RL 中的 KL 锚重新解释为选择旋钮，而不仅是稳定性约束。该机制在多面体均衡中能精确、稳健地选择目标均衡，同时其失效边界（off-manifold、刚性/平坦家族、边界目标、曲率饱和）被明确刻画。

title: Expected Hypervolume Maximization for Multiobjective Optimization under Uncertainties
summary: The problem of multiobjective optimization under uncertainties is often approached by taking the expectation of each objective. In this work, we propose instead to formulate this as a Bayesian decision problem and to rely on the expected value of the hypervolume, which is to be maximized with respect to a finite set of input points. We show that this can be performed using methods based on gradients in a stochastic optimization framework, provided that care is taken with respect to dominated points. Moreover, in the absence of readily available differentiable code, we propose to use Gaussian Processes as differentiable surrogate models, in order to perform the optimization. An additional contribution in this work are some active learning strategies, through acquisition functions which helps construct a surrogate model well-designed for the multiobjective optimization problem at stake. These strategies are compared on simple analytical problems to assess their performances.

AI.tldr: 将不确定性下的多目标优化建模为贝叶斯决策问题，最大化超体积的期望值，并结合随机梯度优化与高斯过程代理模型及主动学习策略。
AI.motivation: 传统不确定性多目标优化多采用对各目标取期望的方式，本文希望以贝叶斯决策视角替代该做法，直接优化超体积的期望值。
AI.method: 以有限输入点集合上的期望超体积为优化目标，构建贝叶斯决策问题；在随机优化框架下使用基于梯度的方法，并处理被支配点的细节问题；当缺乏可微代码时，采用高斯过程作为可微代理模型进行优化；同时提出若干基于采集函数的主动学习策略以构建适配该多目标优化问题的代理模型。
AI.result: 在简单解析问题上对所提出的主动学习策略进行了对比，评估了其性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 所提期望超体积贝叶斯决策框架结合梯度随机优化、高斯过程代理模型与主动学习策略，在简单解析问题上验证了有效性。

title: PACE: Precise AI Cinematic Expression: A Typed Specification for Script-Grounded Previsualization and Geometric Conformance
summary:
Between a screenplay and a film sits a planning problem that is spatial first: who stands where, and what a camera sees from where it stands. An image diffusion model asked for a shot in free text settles that plan by its own defaults. We present PACE (Precise AI Cinematic Expression), a typed representation for the plan: the screenplay evidence, the characters, props and locations it needs, where each subject stands, and what the camera does. A value is written once at the level it belongs to (script, scene, shot or panel) and inherited below it. A compiler turns the result into both the prompt sent to the diffusion model and a 3D scene built in metres, and a camera solver places the camera so that the declared framing is the framing built. Where a declared value becomes geometry, PACE measures, field by field, how far the compiled camera and the staged render sit from the declaration, rather than asking a model to judge.
  On the 11-scene Automatic Drive screenplay, every staged single-subject panel places its subject within 1.2% of frame width of its declared position; with two or three subjects one camera pose cannot satisfy every position, and the residual is reported rather than absorbed. On 204 external director-storyboard shots, delivered head height is 1.906 times the staged target from the director's words, 1.733 from the compiled prompt, and 0.955 with the greybox control; the condition that holds framing best draws the described action least. Declaring the pose on 30 shots raises the action drawn from 58.9% to 74.4% without moving the framing. Transitions, fitted motion and human review of the generated panels remain open. Code: https://github.com/StudioPiLabs/pace-core

AI.tldr: PACE 提出一种类型化的影视规划表示，将剧本、角色/道具/场景、站位与镜头运动按层级声明并继承，经编译器同时生成扩散模型提示词与以米为单位的 3D 场景，并由相机求解器使声明取景即实际取景，从而在逐字段几何偏差上可测量地监督生成。
AI.motivation: 从剧本到成片之间存在一个"空间优先"的规划问题：谁站在哪里、摄影机从何处看到什么。纯文本提示的图像扩散模型只能依赖自身默认值来决定这一空间规划，导致取景与站位不可控、难以验证。
AI.method: 提出 PACE（Precise AI Cinematic Expression）类型化表示，覆盖剧本证据、所需角色/道具/地点、各主体站位及摄影机行为；取值在所属层级（script/scene/shot/panel）只写一次并向下层继承。编译器将表示同时转成扩散模型提示词与公制 3D 场景，相机求解器据此使声明取景与实际构建取景一致；在声明值转为几何之处，逐字段测量编译相机与实拍渲染相对声明的偏差，而非依赖模型评判。
AI.result: 在 11 场景 Automatic Drive 剧本上，所有单主体 staged panel 的站位偏差在画幅宽度的 1.2% 以内；两到三主体时单一相机位姿无法同时满足所有位置，残差被显式报告而非吸收。在 204 个外部导演分镜镜头上，交付头高为导演措辞目标的 1.906 倍、编译提示词的 1.733 倍、greybox 控制的 0.955 倍；最保取景的条件反而最不还原所描述动作。在 30 个镜头上声明姿态，可将所绘动作率从 58.9% 提升至 74.4% 且不改变取景。
AI.conclusion: PACE 以可测量、可继承的类型化空间规划替代扩散模型的空间默认值，实现了取景可控且可逐字段验证的影视生成；转场、运动拟合与生成面板的人工复核仍为待解问题。

title: WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning
summary: Adapting robots to new objects and tasks requires interaction experience that can be costly to obtain. We present WorldContact, a contact-centric world model for deformable-object manipulation, constructed from a limited set of high-quality trajectories to generate additional training data efficiently. It predicts object dynamics using larger time steps than the source numerical simulator, which requires small integration steps to resolve rapid motion and prevent interpenetration. We evaluate WorldContact across 16 shopping-bag manipulation tasks. State-rollout measurements on a single H100 GPU show a $10\times$ speedup over the source simulator, excluding rendering and disk I/O. We use the generated data to fine-tune an existing vision-language-action policy and deploy it directly on a real robot. In bag lifting, the same policy achieves 65% single-attempt success when fine-tuned on source simulation data alone, compared with 95% when fine-tuned on the dataset expanded with WorldContact. These results support efficient data generation with WorldContact for robot policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldContact——面向可变形物体操作的接触中心世界模型，用少量高质量轨迹扩充训练数据，比源数值模拟器快10倍，使策略单次成功率从65%提升至95%。
AI.motivation: 机器人适应新物体与新任务需要交互经验，而真实交互数据获取成本高昂；源数值模拟器为解析快速运动并防止穿透需极小积分步长，导致数据生成效率低。
AI.method: 构建以接触为中心（contact-centric）的世界模型WorldContact，从有限的高质量轨迹中学习可变形物体动力学，并采用比源模拟器更大的时间步进行状态预测，从而高效生成额外训练数据。
AI.result: 在16项购物袋操作任务上评估：单张H100 GPU上的状态推演相比源模拟器实现10倍加速（不含渲染与磁盘I/O）；用生成数据微调现有视觉-语言-动作策略并直接部署于真实机器人，提袋任务单次成功率由仅用源仿真数据的65%提升至95%。
AI.conclusion: WorldContact能够高效扩充数据，支持机器人策略的适应与迁移，验证了接触中心世界模型在可变形物体操作中的有效性。

title: Pretrained Medical Representations for the Practical Screening of Drug Repositioning Candidates
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
summary: Representation learning from medical code sequences in electronic health records and medical claims data has been successful in various clinical applications, such as those regarding disease prediction. However, significant challenges remain in extending this approach to the discovery of scientific hypotheses. One reason is that many existing BERT-based models fail to adequately capture the hierarchical structure of medical codes and the complex interactions between diagnoses and treatments. To address these limitations, we propose a new unified pre-training framework that explicitly integrates hierarchical sub-token aggregation, partial masking, and cross-reference mechanisms. The proposed model consistently outperformed existing methods on both pre-training objectives and downstream clinical event prediction tasks, including the onset of dementia and hospitalization. We also conducted an in silico drug repositioning case study targeting Alzheimer's disease. In the hypothesis generation step, our approach successfully rediscovered known promising drugs in a data-driven manner without relying on such external knowledge sources as the literature. Subsequently, in the hypothesis prioritization step, we introduced a Task-Adaptive Representation Approach to alleviate the over-encoding of historical prescription information within diagnostic vectors, enabling the robust prioritization of generated hypotheses. This study establishes an exploratory screening workflow for hypothesis generation and prioritization based on observational associations. Importantly, this framework is not intended to provide causal evidence, but rather to identify promising candidates for subsequent rigorous causal inference. Overall, this study demonstrates that domain-informed representation learning combined with task-adaptive representation control can enable a practical hypothesis discovery workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出统一预训练框架，融合层次子词聚合、部分掩码与交叉引用机制，学习医学编码序列表示，用于临床事件预测，并构建面向阿尔茨海默病的药物重定位假设生成与优先级排序流程。
AI.motivation: 现有基于BERT的医学编码表示学习多用于疾病预测等任务，难以支撑科学假设发现：模型未能充分捕捉医学编码的层次结构以及诊断与治疗之间的复杂交互。因此需要领域知识驱动的表示学习来支持假设生成与优先级排序。
AI.method: 提出统一预训练框架，显式整合三项机制：层次化子词聚合、部分掩码（partial masking）、交叉引用机制。在下游任务中，进一步提出任务自适应表示方法（Task-Adaptive Representation Approach），缓解诊断向量对历史处方信息的过度编码，实现假设的稳健排序。以阿尔茨海默病为目标开展计算机模拟药物重定位案例研究。
AI.result: 在预训练目标与下游临床事件预测任务（包括痴呆发病与住院）上，模型持续优于现有方法。在假设生成阶段，无需依赖文献等外部知识源，以数据驱动方式成功重新发现已知有前景的药物；在假设优先级排序阶段，任务自适应表示方法有效缓解历史处方信息的过度编码，实现稳健排序。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了一套基于观察性关联的假设生成与优先级排序探索性筛选工作流，旨在为后续严格的因果推断筛选有前景的候选对象，而非提供因果证据。整体表明领域知识驱动的表示学习结合任务自适应表示控制，可形成实用的假设发现工作流。

title: Before the Arrest: Benchmarking LLMs on Criminal Profiling from Incomplete Evidence
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings. Codes are available at: https://github.com/NLP2CT/PIJ-benchmark
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to legal and criminal justice tasks, yet existing work focuses almost exclusively on post-arrest scenarios where the suspect's identity is already known, leaving the critical pre-arrest challenge of inferring suspect characteristics from incomplete evidence largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce the Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment (PIJ), comprising 2,500 real homicide cases from five countries. PIJ evaluates LLMs across three tasks that span the entire criminal investigation pipeline: criminal profiling, which requires abductive reasoning to infer suspect attributes from fragmentary scene evidence, crime process reconstruction, which tests structured information extraction, and sentence prediction, which demands legal deductive reasoning. We evaluate 9 powerful LLMs and find that performance degrades systematically as tasks shift from explicit fact extraction to implicit reasoning over unknown suspect profiles. Categories requiring inferential reasoning, such as motivation and victim-offender relationships, remain the primary bottlenecks. Further analysis reveals substantial gaps between LLMs and human experts, along with pervasive biases in gender, age, and motive attribution. Our findings indicate that pre-arrest inference from incomplete evidence remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIJ基准（含5国2500个真实凶杀案件），评估LLM在刑侦全流程三类任务（犯罪画像、案情重建、量刑预测）上的能力，发现从显性事实抽取到隐性推理性能系统性下降，画像类推理是主要瓶颈，且存在性别、年龄、动机归因偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在司法与刑事司法领域的应用几乎集中于嫌疑人身份已知的捕后场景，而捕前阶段——从残缺证据推断嫌疑人特征——这一关键挑战尚未被探索，需要构建相应基准来填补空白。
AI.method: 构建Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment (PIJ)基准，包含来自5个国家的2500个真实凶杀案件，覆盖刑侦全流程的三类任务：犯罪画像（溯因推理，从碎片化现场证据推断嫌疑人属性）、犯罪过程重建（结构化信息抽取）、刑罚预测（法律演绎推理）；并对9个主流LLM进行评估及与人类专家的对比分析。
AI.result: 随着任务从显性事实抽取转向针对未知嫌疑人画像的隐性推理，模型性能系统性下降；动机、受害者-施害者关系等需推理的类别是主要瓶颈；LLM与人类专家存在显著差距，并普遍存在性别、年龄和动机归因偏差。
AI.conclusion: 基于不完整证据的捕前推断对现有LLM仍是开放挑战，PIJ揭示了模型在隐性推理与公平性方面的不足，指明未来研究方向。

title: Socialized UAV Cross-Task Learning: Towards Cross-Granularity Collaboration through Hierarchical Interaction
summary: Joint learning across heterogeneous tasks is often treated as task coupling through feature sharing, distillation, or auxiliary supervision. However, in cross-task learning, mismatched representational and supervisory granularities make such coupling prone to interference, teacher bias, or unidirectional collapse. We argue that cross-granularity learning is fundamentally a problem of hierarchical interaction regulation rather than simple task coupling. This issue is particularly evident in UAV perception, where visual shifts and detection--segmentation objectives naturally form coarse- and fine-grained knowledge sources. To systematically study this problem, we introduce CrossUAV, a UAV benchmark for joint object detection and instance segmentation that provides a unified evaluation platform for cross-granularity task collaboration. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration (CGSC), a progressive and adaptive framework that regulates when, where, and how tasks exchange information across network hierarchies. CGSC progressively activates cross-task interactions and adaptively adjusts the strength according to task contribution, suppressing harmful interference while exploiting complementary coarse- and fine-grained structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements on both tasks, validating hierarchical dynamic interaction as an effective mechanism for cross-granularity collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文将跨粒度学习重新定义为分层交互调控问题，提出无人机基准 CrossUAV 与渐进自适应框架 CGSC，在目标检测和实例分割上实现一致提升。
AI.motivation: 跨任务学习通常被视为通过特征共享、蒸馏或辅助监督实现的"任务耦合"，但在跨任务场景中，表征与监督粒度不匹配，导致耦合易出现干扰、教师偏差或单向坍缩。作者认为跨粒度学习本质上是分层交互调控问题，而非简单任务耦合。该问题在无人机感知中尤为突出，因为视觉偏移以及检测与分割目标天然构成粗粒度与细粒度知识来源。
AI.method: 工作包含两部分：一是提出 CrossUAV，一个面向无人机场景、联合目标检测与实例分割的基准，为跨粒度任务协作提供统一评测平台；二是提出 Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration（CGSC），一个渐进且自适应的框架，在网络的各层级上调控任务"何时、何处、如何"交换信息。CGSC 渐进式激活跨任务交互，并根据任务贡献自适应调整交互强度，从而抑制有害干扰并利用互补的粗细粒度结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在目标检测与实例分割两项任务上均取得一致提升，验证了分层动态交互是跨粒度协作的有效机制。
AI.conclusion: 跨粒度协作的关键在于对分层交互进行动态调控，而非简单的任务耦合；所提出的 CrossUAV 基准与 CGSC 框架为无人机感知中的跨粒度任务协同提供了有效方案与评测基础。

title: TacSushi: Tactile-Grounded World-Action Modeling for Dexterous Sushi Manipulation
summary: Dexterous food manipulation requires control under deformation, occlusion, and uncertain contact. We present TacSushi, a tactile-grounded, Cosmos3-based world-action policy that learns from recorded future consequences while acting on current observations. The backbone encodes current RGB, language, and hand state, and feature-wise gated fusion incorporates fingertip tactile features into the action representation. During training, a decoder conditioned on demonstrated action chunks predicts logged future visual observations, task progress, relative contact risk, and tactile summaries; this decoder is removed at deployment. Failed trials provide consequence supervision, but their actions are excluded from imitation. We train TacSushi on 340 successful and 50 failed real-robot trials and compare six methods in 600 separate rollouts across three in-distribution tasks and two out-of-distribution ingredient variants. To assess food quality beyond a single geometric threshold, we score terminal outcomes using an anchored visual-quality protocol that equally weights five human ratings and three vision-language-model ratings per rollout. Full TacSushi achieves 68.3% average in-distribution success and 37.5% out-of-distribution success, compared with 36.7%/10.0% without future-consequence supervision and 25.0%/17.5% with direct tactile concatenation in place of gated fusion. These comparisons support complementary benefits of feature-wise gated tactile fusion and training-only predictive supervision.

AI.tldr: TacSushi：一种基于Cosmos3、以触觉为基的世界-动作策略，通过训练期（仅训练）的“未来后果”预测监督与特征级门控触觉融合，实现柔性食物操作，在分布内/外任务上显著超越消融基线。
AI.motivation: 柔性食物操作面临形变、遮挡与接触不确定性。现有模仿学习仅利用成功示范的动作信号，无法充分利用失败试验所蕴含的后果信息；同时触觉信号多以简单拼接方式引入，未与动作表征进行自适应融合。
AI.method: 提出TacSushi：主干编码当前RGB、语言与手部状态；采用特征级门控融合将指尖触觉特征注入动作表征。训练时以示范动作块为条件的解码器预测被记录的未来视觉观测、任务进度、相对接触风险与触觉摘要，该解码器在部署时移除。失败试验仅提供后果监督，其动作不参与模仿。数据集为340次成功与50次失败的真实机器人试验。
AI.result: 在3个分布内任务与2个分布外食材变体的600次独立rollout中比较6种方法。完整TacSushi分布内平均成功率68.3%、分布外37.5%；去掉未来后果监督为36.7%/10.0%；以直接触觉拼接替代门控融合为25.0%/17.5%。终局质量采用锚定视觉质量协议，等权融合每轮5个人工评分与3个视觉语言模型评分。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持特征级门控触觉融合与仅训练期预测性监督两者的互补增益：前者提升触觉-动作表征整合质量，后者在不使用失败动作的前提下提取后果监督信息，共同提升柔性与分布外场景下的操作成功率。

title: MetaRTL: Meta-path Attention Enhanced Relational Table Learning
summary: Relational table learning has gained increasing attention with the widespread use of relational databases. Existing methods typically rely on deep GNN or HGNN stacks, leading to high computational costs and limited performance on large real-world databases. We propose MetaRTL, a two-stage framework for scalable and expressive relational table learning. In the first stage, MetaRTL obtains initial table embeddings via lightweight pre-training. In the second stage, it performs non-parametric message passing to derive meta-path features, which are then aggregated by an attention module, MetaAttn. By shifting computation from deep message passing to efficient meta-path aggregation, MetaRTL captures rich relational semantics while maintaining high efficiency. Experiments on 10 real-world datasets across 24 tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: MetaRTL：两阶段关系表学习框架，先轻量预训练得初始表嵌入，再以非参数化消息传递生成元路径特征并用MetaAttn聚合，兼顾表达力与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有关系表学习方法普遍依赖深层GNN或HGNN堆叠，计算开销高，且在大规模真实数据库上性能受限，亟需兼顾可扩展性与表达力的方案。
AI.method: 提出MetaRTL两阶段框架：第一阶段通过轻量预训练获得初始表嵌入；第二阶段采用非参数化消息传递推导元路径特征，并由注意力模块MetaAttn进行聚合，将计算从深层消息传递转移到高效的元路径聚合。
AI.result: 在10个真实数据集、24项任务上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MetaRTL通过将深层消息传递替换为高效元路径聚合，在保持丰富关系语义的同时显著提升效率，适配大规模真实数据库的关系表学习。

title: AURA: Adaptive Uncertainty-Routed Analysis for Email Threat Detection
summary: Email spam and phishing attacks remain a critical security threat. Adversaries increasingly exploit large language models to craft contextually convincing malicious messages, and existing spam detection systems often struggle to keep pace. Generalization across diverse and evolving attack scenarios is limited, which reduces effectiveness once these systems are deployed in practice. This paper introduces Adaptive Uncertainty-Routed Analysis (AURA), a multimodal email threat detection system that analyzes both the content of an email and its embedded URLs. AURA is built around two layers: the first quantifies prediction uncertainty from a URL classifier, and only ambiguous messages are escalated to a fine-tuned transformer encoder for semantic analysis. The system is evaluated on eight heterogeneous training corpora together with two held-out real-world corpora spanning a decade of adversarial campaigns. AURA reaches a macro F1-score of 0.9858 in-distribution, and on NazPhish-Eval and GuenterTrap-Eval it maintains 0.9502 and 0.9436, respectively, which is evidence of robust generalization under genuine distribution shift.

AI.tldr: AURA是一个多模态邮件威胁检测系统，通过URL分类器的不确定性量化与路由机制，仅将模糊样本升级至微调Transformer编码器进行语义分析，在八个训练语料和两个跨十年真实语料上实现稳健泛化。
AI.motivation: 邮件垃圾与钓鱼攻击仍是关键安全威胁，且攻击者日益利用大语言模型生成语境上更具说服力的恶意邮件。现有检测系统难以跟上攻击演化，跨多样且不断变化的攻击场景泛化能力有限，实际部署后效果下降。
