These findings support structural pre-organization as an explicit design and evaluation target for omission control and motivate evaluating context construction jointly with its utilization in judgment.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体框架 MaSCoD，将候选第三变量与局部结构模式的预组织作为因果发现中"过早遗漏"控制的显式目标；跨数据集/骨干实验显示其呈现保留—选择性权衡，而非一致最优。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的因果发现研究多聚焦于直接边判断，候选图生成阶段很少把"过早遗漏潜在相关因果关系"作为显式设计目标，导致召回受限且缺少针对性评估。
AI.method: MaSCoD 为多智能体框架，在直接边判断之前先组织候选第三变量与局部结构模式（Phase 1 结构假设）；在 Auto-MPG、DWD、Sachs 上以 GPT-5.4 为主骨干、GPT-4o 复现，进行 Full 与 No Phase 1 对比、参考边基线对比、部分消融及分阶段分析。
AI.result: 在全部 6 个数据集—骨干组合中，Full 的平均 Recall 与 F1 均高于 No Phase 1，但同时提高假阳性率；参考边保留优势仅在 DWD+GPT-5.4、Sachs+GPT-4o 出现，并非普遍成立；部分消融表明同时提供两类信息组件并不总优于仅提供一种；分阶段分析显示 Full 与 No Phase 1 的保留差距在直接边判断后即已存在，而 reconciliation 在 Sachs 上为 Full 引入额外参考边损失。
AI.conclusion: 结构预组织应作为遗漏控制的显式设计与评估目标；上下文构建需与其在判断阶段的实际利用方式联合评估，而非假定更多信息必然更好。

title: CellRFT: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
summary: Predicting cellular responses to perturbations supports the study of gene function, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic strategies. Despite advances in single-cell perturbation modeling, existing models typically optimize surrogate losses that do not directly reflect the biological criteria used for evaluation, so better data fitting need not yield better biological predictions. To address this mismatch, we introduce \textbf{CellRFT}, a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that uses biological evaluation as direct training feedback. CellRFT uses policy-gradient optimization to learn from non-differentiable evaluations of generated cell populations and integrates multiple biological rewards through hierarchical reward aggregation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate CellRFT's applicability across different pretrained models and effectiveness in improving perturbation prediction, reveal that optimizing one biological criterion can help or hinder others, and show that complementary rewards can improve criteria beyond those directly optimized, offering a way to probe how biological metrics shape model behavior, with the potential to inform evaluation design. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: CellRFT：用生物评估作为直接训练反馈的强化微调框架，通过策略梯度与分层奖励聚合优化单细胞扰动预测。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞扰动模型多以代理损失训练，而该损失并不直接对应评估所用的生物学指标，导致数据拟合更好未必带来更好的生物学预测，存在训练目标与评估目标不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 提出CellRFT强化微调框架：将生物学评估作为直接训练反馈，采用策略梯度优化，从生成细胞群的非可微评估中学习，并通过分层奖励聚合整合多个生物学奖励。
AI.result: 实验表明CellRFT可适用于不同预训练模型并有效提升扰动预测；发现优化某一生物学指标可能帮助或损害其他指标；互补奖励可改善未直接优化的指标。
AI.conclusion: CellRFT为探究生物学指标如何塑造模型行为提供途径，并有望为评估指标设计提供参考，代码将公开。

title: The Public Discourse Corpus (PDC): A Speaker-Attributed Dataset for Valence and Epistemic Modality with Target Speaker Participation
summary: We introduce the \textbf{Public Discourse Corpus (PDC)}, the first dataset of public-figure interview speech jointly annotated for affective valence and epistemic modality. The corpus contains 998 videos from 100 speakers across seven professional domains, yielding 186,642 sentences (3.1 million words) after sentence segmentation and filtering. To ensure that all retained videos contain analyzable speech from the intended speaker, we introduce \textbf{Target Speaker Participation (TSP)}---a five-category annotation taxonomy with documented inter-annotator reliability ($κ= 0.616$)---as a key methodological contribution that any corpus construction project can adopt. Target-speaker turns are separated from interviewer and third-party speech through an \textbf{audio-first diarization pipeline} combining local Whisper ASR with pyannote speaker separation, released as an open-source implementation. We release the annotated corpus, the annotation tools, the cross-provider validation sample, and the complete processing pipeline. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ictchenbo/public-discourse-corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了公共话语语料库（PDC），这是首个同时标注情感效价与认知情态的公众人物访谈语音数据集，含998个视频、100位说话人、186,642句（310万词），并提出目标说话人参与度（TSP）标注体系与音频优先的说话人分离流程。
AI.motivation: 公众人物访谈语音是研究情感与认知情态表达的重要资源，但缺乏同时标注情感效价和认知情态、且能确保语音来自目标说话人的公开语料库。
AI.method: 构建PDC语料库：采集100位说话人跨七个专业领域的998个视频，经分句与过滤得到186,642句；提出五类别的目标说话人参与度（TSP）标注体系（κ=0.616）；采用音频优先的说话人分离流程，结合本地Whisper ASR与pyannote说话人分离，将目标说话人话轮与主持人及第三方语音区分开。
AI.result: 得到186,642句、约310万词的双维度标注语料；TSP标注达到可接受的标注者间信度（κ=0.616）；说话人分离流程以开源实现形式发布。
AI.conclusion: 公开语料库、标注工具、跨提供方验证样本及完整处理流程，为情感效价与认知情态研究提供可复用的资源与方法学参考。

title: Beyond the Foreground: FOV-Aware Polyp Image Synthesis via Lesion-Guided Adaptive Mucosal Context Propagation
summary: Synthetic image and mask pairs can alleviate scarce colonoscopy annotations, but realistic synthesis requires preserving the supplied lesion while generating compatible mucosa. Existing foreground-guided methods treat all non-foreground pixels as background and rely mainly on local integration. Directly applying them to colonoscopy causes two problems: non-mucosal black regions contaminate generated tissue, and local reasoning produces inconsistent mucosal texture and illumination. We propose LAMP, the first foreground-guided framework for polyp image synthesis based on lesion-guided adaptive mucosal context propagation. LAMP explicitly separates the lesion, valid mucosa, and camera exterior using a field-of-view (FOV) mask. Lesion-to-Mucosa cross-attention extracts lesion appearance conditions for valid-mucosa locations, while FOV-constrained multidirectional Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value propagates them over legal tissue support. An adaptive gate then controls their residual fusion into the diffusion U-Net. Extensive experiments on five polyp datasets demonstrate that LAMP substantially outperforms existing methods in overall generation quality and consistently improves five downstream segmentation models. Our code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP.

AI.tldr: 提出LAMP框架，基于病灶引导的自适应黏膜上下文传播，实现结肠镜息肉图像合成，显式分离病灶、有效黏膜与镜头外部区域，在五个数据集上显著优于现有方法并提升下游分割性能。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜标注稀缺，合成图像-掩码对可缓解该问题，但真实合成需在保留给定病灶的同时生成兼容黏膜。现有前景引导方法将所有非前景像素视为背景且主要依赖局部整合，直接应用于结肠镜会导致两个问题：非黏膜黑色区域污染生成组织，局部推理造成黏膜纹理与光照不一致。
AI.method: LAMP是首个基于病灶引导自适应黏膜上下文传播的前景引导息肉图像合成框架。使用视场（FOV）掩码显式分离病灶、有效黏膜与镜头外部；通过病灶到黏膜的交叉注意力为有效黏膜位置提取病灶外观条件，并借助FOV约束的多方向Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value在合法组织支撑区域传播；最后用自适应门控将其残差融合进扩散U-Net。
AI.result: 在五个息肉数据集上的大量实验表明，LAMP在整体生成质量上显著优于现有方法，并持续提升五个下游分割模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: LAMP通过显式区域分离与全局上下文传播有效解决了结肠镜息肉合成中的背景污染与纹理光照不一致问题，验证了其在生成质量与下游任务上的有效性，代码将开源。

title: Equivariant Filter Design for Acoustic and Depth Aided Inertial Navigation Systems
summary: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) navigating without GPS typically fuse inertial measurements with acoustic Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) velocities and pressure-derived depth. Posing the navigation state on a Lie group improves accuracy and consistency. However, state-of-the-art filters based on the Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (IEKF) append the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) biases as a Euclidean extension, which breaks the group-affine structure required for exact log-linear error dynamics, causing the reported covariance to degrade alongside the estimate. We apply the Tangent-Group (TG) symmetry, which carries the biases within the geometry of the state space, to derive an Equivariant Filter (EqF) for this system, leaving zero linearization error in the navigation states and second-order error only in the biases. We develop an equivariant output model for the DVL, whose update incurs only third-order linearization error, together with a direct pressure output. Monte Carlo simulations benchmark the TG-EqF against a Two-Frame-Group IEKF and a Multiplicative EKF. The TG-EqF reduces error by 18--25\% against both alternatives in each of attitude, velocity, and position. The main benefit is in the covariance it estimates: its Average Normalized Estimation Error Squared (ANEES) stays closer to its nominal value of one than that of the others. Offline analysis on AUV field data corroborates the findings of the simulations, demonstrating reduced position drift.

AI.tldr: 本文将IMU零偏纳入切群(TG)对称的几何状态空间，为AUV的DVL/深度/惯性组合导航推导等变滤波器(TG-EqF)，实现导航状态零线性化误差、仅零偏存二阶误差，并在仿真与实测中优于IEKF和MEKF。
AI.motivation: 无GPS的水下AUV依赖惯性/DVL/深度组合导航；基于IEKF的方法把IMU零偏作为欧氏扩展量附加，破坏了群仿射结构，导致无法获得精确的对数线性误差动力学，估计精度与协方差一致性同时退化。
AI.method: 采用Tangent-Group(TG)对称，将零偏内嵌于状态空间的几何结构中，推导该系统的等变滤波器(EqF)；为DVL设计等变输出模型(更新仅引入三阶线性化误差)，并加入直接压力输出模型。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真中，TG-EqF相对Two-Frame-Group IEKF与Multiplicative EKF在姿态、速度、位置上误差降低18–25%；协方差一致性更优，ANEES更接近标称值1。AUV实测数据的离线分析印证仿真结论，位置漂移减小。
AI.conclusion: 将零偏纳入TG几何可保持群仿射结构，获得低线性化误差与更一致的协方差估计，TG-EqF是AUV组合导航中优于IEKF与MEKF的滤波方案。

title: Not All AI Agents Are Equal: Characterizing Resource and Performance Dynamics
summary: LLM-based AI agents process user requests through iterative reasoning and tool execution, often involving the invocation of remote LLM APIs with local tool containers. This execution model can make the optimization of agent serving difficult because latency, local resource demand, and container bottlenecks inter-mix across requests. However, the current agent ecosystem runs without much consideration of resource dynamics, which results in significant waste of the precious resources. This paper analyzes the resource inter-mix of AI agents for three representative tasks: retrieval-augmented question answering, web search, and software coding. To this end, we characterize the latency with respect to the resource dynamics of processing multiple requests and tasks concurrently. Our measurements show that agents have a wide range of behaviors depending on tasks, so that even the same tool can differ substantially in resource dynamics. We also find that running multiple requests concurrently exposes task-dependent bottlenecks in resource dynamics such as CPU, disk I/O, and memory. Furthermore, we uncover that faster LLM responses or more CPU cores do not always accelerate agents. Based on these observations, we demonstrate new optimization opportunities that exploit the resource dynamics of tasks: CPU-aware tool admission and task-aware CPU allocation. Our results show that the latency of CPU-sensitive agent tasks improves $\sim$5.4$\times$, and the average latency across multiple tasks is reduced $\sim$32% compared to native agents.

AI.tldr: 论文分析基于LLM的AI代理在迭代推理与工具执行中的资源耦合问题，针对检索增强问答、网页搜索和软件编程三类任务进行刻画，发现任务相关瓶颈并提出CPU感知工具准入和任务感知CPU分配优化，CPU敏感任务延迟提升约5.4倍，多任务平均延迟降低约32%。
AI.motivation: LLM代理通过迭代推理与工具执行处理请求，通常涉及远程LLM API调用与本地工具容器。这种执行模式使延迟、本地资源需求和容器瓶颈跨请求交织，导致代理服务优化困难。而当前代理生态在运行时基本不考虑资源动态，造成宝贵资源的显著浪费，因此需要分析AI代理的资源交织特性并探索优化机会。
AI.method: 针对检索增强问答、网页搜索和软件编程三类代表性任务，刻画并发处理多请求和多任务时相对于资源动态的延迟表现，开展系统测量以分析资源交织行为。基于观察结果，提出并验证两类优化：CPU感知的工具准入（CPU-aware tool admission）和任务感知的CPU分配（task-aware CPU allocation）。
AI.result: 代理行为随任务差异显著，即使同一工具在不同任务下资源动态也差异较大；并发多请求会暴露任务相关的资源动态瓶颈，包括CPU、磁盘I/O和内存；更快的LLM响应或更多CPU核心并不总能加速代理。基于上述观察的优化使CPU敏感代理任务延迟改善约5.4倍，多任务平均延迟较原生代理降低约32%。
AI.conclusion: AI代理的延迟与资源动态高度任务相关，资源瓶颈在并发场景下呈现任务依赖性，简单增加LLM速度或CPU核心并不必然带来加速。利用任务资源动态进行CPU感知工具准入与任务感知CPU分配，可显著改善代理服务性能，表明面向资源动态的调度优化是代理服务的重要方向。

title: Past, Future, All at Once: Mitigating Stability-Plasticity Dilemma via Post-hoc JANUS Rectification
summary: Fine-tuning foundation models on new tasks inevitably suffer from catastrophic forgetting. While existing works attempt to mitigate this on the basis of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, they adopted an overly restrictive Subspace Orthogonality condition. In this paper, we introduce a purely post-hoc and tuning-agnostic weight rectification framework that achieves Parameter Space Orthogonality, which is the necessary and sufficient condition for preserving historical performance to the first order. By projecting parameter updates into the JAcobian NUll Space (JANUS), our method significantly recovers compromised historical knowledge without interfering with the underlying fine-tuning process. To overcome the local validity of the Jacobian approximation, we further propose a Multi-step Adaptive Rectification mechanism that utilizes the JANUS shift to dynamically verify the valid trust region and adjust step sizes. Coupled with our proposed ghost projection, ghost orientation comparison, and sequence-level singular value decomposition compression techniques, JANUS also achieves great temporal and spatial efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that JANUS seamlessly integrates with various fine-tuning methods, significantly mitigating the stability-plasticity dilemma by recovering historical knowledge while preserving downstream task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了JANUS，一个纯后处理且与调优方法无关的权重矫正框架，通过将参数更新投影到雅可比零空间实现参数空间正交性，从而在微调基础模型时有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 在基础模型上微调新任务会不可避免地导致灾难性遗忘。现有方法多基于参数高效微调技术来缓解该问题，但它们采用了过于严格的子空间正交条件，限制了效果。
AI.method: 提出参数空间正交性，认为这是保持历史性能的一阶充要条件。方法将参数更新投影到雅可比零空间（JANUS），在不干扰原有微调过程的情况下恢复历史知识。为克服雅可比近似的局部有效性局限，引入多步自适应矫正机制，利用JANUS位移动态验证有效信任域并调整步长。同时提出幽灵投影、幽灵方向比较和序列级奇异值分解压缩等技术以提升时空效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，JANUS能与多种微调方法无缝集成，在保持下游任务适配能力的同时恢复历史知识，显著缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。
AI.conclusion: JANUS作为一种后处理、与调优无关的权重矫正框架，通过参数空间正交性与雅可比零空间投影，在提升微调后历史知识保留的同时保证下游适配，是一种高效且通用的缓解灾难性遗忘方案。

title: Lens: Bringing the Right Semantic Perspective into Focus for Training-Free Multimodal Representation Learning
summary: High-quality representations are essential for a wide range of downstream tasks. Dedicated embedding models are explicitly optimized for representation learning, yet their training data are often more limited in scale and diversity than the massive corpora used to pretrain modern large language models and multimodal large language models. Large-scale pretraining and instruction following enable autoregressive models to select relevant evidence, integrate multimodal information, and infer semantics under different task perspectives, creating a distinctive opportunity for training-free representation learning. However, our analysis reveals that existing semantic-elicitation methods do not reliably orient the extracted states toward the semantic perspective required by the downstream task. Consequently, the resulting representations often remain dominated by salient input content. We characterize this problem as semantic perspective misalignment and propose Lens, a training-free framework that makes representation readout task-directed. Semantic Perspective Anchoring associates the task-required perspective with a task-specific readout phrase, specifying the interpretive role of the positions later used for extraction. Contextualized Phrase Readout places the same phrase after the complete input and aggregates its token states, combining full-context access with the anchored perspective. The resulting representation reflects task-conditioned evidence integration and inference rather than a generic summary of salient content. Without parameter updates, architectural modification, or reranking, Lens achieves an overall Precision@1 of 63.9 across all 36 MMEB datasets, outperforming the closest same-backbone training-free embedding baseline by 10.2 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出免训练框架Lens，通过“语义视角锚定”与“上下文短语读出”解决语义视角错位问题，在36个MMEB数据集上取得63.9的Precision@1，超过最强同骨干免训练基线10.2分。
AI.motivation: 高质量表示对下游任务至关重要。专用嵌入模型虽为表示学习优化，但训练数据的规模与多样性远不及预训练大语言模型和多模态大模型的语料。大规模预训练与指令跟随使自回归模型能在不同任务视角下筛选证据、整合多模态信息并推理语义，为免训练表示学习提供了契机。然而现有语义激发方法无法可靠地将抽取状态导向下游任务所需的语义视角，导致表示被显著的输入内容主导，作者将此问题定义为“语义视角错位”。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架Lens，使表示读出受任务引导。包含两个组件：1）语义视角锚定（Semantic Perspective Anchoring）：将任务所需视角与任务特定的读出短语关联，明确后续抽取位置所承担的解释角色；2）上下文短语读出（Contextualized Phrase Readout）：将同一短语置于完整输入之后，并聚合其token状态，从而兼具全上下文访问能力与已锚定的视角。最终表示体现任务条件下的证据整合与推理，而非对显著内容的通用摘要。
AI.result: 无需参数更新、架构修改或重排序，Lens在全部36个MMEB数据集上取得总体Precision@1为63.9，比最接近的同骨干免训练嵌入基线高出10.2分。
AI.conclusion: Lens通过任务导向的读出机制有效缓解语义视角错位，证明无需训练即可从自回归模型中提取任务条件化的高质量表示，并在多任务多模态嵌入基准上显著优于现有免训练方法。

title: An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras
comment: @inproceedings{ikura2026event, title={An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras}, author={Ikura, Mikihiro and Gava, Luna and Wu, Jiahang and Glover, Arren and Bartolozzi, Chiara}, year={2026}, booktitle={ECCV 2026 Workshop-Event-Based Multimodal Vision: From Imaging to Perception and Understanding} }
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, high temporal resolution perception for real-time vision tasks such as robotics.The novel circuitry (i.e. asynchronous, independent pixels) that enables these advantages also introduces new algorithmic challenges. Velocity-invariant representations alleviate missing observations under slow motion and motion blur under fast motion, but most discard temporal information by converting events into image-like representations. We propose Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF), a real-time velocity-invariant representation that preserves raw events while consistently handling fast motion, stationary scenes, and independently moving objects. SCARF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both computational efficiency and representation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SCARF——一种实时、速度不变的事件相机表示方法，保留原始事件并一致处理快速运动、静止场景与独立运动物体，在计算效率和表示质量上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备低延迟、高时间分辨率的优势，但其异步独立像素电路带来新的算法挑战。速度不变表示可缓解慢速下的观测缺失和快速下的运动模糊，但多数方法将事件转为类图像表示，丢弃了时间信息。
AI.method: 提出Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields（SCARF），一种实时速度不变表示，直接在原始事件上保留事件数据，并一致地处理快速运动、静止场景和独立运动物体。
AI.result: 在计算效率和表示质量两方面均取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: SCARF在保留原始事件时间信息的同时实现速度不变性，兼顾实时性与表示质量，为事件相机的实时视觉任务提供有效表示方案。

title: LIFD: Anchored Diffusion for 3D-Aware Scene Memory in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation under partial observability requires spatial information that extends beyond the current view. Geometry-aware RGB features describe visible structure, but previously observed regions may disappear as the robot or scene moves. Maintaining a useful scene representation therefore requires retaining observation history while inferring missing content without losing its connection to visible evidence. We introduce LIFD (Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do), a framework for persistent, 3D-aware scene memory. LIFD learns a scene-token representation from multi-view agreement and completes it from a single RGB view and recurrent memory. A rectified-flow model generates the tokens while Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention conditions completion on current geometric features. Compact slot features connect this representation to a manipulation policy. Multi-view and geometric supervision are used during representation learning; deployment requires one RGB camera, proprioception, and a task instruction. LIFD (Staged) reaches 91.6% average success on LIBERO and 79.8% on MetaWorld, improving LIBERO average success by 3.1 percentage points over Joint training. On four UR5e task families with ten demonstrations per family, it achieves 56.0% mean success, compared with 40.5% for OpenVLA-7B.

AI.tldr: 提出LIFD框架，通过学习并补全3D场景token记忆，实现部分可观测下的机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境下，机器人操作需要超出当前视野的空间信息。几何感知RGB特征仅描述可见结构，随着机器人或场景移动，先前观测区域会消失；因此场景表示需在保留观测历史的同时，推断缺失内容且不丢失与可见证据的联系。
AI.method: LIFD（Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do）：1）从多视角一致性中学习场景token表示，并依据单张RGB视图与循环记忆进行补全；2）采用rectified-flow模型生成token，Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention以当前几何特征为条件引导补全；3）用紧凑slot特征连接表示与操作策略。训练时使用多视角与几何监督；部署仅需单目RGB、本体感知和任务指令。
AI.result: LIFD（Staged）在LIBERO上平均成功率91.6%，MetaWorld上79.8%，较Joint training在LIBERO平均提升3.1个百分点；在四个UR5e任务族（每族10条示范）上平均成功率56.0%，OpenVLA-7B为40.5%。
AI.conclusion: LIFD通过生成式3D场景token记忆实现持久、几何感知的表示，在仿真与真实操作任务上均优于基线，且部署仅需单目相机。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Agentic AI for Networked Low-Altitude UAVs
comment: Agentic AI, neuro-symbolic AI, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), autonomous decision-making, networked UAV systems
summary: Networked low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) need reliable and adaptive decision-making capabilities to operate under uncertain observations, dynamic environments, and intermittent connectivity, while many existing agentic systems remain limited by hallucination risks, data dependence, and weak generalization. This article investigates neuro-symbolic agentic AI (NSAAI) as a framework for combining neural grounding, symbolic reasoning, and closed-loop agentic interaction to support more reliable and adaptive UAV autonomy. We first examine its capability foundations in data efficiency, compositional generalization, continual learning, and zero-shot transfer, and then develop a reference architecture integrating task and goal management, neuro-symbolic planning, verification and metacognition, skill execution and network interaction, and shared knowledge and memory. An urban fire-inspection case implemented in LAESim illustrates how a UAV can coordinate sensing and cloud access under intermittent connectivity, reuse a verified image-delivery skill, and satisfy explicit evidence conditions before completing the mission. The results illustrate the potential of NSAAI to support reusable skills, evidence-grounded decision-making, and adaptive mission execution in networked UAV systems. We further discuss key research directions in uncertainty-aware reasoning, knowledge and skill expansion, adaptive self-monitoring, and standardized evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文将神经符号智能体AI（NSAAI）作为支撑网络化低空无人机自主性的框架，提出融合神经接地、符号推理与闭环智能体交互的参考架构，并通过LAESim中的城市火灾巡检案例验证其在间歇连接下的可复用技能、证据驱动决策与自适应任务执行潜力。
AI.motivation: 网络化低空无人机需在不确定观测、动态环境和间歇连接下实现可靠且自适应的决策，而现有智能体系统受限于幻觉风险、数据依赖和泛化能力弱。
AI.method: 首先分析NSAAI在数据效率、组合泛化、持续学习和零样本迁移方面的能力基础；随后构建参考架构，集成任务与目标管理、神经符号规划、验证与元认知、技能执行与网络交互、共享知识与记忆等模块；并在LAESim中实现城市火灾巡检案例。
AI.result: 案例表明无人机可在间歇连接下协调感知与云端访问，复用已验证的图像传递技能，并在满足显式证据条件后完成任务，体现了可复用技能、证据驱动决策与自适应任务执行的潜力。
AI.conclusion: NSAAI有望提升网络化无人机系统的可靠性与自适应性；未来研究方向包括不确定性感知推理、知识与技能扩展、自适应自监控及标准化评估。

title: EPIG-Tree: Compute-Optimal Branching for Gradient-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reward-based reinforcement learning for language models, exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), collapses an entire stochastic trajectory into a single scalar reward. This is clean and scalable, but it explores and allocates reward inefficiently: a trajectory may contain many causal decisions, recovery attempts, and environment-randomness events, yet every token or action inherits one trajectory-level advantage. We study tree-based rollout construction as a compute-allocation problem for policy-gradient estimation. Our central claim is that branches should be placed not where the policy is merely uncertain, but where an additional branch most reduces uncertainty about the policy gradient per unit of compute. From a law-of-total-variance decomposition of the local policy-gradient random variable, we derive two allocation laws: new branches reduce decision uncertainty, while repeated suffix rollouts reduce continuation uncertainty. The resulting EPIG-Tree score allocates branches using the already computed rollouts. It estimates occupancy- and score-weighted value uncertainty, along with a suffix law $n_e \propto w_e \|\nabla_θ\log π(a_e|h_e)\| σ_e / \sqrt{c_e}$. Empirically, EPIG reduces gradient MSE in cloned-state control, winning in all nine dense continuous-control environments of a 13-environment sweep and recovering the reference gradient direction near-perfectly, and it improves frozen-LLM gradient calibration relative to entropy branching. In online single-turn math, tree-local credit beats flat GRPO, while branch placement is secondary to token-level credit assignment. In online multi-turn Wordle, EPIG attains the highest final win rate (0.850), overtaking flat GRPO, which saturates early at 0.790, and entropy branching as training proceeds, confirming that the gradient-estimation advantage transfers to a stateful, large-action setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于树的 rollout 构造作为策略梯度估计中的算力分配问题，提出 EPIG-Tree 分支分配准则：分支应放在"每单位算力最能降低策略梯度不确定性"处，从而比均匀/熵式分支更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有基于奖励的强化学习（如 GRPO）将整条随机轨迹压缩为单一标量奖励，虽简洁可扩展但探索与奖励分配低效：轨迹中大量因果决策、恢复尝试与环境随机性事件共享同一轨迹级优势，导致策略梯度估计方差高、算力利用不佳。作者希望改进分支（rollout）的放置方式以提升策略梯度估计效率。
AI.method: 将树式 rollout 构造形式化为策略梯度估计的算力分配问题；对局部策略梯度随机变量做全方差分解，导出两条分配律：新分支降低"决策不确定性"，重复后缀 rollout 降低"延续不确定性"。据此提出 EPIG-Tree 打分，利用已计算的 rollout 估计占用度与分数加权的价值不确定性，并给出后缀律 n_e ∝ w_e ‖∇_θ log π(a_e|h_e)‖ σ_e / √c_e。
AI.result: 在克隆状态控制中降低梯度 MSE，在 13 个稠密连续控制环境扫描中于全部 9 个环境胜出并近乎完美恢复参考梯度方向；在冻结 LLM 梯度校准上优于熵分支。在线单轮数学任务中，树局部 credit 优于扁平 GRPO，分支放置作用次于 token 级 credit 分配。在线多轮 Wordle 中 EPIG 取得最高最终胜率 0.850，超过早期饱和于 0.790 的扁平 GRPO 与熵分支。
AI.conclusion: 分支位置应由对策略梯度不确定性的边际降低（按算力归一）驱动，而非仅依据策略不确定性。EPIG-Tree 的梯度估计优势可迁移到有状态、大动作空间任务；同时表明 token/局部 credit 分配可能比分支放置更关键。

title: QCPruner: Query-Conditioned Population Coverage for Visual Token Pruning
summary: The high visual-token load in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) motivates training-free pruning to reduce later-layer computation, but under a fixed budget, pruning must preserve query-relevant evidence while avoiding redundancy. Existing methods rank tokens, diversify selected subsets, or optimize coverage without using a shared per-visual query utility to weight both visual targets and candidate representatives. We introduce QCPruner, which makes both roles query-conditioned through bilateral utility weighting. Using keyword-matched query anchors, QCPruner fuses two cross-modal cues into utility and applies it to both visual targets and candidate representatives within visual-affinity-based coverage. The resulting nonnegative facility-location objective is monotone and submodular, retains the standard (1-1/e) greedy guarantee, and requires no model training or parameter updates. Across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-Video, and Qwen2.5-VL, QCPruner achieves the highest average relative performance among evaluated complete-system pruning methods at every reported token budget. At 32 of 576 tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it retains 96.1% of unpruned performance, versus 93.9% for the strongest evaluated baseline. At 256 of 1296 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the corresponding values are 96.7% and 92.5%.

AI.tldr: QCPruner提出一种双侧效用加权的免训练视觉token剪枝方法，在保持(1-1/e)贪心保证下提升多模态大模型各预算下的性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型视觉token负载高，需免训练剪枝以减少后层计算；但在固定预算下，剪枝须保留查询相关证据并避免冗余。现有方法仅对token排序、做子集多样化或优化覆盖，未使用共享的逐视觉查询效用同时加权视觉目标与候选代表。
AI.method: QCPruner通过双侧效用加权重构两个角色：用关键词匹配的查询锚点，融合两种跨模态线索得到效用，并将其同时作用于视觉目标与候选代表，嵌入基于视觉亲和度的覆盖中；由此构造的非负设施选址目标单调且子模，保留标准(1-1/e)贪心保证，无需模型训练或参数更新。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-Video与Qwen2.5-VL上，QCPruner在每个报告的token预算下，于所评估的完整系统剪枝方法中取得最高平均相对性能。LLaVA-1.5-7B在576个token中保留32个时保持未剪枝性能的96.1%，最强基线为93.9%；Qwen2.5-VL-7B在1296个token中保留256个时分别为96.7%与92.5%。
AI.conclusion: QCPruner以查询条件化的双侧效用加权统一视觉目标与候选代表，在免训练、具理论保证的前提下，跨多种MLLM与预算稳定优于现有完整系统剪枝方法。

title: Affective Shared Autonomy: Temporal Affect Dynamics and Subjective Evaluation in Bimanual Teleoperation Tasks
summary: Physical teleoperation integrates human cognitive flexibility with robotic precision, yet demanding manipulation tasks frequently induce severe cognitive workload, acute frustration, and execution breakdown. Conventional shared autonomy paradigms rely primarily on task-based rules, such as spatial error boundaries, which disregard the operator's transient affective state and risk misaligned control interventions. To address this limitation, we propose an affect-aware shared autonomy teleoperation framework that dynamically modulates robotic assistance based on real-time operator state estimation. The system estimates operator affective states from synchronized facial video, cardiac signals, and bilateral arm kinematics, outputting a seven-state affective distribution and a three-category operational abstraction (neutral, productive, adverse). Affect-aware assistance is selectively triggered when the user is detected in a continuous adverse state, preserving task-positive engagement without unnecessary disruption. The empirical user study ($N = 30$) confirms that the proposed affective assistance increases the productive states by up to 39.7% without compromising user agency. The collected dataset represents the first multimodal dataset that provides continuous visual, physiological, and operator's bilateral motion tracking of temporal affective state shifts during bimanual teleoperation. Our multimodal fusion model outperforms zero-shot baselines (Qwen, MiniCPM-V) in tracking temporal state dynamics. This real-world deployment offers a new human-centric framework that integrates visual, physiological, and motion tracking for physical human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出情感感知共享自主遥操作框架，基于面部视频、心电信号与双臂运动学实时估计操作者情感状态，仅在持续不利状态下触发辅助，用户研究（N=30）显示有效状态提升最多39.7%，且不损害用户自主性。
AI.motivation: 物理遥操作融合人类认知灵活性与机器人精度，但高负荷任务易引发严重认知负荷、挫败感与执行中断。传统共享自主范式主要依赖任务规则（如空间误差边界），忽视操作者的瞬时情感状态，易导致控制干预错位。
AI.method: 提出情感感知共享自主遥操作框架，根据实时操作者状态估计动态调节机器人辅助。系统从同步的面部视频、心脏信号和双臂运动学中估计情感状态，输出七状态情感分布与三类别操作抽象（中性、有效、不利）；仅当检测到用户处于持续不利状态时选择性触发辅助。
AI.result: N=30的实证用户研究表明，所提情感辅助将有效状态提升最多39.7%，且未损害用户自主性。所采集数据集为首个在双手遥操作中提供连续视觉、生理与操作者双臂运动追踪、刻画时序情感状态变化的多模态数据集。多模态融合模型在跟踪时序状态动态方面优于零样本基线（Qwen、MiniCPM-V）。
AI.conclusion: 该真实世界部署提供了一种以人为中心的新框架，整合视觉、生理与运动追踪用于物理人机交互。

title: Customizable and Jointly Optimized Route Planning: A Deep Architecture Enabling Differentiable Shortest-Path Search
summary: With the widespread use of online navigation and ride-hailing services, achieving optimal route planning for diverse user preferences has recently attracted increasing attention. Classic graph algorithms for pathfinding use heuristic cost functions to define edge weight, thus providing no optimality guarantee of route quality. Prior data-driven approaches equating ground truth of the optimal route with user trajectory, which is however moderately influenced by the navigation service, suffers from the feedback loop problem. To address these issues, we propose a deep architecture that is able to jointly optimize cost functions and route-ranking model towards any route preference. First, we run a multi-objective Dijkstra algorithm offline to collect the set of Pareto optimal routes, deeming it as the complete candidate set. Exploiting the property of such a set, we design a neural network structure that emulates shortest-path search and route ranking in an end-to-end differentiable manner. Second, we define route preference as a task of constrained optimization of route attributes, and propose a novel loss function that optimizes a single-objective variable, with other variables strictly under constraints. We conduct extensive experiments on real-world datasets. The results show that our architecture significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in route quality and customizability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端可微的深度架构，联合优化代价函数与路线排序模型，以支持多样化路线偏好，在真实数据集上路线质量与可定制性显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在线导航与网约车服务普及使多样化路线规划需求上升。经典图搜索依赖启发式代价函数定义边权，无法保证路线质量最优；已有数据驱动方法把用户轨迹视作最优路线真值，但轨迹受导航服务影响，导致反馈回路问题。
AI.method: 1) 离线运行多目标 Dijkstra 算法，收集 Pareto 最优路线集合作为完整候选集；2) 利用该集合性质设计神经网络结构，以端到端可微方式模拟最短路径搜索与路线排序；3) 将路线偏好定义为对路线属性的约束优化任务，提出新损失函数，优化单目标变量并严格约束其余变量。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上进行大量实验，结果表明该架构在路线质量和可定制性方面显著优于当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化代价函数与排序模型并引入约束优化损失，可在避免反馈回路问题的同时实现面向任意偏好的高质量、可定制路线规划。

title: Dynamic Generalized Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
summary: Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport (GW-OT) extends classical optimal transport by introducing structure-aware transport cost. This is particularly relevant for spatial transcriptomics, where dynamical reconstruction should preserve tissue structure in addition to matching expression patterns. While static formulations have been widely used for such structure-aware alignment, a general dynamic formulation for reconstructing continuous trajectories is still missing. We introduce Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE), a theoretical and computational framework to generalize GW-OT dynamically in a simulation-free manner. We formulate a broad class of static and dynamic Quadratic-form OT (QOT) through path actions and prove the static dynamic equivalence. We further develop travelling-pair flow matching, which allows interacting conditional paths and marginalizes their interactions into a single vector field. On synthetic and real spatial transcriptomics data, TP-DATE better preserves spatial structure and improves continuous 3D dynamics reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TP-DATE 框架，将 Gromov–Wasserstein 最优传输动态化，通过路径作用量统一静态与动态二次型 OT，并开发 travelling-pair 流匹配以实现免模拟的连续轨迹重建，在空间转录组数据上更好保留空间结构并改进 3D 动态重建。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组的动态重建不仅需匹配表达模式，还需保留组织结构。GW-OT 虽引入结构感知传输代价，但现有工作多为静态对齐，缺乏用于重建连续轨迹的通用动态表述。
AI.method: 提出 Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation（TP-DATE）：以路径作用量刻画一大类静态与动态二次型最优传输（QOT），并证明静态—动态等价性；进一步提出 travelling-pair 流匹配，允许相互作用的条件路径并将其交互边缘化为单一向量场，实现免模拟（simulation-free）的动态 GW-OT 泛化。
AI.result: 在合成与真实空间转录组数据上，TP-DATE 更好地保持了空间结构，并提升了连续 3D 动态重建效果。
AI.conclusion: TP-DATE 为结构感知最优传输提供了通用动态框架，将 GW-OT 从静态对齐推广到连续轨迹重建，验证了路径作用量与流匹配结合在空间转录组动态建模中的有效性。

title: Schema-Anchored Latent Reasoning for Semantic Parsing-Based Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Semantic parsing (SP)-based knowledge base question answering aims to answer natural language questions by generating executable logical forms (LFs) over knowledge bases (KBs). When applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to this task, a key challenge over large, heterogeneous KBs is selecting question-related schema elements (i.e., relations and classes) and composing them into complex LFs. Recent LLM-based methods often make early discrete commitments to schema elements during intermediate reasoning, allowing incorrect intermediate schema decisions to propagate and finally result in incorrect LFs. To overcome this limitation, we propose SALR, a schema-anchored latent reasoning method for LF construction. It performs multi-step reasoning by generating continuous thoughts in the model's hidden states, thereby delaying the explicit commitment to LF decisions. To ground this latent reasoning process in the corresponding KB schema, SALR aligns continuous thoughts with a codebook of KB schema elements through an alignment objective supervised by schema traces deterministically derived from gold LFs. It then incorporates the aligned schema codes into inputs for subsequent reasoning steps. This schema-mediated feedback guides LF generation without requiring the model to emit an explicit textual reasoning trajectory. Experiments on GrailQA and WebQSP show that SALR achieves consistent overall gains over strong baselines. Notably, on compositional questions from GrailQA, SALR outperforms TIARA, a strong SP-based baseline, by 2.86 F1 points. Further analyses show that schema-mediated feedback affects LF generation and that schema information is recoverable from the latent states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALR，一种面向知识库问答逻辑形式构建的"模式锚定隐式推理"方法：通过在模型隐状态中生成连续思维，并用知识库模式元素码本对齐这些隐思维，从而延迟对模式元素的离散决策，避免错误中间决策传播。在GrailQA和WebQSP上取得一致增益，组合型问题上较TIARA提升2.86 F1。
AI.motivation: 基于语义解析的知识库问答需在大型异构知识库上选择与问题相关的模式元素（关系与类）并组合为复杂逻辑形式。现有LLM方法在中间推理阶段就过早对模式元素做出离散承诺，导致错误的中间模式决策不断传播，最终生成错误的逻辑形式。因此需要一种能延迟显式决策、同时又能与知识库模式对齐的推理机制。
AI.method: SALR执行多步推理时在模型隐状态中生成连续思维，从而延迟对逻辑形式决策的显式承诺；为将该隐式推理过程锚定到对应知识库模式，SALR通过一个由黄金逻辑形式确定性推导出的模式轨迹所监督的对齐目标，把连续思维与知识库模式元素码本进行对齐；随后将对齐得到的模式编码并入后续推理步骤的输入，形成模式中介的反馈来引导逻辑形式生成，而无需模型输出显式的文本推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在GrailQA和WebQSP上的实验表明，SALR相较强基线取得一致的总体性能提升；在GrailQA的组合型问题上，SALR比强语义解析基线TIARA高出2.86个F1点。进一步分析显示，模式中介反馈会影响逻辑形式生成，且模式信息可从隐状态中被恢复。
AI.conclusion: 通过隐式连续思维与知识库模式码本的对齐，SALR有效缓解了中间模式决策过早离散化带来的错误传播问题，在不输出显式文本推理轨迹的情况下实现了模式中介的反馈引导，验证了隐式推理中模式信息的可恢复性与有效性，为LLM-based知识库问答的逻辑形式构建提供了新思路。

title: AVTrace: Diagnosing Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning in Omni Models
summary: Omni models can describe video content, but can they locate events in time, preserve event order, and judge audio-visual synchronization? We introduce AVTrace (Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning Assessment and Capability Evaluation), a silver-standard diagnostic suite spanning onset and span grounding, synchronization, next-step prediction, cross-modal localization, chain parsing, and event-conditioned comprehension. It contains 34,114 training examples and category-balanced development and test splits of 3,500 and 7,000 examples. We evaluate five open omni models under their respective input configurations using reference-blind response normalization followed by deterministic scoring. All five off-the-shelf systems score below the test split's majority-label baseline of 0.556 on synchronization verification, and obtain low scores on chain parsing and event-conditioned grounding and comprehension. Development-set perturbations reveal task-dependent sensitivity in Qwen3-Omni-30B to modality removal and changes in visual input processing, without isolating their underlying causes. Parameter-efficient temporal post-training improves Gemma4-E4B-it on several benchmark metrics. On three external image benchmarks, task metrics change modestly, including some degradations, while teacher-forcing perplexity decreases. Together, these findings show that semantic reference-text overlap should not be treated as a proxy for temporal localization, and that AVTrace can identify task-specific weaknesses while providing a testbed for temporal post-training.

AI.tldr: AVTrace是一个音视频时序推理诊断基准，覆盖起始/跨度定位、同步、下一步预测、跨模态定位、链式解析等任务，含34,114训练样本及3,500/7,000类别均衡开发/测试集；五个开源全模态模型在同步验证上均低于多数类基线0.556，在链式解析与事件条件理解上表现较差。
AI.motivation: 全模态模型虽能描述视频内容，但其在时间维度上的能力（事件定位、事件顺序保持、音视频同步判断）尚不明确；同时现有评估常以语义文本重叠作为时序定位的代理指标，可能高估模型真实能力，因此需要一个针对时序推理的诊断性评测套件。
AI.method: 构建AVTrace银标准诊断套件，任务涵盖起点与跨度定位、音视频同步、下一步预测、跨模态定位、链式解析、事件条件理解；采用参考盲（reference-blind）响应归一化加确定性打分；在各自输入配置下评测五个开源全模态模型，并做开发集扰动实验（模态移除、视觉输入处理变更）及参数高效时序后训练实验，另在三个外部图像基准上做迁移测试。
AI.result: 五个即用系统在同步验证任务上全部低于测试集多数类基线0.556；在链式解析、事件条件定位与理解上得分较低。开发集扰动显示Qwen3-Omni-30B对模态移除与视觉输入处理变化存在任务相关敏感性，但未能分离其底层原因。参数高效时序后训练使Gemma4-E4B-it在多个基准指标上提升；在三个外部图像基准上任务指标变化有限，部分出现下降，同时教师强制困惑度降低。
AI.conclusion: 语义参考文本重叠不应被视为时序定位能力的代理指标；AVTrace能识别任务级弱点，并可作为时序后训练的实验平台。

title: HEROIC: Heterogeneous Evidential Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Identification and Cross-Robot Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent heterogeneous air-ground robot teams are attractive for open world search, with applications for reconnaissance, urban search and rescue missions (USAR), disaster response and recovery, and hazardous environments. These two platforms have different failure modes: aerial robots cover ground quickly but cannot resolve small or occluded targets from altitude, while ground robots can identify objects-of-interest, such as people or hazardous objects, at close range but cover less area. Existing language-tasked teams either have roles fixed prior, or have a language model assign them from hand-written capability tags, so the team is unable to know when within a mission an asset is no longer useful. We present HEROIC, a decentralized heterogeneous multi-agent open-vocabulary search coordination framework that requires agents to communicate in natural language only. HEROIC's initial agent role assignment is derived from sensor properties and a scale law to determine whether targets can be detected with a high confidence. From the mission's natural language prompt alone, this law assigns aerial flight altitudes and sweep spacing. When this calculated height falls below the altitude for safe flight, aerial agents re-task themselves from searcher to aerial triage, escort, and route guide for ground agents. Both robots maintain an evidential belief over the search area (bearing rays for positive evidence, a log-odds posterior for negative evidence) and gate any arrival on close-range verification. In full-stack experiments, HEROIC reaches the target 84% of the time across all 6 scenes, compares to 35-54% for vision-language frontier baselines, frontier-based search, lawnmower, and random-walk running the same perception, all while being 2-4x sooner to arrive at the target.

AI.tldr: HEROIC 是一个去中心化的空地异构多智能体开放词汇搜索协调框架，仅用自然语言通信，基于传感器属性与尺度定律动态分配角色，在6个场景中以84%成功率、2-4倍更快速度到达目标。
AI.motivation: 空地异构机器人团队适合开放世界搜索（侦察、城市搜救、灾害响应、危险环境），但两类平台失败模式不同：空中机器人覆盖快却难以从高空分辨小或被遮挡目标，地面机器人能近距离识别目标但覆盖面积小。现有语言任务团队要么角色预先固定，要么由语言模型依据手写能力标签分配，无法在任务中途判断某资产何时不再有用。
AI.method: 提出 HEROIC 去中心化异构多智能体开放词汇搜索协调框架，智能体仅通过自然语言通信。初始角色分配由传感器属性和尺度定律推导，用于判断能否高置信度检测目标；仅凭任务的自然语言提示即可确定空中飞行高度与扫描间距。当计算高度低于安全飞行高度时，空中智能体将自身从搜索者重任务为空中分诊、护航和地面智能体路线引导。两类机器人均维护对搜索区域的证据信念（正向证据为方位射线，负向证据为对数几率后验），并对任何到达进行近距离验证门控。
AI.result: 在全栈实验中，HEROIC 在全部6个场景中84%的情况到达目标，而视觉-语言前沿基线、基于前沿的搜索、割草机式搜索和随机游走在相同感知下仅为35-54%，且 HEROIC 到达目标快2-4倍。
AI.conclusion: HEROIC 通过基于传感器属性与尺度定律的动态角色分配、自然语言通信和证据信念建模，实现了空地异构团队的高效开放词汇搜索，在成功率和到达速度上显著优于现有基线方法。

title: E-AVI: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Assessment for Automated Video Interviews
summary: Automated video interview assessment integrates verbal content, acoustic delivery, and visual behavior, yet numerical predictions alone provide limited inspectable support. We present E-AVI, an evidence-grounded framework that extracts timestamped multimodal evidence and integrates dimension-conditioned evidence attention with source-level embeddings for scoring. A shared evidence pool further supports natural-language feedback and follow-up question answering. On RecruitView and a private hospitality dataset, E-AVI consistently outperforms fine-tuned multimodal baselines in rank correlation. Ablation, evidence-deletion, bootstrap, human-audit, and QA analyses characterize the predictive contribution, grounding, and practical utility of the evidence pathway. Together, these results demonstrate that our proposed E-AVI framework improves predictive performance while providing inspectable support for assessment, feedback, and interactive analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出E-AVI：证据驱动的自动化视频面试评估框架，提取带时间戳的多模态证据并结合维度条件证据注意力与来源级嵌入进行打分，同一证据池支持自然语言反馈与追问式QA，在两个数据集上排序相关性优于微调多模态基线。
AI.motivation: 自动化视频面试评估整合语言内容、声学表达与视觉行为，但仅输出数值预测缺乏可检查性（可解释与可追溯的支持），难以支撑评估、反馈与交互分析。
AI.method: E-AVI框架：提取带时间戳的多模态证据；引入维度条件证据注意力（dimension-conditioned evidence attention）并将其与来源级嵌入（source-level embeddings）融合用于评分；构建共享证据池以支撑自然语言反馈生成与追问式问答。评估：RecruitView与一个私有酒店业数据集，与微调多模态基线比较排序相关性，并开展消融、证据删除、自助法(bootstrap)、人工审核与QA分析。
AI.result: 在RecruitView与私有酒店业数据集上，E-AVI在排序相关性上持续优于微调多模态基线；消融与证据删除实验表明证据路径对预测有实质贡献；bootstrap、人工审核与QA分析支持证据的接地性与实际可用性。
AI.conclusion: E-AVI在提升预测性能的同时，为面试评估提供可检查的支持，可用于评分、反馈生成与交互式分析。

title: Correct Now, Insufficient Later: Auditing Update Sufficiency in Context Compression
comment: 20 pages, 9 tables, 2 figures. Code and reproducibility materials to be released separately
summary: A memory can answer a current query correctly while discarding distinctions required by a later update. We investigate this failure with a paired-history audit: two histories have the same current answer, receive a shared future update, and require different subsequent answers. A pilot evaluates 24 history pairs across six synthetic mechanisms, 12 memory conditions, two repeats, and two model backends. A deterministic frontier selector obtains strict reveal accuracy of 96/96 on DeepSeek and 82/96 on GLM; a structured writer obtains 62 successes with one unresolved outcome and 56/96. The configured four-outcome joint contrast has finite-sample identification intervals of [0.521, 0.542] and [0.292, 0.313], not confidence intervals. A record-level audit distinguishes retained-state adequacy, response delivery, and answer-schema compliance without changing those original scores. It finds 26 and 25 well-formed but semantically wrong structured reveal memories, while all 14 GLM frontier reveal failures contain correct values in the wrong wrapper. Tombstone removal produces 16/16 exact replay failures in the targeted mechanism. Identifier renaming then exposes a separate flaw: original frontier late-reference adequacy falls from 8/8 to 94/320 transformed instances. We provide and test a label-equivariant repair, but it preserves only 2/8 original late-reference answers: eliminating a naming shortcut does not solve unknown future relevance. These results support a scoped evaluation methodology and reproducible failure analysis, not general superiority of the repaired algorithm. Paid pilot evidence, retrospective diagnostics, and new offline tests are reported separately; no independent held-out or natural-task validation is claimed.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过配对历史审计方法，检验记忆系统在"当前回答正确但丢弃后续更新所需区分信息"这一失败模式。
AI.motivation: 记忆系统可能在回答当前查询时正确，却丢弃了后续更新所需的区分信息。作者希望通过配对历史审计揭示此类失败，并建立可复现的评估方法。
AI.method: 采用配对历史审计：两条历史当前答案相同、接受相同的未来更新、但需给出不同的后续答案。试点评估24对历史，覆盖6种合成机制、12种记忆条件、2次重复、2个模型后端。使用确定性前沿选择器、结构化写入器，并进行记录级审计（区分保留状态充分性、响应交付与答案模式合规性）、墓碑移除测试和标识符重命名测试，最后提供并测试标签等变修复。
AI.result: 前沿选择器严格揭示准确率DeepSeek为96/96、GLM为82/96；结构化写入器为62次成功（1个未决结果）和56/96。四结果联合对比的有限样本识别区间为[0.521, 0.542]与[0.292, 0.313]。记录级审计发现26与25个格式良好但语义错误的结构化揭示记忆，14个GLM前沿揭示失败均为值正确但包装错误。墓碑移除在目标机制中产生16/16精确重放失败。标识符重命名后，原始前沿的晚期引用充分性从8/8降至94/320。标签等变修复仅保留2/8原始晚期引用答案。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种有范围的评估方法与可复现的失败分析，而非宣称修复后算法的通用优越性。付费试点证据、回顾性诊断与新的离线测试分别报告，未声称独立留出集或自然任务验证。消除命名捷径并不能解决未知未来相关性问题。

title: Xeno-Interpretability: Investigating the Alien Minds of LLMs
summary: Large language models are usually interpreted through concepts that humans already possess: truthfulness, refusal, deception, personality, harmfulness, and related categories. This paper asks whether models may also represent and use distinctions for which no adequate human concept exists. We call such internal structures xeno-representations, and their study xeno-interpretability. We distinguish the human-interpretable semantic space from the xeno-semantic space: the region of model-native representations for which no adequate human conceptual counterpart is available. We show that the space of possible internal distinctions in an LLM is substantially larger than the space available through finite human descriptions. We then separate experimental identification from semantic interpretation: an internal representation may be reproducibly located, geometrically characterized, causally manipulated, and linked to downstream behaviour even when its semantic content cannot be adequately expressed in human terms. On this basis, we sketch an empirical programme to identify xeno-representations. We finally examine the implications for AI safety and multi-agent systems, where model-native representations may propagate and stabilize across interacting agents while remaining only partially visible through human-readable communication. Xeno-interpretability therefore shifts the aim of interpretability from finding human concepts inside models toward discovering and characterizing the representational structures that are native to the models themselves and might affect their behaviour in unpredictable ways.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"异我表征"(xeno-representations)与"异我可解释性"(xeno-interpretability)概念，主张LLM内部可能存在无法用现有人类概念充分表达的模型原生表征，并将"实验性识别"与"语义解释"分离，进而提出识别这类表征的实证研究纲要，并讨论其对AI安全与多智能体系统的意义。
AI.motivation: 当前可解释性研究几乎完全依赖人类已有概念(真实性、拒绝、欺骗、人格、危害性等)来解读大语言模型。作者质疑这种"以人类概念为唯一透镜"的范式是否足够，认为模型可能表征并使用与人类概念空间不对应的区分，从而使现有解释框架存在系统性盲区，尤其在AI安全与多智能体传播场景下有潜在风险。
AI.method: 本文为概念性与纲领性工作，主要论证路径包括：(1)区分"人类可解释语义空间"与"异我语义空间"，即模型原生表征中缺乏人类概念对应物的区域；(2)论证LLM可能的内部区分空间显著大于有限人类描述所能覆盖的空间；(3)将"实验性识别"(可重复定位、几何刻画、因果操纵、关联下游行为)与"语义解释"分离，指出前者可在后者不成立时依然成立；(4)据此提出识别异我表征的实证研究纲要。
AI.result: 论文未报告实验数据或定量结果，属于理论论证型成果。核心结果是概念性的：证明内部表征的可定位性、几何可刻画性、因果可操纵性与行为关联性，并不依赖于其语义内容能否被人类语言充分表达；由此确立异我表征作为可独立研究对象的合法性。
AI.conclusion: 异我可解释性将可解释性的目标从"在模型中寻找人类概念"转向"发现并刻画模型自身原生、且可能以不可预测方式影响其行为的表征结构"。作者指出，这些模型原生表征可能在多智能体交互中传播并稳定下来，却只能通过人类可读通信被部分观测，因而对AI安全与多智能体系统具有重要含义。

title: GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 as a Spotlight presentation
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的前馈3D重建框架，通过粗到细轨迹对齐、LoRA几何先验注入、混合权重稀疏光线场优化和轨迹拼接，实现长单目序列的稳定可扩展重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建在大规模单目场景中受限于GPU显存开销过大、局部几何退化以及长时轨迹漂移；现有分块（chunk-based）优化策略几何约束有限，难以在长轨迹上保持全局一致性。
AI.method: 1）以粗到细轨迹对齐为核心，并注入轻量几何先验；2）通过LoRA适配将单目几何线索蒸馏进前馈骨干，提升细结构深度精度且保持推理效率；3）提出混合权重稀疏光线场优化，利用高频几何特征引导局部点云细化并施加一致的帧间光线约束，建立强跨帧几何耦合；4）设计带联合光线误差优化的高效轨迹拼接策略，显式降低累积漂移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在轨迹精度上可与代表性SLAM系统竞争，同时在大规模场景中保持全局一致的3D重建。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持前馈推理效率的同时，实现了长单目序列的可扩展、稳定且全局一致的3D重建，缩小了前馈方法与SLAM系统在轨迹精度上的差距。

title: Vehicle Trajectory Prediction via Neural Fusion of Multiple EKF-Based Trajectory Candidates
summary: Predicting the future trajectories of surrounding vehicles in autonomous driving is important for collision risk assessment and safe ego-vehicle path planning. Conventional neural network-based trajectory predictors typically achieve strong prediction performance by exploiting agent history, dynamic scene graphs, and semantic maps. However, in specific motion regimes such as acceleration, deceleration, and turning, these predictors may fail to reflect physically feasible trajectories. To address this issue, this study proposes a framework that fuses the output of Trajectron++, a neural network-based trajectory predictor, with extended Kalman filter (EKF)-based multiple trajectory candidates at a late stage. On the nuScenes dataset, the proposed method reduces the average displacement error and final displacement error of the Trajectron++ robot baseline by 13.7% and 14.6%, respectively, without modifying the baseline architecture. These results indicate that EKF-based trajectory candidates can effectively complement neural trajectory prediction through learned fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将Trajectron++神经网络预测器与EKF多轨迹候选进行后期融合的框架，在nuScenes上使平均位移误差与终点位移误差分别降低13.7%和14.6%，且不修改基线结构。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中周围车辆轨迹预测对碰撞风险评估和安全路径规划至关重要。基于神经网络的预测器虽借助智能体历史、动态场景图和语义地图取得较强性能，但在加速、减速、转弯等特定运动状态下可能输出物理不可行的轨迹，因此需要引入物理约束来补足。
AI.method: 提出一个后期融合框架，将Trajectron++（神经网络轨迹预测器）的输出与基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）生成的多个轨迹候选在晚期阶段进行融合，并通过学习式融合机制整合两类来源的预测，基线架构本身不作修改。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，相较于Trajectron++基线，平均位移误差（ADE）降低13.7%，终点位移误差（FDE）降低14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 基于EKF的轨迹候选能够通过可学习的后期融合有效补充神经网络的轨迹预测，在特定运动状态下提升物理可行性，同时保持基线模型不变。

title: Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models
summary: People increasingly turn to AI chatbots for news and explanations of world events. But do they receive the same political answers when they ask in different languages? Here we show that the language of a question can change how the same AI systems assess the war in Ukraine. We ask GPT, Claude and Gemini to evaluate twenty statements about the war in 112 languages, collecting 67,200 responses. The balance between Russia-leaning and Ukraine-leaning responses differs across languages. When we group responses by countries' official languages, they follow a pattern resembling worldwide political divisions: relatively more Russia-leaning answers correspond to more favourable public views of Russia, less support for Ukraine in United Nations votes, and less aid to Ukraine. The broad pattern recurs across all three models and remains when individual statement pairs are removed. Our findings suggest a possible route through which information warfare may shape the text used to train AI models, which may in turn spread geopolitical biases.

AI.tldr: 研究对GPT、Claude、Gemini用112种语言、20条关于战争的陈述提问，收集67,200条回答，发现同一AI系统的回答倾向随提问语言变化，且与国家层面的政治立场相关。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地用AI聊天机器人获取新闻和事件解释，但尚不清楚在不同语言提问时是否得到相同的政治性回答，这一潜在的语言相关偏见值得探究。
AI.method: 向GPT、Claude和Gemini就关于乌克兰战争的20条陈述，用112种语言提问，共收集67,200条回答；按国家官方语言分组，并分析回答倾向与各国公众对俄态度、联合国投票支持乌克兰程度及对乌援助之间的关系；通过删除个别陈述对进行稳健性检验。
AI.result: 亲俄与亲乌回答的比例随语言不同而变化；按官方语言分组后呈现类似全球政治分化的模式——较多亲俄回答对应更看好俄罗斯的公众舆论、在联合国投票中较少支持乌克兰以及较少对乌援助；该模式在三个模型中均重复出现，且在移除个别陈述对后依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 提问语言会系统性地影响AI模型的政治判断，提示信息战可能通过塑造AI训练文本而注入地缘政治偏见，进而传播这类偏见。

title: Evaluating Explanation Methods by the Predictors They Induce
summary: Explanations of machine learning models are usually judged by criteria that are hard to compare. We propose a simpler test: if an explanation really describes how a model uses its features, it should be possible to rebuild the model's predictions from it. We turn each explanation into a predictor by reading each feature's effect and adding them up, and measure how well that predictor reproduces the model on unseen data. Nothing is fitted, so the score reflects the explanation itself. The test applies to any explanation that can be written as a function of the features; we demonstrate it on partial dependence plots (PDP), accumulated local effects (ALE), SHAP and LIME. We prove that summing partial dependence curves gives the best possible additive summary of a model when its features are independent, and that this fails when they are dependent. Across 13 real datasets and 9 synthetic designs and four model families, which method scores best depends entirely on feature dependence: where features are independent SHAP is slightly worse than PDP, exactly as the theory predicts; on dependent real data SHAP leads. Some widely used quality metrics even prefer a damaged explanation to an intact one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"重构检验"来评估机器学习解释方法：将解释转化为加性预测器，检验其能否在未见数据上复现原模型预测。理论证明在特征独立时求和部分依赖曲线是最优加性摘要，特征依赖时失效。实验表明最优方法取决于特征依赖程度。
AI.motivation: 现有解释评估标准难以直接比较；需要一个更简单、无需拟合、能反映解释本身质量的统一检验方法。
AI.method: 将每种解释（PDP、ALE、SHAP、LIME）转化为加性预测器：读取各特征效应并求和，在未见数据上测量其复现模型预测的能力，不做任何拟合。理论上证明特征独立时求和部分依赖曲线给出最优加性摘要，特征依赖时该性质失效。在13个真实数据集、9个合成设计和4类模型家族上实验。
AI.result: 最优方法完全取决于特征依赖：特征独立时SHAP略差于PDP，与理论预测一致；依赖的真实数据上SHAP领先。部分常用质量指标甚至会偏好受损解释而非完好解释。
AI.conclusion: 重构检验提供了一个可比、可理论分析的统一解释评估框架，揭示解释方法优劣依赖于特征依赖结构，并暴露部分常用质量指标的缺陷。

title: Stress-testing Alignment Midtraining
summary:
When aligning frontier models through post-training techniques, it is not possible to directly demonstrate all of the behaviours we want a model to exhibit in all possible deployment environments; our model must generalise outside of the post-training distribution. One proposed solution is alignment midtraining (AMT), which continues pretraining on large volumes of alignment-relevant documents to encourage generalisation in later stages of training.
  Despite the prominence of AMT as an alignment approach, there is limited public evidence for its effectiveness. To resolve this, we identify several assumptions around midtraining and evaluate them across scale: up to 110 billion-parameter models and 1 billion midtraining tokens. For instance, we study a scenario where post-training data is ambiguous between two possible motivations. We find that midtraining can steer the model's motivation in simple versions of this setting. However, the presence of a tiny fraction of finetuning data which suggests a competing motivation erases the effects of AMT. We also study scenarios in which we want an AI to follow a number of rules, but only demonstrate a subset of them. We find that demonstrations must be present either in midtraining or post-training datasets for these rules to be robustly learned.
  Based on these and other findings, we do not believe that there is sufficient public evidence for us to confidently state that midtraining can address the core difficulties inherent in aligning powerful AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了对齐中训练（AMT）的有效性，发现其作用有限且易被少量微调数据覆盖，认为目前缺乏足够公开证据证明AMT能解决强AI对齐的核心难题。
AI.motivation: 后训练无法穷举所有期望行为，模型需泛化到后训练分布之外；对齐中训练（AMT）被提出用于在预训练阶段注入对齐相关文档以促进泛化，但其有效性缺乏公开证据，需进行规模化验证。
AI.method: 识别关于中训练的若干假设，并在最大1100亿参数模型、10亿中训练token的规模上进行评估。设置两类场景：一是后训练数据在两种动因间存在歧义；二是仅演示部分规则而要求模型遵循全部规则。
AI.result: 在简单歧义场景下，中训练可将模型动机导向指定方向；但极少量的、指向竞争动机的微调数据即可抹除AMT效果。对于规则遵循，只有在其中训练或后训练数据中出现过演示的规则才能被稳健习得。
AI.conclusion: 综合上述发现，作者认为现有公开证据不足以确信中训练能够解决强AI系统对齐中的核心困难。

title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Project page: https://world.astronex.com.cn ; Code: https://github.com/Astronex-Robotics/Astronex-World ; Weights: https://huggingface.co/Astronex-Lab/Astronex-World
summary: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: Astronex-World 1.0 是一个开源可控视频世界模型基础模型，支持文本/图像到视频的可控未来状态预测，包含双向与因果两种模型，参数为5B，性能可比肩更大规模的模型。
AI.motivation: 构建一个能够根据文本提示或初始观测、在相机轨迹、连续动作和具身标识控制下预测未来视觉状态的开源可控视频世界模型，并支持在rollout中插入文本事件，以服务具身智能与自动驾驶等下游任务。
AI.method: 基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 先验构建双向模型和采用块因果注意力与跨块 KV 缓存的因果模型；用 PRoPE 注入相机内参和外参，以64维动作流调制每个Transformer层；采用五阶段训练：双向相机与动作控制、骨干转块因果生成、蒸馏少步学生模型、恢复混合域动态、非对称 DMD/DMD2 分布匹配。
AI.result: 因果模型可生成 832x480、24fps 视频；五个训练阶段均在两块 NVIDIA L20 48GB GPU 上完成，因果模型可在单卡实时流式生成。WBench Navi 得分73.5，WBench Full 得分70.0；在 Full 上超过13.6B的 LongCat-Video 和14B的 Helios，与22B的 LTX-2.3 相差不到1分，并超过基于同一5B先验在 A100 上后训练的 YUME 1.5。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个高效、开源、可控的视频世界模型基础，以较小参数规模取得竞争力性能，并保留动作输入输出接口，便于具身智能和自动驾驶的后续后训练。

title: RotateIt! Fast and Reliable Single-Arm Garment Unfolding via Online-Adaptive Dynamic Rotation
summary: Robotic garment unfolding is essential for downstream tasks, yet quasi-static methods require repeated actions, while existing dynamic approaches predominantly rely on bimanual flinging. We present RotateIt!, a single-arm framework that uses adaptive axial rotation for dynamic garment unfolding. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first unfolding framework to employ dynamic axial rotation as its primary manipulation primitive. From a randomly initialized tabletop configuration, the robot selects a rotation-effective grasp and rotates the lifted garment about an approximately fixed anchor, generating inertial tension that separates overlapping layers within a compact workspace. A grasp ranker selects the anchor, while an online residual policy adapts the rotation extent and speed, thereby determining the release timing. Across seen and unseen simulated garments and eight unseen real garments, RotateIt! improves success within three attempts by 44.0-61.0 percentage points over quasi-static pick-and-place. The simulation-trained policies transfer zero-shot to the real world, achieving 75.6% success, 41% higher first-attempt coverage, and 26% higher final coverage. The resulting states further enable autonomous robotic folding without manual rearrangement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RotateIt!，一个利用自适应轴向旋转进行动态衣物展开的单臂框架，在仿真和真实环境中均显著优于准静态方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人衣物展开是下游任务（如折叠）的前提。准静态方法需要重复操作，效率低；现有动态方法主要依赖双臂甩动（bimanual flinging），对单臂系统不适用。因此需要一个能在紧凑工作空间内、仅用单臂实现的动态展开方案。
AI.method: 提出RotateIt!单臂框架，以动态轴向旋转（adaptive axial rotation）作为主要操作原语。从随机桌面构型出发，机器人选择一个旋转有效的抓取点，将提起的衣物绕近似固定的锚点旋转，产生惯性张力以分离重叠层。系统包含：抓取排序器（grasp ranker）用于选择锚点；在线残差策略（online residual policy）用于自适应调整旋转幅度与速度，从而决定释放时机。
AI.result: 在已见与未见的仿真衣物以及8件未见真实衣物上，RotateIt!将三次尝试内的成功率相比准静态pick-and-place提升44.0–61.0个百分点。仿真训练策略可零样本迁移至真实世界，达到75.6%成功率、首尝试覆盖率提升41%、最终覆盖率提升26%。
AI.conclusion: RotateIt!证明动态轴向旋转是单臂衣物展开的有效原语，无需双臂甩动即可在紧凑空间中分离衣物层，且仿真策略可零样本迁移到真实环境，展开后的状态还能支持无需人工整理的自主折叠。

title: FedeRICo: Federated Region-Influenced Coupling for Traffic Flow Prediction
summary: Urban traffic forecasting often relies on information distributed across stakeholders who may be unable to share raw data due to privacy or commercial constraints, motivating federated spatial-temporal approaches. In such federated settings, each client observes traffic over a distinct sensor subgraph with its own spatial topology and temporal dynamics, leading to significant heterogeneity across clients. Existing federated spatial-temporal methods typically rely on model parameter aggregation and provide limited mechanisms for recovering spatial dependencies across client boundaries. This introduces two key limitations. Specifically, parameter aggregation across heterogeneous graph domains tends to dilute client-specific representations, while road network partitioning breaks the propagation of traffic dynamics across client boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose FedeRICo, a federated traffic forecasting framework that combines gradient-level collaboration with boundary-aware residual communication. FedeRICo employs a dual-branch forecasting architecture in which a globally guided branch captures transferable forecasting structure, while a private residual branch preserves client-specific corrections and incorporates boundary residual signals. The global branch is coordinated through gradient alignment across all clients, enabling collaborative optimisation without destructive parameter interference. To recover cross-client spatial dependencies, boundary messages are extracted through a trend-residual decomposition that suppresses periodic structure and communicates only transient spatial-temporal residual signals between physically adjacent clients. Experiments across four real-world traffic forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that FedeRICo consistently outperforms state-of-the-art federated spatial-temporal baselines while maintaining competitive training runtime.

AI.tldr: FedeRICo：面向联邦交通预测的梯度级协同+边界残差通信框架
AI.motivation: 联邦场景下各客户端仅观测到不同传感器子图，存在空间拓扑与时间动态的显著异构；现有联邦时空方法依赖模型参数聚合，既会稀释客户端特有表征，又因路网切分阻断跨客户端交通动态传播，导致跨边界空间依赖难以恢复。
AI.method: 提出FedeRICo，采用双分支预测架构：全局引导分支捕捉可迁移预测结构，通过全体客户端间的梯度对齐进行协同优化以规避破坏性参数干扰；私有残差分支保留客户端特化修正并引入边界残差信号。跨客户端空间依赖通过趋势-残差分解提取边界消息，抑制周期性结构、仅在物理相邻客户端间传输瞬态时空残差信号。
AI.result: 在四个真实交通预测基准上，FedeRICo持续优于当前最优的联邦时空基线，且训练运行时间具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以梯度级协同替代粗暴参数聚合，并辅以边界感知的残差通信，可在保护数据隐私的前提下有效缓解客户端异构与路网分割带来的表征稀释与依赖断裂问题，实现精度与效率兼顾的联邦交通预测。

title: MATCH: Model-Aware Tool Learning with Curriculum Scheduling and Hierarchically Gated Rewards
summary: Tool learning enables large language models (LLMs) to use external tools for tasks beyond parametric knowledge. Reinforcement learning can optimize tool-call behavior from feedback, but current methods still face two problems: fixed-threshold curricula can become misaligned with the policy's evolving capability boundary, and additive rewards can leak argument-level credit when the predicted tool is wrong. To address these problems, we propose MATCH, a closed-loop framework for model-aware tool learning with curriculum scheduling and hierarchically gated rewards. Model-Aware Curriculum Learning (MACL) maintains reward-derived sample difficulty that co-evolves with the policy, and each epoch selects samples near the current capability boundary together with a top-k pool of harder cases. Hierarchical Tool-call Gated Reward (HTGR) scores tool name, argument key, and argument value as a gated chain, granting credit at each level only when prerequisites hold. The same HTGR rewards drive both GRPO updates and MACL's difficulty refresh, closing the loop between policy optimization and sample scheduling. On API-Bank and BFCL V3, MATCH reaches 72.19% and 62.87% overall accuracy, outperforming the main supervised and RL-based baselines. Backbone experiments further show consistent improvements across four backbones from two model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MATCH闭环框架，通过模型感知的课程学习(MACL)与分层门控奖励(HTGR)优化LLM工具调用行为，在API-Bank和BFCL V3上分别达到72.19%和62.87%的总体准确率，优于主要监督与RL基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法优化工具调用行为存在两个问题：固定阈值的课程与策略不断演进的能力边界可能失配；加性奖励在工具预测错误时会泄漏参数级信用。
AI.method: 提出MATCH闭环框架，包含模型感知课程学习(MACL)与分层工具调用门控奖励(HTGR)。MACL维护随策略共演化的奖励派生样本难度，每轮选取当前能力边界附近的样本并搭配top-k更难样本池；HTGR将工具名、参数键、参数值作为门控链逐级评分，仅在前置条件满足时授予信用。同一HTGR奖励同时驱动GRPO更新与MACL难度刷新，从而闭环连接策略优化与样本调度。
AI.result: 在API-Bank和BFCL V3上总体准确率分别达72.19%和62.87%，优于主要监督学习和基于RL的基线；跨两个模型家族四种骨干的实验显示出一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MATCH通过模型感知课程调度与分层门控奖励的闭环设计，有效解决了课程失配与信用泄漏问题，在工具学习任务上取得领先性能并具备良好的骨干泛化性。

title: Edustories: A Collection of Real-world Case Studies from Classroom Practices
summary: Despite the widely recognized potential of AI in education, most prior work has focused on individualized student assistance. In contrast, the majority of educational practice worldwide still takes place in collective classroom settings. To enable researchers to study AI assistance in collective teaching, we introduce Edustories, a dataset of 1,492 teacher-written case studies describing real elementary and high-school classroom situations involving challenging student behavior, pedagogical interventions, and their outcomes. Among many other applications, Edustories enables evaluating LLMs' ability to predict the success of teacher interventions, crucial for providing practicing teachers with useful feedback. Comparing the latest models from four language-model families against expert assessments, we find that current models fall short of human expertise in predicting classroom outcomes; the strongest models reach 58% accuracy compared to 64% of human experts. This gap highlights both the limitations and the emerging potential of AI as assistants for practicing teachers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Edustories数据集（1,492个教师撰写的课堂案例），用于研究集体教学场景下的AI辅助，并借此评估LLM预测教师干预成效的能力，发现最强模型准确率58%，低于人类专家的64%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI教育研究多聚焦个性化学生辅导，但全球教育实践大多发生在集体课堂中，缺乏支持集体教学场景下AI辅助研究的数据资源，特别是评估教师干预成效所需的数据。
AI.method: 构建Edustories数据集，包含1,492个由教师撰写的案例研究，描述真实中小学课堂中的挑战性学生行为、教学干预及结果；利用该数据集设置教师干预成功率预测任务，对四个语言模型家族的最新模型进行评估，并与专家评估进行对比。
AI.result: 当前模型在预测课堂结果方面不及人类专家水平，最强模型准确率为58%，人类专家为64%。
AI.conclusion: 模型与专家间的差距既反映AI作为在职教师助手的局限性，也体现其新兴潜力；Edustories为集体教学场景下AI辅助研究提供了数据基础。

title: A Free Lunch? Adapting PP-OCRv6 for Historical Text Recognition
summary: Despite impressive reported scores, large vision-language models have seen limited practical uptake in historical automatic text recognition because of their computational cost, dependence on large-scale pretraining, and hallucination. Historical ATR therefore continues to rely largely on compact CRNN line recognizers, which are visually grounded and trainable on modest data. Lightweight recurrence-free recognizers promise the accuracy of larger models with the practical advantages of CRNNs, yet have not been comprehensively evaluated on historical writing. We adapt PP-OCRv6, a recent compact text recognizer without strong language modeling, for historical line recognition and compare it with a conventional CRNN across generalized pretraining, domain-specific training, corpus-level fine-tuning, and manuscript-specific few-shot adaptation on multilingual Latin- and Arabic-script material. While PP-OCRv6 does not consistently outperform the baseline when trained from scratch, heterogeneous pretraining produces markedly better generalization. Comparisons with the Qwen3.5-based Medusa recognizer further show that fine-tuned PP-OCRv6 can outperform a large VLM tailored towards historical Latin-script HTR.

AI.tldr: 该论文将紧凑无循环识别器PP-OCRv6适配到历史文献行识别任务，并在多语种拉丁与阿拉伯字母材料上与CRNN及大型视觉语言模型（Medusa）进行系统对比，发现异质预训练能显著提升泛化能力，微调后的PP-OCRv6甚至可超越专门面向历史文本的VLM。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽取得高分，但因计算成本高、依赖大规模预训练以及幻觉问题，在历史自动文本识别（ATR）中实际应用受限；该领域仍主要依赖紧凑、视觉接地且可在小数据上训练的CRNN行识别器。轻量无循环识别器理论上兼具大模型精度与CRNN实用性，但尚未在历史书写材料上得到全面评估，因此需要系统检验其可行性。
AI.method: 作者将近期提出的紧凑文本识别器PP-OCRv6（不含强语言建模）适配到历史行识别任务，与常规CRNN基线在多种设定下对比：通用预训练、领域特定训练、语料级微调及手稿特定少样本适配；实验材料涵盖多语种拉丁字母与阿拉伯字母手稿，并与基于Qwen3.5的Medusa大模型识别器进行比较。
AI.result: 从零训练时，PP-OCRv6并未稳定优于CRNN基线；但采用异质预训练后，其泛化性能显著提升。与Medusa识别器的对比进一步表明，经微调的PP-OCRv6能够超越一个专门针对历史拉丁文字HTR定制的大型VLM。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑无循环识别器在历史ATR中具有实用潜力：其优势不在于从零训练的绝对精度，而在于异质预训练带来的强泛化能力与低成本可训练性，使其在微调后可与大型VLM竞争，为历史行识别提供了比大模型更务实的技术路线。

title: TADreamer: Zero-Shot Language-Guided 3D Navigation for Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal Robots via Video Imagination
summary: Language-guided navigation for terrestrial-aerial bimodal robots requires selecting routes and locomotion modes that match scene context and task intent. Generated videos can represent such motion sequences, but recovering metrically consistent navigation references from them is challenging because of scale ambiguity and axis-dependent geometric distortions. We present TADreamer, a zero-shot framework that grounds video-imagined navigation in measured geometry without task-specific training or fine-tuning. A vision-language model translates onboard observations and instructions into navigation prompts, selects valid generated videos, and provides corrective feedback when regeneration is needed. The selected video is reconstructed into 3D waypoints annotated with terrestrial or aerial modes. A two-stage calibration procedure uses field-of-view constraints to initialize scale estimation, then refines axis-dependent scales, rotation, and translation by registering the reconstructed point cloud to measured geometry. The calibrated waypoints and mode labels guide a planner that incorporates measured geometry for robot execution. Real-world experiments demonstrate navigation across seven indoor and outdoor scenarios. With five candidates per round, usable videos are obtained within two rounds in all seven scenarios. On the calibration observations, our method reduces mean absolute depth error by 87.7% and mean absolute relative depth error by 86.3% compared with NavDreamer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TADreamer，一个零样本框架，将视频想象的导航转化为具有度量一致性的三维航路点与运动模态标注，从而指导陆空双模态机器人的导航。
AI.motivation: 陆空双模态机器人需要根据场景上下文与任务意图选择路线和运动模态。生成视频虽能表示此类运动序列，但因其尺度模糊与轴向相关的几何畸变，难以从中恢复度量一致的导航参考，现有方法（如NavDreamer）精度不足。
AI.method: TADreamer采用零样本流程：1）用视觉语言模型将机载观测与指令翻译为导航提示，筛选有效的生成视频，并在需要时提供再生成反馈；2）将选中视频重建为带地面/空中模态标注的三维航路点；3）两阶段标定——先用视场约束初始化尺度估计，再通过将重建点云配准到实测几何来精化轴向相关尺度、旋转与平移；4）标定后的航路点与模态标签输入规划器，结合实测几何驱动机器人执行。
AI.result: 在七个室内外场景的真实世界实验中实现导航。每轮给出五个候选视频时，全部七个场景均在两轮内获得可用视频。在标定观测上，相比NavDreamer，平均绝对深度误差降低87.7%，平均绝对相对深度误差降低86.3%。
AI.conclusion: TADreamer无需任务特定训练或微调，即可将视频想象导航落地到实测几何，显著提升深度恢复的度量一致性并支持陆空双模态真实场景导航。

title: Can Data Attribution Filter Out Subliminal Learning? Not Reliably
summary: Subliminal learning allows language models to transmit behavioral traits through training data with no obvious semantic relationship to those traits, undermining content-based data filtering as a safety intervention. Training data attribution offers an alternative: it identifies the training examples responsible for a given model behavior, independent of their semantic content, and so may apply in exactly the cases where semantic inspection fails. We evaluate three gradient-based attribution methods (GradCos, a contrastive GradCos variant, and EK-FAC) across three models, comparing them against divergence tokens, a strong baseline previously shown to localize subliminal learning (albeit one that requires access to counterfactual teacher models). Filtering at the token level, EK-FAC mitigates a significant part of the effect, the other methods provide little benefit, and all mostly fall short of divergence tokens. Filtering entire samples is less effective for every method, though EK-FAC often gives a stronger signal than divergence tokens in this setting. Success is inconsistent across methods and settings: variants that work well for some model-preference combinations fail for others, and we do not identify a consistent explanation for these differences. Our results suggest that gradient-based attribution can identify data responsible for subliminal learning in some settings, but that some approximations are more reliable than others.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估三种基于梯度的训练数据归因方法（GradCos、对比式GradCos、EK-FAC）在识别"阈下学习"（subliminal learning）责任数据上的效果，并与divergence tokens基线对比，发现token级过滤下EK-FAC能显著缓解该效应，但各方法表现不一致，整体多数不及需要反事实教师模型的基线。
AI.motivation: 阈下学习使语言模型能通过与其行为特征无语义关联的训练数据传递行为特征，从而削弱了基于内容的过滤这一安全干预手段。作者希望探索无需依赖语义内容的替代方案——训练数据归因，以用于语义检查失效的场景。
AI.method: 评估三种基于梯度的归因方法：GradCos、其对比式变体（contrastive GradCos）和EK-FAC，覆盖三个模型；以divergence tokens作为强基线（但其需访问反事实教师模型）；并分别在token级和整样本级进行数据过滤实验。
AI.result: 在token级过滤下，EK-FAC能缓解该效应的显著部分，其余方法收益甚微，且所有方法总体多不及divergence tokens；整样本过滤对所有方法效果更差，但此时EK-FAC常比divergence tokens给出更强信号。各方法与设置间表现不一致：对某些模型-偏好组合有效的变体在另一些组合上失效，且未找到一致的解释。
AI.conclusion: 基于梯度的归因在部分设置下可识别导致阈下学习的数据，但某些近似方法比其他方法更可靠，方法成功与否高度依赖具体方法与设置，缺乏稳定一致的表现。

title: SETTer: Sparse-Encoder Transformer for Long-term Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term multivariate time series plays a significant role in many application areas such as power systems, trading, etc. However, their accurate prediction is quite difficult for conventional forecasting methods as they often exhibit high dimensionality and complex relationships. Recent works show that transformer-based approaches are quite effective for long-term forecasting thanks to their attention mechanism. However, in the presence of complex high-dimensional inputs, they show evidence of oversmoothing, limited capacity, and opacity. To this end, this paper introduces SETTer, a transformer-based model that addresses these challenges by incorporating novel techniques for decoupled self-attention and hybrid masking. The proposed techniques enable SETTer to effectively capture the dominant short- and long-term patterns across the temporal and channel dimensions. In addition, we enrich the model layers with simple explainable structures that indicate the discriminative pattern of SETTer. We show that with a single-layer transformer architecture, SETTer can effectively model long-term dependencies in the presence of varying data complexities. Extensive experiments on real-word benchmark datasets for long-term multivariate time series forecasting demonstrate that SETTer outperforms state-of-the-art models in 88% of the scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SETTer，一种基于 Transformer 的长期多变量时间序列预测模型，通过解耦自注意力与混合掩码技术，有效捕捉时间与通道维度上的长短周期模式，并增强可解释性。
AI.motivation: 长期多变量时间序列广泛存在于电力、交易等领域，其高维性和复杂关系给传统预测方法带来困难。基于 Transformer 的方法虽因注意力机制表现良好，但在复杂高维输入下存在过度平滑、容量受限和可解释性差的问题。
AI.method: SETTer 引入两种新技术：解耦自注意力（decoupled self-attention）与混合掩码（hybrid masking），使其能够在时间维度和通道维度上捕捉主导性的短期与长期模式；同时在模型层中加入简单的可解释结构以指示判别性模式，并采用单层 Transformer 架构。
AI.result: 在真实长期多变量时间序列预测基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SETTer 在 88% 的场景中优于当前最先进的模型。
AI.conclusion: SETTer 通过解耦自注意力和混合掩码，在单层 Transformer 架构下即可有效建模不同数据复杂度下的长期依赖关系，并提升可解释性，在多数基准场景中取得领先性能。

title: Relational Attention for Data-Efficient Language Modeling
comment: BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026. Source code: https://github.com/abrsvn/babylm_dat_2026
summary: We present Relational BabyLM, a system submission to the BabyLM 2026 challenge that combines two cognitively motivated inductive biases in a single decoder-only Transformer. Architecturally, we replace standard self-attention with a Dual Attention Transformer (DAT), which separates the routing of object-level ("sensory") lexical features from structural/relational information (Altabaa and Lafferty, 2025; Altabaa et al., 2024; Webb et al., 2024; Kerg et al., 2022; Webb et al., 2021). Relational attention (RA) disentangled from self-attention greatly increases data efficiency and out-of-training-sample generalization on purely relational tasks, but language modeling requires object-level and relational information to be integrated as well as disentangled, and RA-based LMs have remained largely unexplored. BabyLM's data-constrained training and comprehensive evaluation is an ideal testing ground for whether that data efficiency transfers. As a training intervention, we add a Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat; Teoh et al. 2026) objective that encourages hidden states to compress history incrementally into a dense belief state. Architecture is the dominant factor for structural linguistic generalization; the objective is secondary but still significant. DAT's three relational attention types (full RA vs. the simpler RCA and DisRCA variants) are largely interchangeable at 10M words; full RA pulls ahead at 100M. We also introduce a novel symbol-retrieval mechanism (RoPE-based, as opposed to learned, relative symbols) that matches learned symbol libraries while adding no parameters. On the strict (100M-word) track, our best model ranks 6th of 55 overall and 3rd of 55 on the leaderboard's NLP-task subset at the time of writing; our two strongest models outperform the GPT-2 baseline on most benchmarks, with one attaining the highest EWoK score among strict-track entries.

AI.tldr: Relational BabyLM：将双注意力Transformer（DAT）与下一潜在预测（NextLat）目标结合用于BabyLM 2026挑战，架构比训练目标更主导结构泛化，RoPE符号检索机制零参数增益，严格赛道综合第6/55、NLP子集第3/55。
AI.motivation: 语言建模需要对象级与关系信息的整合，而关系注意力（RA）与自注意力解耦虽能提升数据效率与关系任务泛化，但基于RA的语言模型仍鲜有探索；BabyLM的数据受限训练与全面评测是检验该数据效率能否迁移到语言建模的理想试验场。
AI.method: 在decoder-only Transformer中以Dual Attention Transformer（DAT）替换标准自注意力，将对象级"感觉"词汇特征的路由与结构/关系信息分离；加入Next-Latent Prediction（NextLat）目标，促使隐状态将历史增量压缩为稠密信念状态；比较全RA与更简单的RCA、DisRCA三种关系注意力；提出基于RoPE的相对符号检索机制替代可学习符号库。
AI.result: 架构是结构语言泛化的主导因素，训练目标次要但显著；10M词规模下三种关系注意力基本可互换，100M词规模下全RA更优；RoPE符号检索机制在零新增参数下匹配可学习符号库；严格（100M词）赛道最佳模型综合排名第6/55、NLP任务子集第3/55，两个最强模型在多数基准上超越GPT-2基线，其中一个取得严格赛道条目中最高的EWoK分数。
AI.conclusion: 关系注意力与对象级注意力的解耦对数据高效的语言建模有效，且可通过RoPE符号检索进一步降低参数成本；架构选择优先于目标设计，全RA在更大数据规模下优势显现，验证了关系归纳偏置向语言建模迁移的可行性。

title: PointEvent: Rethinking Event-based Tiny Object Detection via Serialized Motion Evidence Accumulation
summary: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and motion sensitivity for tiny UAV detection, yet distant targets generate sparse and fragmented events that are easily overwhelmed by clutter and ego-motion. Existing methods mainly rely on dense event representations or local sparse spatiotemporal modeling, resulting in redundant computation or fragmented modeling of motion continuity across distant asynchronous events. To address this limitation, we introduce serialized motion evidence accumulation, which treats motion continuity as an ordered evidence propagation process. Specifically, the same event stream is organized into locality-preserving spatiotemporal paths and chronology-preserving temporal paths through the latent complementary serializations. Based on this principle, we propose PointEvent, a lightweight event-wise state-space framework that alternates serialized scans across the complementary orders, progressively consolidating fragmented motion evidence beyond fixed local neighborhoods. A high-resolution event branch preserves fine-grained target responses, while compact context modulation suppresses interference. Experiments demonstrate that PointEvent achieves SOTA with the fewest parameters and fastest measured inference among the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/wzz-z/PointEvent

AI.tldr: 该文提出PointEvent，一种轻量级事件级状态空间框架，通过互补序列化扫描实现运动证据的串行累积，用于远距离微小无人机的检测。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率与运动敏感性，适合微小无人机检测，但远距离目标产生的稀疏、碎片化事件易被杂波与自运动淹没。现有方法依赖稠密事件表示或局部稀疏时空建模，导致冗余计算或跨异步事件运动连续性建模碎片化。
AI.method: 提出"串行化运动证据累积"，将运动连续性视为有序的证据传播过程：通过潜在互补序列化，将同一事件流组织为保局部性的时空路径与保时序的时间路径；在此基础上构建PointEvent——轻量级逐事件状态空间框架，在互补顺序间交替进行串行扫描，逐步整合超越固定局部邻域的运动证据。并设高分辨率事件分支保留细粒度目标响应，配合紧凑上下文调制抑制干扰。
AI.result: 在对比方法中，PointEvent以最少参数量与实测最快推理速度取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 串行化运动证据累积为事件流远距离微小目标检测提供了高效范式，PointEvent在精度与效率上同时取得优势；代码已开源。
