Moreover, the learned verifier achieves 84.2\% adversarial detection accuracy, while its reward signal exhibits 2.03$\times$ higher per-question variance than a self-consistency baseline, providing more discriminative verifications. These results highlight cooperation among specialized players as a promising path toward self-enhanced tool-integrated agents.

AI.tldr: 提出UnifiedPlayers协作框架，通过规划、执行、评估三个玩家协同演化，在GRPO下用角色专属奖励统一优化，实现自进化工具智能体并取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化方法将轨迹生成与评估分离，依赖静态验证器，无法适应新出现的失败模式；而自一致性信号可能强化跨轨迹共享的错误。虽然联合调整规划、执行、评估是潜在替代方案，但会引入根本性的协调挑战：每个组件都在不断改变用于训练其他组件的数据或反馈。
AI.method: 提出UnifiedPlayers协作框架，包含三个玩家：Planning Player生成任务，Execution Player产生带Python工具调用的多轮轨迹，Evaluation Player构建可执行验证器。设计角色专属奖励，在GRPO下将三者协调至共享学习目标。
AI.result: 在两个模型骨干和十二个推理基准上，UnifiedPlayers在数学推理上至少超越最强基线3.5%，在通用推理任务上超越3.9%。学得的验证器达到84.2%的对抗检测准确率，其奖励信号的每问题方差比自一致性基线高2.03倍，提供更具判别力的验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果突出表明，专用玩家之间的协作是迈向自增强工具集成智能体的一条有前景的路径。

title: Support Thresholds, Not Algorithms, Limit Rare-Association Recovery in Co-Purchase Networks
summary: The support threshold of the Apriori algorithm involves a trade-off in conducting market basket analysis: the associations that occur frequently are noted with high threshold; however, the low ones lead to generating the large amount of rules. The paper compares five methods for co-purchase edge filtration on two grocery datasets: i.e., Instacart (3.2 million baskets) and Dunnhumby (208 thousand baskets), including Apriori, Apriori + lift post-filtering, top-$K$ ranking based on lift, and two methods based on networks, noise-corrected (NC) and disparity filter (DF). The top-$K$ method ensures the maximum average lift, while the NC achieves similar lift level by means of a single value of the significance parameter ($α$). These two methods recover substantially more rare high-lift associations than Apriori (80-100% against 22-28%). NC and top-$K$ select meaningfully different edges (18-29% non-overlapping): NC retains statistically validated pairs, while top-$K$ retains rare pairs with high lift but low statistical significance. A rolling-origin holdout evaluation shows that top-$K$ edges recur at higher rates at every split, but NC edges are ~12 pp more likely to remain statistically significant in the held-out network.

AI.tldr: 论文比较五种共购边过滤方法（Apriori、Apriori+lift后过滤、top-K lift排序、NC、DF），在Instacart与Dunnhumby两数据集上评估：top-K平均lift最高，NC以单一显著性参数达到相近lift并能更多保留稀有高lift关联；两者选边差异显著，NC边更稳健。
AI.motivation: Apriori支持度阈值存在两难：高阈值只保留高频关联，低阈值产生海量规则。市场篮子分析需要兼顾稀有但高lift的关联，因此需要比较替代性边过滤方法在覆盖稀有高价值关联与统计稳健性上的表现。
AI.method: 在两个杂货数据集（Instacart约320万篮子、Dunnhumby约20.8万篮子）上对比五种共购边过滤方法：Apriori、Apriori+lift后过滤、基于lift的top-K排序，以及两种网络方法——噪声校正（NC）与差异过滤（DF）；采用滚动起点（rolling-origin）留出评估，考察边的复现率与统计显著性保持情况。
AI.result: top-K方法平均lift最高；NC通过单一显著性参数α达到相近lift水平。二者恢复的稀有高lift关联远多于Apriori（80–100% vs 22–28%）。NC与top-K所选边有18–29%不重叠：NC保留统计验证的配对，top-K保留高lift但低统计显著性的稀有配对。滚动留出评估中，top-K边在各切分点复现率更高，但NC边在留出网络中保持统计显著的可能性约高12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 支持度阈值筛选并非唯一可行方案：top-K在lift与复现率上占优，NC以更少的参数调节实现相近lift并保留统计验证的边、在留出网络中更稳健，两者互补，选择取决于更重视平均lift/复现还是统计显著性与稳健性。

title: HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to the 2026 International Conference on Large Language Models (LLM 2026)
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

AI.tldr: 提出 HerHealthEval 多语言女性健康沟通评测框架，覆盖六种表达形式（英/法/阿拉伯语），发现在语言非对称风险监督下聚合准确率会掩盖安全隐患，改用来源衍生、语言不变的风险标签后可将漏检显著降低。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗沟通中大模型评测多聚焦回答质量，默认模型已正确理解用户诉求，忽视了多语言、语域变化、不确定性表达及信息不足情形下理解失败的潜在安全风险。
AI.method: 构建 HerHealthEval 受控评测框架：每个临床病例提供英、法、现代标准阿拉伯语三语匹配版本，各含六种沟通形式（规范、临床、通俗、间接或模糊、情绪担忧、刻意信息不足）；前五种保留相同临床信息与同一潜在诉求，末一种故意省略关键信息以检验模型是否主动澄清。在多语言指令模型及 QLoRA 适配变体上评测担忧分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性与跨形式一致性。
AI.result: 聚合准确率与一致性可能掩盖安全相关失败；在多语言适配模型 + 语言非对称风险监督下，法语与阿拉伯语漏检（under-triage）高达 0.994；改用来源衍生、语言不变的风险标签进行受控重适配后，漏检分别降至 0.572 与 0.558。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的多语言医疗评测须显式检验语域变化、不确定性处理，以及适配标签的来源与不变性。

title: Needles in a Raystack: Ultra-Sparse LiDAR Occupancy Detection for Bat Tracks
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted and presented at the AI4Nature@AVSS 2026 Workshop of the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026), Lecce, Italy
summary:
Monitoring flying animals is important for understanding and protecting biodiversity, but nocturnal species such as bats are difficult to observe in the field. Using LiDAR, bat movements at night result in ultra-sparse 3D spatio-temporal data in which standard reconstruction losses tend to predict only background and miss real flight paths. We study this problem as voxel-wise occupancy detection in sensor-centric LiDAR raystacks. A lightweight 3D U-Net is proposed that preserves temporal resolution, uses skip connections for spatial detail, and combines weighted binary cross-entropy with Dice loss to handle the strong class imbalance.
  In real LiDAR recordings of bats over open fields, cross-checked with acoustic monitoring, a reconstruction-based 3D convolutional autoencoder baseline fails to recover foreground trajectories. In contrast, the proposed U-Net recovers sparse foreground occupancy in diagnostic experiments and produces coherent occupancy patterns along bat flight trajectories, providing a practical basis for validation-scale experiments, later clustering of flight tracks, and future integration of bat activity information into biodiversity-aware turbine curtailment strategies.

AI.tldr: 利用轻量3D U-Net在传感器中心LiDAR射线栈中做体素级占用检测，从超稀疏夜间数据中恢复蝙蝠飞行轨迹，克服了重构基线只预测背景的问题。
AI.motivation: 夜间飞行物种（如蝙蝠）难以实地观测，而LiDAR记录的蝙蝠运动呈超稀疏3D时空数据，标准重构损失只预测背景、漏掉真实飞行路径，亟需有效的占用检测方法。
AI.method: 将问题建模为传感器中心LiDAR射线栈中的体素级占用检测；提出轻量3D U-Net，保持时间分辨率，用跳跃连接保留空间细节，并以加权二元交叉熵结合Dice损失应对强类别不平衡；对比重构式3D卷积自编码器基线。
AI.result: 在开阔田野的真实LiDAR记录并结合声学监测交叉验证下，重构式3D卷积自编码器基线无法恢复前景轨迹；所提U-Net在诊断实验中恢复稀疏前景占用，并沿蝙蝠飞行轨迹生成连贯的占用模式。
AI.conclusion: 该U-Net为验证规模实验、后续飞行轨迹聚类以及将蝙蝠活动信息纳入生物多样性感知的风机限速策略提供了实用基础。

title: LapaTrack-3D: 6 DoF pre-operative shape tracking for laparoscopic surgery
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Robotics and Bionics (T-MRB)
summary: This work proposes a real-time 6 Degree-of-Freedom (6 DoF) tracking algorithm for monocular laparoscopic surgery. It provides alignment between intra-operative video and pre-operative data (e.g., CT). The 6 DoF tracking offers a solution for accurately locating the internal anatomy of the target organ despite the lack of tactile feedback and transparency. The ORB-SLAM2 framework is adopted and modified for prior-based 3D tracking with four major modifications. First, the primitive 3D shape is used for fast initialization of the ORB-SLAM2 monocular mode. Second, a pseudo-segmentation strategy is employed to separate the target organ from the background for tracking. Third, the 3D shape is incorporated as a geometric prior in its pose graph optimization. Fourth, the Multi-Scale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) algorithm is leveraged and modified for image enhancement in challenging illumination scenarios. In-vivo and ex-vivo experiments validate that LapaTrack-3D provides robust 3D tracking and effectively handles typical challenges such as poor illumination, fast motion, out-of-field-of-view scenarios, partial visibility, and ``organ-background'' relative motion. LapaTrack-3D achieves a processing rate of 13 Hz for 1280*720 pixel video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LapaTrack-3D，一种用于单目腹腔镜手术的实时 6 自由度跟踪算法，通过改进 ORB-SLAM2 实现术中视频与术前数据（如 CT）的对齐，在体与离体实验中实现稳健跟踪并达 13 Hz（1280×720）处理速度。
AI.motivation: 腹腔镜手术缺乏触觉反馈且视野透明，难以准确定位目标器官内部解剖结构；需要将术中视频与术前数据（如 CT）对齐，以提供 6 自由度定位支持。
AI.method: 基于 ORB-SLAM2 框架进行四项改进：(1) 利用原始 3D 形状快速初始化单目模式；(2) 采用伪分割策略将目标器官与背景分离；(3) 将 3D 形状作为几何先验融入位姿图优化；(4) 引入并改进多尺度 Retinex 色彩保真（MSRCP）算法以应对恶劣光照。
AI.result: 在体与离体实验验证 LapaTrack-3D 具有稳健 3D 跟踪能力，可有效处理光照不足、快速运动、视野外、部分可见及"器官-背景"相对运动等典型挑战；对 1280×720 视频处理速率达 13 Hz。
AI.conclusion: LapaTrack-3D 为单目腹腔镜手术提供了一种实时、稳健的 6 自由度跟踪方案，有效实现术中视频与术前数据对齐，能够应对腹腔镜场景中的多种典型挑战。

title: Solving Minimum Span Antibandwidth and Cyclic Antibandwidth Labeling Problems
summary: The Antibandwidth and Cyclic Antibandwidth problems are NP-hard graph labeling problems that aim to maximize the minimum (cyclic) distance between labels assigned to adjacent vertices. Extensive research on these problems has resulted in a variety of mathematical formulations and computational approaches. However, their minimum span perspective, in which a prescribed minimum (cyclic) distance is fixed and the objective is to minimize the label span, has received comparatively little attention. In this paper, we consider this complementary perspective by introducing the Minimum Span Antibandwidth/Cyclic Antibandwidth Labeling (MSABL/MSCABL) problems and developing a unified Boolean Satisfiability (SAT)-based framework for solving them. The SAT-based framework formulates MSABL/MSCABL as a sequence of decision problems and exploits their monotonicity to accelerate the search process. We also consider two SAT solving strategies, parallel and incremental SAT solving: the former examines multiple candidate spans concurrently, while the latter reuses a single SAT instance while progressively restricting the label domain. The proposed approaches are evaluated on benchmark instances from the Harwell-Boeing Sparse Matrix Collection and compared with CPLEXCP, CPLEXMIP, and Gurobi. The results show that SAT-based approaches are highly competitive in solution quality, with the parallel approach performing best overall for MSCABL and the incremental approach for MSABL. With the no-hole constraint, they remain competitive with CPLEXCP and significantly outperform CPLEXMIP and Gurobi, particularly for MSCABL. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SAT solving as an exact approach for MSABL and MSCABL.

AI.tldr: 提出最小跨度反带宽/循环反带宽标号问题（MSABL/MSCABL），建立统一SAT求解框架，采用并行与增量两种策略，在Harwell-Boeing实例上验证其解质量具高度竞争力。
AI.motivation: 反带宽与循环反带宽问题的既有研究多关注最大最小（循环）距离的"最大化"视角，而其"最小跨度"互补视角（固定最小距离、最小化标号跨度）研究稀少，缺少高效精确求解方法。
AI.method: 将MSABL/MSCABL形式化为一系列决策问题，利用其单调性加速搜索；设计两种SAT求解策略：并行SAT（同时检验多个候选跨度）与增量SAT（复用单一实例并逐步收缩标号域）；在Harwell-Boeing稀疏矩阵集基准上与CPLEX-CP、CPLEX-MIP、Gurobi对比，并考察no-hole约束。
AI.result: SAT方法解质量高度竞争力：MSCABL上并行策略总体最优，MSABL上增量策略最优；加入no-hole约束后仍与CPLEX-CP相当，并显著优于CPLEX-MIP与Gurobi，在MSCABL上尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: SAT求解可作为MSABL与MSCABL的有效精确方法，统一SAT框架结合单调性与并行/增量策略具备良好性能。

title: Robust Federated Q-Learning with Almost No Communication
comment: Accepted at the 2026 American Control Conference (ACC 2026)
summary: We consider a federated reinforcement learning setting involving $M$ agents, all of whom interact with a common Markov Decision Process (MDP). The agents exchange information via a central server to learn the optimal value function. Our goal is to understand to what extent one can hope for collaborative sample-complexity speedups in such a setting, when a small fraction of the agents are adversarial and can act arbitrarily. To that end, we propose Robust Fed-Q}, a federated Q-learning algorithm that blends ideas from both model-based and model-free RL, along with the median-of-means device from robust statistics. We prove that despite corruption, with high-probability, Robust Fed-Q (i) guarantees exact convergence to the optimal value function in the limit of infinite samples, and (ii) enjoys near-optimal finite-time rates that benefit from collaboration. In addition, our approach requires just $\tilde{O}(1)$ rounds of communication to achieve each of the above guarantees, a feature of independent interest in FL where communication is the major bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在部分智能体对抗性攻击下的联邦强化学习，提出Robust Fed-Q算法，融合基于模型与无模型RL思想及中位数均值技术，在有限样本下实现精确收敛与协作加速，且通信轮数仅为Õ(1)。
AI.motivation: 在涉及M个智能体与同一MDP交互、通过中央服务器交换信息的联邦强化学习中，需明确当少数智能体为对抗性且可任意行动时，能否实现协作样本复杂度的加速。
AI.method: 提出Robust Fed-Q联邦Q学习算法，结合基于模型与无模型RL的思想，并采用鲁棒统计中的中位数均值（median-of-means）方法抵抗对抗性污染。
AI.result: 证明即使存在污染，Robust Fed-Q以高概率：(i)在样本数趋于无穷时精确收敛到最优价值函数；(ii)具有受益于协作的近最优有限时间收敛速率，且每项保证均仅需Õ(1)轮通信。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在存在对抗性智能体的联邦RL中同时实现精确收敛、协作加速与通信高效，Õ(1)通信特性在联邦学习中具有独立价值。

title: Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol
comment: v1.1. 8 pages. Also archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22817289
summary:
This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure.
  The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration.
  This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并操作化"摘要化偏差"（summarization bias）：LLM倾向于把叙事意义表达为抽象摘要标签，而非生成该意义的可重建推理结构。依据Bulut Doctrine的"讲述—展示"轴，偏差分为生成型（要求以客观投射展示情绪却退化为直接声明）与评价型（评判叙事质量时奖励讲述模式、漏检展示模式的抑制），后者危害更大。本文不主张已验证，仅定义构念、对照LLM-as-judge偏差、将既有独立信度研究重读为方向性证据，并预注册双机制检验及可放弃该构念的判定规则。
AI.motivation: LLM日益充当评判者与奖励模型，若其存在指向"讲述模式"的方向性偏差，将持续施加选择压力，使文本退化为直白声明。现有LLM-as-judge偏差研究尚未刻画这一沿叙事"讲述—展示"轴的特定方向性倾向，需先明确定义该构念并给出可检验形式。
AI.method: 概念定义与操作化：以Bulut Doctrine的讲述—展示轴为框架（讲述=显性声明、低重建负荷；展示=表层抑制、需由物理线索与间接性重建，即Objective Projection，为高负荷条件）；将偏差拆为生成型与评价型两个机制；把一项已完成的独立信度研究重新解读为与其一致的方向性证据；并预注册双机制检验及判定规则（含放弃该构念的条件）。
AI.result: 本文未报告已验证的实证结果。所提供的是：构念定义、与LLM-as-judge偏差的定位、从既有独立信度研究中获得的与假设一致的方向性证据，以及预注册的检验方案与决策规则。
AI.conclusion: "摘要化偏差"目前仍属待验证的构念，而非已确立结论。其价值在于把叙事学中的讲述—展示轴转化为可操作、可证伪的LLM评估假设；若预注册的双机制检验未满足判定条件，该构念应被放弃。

title: MTF-Net: Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network for Pedestrian Intention Prediction
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, accepted on International Conference on Cloud and Network Computing
summary: Accurately predicting pedestrian intentions is crucial for ensuring safe and proactive interaction between autonomous vehicles and pedestrians. However, existing approaches often depend on architectures that either model temporal dependencies within individual modalities or fuse modalities only at coarse semantic levels. To address these limitations, we propose MTF-Net, a novel Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network that jointly models kinematic, appearance, and contextual cues for pedestrian intention prediction. MTF-Net integrates four complementary modalities-bounding-box dynamics, human pose keypoints, local context, and scene-level semantics within a recurrent fusion framework enhanced by gated linear units (GLUs). These GLU-based modules adaptively regulate cross-modal information flow, enabling interpretable and efficient feature interaction across temporal scales. Through three dedicated temporal encoding branches and an attention-guided fusion head, the proposed model robustly anticipates pedestrian crossing intentions several frames before they occur. Extensive evaluations on the PIE and JAAD benchmarks demonstrate that MTF-Net surpasses recent transformer- and graph-based models, achieving up to 0.95 AUC on PIE and 0.94 AUC on JAAD, while maintaining real-time performance. The results highlight that reliable pedestrian intention prediction arises from principled multi-modal fusion rather than excessive architectural complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出MTF-Net，通过门控线性单元（GLU）融合四种模态（边界框动态、人体姿态关键点、局部上下文、场景语义），在PIE和JAAD上分别达到0.95和0.94 AUC，并保持实时性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶与行人安全交互需要准确预测行人意图。现有方法存在两类局限：一是仅在单模态内部建模时序依赖，二是仅在粗糙语义层面进行模态融合，难以充分利用多模态时序信息。
AI.method: MTF-Net为多模态时序特征融合网络。将边界框动态、人体姿态关键点、局部上下文、场景级语义四种互补模态整合进循环融合框架，并以GLU模块自适应调节跨模态信息流；通过三条专用时序编码分支和一个注意力引导融合头，实现跨时间尺度的可解释、高效特征交互。
AI.result: 在PIE基准上AUC最高达0.95，在JAAD上达0.94，超过近期基于Transformer和图结构的模型，同时保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的行人意图预测源于有原则的多模态融合，而非过度复杂的网络架构。

title: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
summary: Placing a grasped book into a tight shelf is a compact but difficult contact-rich control problem: millimetre-scale pose error can turn a geometrically valid approach into jamming, failed release, or incomplete seating. We study this final phase after grasp acquisition and global approach, and ask how control authority should be divided between known geometry and learned behaviour. Our method retains a nominal task-space controller for structured insertion and seating, while residual PPO supplies bounded local corrections and decides when to release. Only the brief open-retreat-reclose transition is scripted. For the final policy used on hardware, a deployment-matched simulation evaluation over 512 fixed conditions yields 98.50 percent mean success (0.23 percentage-point sample SD) across three independent training runs, compared with 37.89 percent for nominal control. On the physical xArm7, 60 trials over 30 matched conditions show the same qualitative advantage: residual control raises success from 26.7 percent to 63.3 percent, reduces failures from 22 to 11, and wins 13 of the 15 matched conditions in which the two controllers differ. Robustness tests show that performance remains above 87 percent under initialization perturbations up to 1.5x, while very tight clearances expose the geometric limit of local correction. These results support a hybrid design in which geometry preserves reliable task structure and learning is concentrated on the contact-sensitive behaviour that fixed rules handle poorly.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究机械臂将已抓取的书本插入狭窄书架的接触丰富控制问题，提出保留名义任务空间控制器负责结构化插入与就位，并由残差PPO提供有界局部修正和释放决策的混合架构。仿真512个固定条件下平均成功率98.50%（对比名义控制37.89%），xArm7实测成功率从26.7%提升至63.3%，验证了"几何保结构、学习管接触"的混合设计。
AI.motivation: 将抓取的书本放入狭窄书架时，毫米级位姿误差即可导致卡阻、释放失败或未完全就位，是典型的高精度接触丰富控制难题。作者聚焦抓取与全局接近之后的最终插入阶段，核心问题是：控制权限应如何在已知几何与学习行为之间分配。
AI.method: 采用混合控制架构：保留名义任务空间控制器完成结构化插入与就位；残差PPO输出有界局部修正，并决定释放时机；仅对短暂的"张开—退出—再闭合"过渡阶段使用脚本化控制。硬件部署策略通过部署匹配的仿真评估进行验证，并在物理xArm7上进行对照试验。
AI.result: 仿真中，对最终硬件策略在512个固定条件下进行部署匹配评估，三个独立训练run平均成功率98.50%（样本标准差0.23个百分点），名义控制为37.89%。物理xArm7上30个匹配条件共60次试验，残差控制将成功率从26.7%提升至63.3%，失败次数由22降至11，并在15个两控制器表现不同的匹配条件中赢得13个。鲁棒性测试表明，初始化扰动达1.5倍时性能仍高于87%，但极小间隙暴露了局部修正的几何极限。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种混合设计范式：由几何信息保持可靠的任务结构，而将学习集中在固定规则难以处理的接触敏感行为上。该方法在仿真与实物上均显著优于纯名义控制，且具备一定鲁棒性，但其局部修正能力受几何间隙限制。

title: Perception, Layout, and Validation: Calibrated Confidence for Reliable Straight-Through Processing of Financial Documents
summary: Straight-through processing (STP) on extracted key-value fields from financial documents without human review requires a calibrated probability together with a bounded guarantee on the residual error of the auto-approved tier. The emergence of modern Vision Language Models (VLMs) provides an out-of-the-box capability for extracting the key-values, but their verbalized confidence signals are unreliable and weakly track field correctness. This paper introduces a decomposed confidence layer along three interpretable channels, including perception, layout, and validation. Together with a final conformal risk control, the score can be used for reliable STP of financial documents. The method is validated on three public datasets covering real invoices, synthetic invoices, and ad-buy forms, using two different VLM families (Qwen3.6-27B and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite). Our decomposed score consistently improves the separation of correct from incorrect extractions, substantially raising the AUROC from 0.54-0.74 for VLM verbalized signals to 0.90-0.99 with contributions from all three designed channels. Crucially for industrial deployment, this enables usable STP. The native VLM confidence signals could clear only 0.1%-7.0% of fields under risk control at a target error of <10%. In contrast, the proposed method auto-approves 49-72% of fields while holding the empirical error of the accepted tier at or below the target.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由感知、布局、校验三个可解释通道组成的分解式置信度层，并结合保形风险控制，为金融文档的直通式处理（STP）提供可靠的概率校准与误差约束。在三个公开数据集和两种VLM家族上，AUROC由原生置信信号的0.54-0.74提升至0.90-0.99，自动批准率从0.1%-7.0%提升到49-72%，且接受层的经验误差不超过目标阈值。
AI.motivation: 金融文档的直通式处理（STP）要求无需人工复核即可自动批准抽取的键值字段，这需要校准良好的概率以及对自动批准层残余误差的有界保证。现代VLM虽可开箱即用地抽取键值，但其口头化（verbalized）置信信号不可靠、与字段正确性关联弱，无法支撑工业级STP。
AI.method: 将置信度分解为三个可解释通道——感知（perception）、布局（layout）、校验（validation），在此分解分数之上叠加最终的保形风险控制（conformal risk control），形成可用于金融文档可靠STP的评分机制。在覆盖真实发票、合成发票和广告购买表单的三个公开数据集上，使用Qwen3.6-27B与Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite两个VLM家族进行验证。
AI.result: 分解式评分一致地改善了正确与错误抽取的区分能力，AUROC从VLM口头化信号的0.54-0.74显著提升至0.90-0.99，且三个设计通道均有贡献。在目标误差<10%的风险控制下，原生VLM置信信号仅能放行0.1%-7.0%的字段，而所提方法可自动批准49-72%的字段，同时将接受层的经验误差保持在目标以内。
AI.conclusion: 分解式置信度与保形风险控制的结合可显著提升VLM抽取信号的可靠性，实现工业可用的金融文档STP，在满足残余误差保证的前提下大幅提高自动批准率，降低人工复核需求。

title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
summary: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

AI.tldr: 提出按需注意力（ODA），用轻量recall head预测全局注意力的收益，实现局部优先解码，在保留预训练权重和历史KV缓存的前提下减少全局读取并加速长上下文推理。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中，全注意力解码在每一步都读取不断增长的历史，而不论其对下一步预测是否有益，导致效率低下。作者发现预训练模型在全局读取之前的解码状态已包含可预测该收益的信息。
AI.method: ODA采用局部优先的解码策略，训练一个轻量recall head，根据生成过程中预测收益的变化选择性触发全局注意力。仅训练recall head，冻结预训练权重，并保留完整历史KV缓存以备后续召回。同时在vLLM中实现GPU端条件执行，将减少的全局读取转化为实际解码加速。
AI.result: 在Qwen与Gemma模型（含混合注意力骨干）上的实验表明，选择性召回恢复了局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时显著减少全局读取，并在长上下文长度上相对全注意力实现实际解码加速。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持一种长上下文推理范式：预训练模型可自行引导对其所保留信息的访问，从而兼顾性能与效率。

title: MoSSGate: Memory-Modulated State-Space Gating for Skin Lesion Segmentation
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, accepted on International Conference on Cloud and Network Computing
summary: Accurate skin lesion segmentation is crucial for reliable computer-aided dermatological diagnosis, yet existing convolutional and transformer-based models often struggle to jointly capture long-range spatial dependencies and fine boundary details under limited computational budgets. This trade-off between global context modeling and boundary-aware localization frequently leads to over-segmentation, fragmented predictions, or missing thin peripheral structures. To address this challenge, we propose MoSSGate, a plug-and-play module for U-Net that integrates (i) boundary-aware spatial gating to restrict long-range propagation to informative regions, (ii) an external memory modulator that provides sample-adaptive dynamic control, and (iii) parallel 2D state-space modeling for efficient global context aggregation with linear complexity. The proposed design enables adaptive, context-aware information propagation while preserving sharp and accurate lesion boundaries. Extensive experiments on the ISIC 2017 and ISIC 2018 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy with strong efficiency, achieving 86.3% and 85.9% mIoU and 92.6% and 90.6% Dice, respectively, while requiring substantially fewer FLOPs than most competing CNN-based methods. These results highlight a favorable accuracy efficiency trade-off for high-resolution medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用模块MoSSGate，结合边界感知空间门控、外部记忆调制器和并行2D状态空间建模，以线性复杂度实现全局上下文聚合，在ISIC 2017/2018上取得高精度且计算量显著低于多数CNN方法。
AI.motivation: 皮肤病变分割对计算机辅助诊断至关重要，但现有卷积与Transformer模型在有限算力下难以兼顾长程空间依赖与精细边界，导致过度分割、预测碎片化或遗漏细小边缘结构。
AI.method: 提出用于U-Net的即插即用模块MoSSGate，包含：(i) 边界感知空间门控，将长程传播限制在信息量丰富的区域；(ii) 外部记忆调制器，提供样本自适应的动态控制；(iii) 并行2D状态空间建模，以线性复杂度高效聚合全局上下文，实现自适应、上下文感知的信息传播并保持锐利边界。
AI.result: 在ISIC 2017和ISIC 2018基准上分别达到86.3%、85.9% mIoU和92.6%、90.6% Dice，精度领先，且FLOPs显著少于多数竞争性CNN方法。
AI.conclusion: MoSSGate在高分辨率医学图像分割中实现了有利的精度—效率权衡。

title: MaskHarness-WAM: Instance-Grounded Harnessing for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires not only stable local visuomotor control, but also continuous target tracking and reliable task progress assessment throughout execution. This challenge becomes particularly critical when multiple objects share identical appearances and must be manipulated in a prescribed order. In such scenarios, relying solely on a limited-horizon manipulation policy is often insufficient to determine which instance should be operated on and when the task should transition to the next stage. To address this challenge, we propose MaskHarness-WAM, an instance-grounded harness for long-horizon manipulation. The proposed system connects high-level task planning with low-level manipulation policies through target masks, while leveraging visual feedback for subtask scheduling and continuous execution. Since each subtask corresponds to a different target instance, the low-level policy requires a newly established initial target mask under the updated scene at each subtask transition. The harness continuously re-observes the environment, generates, and verifies the target mask at subtask boundaries, thereby updating the instance-level spatial condition provided to the low-level policy. Furthermore, the system advances the manipulation process by switching target instances according to the verified completion status of each subtask. Experiments on a real robot platform demonstrate that MaskHarness-WAM substantially outperforms limited-horizon policies on sequential multi-object manipulation, showing its effectiveness in extending local manipulation skills to reliable long-horizon execution.

AI.tldr: 提出 MaskHarness-WAM，一种基于实例掩码的长期操作框架，通过目标掩码连接高层任务规划与低层操作策略，并利用视觉反馈进行子任务调度与连续执行，在真实机器人平台上显著优于有限视野策略。
AI.motivation: 长期机器人操作需要稳定的局部视觉运动控制，还需要持续的目标跟踪与可靠的任务进度评估。当多个物体外观相同且必须按指定顺序操作时，仅依赖有限视野的操作策略难以判断应操作哪个实例、何时切换到下一阶段。
AI.method: MaskHarness-WAM 通过目标掩码将高层任务规划与低层操作策略相连，并利用视觉反馈进行子任务调度与连续执行。由于每个子任务对应不同的目标实例，低层策略在每次子任务切换时需要在更新后的场景中重新建立初始目标掩码。该框架在子任务边界处持续重新观察环境、生成并验证目标掩码，从而更新提供给低层策略的实例级空间条件；并根据各子任务的验证完成状态切换目标实例以推进操作过程。
AI.result: 在真实机器人平台上的实验表明，MaskHarness-WAM 在顺序多物体操作任务上显著优于有限视野策略。
AI.conclusion: MaskHarness-WAM 能有效将局部操作技能扩展为可靠的长期执行，实例级掩码验证与子任务调度机制具有有效性。

title: MTVA-Bench: Evaluating the Language Model Inside Cascaded Voice Agents
summary: Generally, most voice agents are cascaded systems, i.e., an ASR model transcribes the caller's audio, a language model reads the transcript and decides what to say and which backend tools to call, and a TTS model speaks the reply. Nearly all of the decision making happens in the language model, but existing evaluations measure it either too broadly or too narrowly. End-to-end voice benchmarks score the full pipeline, so recognition errors and model errors mix into a single number. LLM benchmarks isolate the model but they do not evaluate what makes real phone calls hard, such as transcription issues, caller's voice being split across messages and the requirement that replies follow the language and script specified. We introduce the Multi-Turn Voice Agent Benchmark (MTVA-Bench), which evaluates the language model on the same conditions it faces inside a cascaded system. The caller is played by an LLM following a set of rubrics and tool calls are answered by a mock backend which responds to the arguments the model actually sent. The benchmark contains 49 agents working across 490 reviewed scenarios and supports 7 languages. Scoring is a combination of deterministic checks on tool calls with two LLM judges, one that scores scenario specific rules and one that grades conversation quality without access to the task. Both judges must cite specific messages from the transcript. Task and conversation scores are weighted equally, since a call can complete its task and still go badly for the caller. In a seven-model study, six of the models select the correct tool within 6.4 points of one another, but their overall scores span 24.4 points. Most of the gap comes from argument values, action ordering, rule compliance, and what the model says around its tool calls.

AI.tldr: 提出MTVA-Bench，在级联语音代理的真实条件下评测语言模型，涵盖49个代理、490个场景、7种语言，通过确定性工具调用检查加两名LLM裁判打分，揭示模型间整体分数差异远大于工具选择准确率差异。
AI.motivation: 现有评测过宽或过窄：端到端语音基准把识别错误与模型错误混为单一分数，LLM基准则忽略了真实通话的难点，如转写问题、来电者语音被拆分到多条消息、回复需符合指定语言与文字系统。
AI.method: MTVA-Bench让语言模型处于级联系统中的相同条件：由LLM按评分细则扮演来电者，模拟后端按模型实际发送的参数应答工具调用；包含49个代理、490个经审核场景、支持7种语言。评分结合工具调用的确定性检查与两名LLM裁判，一名评场景特定规则，一名在不接触任务信息下评对话质量，且均须引用转写中的具体消息；任务分与对话分等权。
AI.result: 在七模型研究中，六个模型选择正确工具的表现相差不超过6.4分，但整体分数跨度达24.4分；差距主要来自参数取值、动作顺序、规则遵守以及模型在工具调用前后所说的话。
AI.conclusion: 应在级联语音代理的真实条件下评测语言模型，工具选择准确率不足以反映整体能力，参数、顺序、规则合规与话术质量才是主要区分点。

title: SoftTri: Smooth Triangular Membership Functions for Adaptive Fuzzy Inference Systems
summary: Triangular membership functions (MFs) are widely used in fuzzy systems because of their interpretability, low parameterization complexity, and strong locality properties. However, their inherent nondifferentiability at knot points limits the effectiveness of gradient-based optimization in adaptive neuro-fuzzy architectures, often necessitating subgradient approximations or heuristic smoothing techniques. In this paper, we propose \emph{SoftTri}, a differentiable triangular membership function constructed using a smooth soft-hinge mechanism inspired by Swish-type activations. The proposed formulation preserves the geometric structure and localized behavior of classical triangular MFs while providing $C^\infty$ smoothness with respect to both the input variable and the membership parameters $(a,b,c)$ for any finite sharpness parameter $β>0$. Closed-form analytical gradients are derived to enable efficient and fully differentiable backpropagation-based learning. SoftTri is integrated into a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy neural network with grid-partitioned rules and evaluated on multiple one-dimensional and two-dimensional nonlinear approximation benchmarks as well as a real-world regression task using the Airfoil Self-Noise dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that SoftTri consistently improves optimization stability and approximation accuracy compared with classical triangular membership functions, while achieving performance comparable to or better than Gaussian MFs under identical rule structures and training settings. The proposed approach provides an effective compromise between interpretability and differentiable optimization in modern neuro-fuzzy learning systems.

AI.tldr: 提出SoftTri——一种基于软铰链机制的可微三角隶属函数，在保持三角MF几何结构与局部性的同时实现C^∞光滑，并给出解析梯度，用于可微神经模糊学习。
AI.motivation: 经典三角隶属函数(MF)因可解释性强、参数少、局部性好而被广泛使用，但其在拐点处不可微，限制了基于梯度的优化在自适应神经模糊架构中的效果，通常只能借助次梯度近似或启发式平滑。
AI.method: 借鉴Swish型激活的平滑软铰链机制构造SoftTri，保留经典三角MF的几何结构与局部行为，对输入变量与隶属参数(a,b,c)均具有C^∞光滑性（任意有限锐度参数β>0）；推导闭式解析梯度以支持高效全可微反向传播学习；将其集成到网格划分规则的Takagi–Sugeno模糊神经网络中。
AI.result: 在多个一维、二维非线性逼近基准以及Airfoil Self-Noise真实回归任务上评估：相比经典三角MF，SoftTri稳定提升优化稳定性与逼近精度，并在相同规则结构与训练设置下与高斯MF性能相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: SoftTri在现代神经模糊学习系统中为可解释性与可微优化之间提供了有效折中。

title: dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models
summary: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文将交错注意力与RNN层的混合架构自回归模型（Qwen3.5，0.8B/2B/4B/9B）适配为扩散语言模型，构建dQwen3.5系列，发现混合骨干是高效的适配起点。
AI.motivation: 将预训练自回归（AR）模型适配为扩散语言模型（DLM）是低成本路径，但现有适配几乎都从全注意力Transformer出发；而AR建模已转向注意力与RNN层交错的混合架构。RNN结构上具有因果性，难以双向化，这构成适配障碍，本文即探究此类骨干能否成为有效的DLM。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5的0.8B、2B、4B、9B四个规模上，将交错注意力与RNN层的混合架构适配为扩散语言模型，得到dQwen3.5系列，并以全注意力模型作为对照。
AI.result: 与全注意力对照相比，混合骨干达到相同训练损失所需token数约为其一半；在各规模上，dQwen3.5的任意顺序解码行为与全注意力DLM相似，且在并行解码下表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 尽管存在RNN因果性带来的结构错配，混合骨干仍可作为扩散语言模型的高效适配起点，在训练效率与解码表现上兼具优势。

title: A Two-Stage Multi-Scale Attention-Based Network for Weakly Supervised Cataract Fundus Image Enhancement
summary: Cataract is a major cause of vision loss and hinders further diagnosis. However, cataract fundus image enhancement often grapples with challenges such as limited paired cataract retinal images and insufficient recovery of fine details in the retinal images. To mitigate these challenges, we in this paper propose a two-stage multi-scale attention-based network (TSMSA-Net) for weakly supervised cataract fundus image enhancement. Our TSMSA-Net leverages the domain transformation to synthesis paired real-like cataract images, solving the problem of difficult acquisition of paired images. To further extract detailed information from fundus images and reduce the generation of artifacts during the enhancement process, we propose a multi-scale attention-based stage to learn more useful features for cataract image enhancement. Experimental results on Kaggle and ODIR-5K demonstrate that our TSMSA-Net outperforms current state-of-the-art cataract fundus images enhancement even without paired images and exhibits certain generalization ability. Experimental results on Kaggle and ODIR-5K datasets indicate that our TSMSA-Net outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods for cataract fundus image enhancement, even in the absence of paired images. Additionally, it demonstrates a certain level of generalization capability. The enhancement also can improve the performance of vessel segmentation and classification in cataract images.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段多尺度注意力网络TSMSA-Net，实现弱监督白内障眼底图像增强，在无配对图像条件下超越现有SOTA并具有泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 白内障是视力丧失的主要原因并妨碍后续诊断。白内障眼底图像增强面临两大挑战：配对的白内障-视网膜图像稀缺，以及增强过程中视网膜图像细节恢复不足。
AI.method: TSMSA-Net采用两阶段架构：第一阶段利用域变换合成类真实白内障图像，缓解配对图像难以获取的问题；第二阶段设计多尺度注意力模块，提取更有效的特征以增强细节并减少伪影生成。整体采用弱监督学习范式。
AI.result: 在Kaggle和ODIR-5K数据集上，TSMSA-Net在即使没有配对图像的条件下也优于当前最先进的白内障眼底图像增强方法，并表现出一定的泛化能力；增强后的图像还能提升白内障图像中血管分割与分类的性能。
AI.conclusion: TSMSA-Net通过域变换合成与多尺度注意力机制，有效应对配对数据缺失和细节恢复不足的问题，验证了弱监督框架在白内障眼底图像增强中的有效性与下游任务增益价值。

title: Compliance for Free: Learning Identifiable Impedance via Bilateral Teleoperation
summary: Vision-language-action models tell a robot where to move, but not how hard to push. Contact-rich tasks depend on that second quantity, compliance, yet no widely used demonstration interface records it. The obstacle is identifiability as realized pose and measured force cannot separate the operator's intended equilibrium from their stiffness, so VR controllers, SpaceMouse and handheld grippers cannot supply compliance supervision even in principle. Prior compliance-output policies work around this with hand-specified task structure, privileged simulation contact state, or dedicated force and tactile hardware. Four-channel bilateral teleoperation removes the ambiguity directly by using the leader arm as a separate measurement of the intended equilibrium, making per-axis stiffness identifiable by regression using only the joint-torque sensing already on the manipulator. This yields per-timestep, direction-dependent compliance labels at zero annotation cost, which we use to fine-tune a VLA to emit stiffness alongside pose. On a Franka Research 3 wiping task, ours is the only policy of five whose contact force changes when the instruction asks for a firm wipe rather than a normal one (6.4N (normal) to 9.1N (firm) RMS, Cohen's d = 0.89, p = 0.023

AI.tldr: 论文指出视觉-语言-动作模型只给出"往哪动"而不给出"用多大力"，其根源是柔顺性（刚度）在常规示教接口下不可辨识；作者用四通道双边遥操作以领导者臂作为期望平衡位置的独立测量，仅靠机械臂已有的关节力矩传感即可回归出逐轴刚度标签，零标注成本地微调 VLA 同时输出位姿与刚度，在 Franka Research 3 擦抹任务上实现了唯一随指令力度变化的接触力。
AI.motivation: 接触密集型任务不仅需要知道运动方向，还需要知道"推多用力"，即柔顺性/刚度；但现有常用示教接口（VR 控制器、SpaceMouse、手持夹爪）无法记录该量。其根本障碍是可辨识性：已实现的位姿与测得的力无法将操作者"期望平衡位置"与"刚度"分离开来，因此这些接口原则上无法提供柔顺性监督信号。已有输出柔顺性的策略只能依赖人工指定任务结构、特权仿真接触状态或专用力/触觉硬件来规避该问题，缺乏通用且低成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用四通道双边遥操作，把领导者臂作为期望平衡位置的独立测量，从而直接消除位姿与刚度的歧义；仅利用机械臂上已有的关节力矩传感，通过回归得到逐轴刚度。由此产生逐时间步、方向相关的柔顺性标签，且零额外标注成本。再用这些标签微调一个 VLA 模型，使其在输出位姿的同时输出刚度。
AI.result: 在 Franka Research 3 擦抹任务上，与五种策略相比，该方法是唯一在指令要求"用力擦"时接触力发生变化的策略：从正常擦的 6.4N 提升到用力擦的 9.1N（RMS），Cohen's d = 0.89，p = 0.023，具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 通过双边遥操作使刚度可辨识，可以零标注成本地获取逐时间步、方向相关的柔顺性标签，并成功让 VLA 在输出动作的同时输出刚度，验证了柔顺性监督在真实接触任务中的有效性，为 VLA 从"往哪动"扩展到"用多大力"提供了一条无需专用力/触觉硬件的可行路径。

title: PaGNet: A Panel-Aware GBDT--Neural Network for Multi-Target Corporate Tax Avoidance Proxy Forecasting
summary: Forecasting corporate tax avoidance proxies from firm--year panel data is challenging because predictive signals are distributed across short firm histories and related targets, while screening-oriented use requires transparent model behavior. We propose PaGNet (Panel-Aware GBDT--Neural Network), a two-branch hybrid that combines a LightGBM branch using panel-temporal summaries with a Panel-MLP branch using attention-pooled temporal aggregation and shared-trunk multi-task learning. A per-target validation-optimal blender produces both the final prediction and a compact branch-reliance diagnostic without trainable fusion parameters. On the KoTaP panel of 1{,}754 Korean listed firms from 2011--2024, PaGNet is evaluated under a leakage-free, shared-hyperparameter protocol across four feature regimes. In the direct-proxy-lag-excluded FS1 regime and the tax-history-augmented FS2 regime, accrual targets (TSTA, TSDA) route stably to the LightGBM branch, where PaGNet raises explained variance over the strongest of six baselines by roughly $0.08$--$0.11$ on the primary split. GETR often leans toward the neural branch, while CETR exposes a validation--test branch-selection mismatch rather than a stable branch assignment. A panel-flatten control shows that most accrual gains come from observed multi-year base-panel values, with PaGNet's panel-aware representation adding a smaller but directionally consistent refinement. Rolling-origin analysis confirms stable accrual routing, bounds ETR diagnostics to split-specific behavior, and identifies a far-horizon split where supervised models underperform naive persistence. PaGNet is therefore best viewed not as a universally superior tabular learner, but as a proxy-aware panel model that combines competitive forecasting with explicit per-target branch-reliance reporting.

AI.tldr: 提出PaGNet——融合LightGBM与Panel-MLP的双分支混合模型，用于企业避税代理变量的面板预测，在韩国KoTaP样本上通过逐目标最优混合器同时输出预测与分支依赖诊断，兼顾预测性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 企业避税代理变量的firm-year面板预测面临三重挑战：预测信号分散于较短的个体历史与相关目标之间；筛选导向的应用要求模型行为透明；不同避税代理（权责发生制类与有效税率类）的信号结构差异大，单一模型难以普遍占优。
AI.method: PaGNet为双分支混合：一支为使用面板—时序汇总特征的LightGBM，另一支为采用注意力池化时序聚合与共享主干多任务学习的Panel-MLP；由逐目标验证集最优混合器生成最终预测及紧凑的分支依赖诊断，且不含可训练融合参数。在KoTAP（2011–2024年1754家韩国上市公司）上采用无泄漏、共享超参数协议，跨四种特征配置评估，并设置面板展平控制与滚动原点分析。
AI.result: 在排除直接代理滞后的FS1与加入税务历史的FS2中，权责发生制目标TSTA、TSDA稳定路由至LightGBM，主划分上解释方差较六个基线中最强者提升约0.08–0.11；GETR多倾向神经分支；CETR暴露验证—测试分支选择不一致而非稳定分配。面板展平控制显示权责发生制增益主要来自观测到的多年基线面板值，面板感知表示仅带来较小但方向一致的改进；滚动原点分析确认路由稳定，并将ETR诊断限制为划分特定行为，同时发现长预测期划分中监督模型劣于朴素持续性基准。
AI.conclusion: PaGNet不应被视为普适更优的表格学习器，而是一种代理感知的面板模型，在具备竞争力的预测能力之外，提供显式的逐目标分支依赖报告，适配筛选导向的透明性需求。

title: Evaluating Financial Sentiment in the Age of AI
summary: Financial sentiment measures are widely used in empirical finance, but it remains unclear whether general-purpose large language models (LLMs) improve on existing finance-specific methods. This paper evaluates twelve sentiment models, including dictionary-based methods, finance-specific transformers, and open-source LLMs, using two criteria: linguistic validity and economic validity. We find that general-purpose LLMs achieve classification performance comparable to finance-specific transformer models without task-specific fine-tuning. However, higher classification accuracy does not translate into stronger economic relationships. Several models produce sentiment measures that are significantly associated with earnings surprises, but none is significantly associated with next-day stock returns. Model performance is strongest for announcements with large earnings beats or misses and substantially weaker for announcements with more moderate earnings surprises. These findings suggest that financial sentiment captures information about firms' economic performance but has limited ability to explain short-run market reactions

AI.tldr: 通用大语言模型在金融情绪分类上可与金融专用Transformer模型媲美，但更高分类精度并未带来更强经济有效性；多数模型的情绪指标与盈余惊喜显著相关，却均无法显著预测次日股票收益。
AI.motivation: 金融情绪指标在实证金融中被广泛应用，但尚不清楚通用大语言模型（LLMs）是否优于现有的金融专用方法，即通用LLM的高分类精度能否转化为更强的经济解释力，这是论文的核心动机。
AI.method: 评估十二种情绪模型，涵盖基于词典的方法、金融专用Transformer模型以及开源LLMs。采用两项标准：语言学有效性（分类性能）与经济有效性（与盈余惊喜、次日股票收益的关联）。
AI.result: 通用LLM无需任务特定微调即可达到与金融专用Transformer相当的分类表现；但更高分类准确率未转化为更强经济关系。多个模型的情绪指标与盈余惊喜显著相关，但没有一个与次日股票收益显著相关。模型表现在盈余大幅超预期或不及预期的公告上最强，在盈余惊喜较温和的公告上明显更弱。
AI.conclusion: 金融情绪主要捕捉企业经济绩效信息，对解释短期市场反应的解释力有限。语言学有效性与经济有效性并不一致，评估金融情绪模型时不应仅依赖分类精度。

title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
summary: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"harm laundering"（危害洗白）概念，指LLM安全对齐将显性歧视内容转化为隐性表征伤害而非真正消除。基于45万条性别指向补全、15个GPT系列模型的实证分析发现：毒性分数随模型迭代下降，但表征伤害上升，二者背离，毒性分数并非危害降低的充分代理。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估依赖表面形式分类器，报告危害分数随模型代际下降，学界据此认为模型安全性提升。作者质疑该方法论存在系统性缺陷：显性歧视内容可能并非被移除，而是被转化为更隐蔽的形式。因此需要揭示这种"分数下降≠危害减少"的评估盲区。
AI.method: 构建45万条性别指向补全数据集，覆盖GPT-2至GPT-5共15个模型、3种人口统计条件。采用主题聚类分析表征内容迁移，结合三个独立分类器（含Detoxify毒性评分、REGARD表征伤害评分）与情感分析进行交叉验证，并计算指标与模型发布日期的相关性。最后形式化"危害洗白"为三项标准检验，并提出三阶段检测协议。
AI.result: GPT-2中女性指向输出普遍存在的性暴力聚类在GPT-4时消失，但男性指向补全获得正向表征领域（照护、情感表达、盟友身份），女性指向则未获得；GPT-5中Topic 5（1,997份文档）将乳腺癌框定为男性权利议题，女性指向无对应聚类，且三个分类器均判为非毒性。情感分数在GPT-4反转（早期贬低女性，后期过度矫正）。女性指向主题多样性在GPT-4对齐边界相对男性下降36%（W/M=0.58，GPT-2为0.91）。REGARD表征伤害差异与发布日期的相关性显著（ρ=+0.55，p=.034），Detoxify则不显著（ρ=-0.23，p=.42），即毒性分数下降的同时表征伤害上升。
AI.conclusion: 危害被"洗白"而非消除：安全对齐使毒性可测指标下降，却以表征伤害的隐性转移为代价。在OpenAI GPT谱系内，毒性分数降低不足以作为危害降低的代理指标。作者提出的三标准检验与三阶段检测协议可推广至任意生成模型，呼吁安全评估从表面形式分类转向对表征层面的系统监测。

title: Scene-Q: Confidence-Aware Coarse-to-Fine Querying of 3D Scenes with Selective VLM Reasoning
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IROS 2026
summary: Indoor mobile robots require open-vocabulary scene understanding that grounds natural-language queries in a consistent 3D map. Many existing systems ultimately rely on cosine-similarity retrieval with contrastive image--text encoders, which is efficient but brittle when labels are near-synonymous or multiple similar instances appear. We present Scene-Q, a confidence-aware coarse-to-fine querying framework that normalizes encoder scores with temperature scaling and selectively invokes a reasoning VLM only for low-confidence cases. High-confidence queries are answered by fast retrieval, while ambiguous ones are reranked over a small top-K candidate set using the original multi-view images and instance bounding boxes, enabling context-aware disambiguation at low cost. Scene-Q improves open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation on ScanNet200 and natural-language 3D instance retrieval on real-world reconstructions, with the largest gains on spatial and relational queries while keeping a substantial fraction of queries on the fast path.

AI.tldr: Scene-Q 是一个置信度感知的由粗到细查询框架，通过温度缩放归一化编码器分数，仅对低置信度查询调用推理 VLM 进行重排序，在保持低成本的同时提升开放词汇 3D 场景理解性能。
AI.motivation: 室内移动机器人需要开放词汇的场景理解，将自然语言查询落地到一致的 3D 地图中。现有系统多依赖对比式图像-文本编码器的余弦相似度检索，虽高效但在标签近义或多个相似实例出现时表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出 Scene-Q：采用置信度感知的由粗到细查询框架。首先用温度缩放对编码器分数进行归一化；对高置信度查询直接用快速检索回答；对模糊查询，则在小的 top-K 候选集上，利用原始多视图图像和实例边界框调用推理 VLM 进行重排序，实现低成本、上下文感知的消歧。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet200 的开放词汇 3D 实例分割以及真实重建上的自然语言 3D 实例检索任务中均取得提升，其中在空间类和关系类查询上增益最大，同时仍有相当比例的查询走快速路径。
AI.conclusion: Scene-Q 通过置信度分流的粗到细设计，在检索效率与推理精度之间取得平衡，有效缓解近义标签与相似实例带来的检索脆弱性，适用于室内机器人开放词汇 3D 场景理解。

title: DR-MPC: Fast and Feasible Dynamics-Relaxed Model-Predictive Control for Legged Locomotion
summary: This paper presents dynamics-relaxed model predictive control (DR-MPC), a novel MPC formulation for legged locomotion, and a tailored interior-point method (IPM) solver. The formulation combines online optimization feasibility by construction with a contact-aware input parameterization. DR-MPC moves the dynamics equality and affine input constraints into quadratic penalties and retains only nonempty box constraints. The resulting box-constrained quadratic program (QP) has a block-arrow Hessian that enables the state and affine-output directions to be eliminated through a Schur complement. The solver factors only the reduced control system after swing-force elimination and contact-aligned move blocking. For the evaluated implementations using the same DR-MPC formulation, our method achieves median end-to-end MPC speedups of $16.0\times$ over HPIPM and $4.4\times$ over OSQP, with comparable locomotion performance in simulation. DR-MPC achieves a median onboard MPC end-to-end time of $4.4$ ms and is validated on a Unitree Go1 quadruped. Open-source code will be made available after publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DR-MPC（动力学松弛模型预测控制）及其定制的内点法求解器，通过将动力学等式约束和输入约束转为二次惩罚，仅保留盒约束，实现端到端MPC加速并验证于四足机器人。
AI.motivation: 传统腿足机器人MPC需在线求解含动力学等式约束与仿射输入约束的优化问题，计算负担重、实时性受限于求解器效率，难以在机载平台高速运行。
AI.method: 将动力学等式约束和仿射输入约束移入二次惩罚项，仅保留非空盒约束，形成盒约束二次规划（QP）；利用块箭头（block-arrow）Hessian结构，通过Schur补消去状态与仿射输出方向；定制内点法求解器仅因式分解经摆动受力消除与接触对齐移动分块（move blocking）后的降维控制系统。
AI.result: 在相同DR-MPC公式下，本方法端到端MPC中位加速达HPIPM的16.0倍、OSQP的4.4倍，仿真中运动性能相当；机载MPC端到端中位时间4.4 ms，并在Unitree Go1四足机器人上完成验证。
AI.conclusion: DR-MPC通过构造保证在线优化可行性与接触感知输入参数化，配合结构化定制的IPM求解器，显著提升腿足机器人MPC实时性，同时保持相当的运动性能，具备机载部署可行性。

title: Sequential Contextual Fit Predicts Human Behavioural and Neural Dynamics Across Domains
summary: Human perception, action and decision making unfold in sequences, but computational predictors are often domain-specific. This study computes and tests sequential contextual fit (SCF), an embedding-based measure of how well a current information state matches its recent context. The metric uses a simple recency-weighted similarity kernel and can be applied to words, sounds, visual scenes, affective states, choices, actions and neural representations. Across language processing, music-evoked emotion, a subset of audiovisual emotion EEG data, gambling decisions, human activity recognition and decision-related EEG, lower contextual fit predicted longer processing times, larger affective or behavioural transitions and stronger neural-state changes. These effects remained after controlling for established predictors including surprisal, reinforcement-learning prediction error, acoustic change, visual change and sensor change. SCF therefore provides a computational measurement layer for relating contextual compatibility to behavioural processing and cognitive/neural state-transition dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出序贯情境契合度（SCF），一种基于嵌入的度量，用于衡量当前信息状态与其近期情境的匹配程度，并在多领域验证其预测加工时间、行为转换和神经状态变化的能力。
AI.motivation: 人类知觉、行动与决策以序列方式展开，但现有计算预测指标多局限于特定领域，缺乏一个可跨模态、跨任务通用的情境兼容性测量层。
AI.method: 采用简单的近因加权相似性核计算SCF，即当前信息状态嵌入与近期情境嵌入的加权相似度；可应用于词语、声音、视觉场景、情绪状态、选择、动作及神经表征，并在语言加工、音乐诱发情绪、视听情绪脑电、赌博决策、人类活动识别和决策相关脑电等任务中测试，同时控制惊讶度、强化学习预测误差、声学变化、视觉变化与传感器变化等既有预测因子。
AI.result: 在多个领域中，较低的SCF预测更长的加工时间、更大的情绪或行为转换以及更强的神经状态变化；这些效应在控制已有预测因子后依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: SCF为将情境兼容性与行为加工及认知/神经状态转换动力学相联系提供了一个通用计算测量层，具备跨领域适用性。

title: Towards a Unified Modality-Agnostic Multimodal Framework for Cognitive Workload Assessment
comment: Accepted at the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
summary: Cognitive workload reflects the mental effort required during task performance and is central to the design of adaptive human-machine systems. The use of biosignals to measure cognitive workload has been extensively researched and documented; however, studies examining the effects of combining heterogeneous biosignal modalities for this purpose remain limited. To provide insight into this area, we developed a unified, modality-agnostic, hierarchical Transformer-based architecture to process heterogeneous biosignal modalities within a single model. We use this framework in a pilot study evaluating all $31$ possible combinations of five modalities: Electrocardiogram (ECG), Electrodermal Activity (EDA), Respiration (RESP), Peripheral Oxygen Saturation (SpO$_2$), and Electroencephalogram (EEG), under leave-one-subject-out validation across three cognitively distinct tasks: abstract reasoning (IQ), arithmetic problem solving (MATH), and a game task (GAME). In this pilot setting, the results suggest that: (i) EEG is the strongest single modality, ranking highest in IQ, GAME, and the pooled ALL setting, where samples from all three tasks are combined; (ii) adding more modalities does not consistently improve performance; (iii) the full five-modality combination achieves the highest \textit{Average} score of $73.02%$ on IQ and $68.08%$ when the \textit{Average} scores are averaged over the four evaluation settings: IQ, MATH, GAME, and ALL; and (iv) the proposed method reduces model size by approximately $50%$ compared with late-fusion alternatives while maintaining a lower inference time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种统一的、模态无关的层次化Transformer架构，用于在单一模型中处理异构生物信号，并通过试点研究评估五种模态全部31种组合对认知工作负荷的测量效果。
AI.motivation: 认知工作负荷反映任务执行中的心理努力程度，是自适应人机系统设计的核心。利用生物信号测量认知工作负荷已被广泛研究，但关于融合异构生物信号模态效果的研究仍然有限。
AI.method: 开发统一的、模态无关的层次化Transformer架构，在单一模型中处理异构生物信号模态。在留一被试验证下，评估五种模态（ECG、EDA、RESP、SpO₂、EEG）的全部31种组合，覆盖三项认知任务：抽象推理（IQ）、算术解题（MATH）和游戏任务（GAME）。
AI.result: 试点结果表明：(i) EEG是最强的单一模态，在IQ、GAME及合并全部任务的ALL设置中排名最高；(ii) 增加更多模态并不总能一致地提升性能；(iii) 五模态全组合在IQ上取得最高的平均分73.02%，在IQ、MATH、GAME、ALL四个评估设置的平均分上达到68.08%；(iv) 相比后融合替代方案，所提方法将模型规模减少约50%，同时保持更低的推理时间。
AI.conclusion: 异构生物信号模态融合并非模态越多越好，EEG在单模态中表现最优；所提统一层次化Transformer架构在保证性能的同时显著缩减模型规模并降低推理时间，为多模态认知工作负荷测量提供了有效框架。

title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

AI.tldr: 提出RetireOPD方法：先用环境奖励训练技能条件教师，再以强化学习(RL)与自蒸馏(OPD)联合训练无技能学生，并通过自适应退休机制在师生差异不再缩小且学生达标后自动停用教师、转为纯RL训练，在多任务多模型规模上显著超越RL基线及教师模型。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体用RL训练时每条轨迹仅获单一标量奖励，因此自同策略蒸馏(OPD)被用于从具备特权任务技能的自教师提供稠密token级监督，使无技能学生内化技能。但该范式在智能体任务中存在两个问题：仅有特权信息并不总能使教师可靠，且教师监督的收益具有阶段性依赖。为此需要一种能自适应控制教师介入时机的方案。
AI.method: RetireOPD分两阶段：首先用环境奖励优化一个解耦的技能条件教师；随后用RL与OPD联合训练无技能学生。不同于预设蒸馏调度，采用"自适应退休"(Adaptive Retirement)：当师生差异不再缩小且学生达到教师成功率的目标准比例时，学生自行丢弃教师，之后仅用RL继续训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5系列1.5B至7B模型上，RetireOPD相较RL基线将ALFWorld成功率提升14.1%–18.8%，WebShop准确率提升11.8%–19.0%，并在全部设置下超越其自身的技能条件教师。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，教师监督的有效性取决于阶段，而非单纯依赖特权信息；通过将高质量技能条件教师与自适应退休的自蒸馏结合，无技能学生可稳定超越教师，实现更优的智能体任务性能。

title: SAGE-Yoga: Multi-Cue Learning for Yoga Pose Classification and Joint-Level Correction
summary: Automated yoga analysis requires both accurate pose classification and interpretable feedback on pose execution. However, existing methods often rely on a single visual prediction, struggle to distinguish visually similar poses, and treat pose classification and correction as separate tasks. To address these limitations, we propose SAGE-Yoga, a unified coarse-to-fine framework for yoga pose classification and joint-level correction from a single RGB image. Inspired by how yoga instructors assess posture using multiple complementary cues, SAGE-Yoga first employs a bagging-based ensemble of complementary visual backbones to generate a ranked set of candidate pose classes. Additionally, a margin-based gating mechanism preserves confident visual predictions while invoking geometric verification only for ambiguous cases. Moreover, once the final pose class is determined, SAGE-Yoga retrieves a medoid reference pose and compares the observed joint angles with class-specific distributions to identify misaligned joints. Finally, these deviations are translated into actionable corrective feedback. Empirically, experiments on the Yoga-82 dataset show that the visual ensemble achieves 89.0% Top-1 accuracy, while the complete framework improves performance to 90.7% Top-1 accuracy and 90.1% Macro-F1. These results demonstrate that combining complementary visual evidence with selective geometric verification improves fine-grained pose classification while enabling interpretable, joint-level correction.

AI.tldr: SAGE-Yoga是一个统一的由粗到细框架，从单张RGB图像同时实现瑜伽姿态分类与关节级纠正反馈。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖单一视觉预测、难以区分视觉相似的姿态，且将姿态分类与纠正视为分离任务。
AI.method: 采用基于bagging的互补视觉骨干集成生成候选类别排序；用基于margin的门控机制，对低置信样本触发几何验证；确定类别后检索medoid参考姿态，对比关节角度与类别特定分布定位错位关节，并转化为纠正反馈。
AI.result: 在Yoga-82数据集上视觉集成达89.0% Top-1准确率，完整框架提升至90.7% Top-1和90.1% Macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: 结合互补视觉证据与选择性几何验证，可提升细粒度姿态分类并实现可解释的关节级纠正。

title: Mechanical Precision Weeding with a Quadruped Robot
summary: Herbicide-based weed control is increasingly unsustainable due to rising weed resistance and the adverse environmental impacts of chemical use. While mechanical weed control avoids these drawbacks, it is typically implemented using large machines that cause soil compaction. We propose a novel alternative based on small mobile robots for mechanical weeding. Compared with existing automated mechanical weeding approaches, the proposed method offers reduced soil compaction, simpler automation, and improved scalability. Our solution involves a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped robot equipped with a custom weed removal tool featuring a milling bit at its end. The tool is rigidly attached to the robot and uses the degrees of freedom of the robot base by actuating the legs, while keeping the feet stationary. We develop a software architecture that enables autonomous weed removal and integrate this system with all other required components. We analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the current proof of concept both in an indoor and outdoor environment and provide recommendations for future work to make the system more accurate and efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出用小型四足机器人（Boston Dynamics Spot）搭载末端带铣刀的除草工具进行机械除草，以缓解除草剂抗性与大型机械土壤压实问题，并构建自主除草软件架构，在室内外评估概念验证的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 基于除草剂的杂草控制因杂草抗性上升和化学使用的环境负面影响而愈发不可持续；机械除草虽可避免这些问题，但通常由大型机械实施，会造成土壤压实。
AI.method: 提出基于小型移动机器人的机械除草新方案；采用Boston Dynamics Spot四足机器人，配备定制的末端带铣刀的除草工具；工具刚性连接于机器人，通过驱动腿部并保持足端静止来利用机器人基座的自由度；开发支持自主除草的软件架构，并将系统与所有所需组件集成。
AI.result: 在室内与室外环境中分析了当前概念验证系统的精度与效率，并给出提升系统精度与效率的未来工作建议。
AI.conclusion: 该小型机器人机械除草方案相较现有自动化机械除草方法具有减少土壤压实、自动化更简单、可扩展性更好的潜力，但当前概念验证在精度与效率方面仍需改进。

title: JointMatch: A Unified Heterogeneous Graph Neural Solver for Large-Scale Ride-Sharing Matching
summary: Ride-sharing platforms must continuously decide which open requests to bundle into shared trips and which idle vehicles should serve them. The dominant academic approach decomposes this into two sequential matching problems -- request pairing first, then vehicle assignment -- and applies a separate solver to each. This decomposition is convenient computationally but loses revenue and scales poorly because the first stage commits to ride bundles before the available vehicles are known. We propose JointMatch, a learning-based framework that handles request pairing and vehicle assignment together on a single graph. The graph is sparsified by spatial proximity so that its size grows linearly rather than quadratically with the number of vehicles and requests, and a graph neural network scores all candidate decisions in one forward pass. On the New York City Yellow Taxi data, the framework already exceeds both the classical Blossom heuristic and a faithfully-trained two-stage GNN baseline -- often by a wide margin -- and at city scale (fleet 10000) it runs more than $20\times$ faster per dispatch epoch than either. A supervised training stage closes most of the remaining revenue gap, and a policy-gradient fine-tune aligns the trained model with realised revenue.

AI.tldr: 提出JointMatch，将拼车中的请求配对与车辆分配统一到单张稀疏图上，用GNN一次前向打分所有候选决策，兼顾收益与效率。
AI.motivation: 主流方法把拼车调度拆成"请求配对→车辆分配"两步串行匹配并分别求解；该分解虽便于计算，却在车辆信息未知时已锁定拼车组合，导致收益损失且扩展性差。
AI.method: JointMatch在单张图上联合处理请求配对与车辆分配；利用空间邻近性稀疏化图，使规模随车辆与请求数线性增长而非二次增长；采用图神经网络一次前向传播对所有候选决策打分；训练上先用监督阶段，再用策略梯度微调对齐实际收益。
AI.result: 在纽约市Yellow Taxi数据上，超过经典Blossom启发式和忠实训练的两阶段GNN基线，且往往优势明显；在城市规模（车队10000）下，每个调度epoch比两者快20倍以上；监督训练弥补了大部分剩余收益差距，策略梯度微调进一步对齐实际收益。
AI.conclusion: 将配对与分配联合建模可避免两阶段分解的收益损失与扩展瓶颈，稀疏图+GNN的联合框架在收益与计算效率上均优于两阶段基线，是拼车调度可扩展的解决路径。

title: Scene-Conditioned Relation Routing for urban cellular activity forecasting
comment: Accepted in IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC), 2026
summary: Urban cellular activity forecasting requires jointly modeling heterogeneous spatiotemporal signals, including SMS usage, mobile network traffic, and call activity. Existing methods often separate temporal modeling, spatial relation learning, and multi-signal prediction, relying on fixed graph structures or static multi-task learning schemes, which limits their adaptability to changing urban scenes. We propose SCRR-Net, a scene-conditioned spatial relation routing framework in which urban contextual information jointly controls spatial dependency selection and cross-task knowledge transfer. SCRR-Net includes a context encoder, a spatial graph expert routing module, a temporal Transformer encoder, and a task knowledge routing module. Experiments on the Milano and Trento datasets demonstrate that SCRR-Net consistently outperforms competing methods on SMS, network traffic, and call activity forecasting, while providing interpretable routing behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出场景条件化的空间关系路由框架SCRR-Net，用城市上下文同时调控空间依赖选择与跨任务知识迁移，在米兰和特伦托数据集上优于现有方法并可解释路由行为。
AI.motivation: 城市蜂窝活动预测需联合建模短信、移动网络流量与通话等异构时空信号；现有方法将时序建模、空间关系学习与多信号预测分离，依赖固定图结构或静态多任务学习，难以适应城市场景变化。
AI.method: SCRR-Net包含四个模块：上下文编码器（context encoder）、空间图专家路由模块（spatial graph expert routing）、时序Transformer编码器，以及任务知识路由模块（task knowledge routing）。由城市上下文信息联合控制空间依赖选择与跨任务知识迁移。
AI.result: 在Milano与Trento数据集上，SCRR-Net在短信、网络流量与通话活动预测任务上持续优于对比方法，且路由行为具有可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 以场景条件化的路由机制替代固定图结构与静态多任务方案，可提升城市蜂窝活动多信号预测的适应性与精度，并增强模型可解释性。

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
summary: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

AI.tldr: 提出领域无关的世界建模框架 JEPA-Anything，基于正交预测因子分解（OPF）扩展 JEPA，在七个异构领域统一学习预测性表征并支持干预与科学发现。
AI.motivation: 现有预测模型大多局限于单一领域，缺乏可跨异构系统通用的世界建模学习原则，论文试图验证是否存在一种通用的因子化预测原则可支撑跨领域世界建模。
AI.method: JEPA-Anything 基于 OPF：将潜在目标分解为互补因子，通过专用通路分别学习，再在共享预测设计中重组，作为对联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的扩展。
AI.result: 在视觉、生物、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场、天气七个领域评估；相比匹配的 JEPA 基线，10 项动力学任务全部提升，Interventional Pong 单干预预测误差降低 34.8%；四个分子系统中一步与100步误差均为最低；因子提名生物干预获细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤片段与小鼠实验支持；潜在轨道模态恢复开普勒标度指数，拟合斜率为 -1.4991。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持跨异构世界存在共同的因子化预测原则，将世界建模与干预及实验验证的科学发现相连接。

title: Distance to Class Prototypes: Active Learning for Object Detection
summary: Deploying a deep object detector in a new setting is limited less by architecture than by the cost of annotating data from that setting. Active learning lowers the cost by choosing which images to label, and the choice is only as good as the signal used to score an unlabeled image. That signal is usually the class posterior, which is cheap but poorly calibrated, or the disagreement across several models or several stochastic passes, which is better but multiplies inference over a pool far larger than the labeled set. We propose a signal richer than the posterior yet still read from one forward pass of one network. A supervised contrastive term added to the training objective shapes a per-object embedding space in which distance encodes class membership, and an unlabeled detection is scored by how far it lies from the region occupied by its predicted category, weighted by its confidence. The criterion needs no ensemble, no auxiliary predictor and no repeated inference, and its entire cost is 2.89M parameters, an increase of 8.3% over a bare detector. On PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO it beats the posterior of the same detector in every round in which a selection is made, by up to 1.08% mAP50 against run to run deviations of 0.02% to 0.18%, and it stays competitive with ensemble and Monte Carlo dropout criteria costing three to fifty forward passes per unlabeled image. Experiments use the single-stage detector under which the compared criteria report their results, so that the selection decision is isolated from the strength of the detector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于单次前向传播的主动学习样本选择信号：在训练目标中加入监督对比项，塑造逐目标的嵌入空间，使距离编码类别归属；用无标注检测框到其预测类别占据区域的距离（按置信度加权）进行评分。该方法无需集成、无辅助预测器、无需重复推理，仅增加2.89M参数（较裸检测器增加8.3%），在PASCAL VOC与MS-COCO上每一轮选择均优于同类检测器的后验评分（最高提升1.08% mAP50），并与需3~50次前向的集成与MC Dropout准则保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 在新场景部署深度目标检测器时，主要瓶颈不是网络架构，而是该场景数据的标注成本。主动学习通过选择需要标注的图像来降低成本，而选择效果取决于对未标注图像打分的信号质量。常用信号中，类别后验概率计算廉价但校准差；多模型或多随机前向的不一致性信号更优，但对远大于已标注集的候选池需多次推理，代价高昂。因此需要一种既比后验更丰富、又只需单网络单次前向即可获得的信号。
AI.method: 在训练目标中引入监督对比项（supervised contrastive term），塑造逐目标（per-object）的嵌入空间，使嵌入距离编码类别归属关系。对未标注检测，计算其嵌入到“预测类别所占据区域”的距离，并以该检测的置信度进行加权，作为主动学习的选取分数。该准则不需要集成模型、不需要辅助预测器、也不需重复推理；其全部额外开销为2.89M参数，相比裸检测器增加8.3%。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC与MS-COCO上，该方法在每一次进行选择的轮次中均优于同一检测器的后验评分，最高提升1.08% mAP50，而运行间波动仅为0.02%~0.18%。同时，该方法与每张未标注图像需3至50次前向传播的集成（ensemble）及Monte Carlo dropout准则保持竞争力。实验使用所比较准则报告结果时所用的单阶段检测器，以将选择决策与检测器本身的强弱相隔离。
AI.conclusion: 通过监督对比学习构造的逐目标嵌入距离信号，能够在仅单次前向传播、极小参数增量（8.3%）的条件下，为主动目标检测提供优于类别后验、并可与高成本集成/MC Dropout方法相当的选择准则，从而在不依赖重复推理的前提下更有效地降低新场景的标注成本。

title: FlipToSee: A Probabilistic Stable Placement Prior for Active Visual Exploration via Regrasping
summary: Active visual exploration of tabletop objects often requires reorienting an unknown resting object onto a different stable support face to expose occluded surfaces. To identify such placements without exhaustive physical search, we learn a probabilistic placement prior from a single-view point cloud. Stable placement prediction is inherently multimodal, and conventional 6-DoF regression introduces further ambiguity by modeling translation and in-plane yaw. We therefore propose FlipToSee, a probabilistic framework that removes this representational ambiguity by parameterizing placements as unit support normals on $S^2$ while modeling their multimodal conditional distribution via a von Mises--Fisher mixture density network. To decouple mode diversity from physical robustness, FlipToSee deterministically extracts a compact candidate set from the mixture components and applies robustness-aware reranking using an auxiliary head trained with candidate-aligned supervision. In simulation, FlipToSee achieves $98.4\%$ first-proposal success on in-distribution objects, $95.3\%$ on out-of-distribution shapes, and $90.0\%$ under zero-shot transfer to household YCB objects. We further demonstrate the learned placement prior on a physical robot by integrating it with grasp and motion planning for exploratory regrasping.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlipToSee 概率框架，将稳定放置参数化为 S² 上单位支撑法向，用 vMF 混合密度网络建模多模态分布，并解耦模式多样性与物理稳健性，实现单视角点云下的高效放置预测与机器人重抓取。
AI.motivation: 主动视觉探索桌面物体常需把未知静止物体重新朝向到另一个稳定支撑面，以暴露被遮挡表面。为避免穷举式物理搜索，需要从单视角点云预测稳定放置。该问题本质是多模态的，而传统 6-DoF 回归同时建模平移与平面内偏航，进一步引入表示歧义，导致预测困难。
AI.method: FlipToSee 将放置参数化为 S² 球面上的单位支撑法向，从而消除表示歧义；使用 von Mises–Fisher 混合密度网络建模其多模态条件分布。为解耦模式多样性与物理稳健性，模型从混合分量中确定性提取紧凑候选集，并用候选对齐监督训练的辅助头进行稳健性感知重排序。
AI.result: 仿真中，FlipToSee 在分布内物体上首次提案成功率达 98.4%，分布外形体上达 95.3%，零样本迁移至家庭 YCB 物体达 90.0%。并在物理机器人上结合抓取与运动规划验证了所学放置先验，用于探索性重抓取。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稳定放置表示为球面单位法向并以 vMF 混合建模，可有效消除 6-DoF 回归的表示歧义；确定性与稳健性重排序的解耦策略在仿真与真实机器人上均取得高成功率，验证了该放置先验在主动视觉探索与探索性重抓取中的实用性。

title: When AI Agents Commit: Cognitive Serializability Across Data, Evidence, Policy, and Authority
summary: Autonomous agents derive concrete mutations from database reads, retrieved evidence, policy, beliefs, and delegated authority. Those inputs may change while reasoning is in progress. Database isolation orders the submitted transaction; agentic transaction processing determines whether a proposal satisfies an executable contract. Neither guarantee establishes a common valid point for the mutation and its derivation inputs unless the contract represents the relevant predicates. Typed dependency tokens distinguish content integrity from applicability, and trusted mediation captures the values exposed to reasoning. Under strict Cognitive Serializability, committed effects admit a serial order and a logical event at which every value exposed to derivation is unchanged. The fences last until the runtime event that realizes the sealed durability domain. The weaker Effect-Compatible Cognitive Admission recertifies an effect against a simultaneously held current dependency vector and current policy without claiming to serialize the original stochastic derivation. TCT combines immutable versioned executable definitions, registry-derived authority plans, sealed envelopes, guard-first commit transactions, post-seal envelope- and witness-bound grants, co-committed receipts, idempotent grant finalization, and receipt-driven epistemic reconciliation. Complete registered footprints and a single growing phase induce an acyclic lock-point order over local guards and incompatible external reservations. The corresponding results give serializability conditions and an observational-equivalence boundary for zero-error soundness and positive progress. A falsification suite tests the implementation obligations: the prototype prevented all injected anomalies and added 3.22 ms mean commit overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"类型化认知事务"(TCT),通过类型化依赖令牌、可信中介与密封封装等机制,为自主智能体的突变(效应)提供严格认知可串行化与较弱的效应兼容认知准入两种保证,并给出可串行化条件与零错误可靠性的观测等价边界。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体的突变来源于数据库读取、检索证据、策略、信念与委托授权等多种输入,这些输入可能在推理进行中发生变化。现有的数据库隔离只对提交事务排序,而智能体事务处理只判定提案是否满足可执行契约,二者都无法为突变及其派生输入建立共同的"有效点",除非契约显式表示相关谓词。因此需要区分内容完整性与适用性,并保证推理所暴露的取值在突变提交时未被改变。
AI.method: TCT 组合了不可变版本化可执行定义、注册表派生的授权计划、密封封装、守卫优先的提交事务、密封后绑定封装与见证的授权、共同提交回执、幂等授权终结以及回执驱动的认知协调。用类型化依赖令牌区分内容完整性与适用性,用可信中介捕获暴露给推理的取值。在此之上定义严格认知可串行化与较弱的效应兼容认知准入,并以完整注册足迹与单一增长阶段导出局部守卫与不兼容外部预留上的无环锁点序。
AI.result: 论文给出相应的可串行化条件,以及针对零错误可靠性与正向进展的观测等价边界。证伪测试套件检验实现义务:原型阻止了所有注入的异常,平均提交开销增加 3.22 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过 TCT 的多重机制,可在不宣称串行化原始随机推导的前提下,为智能体效应提供从严格到宽松的认知事务保证,并以低提交开销实现零错误可靠性。

title: Subdomain-aware representation compression for pretrained image embeddings
summary: Dimensionality reduction is a well-known technique for improving space efficiency, typically applied uniformly across an entire dataset. This paper investigates the possibilities of using dimensionality reduction techniques for subdomain representation compression. We explore standard techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear discriminant analysis (LDA) in image domains. The results not only demonstrate the expected improvements in space and computation complexity crucial for edge-device ML applications but also show improvements in accuracy over direct full-embedding procedure. One possible explanation is that dimensionality reduction effectively extracts subdomain features. We also performed experiments to demonstrate transfer learning capabilities using the compressed representations.

AI.tldr: 本文将 PCA 与 LDA 等降维技术用于图像子域表征压缩，发现其不仅降低空间与计算复杂度，还提升了精度，并验证了压缩表征的迁移学习能力。
AI.motivation: 传统降维通常对整个数据集统一应用，本文则关注其在子域表征压缩中的潜力，动机在于满足边缘设备机器学习对空间效率与计算复杂度的严苛需求，同时探索降维是否能作为有效的子域特征提取手段。
AI.method: 在图像域中采用 PCA 和 LDA 等标准降维技术，对子域表征进行压缩，并与直接使用完整嵌入（full-embedding）的流程进行对比；同时设计实验考察压缩表征的迁移学习能力。
AI.result: 实验显示压缩方案在空间与计算复杂度上获得预期改善，对边缘设备应用至关重要；此外，相比直接使用全嵌入，其准确率还有所提升。作者推测原因是降维有效提取了子域特征。迁移学习实验也表明压缩表征具备可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 降维不仅可用于全局数据集的效率优化，也适用于子域表征压缩；它能在提升效率的同时带来精度增益，并支持迁移学习，为边缘设备场景提供了有前景的方案。

title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
summary: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文整合六种群际敌意理论，用286万条2024年美国大选期间的社交媒体帖子在同一实证框架下建模，揭示敌意修辞的结构与时间组织规律。
AI.motivation: 敌意修辞会正常化排斥、正当化不公并加剧极化与政治暴力；但既有社会心理学、道德心理学与政治学理论大多平行发展，彼此假设不同甚至冲突，且极少在真实话语中相互检验，导致对敌意修辞机制的理解碎片化，缺乏其在现实话语中如何呈现与相互关联的清晰认识。
AI.method: 使用2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X上的286万条帖子，将六种群际敌意基础理论机制——边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊化、负面评价、去人性化与行动导向——纳入一个共同实证框架进行建模，以还原群际敌意修辞的整体组织方式。
AI.result: 结构上，边界建构与威胁建构构成系统的核心锚点；时间上，各机制呈现规律性排序：边界建构、贬损与行动导向倾向于较早出现，去人性化与威胁建构较晚，替罪羊化最晚。
AI.conclusion: 刻画这些理论框架在话语中的实际表现，有助于弥合社会科学传统间的长期分歧，并为计算社会科学在超越单一标签检测之外建模群际敌意修辞提供更清晰的实证基础。

title: Generative Verification: Rethinking the Uncertainty Signal for Active Learning of Object Detection
summary: Nearly every acquisition function for active object detection shares one arrangement, in that the model being improved is also the model being interrogated. We depart from it. In generative verification an independent generative model re-derives the label of a detection from the pixels inside its predicted box, and the disagreement between the two becomes the acquisition signal. Two properties follow from the arrangement itself rather than from any tuning. A displaced box, a box on background and a correct box carrying the wrong label all yield a crop that fails verification, so the failure modes arrive already combined in one scalar and the hand-weighted classification and localization terms of existing criteria are no longer needed. And because the verifier never observes the detector confidence, confidently wrong detections score highest, although a self-derived signal reads them as uninteresting and they are the costliest to leave unlabeled. We build the verifier as a conditional diffusion model whose diffusion target is a label representation rather than an image. Its reverse process is stochastic, so repeated generations return a distribution whose concentration reports how firmly the evidence determines the label, where a classifier returns a single point estimate. On PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO the signal outperforms output-uncertainty, feature-geometry, perturbation and ensemble criteria, gaining about one mAP50 point per round on MS-COCO, with its largest margins in the early rounds where confident detector errors are most common.

AI.tldr: 提出"生成式验证"主动目标检测框架：用独立的生成模型（条件扩散模型）从预测框内像素重新推导标签，以两者不一致度作为采集信号，无需人工加权分类与定位项，在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO上优于多种现有准则。
AI.motivation: 现有主动目标检测的采集函数几乎都采用同一范式：被改进的模型同时也是被查询的模型，即用检测器自身的置信度或特征来估计不确定性。但检测器自信的错误检测（confidently wrong）恰恰代价最高，自派生信号却将其视为不具信息量，从而错失最有价值的标注样本。
AI.method: 提出生成式验证（generative verification）：由一个独立的生成模型根据预测框内像素重新推导该检测的标签，检测结果与生成验证结果之间的不一致即作为采集信号。验证器构建为条件扩散模型，其扩散目标是标签表示而非图像；反向过程具有随机性，多次生成得到分布，以该分布的集中度衡量证据对标签的确定程度（区别于分类器的单点估计）。
AI.result: 该信号天然融合了多种失败模式：位移框、背景框、标签错误的正确框均导致裁剪区域验证失败，因此无需再手工加权分类项与定位项。由于验证器不观察检测器置信度，自信错误检测得分最高。在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO上，该信号优于输出不确定性、特征几何、扰动与集成等准则，MS-COCO上每轮约提升1个mAP50，且在自信检测错误最集中的早期轮次优势最大。
AI.conclusion: 通过将"被查询模型"与"被改进模型"解耦，生成式验证以单一标量统一了分类与定位失败模式，并能优先选出高代价的自信错误样本；条件扩散验证器以分布集中度提供比单点估计更丰富的证据确定性度量，验证了该范式在主动目标检测中的有效性。

title: Graph-Based Design of Soft Grippers with Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Optimisation
summary:
Effective manipulation across diverse objects is critical for applications ranging from agricultural harvesting to laboratory and domestic automation. While the inherent compliance of soft robotics is well suited to this challenge, designing grippers that generalize across tasks remains difficult due to the vast design space of continuum mechanics and the risk of overfitting to specific scenarios.
