We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 EliGSiR，一种面向在线 RGB-D 建图的持续高斯泼溅框架，通过证据引导的自适应优化预算分配，在保留历史重建的同时提升在线建图质量。
AI.motivation: 传统 3D Gaussian Splatting 依赖封闭观测集与长优化调度，难以满足在线持续 RGB-D 建图需求：新观测不断到来，且已重建区域必须保持不退化。
AI.method: EliGSiR 包含三项机制：Map-Guided View Scheduling 依据当前地图状态过滤冗余新视图并重新考量保留视图；Load-Adaptive Fidelity 根据当前建图负载动态调整监督分辨率而非固定调度；Targeted Geometry Growth 将深度监督与高斯创建解耦，仅在重复 RGB-D 观测指示结构缺失或错位处增加几何容量。
AI.result: 在 Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++ 及真实 RGB-D 序列上评估。TUM fr3/long_office_household 上，使用相同 GT 位姿达 21.52 dB（SplaTAM 为 19.42 dB）；跟踪位姿对比中，EliGSiR 配合在线 ORB-SLAM3 位姿 155.5 s 达 23.02 dB，CaRtGS 使用原生跟踪器 230.9 s 为 20.10 dB。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，自适应视图调度、监督保真度与几何增长三者协同，可显著提升在线获取过程中可用建图预算的利用效率，兼顾最终重建质量与全程地图质量。

title: RoboFind: Multi-Agent Personalized Object Search for People Who Are Blind or Have Low Vision
summary: Blind and low-vision users often need to locate a specific personal object rather than an arbitrary instance of the same category. The task calls for a robot that can move through the space and reach viewpoints the user cannot, and for an accessible interface where the user says which object is meant and learns whether the right one was found. We present RoboFind, a multi-agent framework in which a smartphone teaches the target and a quadruped robot carries out the search. A Target Teaching Agent converts guided smartphone recordings into a semantic target profile and a reusable multi-view reference bank through an accessible capture flow with AR guidance, speech and haptic feedback, and screen-reader support, so later missions refer to a stored object without repeating the teaching process. At runtime, a Navigation Agent explores the environment and proposes candidate targets, a Verification Agent checks each candidate against the stored references, and a Coordination and Recovery Agent completes the mission or triggers recovery and continued search. Across 32 real-robot missions, RoboFind reaches 85.0% success against 25.0% for a reconstructed sequential first-stop baseline over 20 trials with ten targets, and reduces false success from 75.0% to 5.0%. On six shared targets it succeeds in 10/12 trials, against 5/12 for 12 independently executed GPT-6 Astra-only trials. These results show that the multi-agent design fits the demands of personalized object search, where verifying object identity before declaring completion is what makes the outcome something a user can rely on.

AI.tldr: RoboFind：面向盲人及低视力用户的个性化物品搜寻多智能体框架，由智能手机"授教"目标、四足机器人执行搜寻；32次真机任务成功率85.0%（基线25.0%），误判成功从75.0%降至5.0%。
AI.motivation: 盲人及低视力用户常需定位特定的个人物品，而非同类别的任意实例。该任务要求机器人能进入用户无法到达的视角，并提供可访问界面：用户说明要找的物品，并能得知是否找到了正确的那一件。现有方法（如仅凭首停即判定的顺序基线）易产生高误判。
AI.method: RoboFind为多智能体框架。授教阶段：Target Teaching Agent通过AR引导、语音与触觉反馈、屏幕阅读器支持的可访问采集流程，将智能手机录制视频转化为语义目标画像与可复用多视角参考库。运行阶段：Navigation Agent探索环境并提名候选目标；Verification Agent将候选与存储参考比对核验；Coordination and Recovery Agent完成使命或触发恢复与继续搜索。
AI.result: 32次真机任务成功率85.0%，对照重建的"顺序首停"基线20次试验（10个目标）为25.0%；误判成功由75.0%降至5.0%。在6个共享目标上12次试验成功10次，而12次独立执行的"仅GPT-6 Astra"试验仅成功5次。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体设计契合个性化物品搜寻需求：在宣布完成前先核验物品身份，是使结果真正可为用户所信赖的关键。

title: SkillAA: Attribution-Guided Skill-Graph Updating with Targeted Validation and Rollback
summary: External skills provide domain procedures without parameter updates, but existing methods often edit skills directly from failed rollouts without structured routing from an observed failure to an editable location; existing skill graphs also underuse semantic boundaries, object addresses, and topological dependencies for skill retrieval, targeted updating, and scoped validation. We introduce SkillAA (Skill Abductive Attribution), a structured skill-optimization framework for frozen language models. It represents skill applicability, execution, and composition in a unified graph, allowing the same structure to support skill selection, attribution-guided repair, and update validation. SkillAA contrasts successful and failed executions to route candidate repairs to specific graph objects, updates only the selected local structure, and uses Local and Big Gates to screen candidate changes before commitment. With gpt-5.6-sol, SkillAA reaches 81.5%, 66.7%, and 91.2% on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA, respectively, and attains the highest observed mean in every main setting. These results support the utility of attribution-guided graph editing and graph-scoped validation.

AI.tldr: SkillAA 提出一种面向冻结语言模型的结构化技能优化框架，用统一图结构承载技能适用性、执行与组合，支持技能选择、归因引导修复与更新验证。方法通过对比成功/失败执行，将候选修复路由到具体图对象，仅更新选定局部结构，并用 Local/Big Gates 筛选候选改动。在 SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA 上分别达到 81.5%、66.7%、91.2%，在各主要设置中取得最高观测均值。
AI.motivation: 外部技能可在不更新参数的情况下提供领域流程，但现有方法多直接从失败轨迹编辑技能，缺乏从观测失败到可编辑位置的结构化路由；已有技能图对语义边界、对象地址与拓扑依赖利用不足，难以支撑技能检索、定向更新与范围化验证。
AI.method: SkillAA（Skill Abductive Attribution）将技能适用性、执行与组合统一表示为图；通过对比成功与失败执行，将候选修复路由至特定图对象；仅更新被选中的局部结构；并采用 Local Gate 与 Big Gate 在提交前筛选候选变更。
AI.result: 在 gpt-5.6-sol 上，SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA 分别达到 81.5%、66.7%、91.2%，并在所有主要设置中取得最高观测均值。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持归因引导的图编辑与图范围化验证的有效性，表明结构化路由与局部更新机制对冻结语言模型的技能优化具有实用价值。

title: A Learning Algorithm for Threshold Boolean Networks with Prescribed Fixed Points
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, to be published in 20th International Meeting, CIBB 2025, Revised Selected Papers
summary: We present a learning algorithm for inferring threshold Boolean networks (TBNs) with a prescribed set of fixed points. The proposed method employs a custom differentiable loss function that jointly enforces fixed point preservation, penalizes spurious attractors, encourages binary outputs, and promotes sparsity through L1 regularization. Applied to the FOS-GRN model of Arabidopsis thaliana, the approach achieved perfect reconstruction (i.e., all 10 desired fixed points and no spurious ones) in 5 out of 30 independent runs, recovering on average 8.53 $\pm$ 0.90 correct fixed points with no spurious attractors. In contrast, standard methods such as the Perceptron and Logistic Regression recovered up to 10 fixed points but introduced between 8 and 31 spurious ones. An additional analysis varying the sparsity coefficient ($λ$) confirmed that the method's performance and the structural properties of the inferred networks remain robust within a practical range (up to 0.01) of regularization strengths. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of the proposed algorithm in capturing meaningful network dynamics under prescribed dynamical constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可微损失驱动的阈值布尔网络（TBN）学习算法，在满足指定不动点约束的同时抑制伪吸引子，在拟南芥FOS-GRN模型上取得优于Perceptron与Logistic Regression的重建效果。
AI.motivation: 从网络动力学约束（指定不动点）出发推断阈值布尔网络具有挑战性：既要保留目标不动点，又需避免产生伪吸引子，而标准方法（如Perceptron、Logistic Regression）虽能拟合不动点，却常引入大量伪吸引子，破坏动力学行为的可信度。
AI.method: 提出一种学习算法，采用定制的可微损失函数，联合实现四项约束：（1）保持指定不动点；（2）惩罚伪吸引子；（3）促使输出二值化；（4）通过L1正则化促进稀疏性。在拟南芥FOS-GRN模型上，以30次独立运行评估重建性能，并额外分析稀疏系数λ对性能与网络结构性质的影响。
AI.result: 在30次独立运行中，5次实现完美重建（10个目标不动点全部恢复且无伪吸引子）；平均恢复8.53±0.90个正确不动点且不产生伪吸引子。相比之下，Perceptron和Logistic Regression虽可恢复多达10个不动点，但引入了8至31个伪吸引子。λ敏感性分析表明，在实用范围（最高0.01）内，方法性能与推断网络的结构性质保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法在指定动力学约束下能有效且稳定地捕捉有意义的网络动力学，在不动点保真与伪吸引子抑制方面优于标准方法，并对正则化强度具有较好鲁棒性。

title: MM-Future: Multi-Mode Joint World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving involves coupled decision-making and scene evolution under multi-mode uncertainty. To capture this coupling and uncertainty, we introduce MM-Future, a world-action model that generates multiple paired scene-action hypotheses and models bidirectional interaction within each pair. Each hypothesis is initialized from a structured action prior and an independent future scene source, which are then co-evolved through a modality-aware diffusion Transformer. To support efficient multi-mode rollout, MM-Future compresses multi-view video into planning-oriented representations, dubbed MM-Tokens. Finally, a future-conditioned proposal scorer ranks trajectory candidates by shared history context and their paired predicted future. On NAVSIM navtest, MM-Future achieves 94.0 PDMS and 91.5 EPDMS, while attaining a 32.3 HD-Score in zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show consistent improvements over both single-mode and action-only variants, validating the benefit of multi-mode joint world-action modeling.

AI.tldr: MM-Future 是一种世界-动作模型，通过生成多个配对的场景-动作假设并建模其双向交互，实现自动驾驶中多模态不确定性下的耦合决策与场景演化，在 NAVSIM 与 HUGSIM 上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要在多模态不确定性下同时进行决策与场景演化，二者相互耦合。现有方法难以同时捕捉这种耦合关系与多模态不确定性，往往只做单一模式预测或仅建模动作而不联合建模未来场景。
AI.method: 提出 MM-Future 世界-动作模型：生成多个成对的场景-动作假设，每个假设由结构化动作先验与独立未来场景源初始化，并通过模态感知的扩散 Transformer 协同演化；将多视角视频压缩为面向规划的 MM-Tokens 表示以支持高效多模态推演；最后用未来条件化的提议打分器，基于共享历史上下文与配对预测未来对轨迹候选排序。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 上达到 94.0 PDMS 与 91.5 EPDMS；在 HUGSIM 零样本闭环评测中取得 32.3 HD-Score。消融实验表明相对单模态与仅动作变体均有稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态联合的世界-动作建模能有效提升自动驾驶决策性能，验证了耦合建模场景演化与动作决策的价值。

title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

AI.tldr: Navi-Agent：一种零样本VLN-CE智能体，通过视觉观测与运动历史构建无坐标空间状态（导航拓扑），实现闭环导航，性能达几何约束类方法SOTA。
AI.motivation: 连续环境下的视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体在未知环境中执行长程指令。现有零样本系统多依赖几何定位或坐标表示维持空间状态；近期几何约束导航方法虽去除了深度与全局一致坐标，但在地点确认、进度验证与恢复方面保持持续空间感知仍有困难。
AI.method: 提出Navi-Agent，从视觉观测与已执行运动历史构建无坐标空间状态，组织为导航拓扑：节点表示视觉地点，边表示运动转移。该表示支持基于观测的近似自定位、任务进度验证和基于视觉重访的恢复。智能体将指令分解为子目标，执行局部视觉导航，并通过构建的空间状态验证已访问地点，形成闭环导航。
AI.result: 在零样本VLN-CE基准与真实机器人平台上，Navi-Agent在几何约束方法中达到SOTA，同时与依赖几何定位的方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 无坐标的拓扑式空间状态表示可在不依赖深度与全局坐标的条件下支撑长程VLN-CE的定位、验证与恢复，兼具性能与实用性。

title: How Do Agent Harnesses Create Value? Planning Information and Release Control in Stateful LLM Agents
summary: Agent harnesses supply planning guidance, organize execution, and check completion. We study how these components affect success, erroneous acceptance, and cost in two Retail experiments and an Airline pilot in $τ^2$-bench. The primary comparison pairs prewritten task-specific plans (Fixed) with shuffled policy text matched in word count (Sham), isolating the contribution of guidance content. Across 265 matched cells, Fixed improves oracle-verified success by 7.17 percentage points (90\% task-clustered bootstrap interval, 1.15--13.36 points), with gains concentrated in higher-complexity tasks. A read-only terminal verifier rejects 61\% of Retail oracle-invalid episodes while withholding 17\% of correct ones, at less than one cent of additional cost per episode. Which component matters more depends on the loss assigned to erroneous acceptance: at low liability the planning gain dominates; at high liability the verifier's avoided false passes dominate---and a standalone verifier captures nearly all the false-pass benefit of the full planning-plus-verification stack at a fraction of its cost.

AI.tldr: 研究智能体harness中规划指导与完成校验两类组件对成功率、错误接受率和成本的影响。
AI.motivation: 智能体harness包含规划指导、执行组织和完成校验等组件，但其各自对任务成功、错误接受与成本的独立贡献尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在τ²-bench上开展两个Retail实验与一个Airline试点；以任务专用预写计划（Fixed）与词数匹配的打乱策略文本（Sham）作主对照，隔离指导内容的作用；另用只读终端校验器检测完成情况，共265个匹配单元，采用任务聚类bootstrap。
AI.result: Fixed使oracle验证成功率提升7.17个百分点（90%任务聚类bootstrap区间1.15–13.36），增益集中于高复杂度任务；只读终端校验器拒斥61%的Retail oracle无效回合，误扣17%正确回合，每回合额外成本不足一美分。
AI.conclusion: 组件相对重要性取决于错误接受的损失设定：低责任时规划增益占优，高责任时校验器避免的误通过占优；独立校验器能以极低成本捕获完整规划加校验栈近全部误通过收益。

title: Improving Generalization and Robustness in Offline Reinforcement Learning via Boundary-Aware Data Augmentation
summary: Current offline reinforcement learning (ORL) algorithms tend to overfit the training dataset and exhibit poor in-distribution generalization and robustness performance when deployed to real environments, thus compromising their effectiveness. Existing methods typically enhance in-distribution generalization and robustness by leveraging regularization techniques widely used in computer vision. However, due to the high sensitivity of low-level physical signals to distributional shifts, these methods still suffer from notable limitations in in-distribution generalization and robustness, making it difficult to achieve stable performance in complex environments. To address this issue, we theoretically analyze the error bounds of the behavior policy and action-value function trained with random episode interpolation, revealing that the error scales positively correlated with the distance between states. Based on this insight, we propose a method called $\bf{B}$oundary-$\bf{A}$ware $\bf{D}$ata $\bf{A}$ugmentation (BADA), which leverages neighboring states to construct interpolation boundaries, enabling the generation of synthetic data that more faithfully preserves the original data distribution. We first conduct qualitative studies in a toy environment, showing that BADA generates mixed samples that preserve desirable policy smoothness while accurately reconstructing multimodal value distributions. Extensive experiments on limited offline datasets further demonstrate that BADA attains state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对离线强化学习算法过拟合、分布内泛化与鲁棒性差的问题，提出边界感知数据增强方法 BADA，通过邻域状态构建插值边界生成更贴合原始分布的合成数据。
AI.motivation: 现有离线强化学习算法易过拟合训练数据集，部署到真实环境时分布内泛化与鲁棒性不足，效果受损。虽然已有方法借用计算机视觉中的正则化技术缓解该问题，但低层物理信号对分布偏移高度敏感，这些方法仍存在明显局限，难以在复杂环境中保持稳定性能。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析了采用随机回合插值训练的行为策略与动作价值函数的误差界，发现误差与状态间距离呈正相关。基于此提出边界感知数据增强（BADA），利用相邻状态构建插值边界，从而生成更忠实保留原始数据分布的合成数据。
AI.result: 在玩具环境中的定性研究表明，BADA 生成的混合样本在保持良好策略平滑性的同时，能准确重建多模态价值分布；在受限离线数据集上的大量实验进一步表明，BADA 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: BADA 通过边界感知的插值数据增强，有效提升了离线强化学习的分布内泛化与鲁棒性，并在多种基准上取得领先表现，验证了理论分析对方法设计的指导价值。

title: Compact Vision Models for Iris Presentation Attack Detection under Presentation Attack Instrument Shift and Environmental Degradation
comment: Accepted at BIOSIG 2026. This preprint includes minor nomenclature and editorial corrections clarifying the project-specific Patch-ABMIL and Compact-TransMIL variants
summary: Iris presentation attack detection (PAD) is security-critical when a subsystem that appears reliable during development encounters presentation attack instruments (PAIs) or acquisition conditions absent from validation data. We benchmark three compact scratch-trained computer-vision models, each with at most approximately 0.26 million trainable parameters, on the Notre Dame subset of LivDet-Iris 2017 under PAI-driven domain shift and environmental degradation. All models are trained without external pretraining or data augmentation and evaluated over five seeds. A validation-selected threshold is transferred unchanged to the known-attack, unknown-attack, corrupted, and pooled test partitions. From known to unknown attack presentations, Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate (APCER) increases by 17.11-30.47 percentage points and Detection Equal Error Rate (D-EER) increases by 7.38-12.73 percentage points. At the validation-selected threshold, ZACH-ViT obtains the lowest unknown-attack APCER (47.69 +/- 4.84%) and D-EER (38.87 +/- 0.93%), while Compact-TransMIL obtains the lowest Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate (BPCER). ZACH-ViT also gives the lowest unknown-attack BPCER at an APCER limit of 10% (81.29 +/- 1.95%). The high absolute errors show that the comparative advantage of the best compact model does not constitute deployment readiness under unknown PAIs.

AI.tldr: 该文在LivDet-Iris 2017的Notre Dame子集上，用三个参数量约≤0.26M的紧凑模型评测虹膜呈现攻击检测在未知PAI与图像退化下的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 虹膜PAD具有安全关键性：子系统在开发阶段看似可靠，但遇到验证数据中未出现的呈现攻击工具（PAI）或采集条件时会失效，因此需评估PAI驱动的域偏移与环境退化下的真实泛化能力。
AI.method: 基准测试三个紧凑的从零训练（scratch-trained）计算机视觉模型，每个模型可训练参数至多约0.26M；不使用外部预训练与数据增强；在5个随机种子上评估；将验证集选定的阈值原样迁移到已知攻击、未知攻击、受损（corrupted）及合并测试分区。
AI.result: 从已知攻击到未知攻击呈现，APCER上升17.11–30.47个百分点，D-EER上升7.38–12.73个百分点。在验证阈值下，ZACH-ViT取得最低的未知攻击APCER（47.69±4.84%）与D-EER（38.87±0.93%）；Compact-TransMIL取得最低BPCER；ZACH-ViT在APCER限制10%时也取得最低未知攻击BPCER（81.29±1.95%）。
AI.conclusion: 最佳紧凑模型的相对优势不足以构成面向未知PAI的部署就绪性，因其绝对误差仍然很高。

title: Imagine-TAMP: Imagination-Guided Task and Motion Planning in Partial Observability
summary: Robots operating in cluttered environments must often manipulate objects whose locations are only partially observable. A central challenge is deciding whether to acquire another observation or to first manipulate objects that may occlude the target. Conventional task and motion planning (TAMP) approaches typically make this decision using symbolic action costs or expensive geometric planning, neither of which adequately captures how likely an observation is to reveal an occluded target. We introduce Imagine-TAMP, an interleaved planning and execution framework that uses semantic and geometric imagination to compare alternative task-level strategies under partial observability before committing to expensive motion planning. A vision-language model shapes a particle belief over target locations using commonsense relationships between the target and visible objects, while a generative scene model estimates plausible geometry in unobserved regions. Given a target hypothesis and imagined scene, Imagine-TAMP generates multiple symbolic plan skeletons and assigns non-unit costs that approximate both manipulation effort and target visibility from sensing actions, distinguishing a short but poorly informative observation strategy from a longer strategy that first manipulates an occluder to better expose the target. The selected skeleton is then refined into a feasible continuous plan and executed, with new observations updating the belief and triggering replanning when necessary. Experiments show that imagination-guided evaluation improves observation-versus-manipulation decisions: in viewpoint-constrained shelf scenes, non-unit geometric evaluation increases success from 46.0% to 84.0%, while semantic belief shaping further reduces manipulation and replanning. On a real robot, the complete system reduces planning time by 32% relative to a geometry-only ablation.

AI.tldr: 提出Imagine-TAMP，用语义与几何"想象"在部分可观测下评估任务级策略，改进观测与操作的决策权衡。
AI.motivation: 杂乱环境中目标位置常仅部分可观测，机器人需在"再观测一次"与"先操作可能遮挡目标的物体"之间做选择。传统TAMP依赖符号动作代价或昂贵几何规划，无法刻画一次观测揭示被遮挡目标的可能性。
AI.method: 交错的规划与执行框架：视觉语言模型利用目标与可见物体的常识关系塑造粒子信念；生成式场景模型估计未观测区域的合理几何。基于目标假设与想象场景生成多个符号计划骨架，并赋予非单位代价，同时近似操作代价与感知动作带来的目标可见性收益；选中骨架再细化为连续可行规划并执行，新观测更新信念并在必要时重规划。
AI.result: 在视角受限的货架场景中，非单位几何评估将成功率从46.0%提升至84.0%；语义信念塑造进一步减少操作与重规划次数。实机系统相较仅几何的消融版本规划时间减少32%。
AI.conclusion: 想象引导的评估有效改善"观测 vs 操作"决策，语义与几何结合可提升成功率并降低规划开销。

title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/NVlabs/SoL-Pi . Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/SoL-Pi/
summary: As coding agents move from supervised code completion to unattended, around-the-clock exploration, their work expands from isolated predictions into long trajectories of reasoning, tool use, and feedback. Token efficiency therefore becomes important for scaling recursive self-improvement. We take an RSI-inspired approach at the harness layer, scaling auto-research loops across increasingly numerous and diverse environments for harness rollouts. At this scale, the process yields reusable improvements that transfer beyond their development setting, moving automated harness discovery toward production-level outcomes. Four mechanisms survive selection and form SoL-Pi, spanning action execution, context compaction, observation handling, and delegated reading. On the 51-task EdgeBench evaluation, SoL-Pi achieves performance comparable to Pi across GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 while reducing recorded token traffic by 44.7-49.0% and API cost by about one third. In other words, estimated hourly savings are \$8.75-\$13.50 relative to native Codex and Claude Code harnesses, and \$4.36-\$5.71 relative to Pi.

AI.tldr: 提出SoL-Pi：一种在harness层通过RSI式自动研究循环进行token高效化的编码智能体框架。在51任务EdgeBench上，性能与Pi持平（GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 5），token流量减少44.7-49.0%，API成本降低约三分之一。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体从监督式代码补全转向无人值守的持续探索后，工作形态由孤立预测扩展为包含推理、工具调用与反馈的长轨迹，token效率因此成为递归自我改进（RSI）可扩展性的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 在harness层采用RSI-inspired方法，将自动研究循环扩展到数量与多样性不断增长的rollout环境中；经选择保留四项可迁移机制构成SoL-Pi，覆盖动作执行、上下文压缩、观测处理与委托式阅读。
AI.result: 在51任务EdgeBench上，SoL-Pi在GPT-5.6 Sol与Opus 5上性能与Pi相当，记录token流量降低44.7-49.0%，API成本降低约三分之一；相对原生Codex与Claude Code harness每小时节省约\$8.75-\$13.50，相对Pi节省\$4.36-\$5.71。
AI.conclusion: harness层的大规模自动研究可产出超越开发环境、可复用的改进，推动自动化harness发现走向生产级成果。

title: TouchSight: Bare-Handed Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Video via Generative Visual Augmentation
summary: Tactile signals provide direct contact and force measurements that are essential for understanding physical interactions and enabling dexterous robotic manipulation. However, tactile sensing requires direct measurement at contact interfaces, making large-scale data collection reliant on intrusive, costly, and restrictive instrumentation. We present TouchSight, a monocular egocentric vision framework for dense full-hand contact force prediction that leverages 500 hours of pressure-glove recordings and extensive hand-object interaction (HOI) data. To address the appearance gap between gloved training data and bare-hand real-world scenarios, we construct TwinTouch-20H: 20 hours of paired visual data in which generative video models re-render gloved recordings as bare-hand observations against new backgrounds while preserving the original measured tactile labels. TouchSight predicts dense force from both gloved and generated bare-hand videos, outperforms prior contact prediction methods on OakInk2, qualitatively generalizes to natural bare-hand egocentric videos from unseen datasets, and improves consistently as glove supervision scales. These results demonstrate that dense tactile signals can be recovered from egocentric vision alone, without tactile instrumentation at capture time.

AI.tldr: TouchSight 提出一种单目第一人称视觉框架，可从视觉信号中预测密集的全手接触力，无需在采集时使用触觉设备。
AI.motivation: 触觉信号对理解物理交互和实现灵巧机器人操作至关重要，但触觉感知需在接触界面直接测量，导致大规模数据采集依赖侵入式、昂贵且受限的仪器。因此作者希望仅凭第一人称视觉恢复密集触觉信号。
AI.method: 利用 500 小时压力手套记录及大量手-物交互数据；构建 TwinTouch-20H，即 20 小时配对视觉数据，用生成式视频模型将戴手套记录重渲染为裸手观测并更换背景，同时保留原始测量的触觉标签；TouchSight 从戴手套视频和生成的裸手视频中预测密集力。
AI.result: 在 OakInk2 上优于先前接触预测方法；可定性泛化到未见数据集的自然裸手第一人称视频；随手套监督规模扩大性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，密集触觉信号可仅从第一人称视觉中恢复，而无需在采集时使用触觉仪器。

title: Resilient Motion Planning for Free-Flying Space Robots under Actuator Failures
summary: Free-flying robots rely on multiple thrusters to maneuver in space. If one or more of these thrusters fail, the robot may lose control authority and risk mission failure. At the same time, their free-flying nature implies that, even in the absence of actuation, they continue along (locally) straight-line trajectories. In this work we present a probabilistic, proactive, motion planning framework that explicitly accounts for actuator failures in space. We model actuator failure modes as a Markov chain and propagate the probability of successfully reaching the goal along the planning horizon. Precomputed reachable sets evaluate the robot's capabilities of reaching waypoints under potential failures and an RRT$^*$-based planner concatenates these waypoints. The resulting algorithm maximizes the overall target-reaching probability, providing maximally resilient motion plans utilizing free-flying properties. We validate our approach experimentally on a physical free-flyer platform with injected actuator failures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种概率式主动运动规划框架，显式考虑空间执行器故障，将故障建模为马尔可夫链并沿规划时域传播到达目标的成功概率，用预计算可达集评估故障下的可达能力，再用RRT*拼接航点，最大化目标到达概率，实现最大限度韧性规划，并在物理自由飞行器平台上实验验证。
AI.motivation: 自由飞行机器人依赖多个推力器进行机动，一旦一个或多个推力器失效，可能失去控制权限并导致任务失败；而其自由飞行特性意味着即使无驱动仍沿（局部）直线轨迹继续运动，因此需要在规划中显式考虑执行器故障。
AI.method: 将执行器故障模式建模为马尔可夫链，沿规划时域传播成功到达目标的概率；利用预计算的可达集评估机器人在潜在故障下到达航点的能力；采用基于RRT*的规划器连接这些航点，形成整体算法。
AI.result: 该算法最大化整体目标到达概率，提供利用自由飞行特性的最大限度韧性运动规划；并在物理自由飞行器平台上通过注入执行器故障进行了实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过概率建模、可达集评估与RRT*航点拼接，可在执行器故障情形下生成最大化到达成功概率的韧性运动规划，并通过物理自由飞行器实验验证了方法的有效性。

title: FreqCondNorm: Towards Cross-domain Predictive Maintenance through a Frequency-Conditioned Transformer Foundation Model
summary: Deep learning predictive maintenance models suffer from poor transferability across machines and operating conditions, especially when labelled data are scarce and signals span five orders of magnitude in sampling frequency (1 Hz to ~100 kHz). We propose FreqCondNorm, a Transformer-based architecture that introduces a FiLM-style frequency-conditioned normalization layer to unify heterogeneous time-series within a single model. The architecture is pretrained on five public predictive maintenance datasets (CWRU, MFPT, UOC18, PRONOSTIA, CMAPSS) using masked auto-encoding and contrastive learning with balanced domain sampling. On fault diagnosis, the model achieves 99.2% accuracy on CWRU (+6.4 pp over CNN) and 82.1% zero-shot accuracy on MFPT, demonstrating strong transfer across sampling frequencies. However, the approach does not improve remaining useful life prediction, suggesting a mismatch between pretraining and RUL objectives that warrants future investigation.

AI.tldr: 提出 FreqCondNorm——一种引入 FiLM 风格频率条件归一化层的 Transformer 架构，将采样频率跨越 1 Hz 至 ~100 kHz 的异构时序统一到单一模型中，并基于五个公开 PHM 数据集进行掩码自编码与对比学习预训练，在故障诊断任务上实现跨频率的强迁移，但未改善 RUL 预测。
AI.motivation: 深度学习预测性维护模型在跨机器、跨工况场景下迁移性差，尤其当标注数据稀缺、且信号采样频率跨越五个数量级（1 Hz 至 ~100 kHz）时，异构时序难以被单一模型统一建模。
AI.method: FreqCondNorm：基于 Transformer 的架构，核心是 FiLM 风格的频率条件归一化层，用于在单模型内统一异构时序。在 CWRU、MFPT、UOC18、PRONOSTIA、CMAPSS 五个公开预测性维护数据集上，采用掩码自编码与对比学习，并结合平衡域采样进行预训练。
AI.result: 故障诊断方面：CWRU 上达 99.2% 准确率（较 CNN 提升 6.4 个百分点）；MFPT 上零样本准确率 82.1%，表明跨采样频率具备强迁移能力。但在剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测方面未取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 频率条件归一化可有效统一跨采样频率的异构时序并支撑故障诊断的跨域迁移；但预训练目标与 RUL 预测目标之间存在不匹配，该问题值得后续研究。

title: Hypernetwork-Parameterized Spatially Adaptive Neural Operators for PDE Learning
summary: Spatially heterogeneous partial differential equations (PDEs) exhibit location-dependent dynamics arising from variations in geometry and physical coefficients. Existing neural operators improve localized modeling through multiscale features, attention mechanisms, or domain decomposition, yet their update rules often remain spatially shared. Hypernetwork-based methods adapt parameters across PDE instances but typically generate only one global parameterization per instance. Consequently, shared operators may underfit boundaries and high-gradient regions, with these localized errors accumulating during autoregressive rollout. We propose a spatially adaptive neural operator (SANO), which replaces this spatially shared parameterization with a spatially continuous field of location-dependent operator parameters. SANO uses Fourier-encoded coordinates and a coordinate-conditioned hypernetwork to generate spatial operator-conditioning codes at sampling points. A Hyper-Neural Element (HNE) mechanism interpolates these codes within local subregions, coupling neighboring operators while allowing their update rules to vary across space, and partition-of-unity weights assemble the overlapping local predictions. Experiments on one-, two-, and three-dimensional PDEs and two perforated-domain elliptic benchmarks show that SANO consistently outperforms competitive neural-operator, hypernetwork-based, and physics-informed baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间自适应神经算子SANO，用空间连续的位置相关算子参数场替代空间共享参数化，通过坐标条件超网络与Hyper-Neural Element机制实现局部自适应更新，在多维PDE及穿孔域基准上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 空间异质PDE具有位置相关动态，源于几何与物理系数的变化。现有神经算子虽通过多尺度特征、注意力或域分解改进局部建模，但其更新规则通常仍为空间共享；基于超网络的方法虽能跨PDE实例自适应参数，但通常只为每个实例生成单一全局参数化。因此，共享算子可能在边界和高梯度区域拟合不足，且这些局部误差在自回归推演中会累积。
AI.method: 提出空间自适应神经算子（SANO），以空间连续的位置相关算子参数场取代空间共享参数化。具体使用傅里叶编码坐标与坐标条件超网络，在采样点生成空间算子条件编码；设计Hyper-Neural Element（HNE）机制，在局部子区域内插值这些编码，耦合相邻算子同时允许其更新规则随空间变化；并通过单位分解（partition-of-unity）权重组装重叠的局部预测。
AI.result: 在一维、二维、三维PDE以及两个穿孔域椭圆基准上，SANO一致优于具有竞争力的神经算子、基于超网络的方法和物理信息基线。
AI.conclusion: SANO通过空间连续、位置相关的算子参数化与局部插值组装机制，有效缓解了共享算子在边界和高梯度区域的拟合不足及自回归误差累积问题，在多种维度与异质域任务上均取得更优性能。

title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing converts document images into structured content and requires reliable performance across diverse layouts and acquisition conditions. Yet training corpora are biased toward common document types and clean digital pages, while expanding coverage alone does not specify how to address a parser's remaining weaknesses. We present WeVisDoc, a two-stage data-centric framework for robust end-to-end document parsing. Stage I broadens semantic, structural, and appearance coverage through heterogeneous data and structure-preserving degradation synthesis. Stage II uses a held-out probe to measure the Stage I parser's residual errors within fixed visual-structural clusters. These diagnostics guide targeted data construction and reallocation of the target-token budget. WeVisDoc-4B achieves an Overall score of 95.38 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and a mean Overall score of 75.54 across the three PureDocBench tracks, ranking first among the compared end-to-end parsers in all four settings. Compared with Stage I, Stage II improves Overall scores for the 2B and 4B models on both benchmarks, with larger gains on the degraded PureDocBench tracks, including a 4.03-point gain for the 4B model on the Real Degraded track.

AI.tldr: 提出WeVisDoc两阶段数据中心框架，通过异构数据扩充与结构保持退化合成提升覆盖面，再以留出探针诊断残差错误以指导针对性数据构造与目标token预算再分配，实现稳健端到端文档解析。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析训练语料偏向常见文档类型与干净的数字化页面，且单纯扩充覆盖范围并不能明确指出如何解决解析器的剩余弱点，因此需要一种能针对残差错误进行定向优化的数据中心方法。
AI.method: WeVisDoc为两阶段数据中心框架：Stage I通过异构数据与结构保持的退化合成，扩展语义、结构与外观覆盖；Stage II利用留出探针在固定视觉-结构聚类内测量Stage I解析器的残差错误，据此指导针对性数据构造并重新分配目标token预算。
AI.result: WeVisDoc-4B在OmniDocBench v1.6上Overall得分为95.38，在PureDocBench三条赛道平均Overall为75.54，在四个设置中均位列所比较的端到端解析器第一。相较Stage I，Stage II在两大基准上均提升2B与4B模型的Overall分数，且在退化的PureDocBench赛道上增益更大，其中4B模型在Real Degraded赛道提升4.03分。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段数据中心框架能有效提升端到端文档解析器在多样布局与采集条件下的稳健性，尤其在退化场景中收益显著，表明基于残差诊断的定向数据构造与预算再分配优于单阶段扩充策略。

title: Time-Efficient Iterative Learning Planning for Safety-Critical Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
summary: Autonomous mobile robots require timeefficient planning and safety-critical dynamic obstacle avoidance under constrained onboard computation. While Iterative Learning Planning (ILP) offers lightweight and efficient traversal planning, it lacks explicit mechanisms for dynamic obstacle perception and avoidance. This article extends ILP to safety-critical navigation in dynamic environments by integrating an anticipatory risk-blended control barrier function (ARB-CBF). The extended ILP learns traversal-speed and steering-bias profiles via a fractionalpower update based on local obstacle risk, generating nominal control commands that ARB-CBF modifies at runtime for real-time safety guarantees. Algorithmic analysis demonstrates that the ILP replanning stage scales at O(kN) for k iterations and N waypoints, while ARB-CBF executes with linear complexity. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the framework, demonstrating superior temporal efficiency and safety with lower computational overhead compared to optimizationbased baselines, making it highly suitable for resourceconstrained platforms.

AI.tldr: 将迭代学习规划(ILP)与预见性风险混合控制屏障函数(ARB-CBF)结合，实现动态环境下安全关键的自主导航，兼顾时间效率与实时安全性。
AI.motivation: 自主移动机器人在受限的机载计算下，需同时满足时间高效的规划与安全关键的动态避障。ILP虽轻量高效，但缺乏动态障碍感知与规避机制，故需扩展其安全能力。
AI.method: 扩展ILP：基于局部障碍风险的分数幂更新学习通行速度与转向偏置剖面，生成名义控制指令；运行时由ARB-CBF对名义指令进行修正以提供实时安全保证。
AI.result: 算法分析表明ILP重规划阶段复杂度为O(kN)（k次迭代、N个路径点），ARB-CBF具线性复杂度；仿真与真实实验验证了框架在时间效率与安全性上优于基于优化的基线，且计算开销更低。
AI.conclusion: 该ILP+ARB-CBF框架在资源受限平台上实现了高效且安全的动态导航，适合嵌入式部署。

title: Refuse, Decompose, Refresh: A Claim-Safe Protocol for Closed-Loop AI Evaluation
comment: 8 pages, 0 figures, 3 tables. The reproducibility artifact is linked in the paper
summary: An AI evaluation can be perfectly reproducible and still support the wrong claim. This risk is acute in closed-loop systems: policy determines visited states, observable components, and which failures leave a measurable trace. We propose a claim-safe protocol with three actions. Refuse: abstain when a clean reference stream or matched runtime comparison lacks support. Decompose: report protocol execution, operational false admission, and structural hypotheses separately rather than as one PASS/FAIL label. Refresh: treat distribution-shift alarms as requests to invalidate and recompute a reference map, not as fault evidence. We instantiate the protocol in an aggregate-only simulator with 24 policy components, three demand regimes, two fault-mask families, and independent development and heldout seeds. The preregistered heldout contains 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows. Only 55/72 regime-component units were reference-admitted and 54/55 remained runtime-admitted, making abstention part of the result. Stable false admission was 0/20 represented components, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391 under a frozen 0.20 rule. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic outpredicted nominal fault-cell fraction: across 540 unit-arm rows nested in 20 component clusters, the cell-minus-traffic negative-log-likelihood difference was 0.1264 nats per row, with a 95% component-cluster interval of [0.0593, 0.1918]. A drift log shows why "null" must be reference-relative: clean fault-null streams triggered 15/15, 0/15, and 14/15 alarms across three regimes, while only the middle regime matched the frozen detector reference. Rather than a universal threshold, we contribute an executable contract linking observable support, statistical calibration, and justified claims.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"claim-safe"评估协议（Refuse/Decompose/Refresh三动作），在聚合仿真中验证：弃权率成为结果一部分，稳定误纳率为0/20（95%上界0.1391），且被影响清流比名义故障格更能预测结果，漂移日志表明"null"必须相对于参考。
AI.motivation: AI评估可完美复现却仍支持错误结论，该风险在闭环系统中尤为突出：策略决定访问状态、可观测组件以及哪些失败会留下可测痕迹。因此需要一个可执行契约，将可观测支持、统计校准与可辩护结论绑定。
AI.method: 提出三动作协议：Refuse（缺少干净参考流或匹配的运行时比较时弃权）、Decompose（分别报告协议执行、操作性误纳、结构性假设，而非单一PASS/FAIL）、Refresh（将分布漂移告警视为使参考图失效并重算的请求，而非故障证据）。在仅聚合仿真中实例化：24个策略组件、3种需求情景、2类故障掩蔽族、独立开发与保留种子；预注册保留集含1440个案例、21600行分区。
AI.result: 仅55/72情景-组件单元通过参考准入，其中54/55保持运行时准入，弃权成为结果的一部分。稳定误纳为0/20代表性组件，冻结0.20规则下单侧精确95%上界为0.1391。在准入单元内，受影响清流比名义故障格占比预测更好：540行单元-臂（嵌套于20个组件簇）的格减流负对数似然差为0.1264 nats/行，95%组件簇区间[0.0593, 0.1918]。漂移日志显示干净故障零流在三情景分别触发15/15、0/15、14/15告警，仅中间情景匹配冻结探测器参考。
AI.conclusion: 不应采用通用阈值，而应贡献一个将可观测支持、统计校准与正当结论连接起来的可执行契约；弃权与参考相对性是评估有效性的组成部分。

title: ZeroHAT: Behavior-Conditioned Zero-Shot Human Activity Trace Generation
summary: Human activity traces record individuals' timestamped visits to points of interest and are essential for applications such as mobility prediction and urban simulation. However, accessing large-scale HATs is challenging due to high collection costs and privacy concerns. Synthetic HAT generation offers a promising way to make such data available and has attracted growing interest from both industry and academia. Although many efforts have been devoted to this topic, most of them rely on real data from a region to generate synthetic data for the same region, which is infeasible for the many regions where real HATs are unavailable. To fill this gap, we propose ZeroHAT, a behavior-conditioned framework that generates synthetic HATs for a target region in a zero-shot manner by transferring behavioral patterns learned from real HATs in source regions and adapting them with publicly available contextual information about the target region. ZeroHAT has three key novel components: (i) a multidimensional consistency-aware intent extractor; (ii) a cross-region behavioral cloning module; and (iii) a behavior-conditioned activity realization module. We evaluate ZeroHAT on a ten-city benchmark, where extensive experiments show that ZeroHAT achieves 4.5-6.4x the normalized downstream utility of the strongest baseline and improves average fidelity by 15.6%-40.8% across target regions.

AI.tldr: 提出ZeroHAT，一个行为条件化的零样本框架，通过迁移源区域真实人类活动轨迹中的行为模式并结合目标区域公开上下文信息，为目标区域生成合成人类活动轨迹。
AI.motivation: 人类活动轨迹（HATs）对移动性预测、城市模拟等应用至关重要，但大规模采集面临高成本和隐私问题。合成HAT生成是可行替代方案，然而现有方法大多依赖同一区域真实数据生成同区域合成数据，对于缺乏真实HATs的众多区域不可行。
AI.method: ZeroHAT包含三个关键组件：(i) 多维度一致性感知意图提取器；(ii) 跨区域行为克隆模块；(iii) 行为条件化活动实现模块，从而实现跨区域零样本迁移生成。
AI.result: 在十城市基准上实验表明，ZeroHAT达到最强基线归一化下游效用的4.5-6.4倍，并在各目标区域平均保真度提升15.6%-40.8%。
AI.conclusion: ZeroHAT通过跨区域行为迁移与上下文适配，有效解决无真实HATs目标区域的合成数据生成问题，显著优于现有基线。

title: When Do Language-Grounded Explanations Help? A Graph-Bottleneck for Farm Monitoring Interpretable Sheep Facial Pain
summary: Automated pain recognition from facial expression could make continuous welfare assessment practical in sheep, but adoption depends on trust: a stockperson cannot act on a score that arrives without justification. We ground a model in the Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES) by letting each detected facial region attend over text embeddings of the clinical descriptors and then test whether the resulting explanations mean anything. They do not. Ablating an entire descriptor changes the predicted logit by about $10^{-4}$, and the most-attended cue agrees with the predicted pain level in only $32.6\%$ of regions, although the attention maps, the learned gate, and the generated text all proposed otherwise. We therefore remove the appearance bypass with a concept bottleneck whose classifier reads only SPFES concept scores, supervised by per-region state annotations that image-level pipelines discard. This costs $0.05$--$0.10$ in Cohen's $κ$ but yields concepts that are demonstrably learned: minority pain-indicating states are recovered at $3.5$--$8.3\times$ their base rates, and the ear and eye severity orderings emerge without severity supervision. Removing the supervision alone leaves $κ$ unchanged while concept accuracy falls to $0.109$, showing that architectural necessity does not imply semantic validity. We also show that pooled concept accuracy is misleading under clinical imbalance and provide a cross-validated, protocol-matched benchmark of seven methods on this dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"注意力解释即为可信解释"的假设：基于SPFES的注意力模型其解释与预测几乎无关；改用概念瓶颈后语义有效性显著提升，但代价是κ下降0.05–0.10。
AI.motivation: 绵羊面部自动疼痛识别可实现持续福利评估，但落地依赖信任：饲养员无法依据一个无理由的分数采取行动。因此需要模型给出"有意义"的解释，并检验这些解释是否名副其实。
AI.method: 1）构建基于Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale（SPFES）的模型，让每个检测到的面部区域在临床描述符的文本嵌入上做注意力；2）通过消融描述符、比对最受关注线索与预测疼痛等级进行解释有效性检验；3）移除外观旁路，构建概念瓶颈：分类器仅读取SPFES概念分数，并由图像级流程丢弃的逐区域状态标注监督；4）对照实验：仅去掉监督、保留结构，考察κ与概念准确率变化。
AI.result: 注意力解释不可信：消融整个描述符仅使logit变化约10⁻⁴；最受关注线索与预测疼痛等级一致率仅32.6%，尽管注意力图、学习门控与生成文本都暗示相反结论。概念瓶颈代价为Cohen's κ下降0.05–0.10，但概念确实被学到：少数疼痛指示状态以基准率3.5–8.3倍被找回，耳与眼严重度排序在无严重度监督下自发出现。仅移除监督而保留架构时κ不变，但概念准确率降至0.109，说明架构必要性≠语义有效性。还指出临床不平衡下池化概念准确率具误导性，并提供七个方法的交叉验证、协议对齐基准。
AI.conclusion: 注意力/生成式解释可能在数值上毫无因果作用，可信度需以消融与语义一致性实证检验；概念瓶颈以适度κ损失换取可验证的概念学习，但概念有效性来自监督而非结构本身；评估应避免池化准确率，采用协议匹配的交叉验证基准。

title: Spatial-Semantic Uncertainty in VLM-Based Target Search: Balancing Exploration and Identification
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026) WorkshopRethinking Uncertainty for Modern Robotics Paradigms
summary: Robots searching for a target from a natural-language description must determine not only where to search, but also which observed candidate is the desired target. These decisions reflect two distinct sources of uncertainty - spatial uncertainty over candidate locations and semantic uncertainty over target identity - that are often conflated in VLM-based search systems. We introduce a spatial-semantic uncertainty formulation that maintains separate beliefs over each component and integrates probabilistic VLM evidence into a global target-identity posterior, including probability mass for undiscovered targets. This decomposition allows an information-theoretic planner to independently value candidate discovery and target disambiguation through spatial and semantic expected information gain (EIG), providing an explicit mechanism for trading broader exploration against earlier identification. We evaluate six VLM uncertainty-elicitation interfaces on 500 synthetic targets and show that similar recognition accuracy can conceal substantial differences in calibration and false confidence. In degraded-observation search-and-identify experiments, EIG-based planners reach confident decisions in 75.0%-92.5% of trials, compared with 20.0% for Random search, while different spatial-semantic weightings achieve comparable identification accuracy once confidence is attained. Increasing semantic emphasis reduces unnecessary exploration and VLM queries, demonstrating that explicitly planning over semantic uncertainty can accelerate target resolution without sacrificing decision quality. These results highlight the distinct roles of uncertainty representation and uncertainty-driven planning in embodied VLM systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出空间-语义不确定性分解框架，将目标搜索中的位置不确定性与身份不确定性分离建模，并基于信息论规划实现探索与识别的权衡。
AI.motivation: 机器人在自然语言描述引导下搜索目标时，需同时决定"去哪搜索"和"哪个候选是目标"，这对应空间不确定性与语义不确定性。VLM搜索系统常混淆这两类不确定性，缺乏显式区分与规划机制，导致探索与识别难以有效权衡。
AI.method: 提出空间-语义不确定性建模：分别维护两类信念，将VLM的概率证据整合为全局目标身份后验（含未发现目标概率质量）；由此信息论规划器可分别以空间EIG和语义EIG评估候选发现与目标消歧的价值，显式权衡广泛探索与提前识别。并评估六种VLM不确定性引出接口。
AI.result: 在500个合成目标上，六种接口识别准确率相近但校准与虚假置信差异显著。退化观测搜索-识别实验中，EIG规划器在75.0%-92.5%的试验中达成置信决策，Random仅20.0%；不同空间-语义权重在达成置信后识别准确率相当，提高语义权重可减少冗余探索与VLM查询。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并规划语义不确定性可在不牺牲决策质量的前提下加速目标识别，凸显不确定性表示与不确定性驱动规划在具身VLM系统中的不同作用。

title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task
comment: 37 pages, 4 figures. Preregistration: https://osf.io/5jp7s . Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21318346
summary: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究以同一评分代码回放100组人类Wason任务讨论，并与信念锚定的LLM智能体组对比，发现"全体共识率"高度依赖参与与终态的操作化定义（人类估计24.0%–57.0%），智能体组的共识率在多种敏感性分析下仍显著更高（差距约34–44个百分点），且高共识并不对应更高的集体准确性。
AI.motivation: 全体共识率常被当作集体认知的指标，但其数值取决于"参与"与"最终状态"如何被操作化定义。人类群体中存在大量不发言者，而LLM智能体几乎总是发言，这种测量不对称可能人为夸大或掩盖人机群体共识差异，因此需要一套评分定义明确、可比性强的评估基准。
AI.method: 回放100组留出的人类Wason任务讨论组，构建匹配的LLM智能体组；依据每位参与者讨论前的答案植入一个"信念锚定"智能体，并用同一套评分代码对人和智能体打分。通过多种人类评分定义、两类解盲后敏感性分析（基于提交样本 n=98；参与度匹配样本 n=45）来削减不同的测量不对称；并检验去除提前停止机制、以及去除可记忆答案的重参数化后的稳健性。
AI.result: 不同人类评分定义下共识率估计在24.0%–57.0%之间；约五分之一参与者从未发言，而智能体几乎全部发言。基于提交的比较（n=98）在chat与reasoning模式下差距为34.0与43.9个百分点；参与度匹配比较（n=45）差距为34.1与44.4个百分点，两条路径虽削减了不同测量不对称，但结果收敛在0.5个百分点以内。去除提前停止及消除可记忆答案后差距依然存在，此时reasoning模式组近乎全体一致，但多数为错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 模拟共识并不能反映集体准确性；信念锚定的智能体组在该情境下是人类群体结果分布的有偏估计。研究提供了一套"评分定义显式化"的框架，用于评估模拟群体对人类审议结果的估计效度。

title: EviRec: Continual Evidence Learning for Dual Cold-Start POI Recommendation
summary: Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation is a core task in location-based services, yet most existing methods assume a fixed user population and POI catalog. Through a large-scale data-driven analysis of 10 U.S. cities, we identify substantial POI churn, user turnover, category drift, and decay in static POI memory, motivating the study of continual dual cold-start POI recommendation. To address this setting, we propose EviRec, a continual evidence-learning framework that estimates how much historical evidence should be trusted separately for each candidate POI. EviRec scores each visible candidate from three complementary views: a matching view based on the user's recent mobility profile, a transition-memory view that captures repeated mobility routines, and a lifecycle view that reflects candidate maturity. Because a near-zero transition score may indicate either irrelevance or insufficient observation, EviRec qualifies the evidence using each candidate's observation state and applies a reliability gate to adaptively route between transition-memory and lifecycle evidence. We evaluate EviRec on a full-year, five-city POI check-in dataset containing more than 30,000 users and 684,200 trajectories. Experimental results show that EviRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with the largest gains concentrated on cold-start queries. In particular, EviRec improves NDCG@10 by 20.4\% on Dual-New cases over the strongest baseline. In-depth analyses further confirm that these gains arise primarily from candidate-specific reliability gating while largely preserving previously learned mobility routines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviRec，一个面向"持续双重冷启动"POI推荐场景的证据学习框架，通过为每个候选POI单独估计历史证据可信度，在三个互补视角下打分并利用可靠性门控自适应路由，在双新查询上NDCG@10较最强基线提升20.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有POI推荐方法大多假设用户群体与POI目录固定不变，但基于美国10个城市的大规模数据分析发现存在显著的POI更替、用户流失、类别漂移以及静态POI记忆衰减问题，因此有必要研究持续双重冷启动POI推荐（用户与POI同时为新）这一更现实的设定。
AI.method: EviRec是一个持续证据学习框架，为每个候选POI分别估计应信任多少历史证据。它从三个互补视角对可见候选项打分：基于用户近期移动画像的匹配视角、捕捉重复移动规律的转移记忆视角、反映候选成熟度的生命周期视角。由于接近零的转移分数可能意味着不相关或观测不足，EviRec利用每个候选的观测状态对证据进行限定，并施加可靠性门控在转移记忆证据与生命周期证据之间自适应路由。
AI.result: 在覆盖五个城市、包含30,000多名用户和684,200条轨迹的整年POI签到数据集上评估，EviRec持续优于最先进基线，且增益最大的部分集中在冷启动查询上；在Dual-New场景下NDCG@10较最强基线提升20.4%。深入分析进一步证实，这些增益主要来源于候选级别的可靠性门控，同时很大程度上保留了先前学到的移动规律。
AI.conclusion: EviRec通过候选级别的可靠性门控有效应对持续双重冷启动POI推荐，在显著提升冷启动性能的同时缓解灾难性遗忘，验证了针对每个候选POI单独评估历史证据可信度的必要性与有效性。

title: Cross-Architecture Foundation-Model Distillation for Edge Flood Segmentation
comment: Main paper (17 pages) with supplementary material (11 pages). Submitted to IEEE JSTARS, Special Section on Generalist-Specialist Model Synergy for Remote Sensing: Theories, Methods, and Applications
summary: Geospatial foundation models can provide strong flood-segmentation performance, but their size limits deployment on memory-constrained edge hardware. We distill a 300-million-parameter Prithvi-EO-2.0 teacher, fine-tuned on the 252 manually labeled Sen1Floods11 training scenes, into a 0.7-million-parameter EfficientViT-B0 student. The teacher supervises additional unlabeled Sentinel-2 imagery, allowing the student training set to grow without new manual annotations. At the matched budget of 252 scenes, teacher-supervised training is competitive with direct training and improves STURM-Flood performance across tested configurations; a geometry-matched control shows that label source alone does not explain the difference. Scaling the teacher-supervised pool to 2,500 scenes narrows the remaining student--teacher gap: the float student reaches 0.787 water intersection over union on the Sen1Floods11 test split against 0.822 for the teacher, matches the teacher on STURM-Flood under our evaluation protocol, and remains below it on WorldFloods-v2. After activation replacement and quantization-aware training, the student runs as a 1.5-megabyte 8-bit integer (INT8) TensorRT engine on a Jetson Xavier NX at 5.57 milliseconds of graphics processing unit (GPU) compute per 512-by-512 image, with approximately 14 megabytes of runtime device memory. A fixed modified normalized difference water index (MNDWI) threshold is competitive with both models on the two clean external benchmarks, so we interpret those benchmarks as generalization tests rather than as evidence of learned-model superiority over a spectral rule. The results support the conclusion: foundation-model supervision can amplify a fixed manual annotation budget into a substantially larger training set and yield a compact, deployable edge model.

AI.tldr: 将3亿参数的Prithvi-EO-2.0洪水分割基础模型蒸馏至70万参数的EfficientViT-B0学生模型，实现边缘端部署，并以监督信号放大有限人工标注预算。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型虽具备强洪水分割性能，但参数量巨大，难以在内存受限的边缘硬件上部署，需要紧凑且可部署的模型。
AI.method: 以经252个手工标注Sen1Floods11训练场景微调的3亿参数Prithvi-EO-2.0为教师，蒸馏到70万参数EfficientViT-B0学生；教师监督额外无标注Sentinel-2影像以扩充学生训练集；设置几何匹配对照组以排除标签来源单一解释；将监督池扩至2500场景；并进行激活替换与量化感知训练，导出INT8 TensorRT引擎。
AI.result: 在252场景等预算下，教师监督训练与直接训练相当并提升STURM-Flood表现；扩至2500场景后，学生Sen1Floods11测试水体制交并比为0.787（教师0.822），在STURM-Flood上匹配教师，在WorldFloods-v2上仍低于教师；INT8引擎在Jetson Xavier NX上每512×512图像GPU计算5.57 ms，运行时显存约14 MB，模型体积1.5 MB；固定MNDWI阈值在两个干净外部基准上与两模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型监督可将固定人工标注预算放大为显著更大的训练集，并产出紧凑、可部署的边缘模型；两个干净外部基准应视为泛化测试，而非学习模型优于光谱规则的证据。

title: Visual Sim-to-Real Learning for Robotic Insertion under Geometric Variations: Application to Rebar Installation
summary: Rebar insertion is among the most repetitive and physically demanding tasks on construction sites, and a contact-rich problem at 1.4 mm clearance. The parts, however, vary at two levels: a nominal design per structural member, and fabrication tolerance around each nominal design. Real-world data therefore has to be re-collected as designs and batches change. We present RebarSim, a visual sim-to-real system trained entirely in simulation. A privileged state-based teacher is trained with reinforcement learning over procedurally generated rebar geometries, then distilled into a multi-view student that maps raw RGB and proprioception directly to actions under extensive domain randomization. The student transfers to the real world zero-shot, seating rebars taken from a real factory production run in 91.3% of real-robot rollouts. Underlying that result, geometry diversity and pretraining both bring benefits. Training across a diverse set of nominal designs rather than one lifts the zero-shot success of both the teacher and the student on unseen designs, and the student policy outperforms a single-design specialist on that specialist's own design. A pretrained student then adapts to a new design with 4--6x fewer distillation samples than one trained from scratch. Visual sim-to-real transfer depends on appearance randomization and the DAgger mixture: removing either one sharply lowers success. Videos, code, and task assets are available at https://rebarsim.github.io.

AI.tldr: RebarSim是一个完全在仿真中训练的视觉sim-to-real系统，通过特权状态教师策略蒸馏到多视角学生策略，实现钢筋插入任务的零样本真机迁移，真实机器人rollout成功率达91.3%。
AI.motivation: 钢筋插入是建筑工地中重复性高、体力消耗大的任务，且属于1.4毫米间隙的接触密集问题。零件在设计层面（结构构件的标称设计）和制造公差层面都存在变化，导致真实世界数据随设计和批次变化而需重新采集，因此需要一种能在仿真中训练并直接迁移到真机的方案。
AI.method: 提出RebarSim视觉sim-to-real系统，全部在仿真中训练。先在程序化生成的钢筋几何模型上，用强化学习训练基于特权状态的教师策略；再将其蒸馏为多视角学生策略，该学生策略在大量域随机化下直接将原始RGB和本体感知映射为动作。
AI.result: 学生策略实现零样本真机迁移，在来自真实工厂生产批次的钢筋插入任务中，真实机器人rollout成功率为91.3%。几何多样性和预训练均有收益：跨多种标称设计训练可提升教师和学生在未见设计上的零样本成功率，且学生策略在该单设计专家自己的设计上优于单设计专家；预训练学生策略适应新设计所需蒸馏样本比从头训练少4--6倍。视觉sim-to-real迁移依赖外观随机化和DAgger混合，去掉任一者成功率都会显著下降。
AI.conclusion: RebarSim验证了完全在仿真中训练、零样本迁移到真机的视觉sim-to-real方案在接触密集的钢筋插入任务上的有效性。几何多样性训练和预训练是关键增益来源，外观随机化与DAgger混合是视觉迁移的必要条件。视频、代码和任务资产见 https://rebarsim.github.io。

title: Limits of Confidence in Diffusion
summary: Discrete diffusion, including remasking and uniform-state samplers, generate a sequence by writing multiple token positions per step, drawing each from a per-position distribution and choosing which positions to write from those same distributions. For domains of general interest (pixels, phonemes, or words) there are inherent dependencies between tokens. We show that a step matches the training distribution only when the positions it writes are conditionally independent given the tokens already fixed, that no product of per-position distributions can match a dependent group, and that per-position distributions do not determine whether a group is dependent: two joint distributions can have identical per-position marginals while differing in which combinations of values occur. On ScanAndAdd, a synthetic task whose joint distribution is available in closed form, we verify that every group of two or more undetermined positions a confidence ranking writes is dependent, and measure the generated distribution to be $29\times$ the sampling-noise floor total variation while per-sample metrics are $1.0$.

AI.tldr: 离散扩散采样器每步并行写入多个token位置，但仅当所写位置在已固定token条件下条件独立时，该步才与训练分布匹配；一般依赖型数据上逐位置分布之积无法匹配联合分布，且逐位置边缘分布无法判定依赖结构。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散（remasking、uniform-state采样器）在像素、音素、词等存在固有token依赖的领域中，每步从逐位置分布中并行采样多个位置。作者质疑这种"逐位置边缘分布之积"式并行写入能否复现训练时的联合分布，即其生成过程的正确性前提是否成立。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明一步采样匹配训练分布当且仅当所写位置在已固定token条件下条件独立；证明任何逐位置分布之积都无法匹配依赖组；并构造反例说明两个联合分布可具有完全相同的逐位置边缘分布却在取值组合的出现情况上不同，故边缘分布不能确定组是否依赖。实验：在联合分布可闭式获得的合成任务ScanAndAdd上，检验置信度排序（confidence ranking）所写入的任意≥2个未定位置组成的组是否依赖，并测量生成分布的总变差与采样噪声下限之比。
AI.result: 在ScanAndAdd上验证：置信度排序写入的每个包含≥2个未定位置的组均为依赖组；测得生成分布的总变差为采样噪声下限的29倍，而逐样本指标（per-sample metrics）却为1.0，说明逐样本指标无法反映分布层面的失配。
AI.conclusion: 并行写入多个位置的离散扩散采样在存在依赖的数据上无法匹配训练分布，其根本原因是逐位置边缘分布不足以刻画联合依赖；逐样本指标具有误导性，需以分布层面的总变差等度量评估生成质量。

title: Sharp Reconstruction Bounds for Autoencoders Using the Same Forward Map
summary: We study reconstruction in autoencoders that apply the same forward map before and after setting the observed coordinates to zero. For equal odd input and hidden dimensions $d\geq 3$, among orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms whose Jacobian singular values lie in $[m,M]$, we show that the least uniform reconstruction-derivative error is $\max\{1-M(M-m)/2,0\}$, with affine maps attaining this sharp bound at every prescribed depth. A translated radial rotation can nevertheless reconstruct any prescribed ball exactly with singular values arbitrarily close to one, motivating additional conditions for a finite-data bound. We test this prediction on a 798,452-point terrestrial LiDAR forest scan. At input scale $0.05$, the mean theoretical bound is $0.155$, about $84\%$ of the mean normalized training error $0.185$ across four spatial regions, two depths, and three seeds. At this scale, adding one hidden coordinate reduces the mean reconstruction error below $6\times10^{-6}$.

AI.tldr: 研究在观测坐标置零前后施加相同前向映射的自编码器重构问题，给出保持定向微分同胚下最均匀重构导数误差的锐界，并在大规模LiDAR森林扫描数据上验证理论预测。
AI.motivation: 理解自编码器为何能在降维或非平凡映射下实现精确重构，并为其重构能力建立理论下界/上界，以解释并预测实际数据上的重构误差。
AI.method: 对输入与隐藏维度为相等奇数 d≥3 的情形，考虑 Jacobian 奇异值位于 [m,M] 的保持定向微分同胚，分析在置零前后使用相同前向映射时的最小均匀重构导数误差；构造仿射映射达到该锐界，并构造平移径向旋转变换实现球上精确重构；随后在 798,452 点地面 LiDAR 森林扫描数据上，跨四个空间区域、两种深度与三个随机种子进行实证检验。
AI.result: 理论最小均匀重构导数误差为 max{1−M(M−m)/2, 0}，且可由仿射映射在任意指定深度处达到该界；平移径向旋转能以任意接近 1 的奇异值精确重构给定球。实验上，在输入尺度 0.05 时平均理论界为 0.155，约为四个区域、两种深度与三个种子下平均归一化训练误差 0.185 的 84%；该尺度下增加一个隐藏坐标可将平均重构误差降至 6×10⁻⁶ 以下。
AI.conclusion: 理论给出的重构误差锐界能较好地预测实际自编码器的重构性能；但球上精确重构的存在表明需引入额外条件才能得到有限数据下的界，同时增加少量隐藏维度可显著提升重构精度。

title: SenseFuse: Label-Free Fusion of Image and Shape Encoders for Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary scene understanding is fundamental for robotics, laying the groundwork for spatial reasoning and object manipulation. While closed-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation heavily leverages 3D shape information, state-of-the-art open-vocabulary methods remain predominantly restricted to 2D image features or image-distilled representations during mask labeling. In this paper, we propose SenseFuse, a label-free fusion method that balances 2D image and 3D shape encoders for robust open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, refining only the mask-labeling stage of existing pipelines. We reveal that 2D image and 3D shape encoders exhibit largely disjoint failure patterns and rarely share identical wrong labels, whereas two 2D image encoders frequently repeat the same errors. This distinct behavior makes the 2D and 3D pair inherently complementary. We introduce an adaptive mechanism that selects a scene-level fusion weight to maximize a label-free sensitivity measure, estimated directly from a single scene's unlabeled proposals in milliseconds. SenseFuse improves labeling accuracy in every evaluated setting across ScanNet200, Replica, and ScanNet++, recovering 67-100% (median 93%) of the gain achievable with an oracle weight, and it raises instance AP in 21 of 22 reported settings. Code is available at https://github.com/hanes1207/SenseFuse.

AI.tldr: 提出SenseFuse，一种无标签融合方法，在开放词汇3D实例分割的掩码标注阶段自适应结合2D图像与3D形状编码器，提升标注精度与实例AP。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇3D实例分割对机器人空间推理与操作至关重要，但现有SOTA方法在掩码标注时主要依赖2D图像特征或图像蒸馏表示，未能充分利用3D形状信息，而闭词汇方法却高度依赖3D形状。
AI.method: 核心洞察：2D图像编码器与3D形状编码器失败模式基本不相交、很少共享相同错误标签，而两个2D图像编码器则常重复相同错误，因此2D-3D组合天然互补。SenseFuse仅改进现有流水线的掩码标注阶段，引入自适应机制，从单场景未标注候选（proposal）出发，在毫秒内估计无标签敏感度度量，据此选择场景级融合权重。
AI.result: 在ScanNet200、Replica和ScanNet++上，SenseFuse在所有评估设置中均提升标注精度，恢复oracle权重可达增益的67%-100%（中位数93%），并在22个报告设置中的21个提升了实例AP。
AI.conclusion: 融合2D图像与3D形状编码器可有效弥补单一模态偏差，且无需人工标签即可实现近oracle性能的自适应加权，为开放词汇3D实例分割提供了一种轻量、即插即用的改进方案。

title: Worst-Case Hidden-Vehicle Trajectory Search in Spatiotemporal Occlusion Regions
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Safe and Defensive Autonomous Driving (SDAD) as an Oral Presentation; Best Paper Award. Workshop website: https://sdad.cc/papers.html
summary: Occlusion creates fundamental uncertainty in autonomous driving. Existing methods often propagate frame-wise hypotheses or optimize ego behavior against prescribed hidden-agent predictions, leaving the worst history-consistent interaction unexplored. We introduce History-Conditioned Minimax Trajectory Search (HC-MTS), which combines temporal occlusion reasoning with response-aware search. First, HC-MTS constructs finite hidden-state modes, each certified by a backward witness satisfying multi-frame visibility, occupancy, semantic-map support, and class-specific kinematic constraints. It then solves a bilevel minimax problem: an inner finite oracle maximizes the ego driving score over destination attainment and ride comfort, while the outer search selects the legal hidden-vehicle trajectory that minimizes this best-response value. Across eight Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios, increasing the visibility-memory horizon from K=1 to K=20 reduces the mean per-scenario vehicle, pedestrian, and total retained hidden-seed counts by 18.12%, 21.67%, and 18.45%, respectively. HC-MTS identifies six avoidable counterexamples, while no legal collision-producing attacker is found in the remaining two scenes within the finite search budget.

AI.tldr: HC-MTS将时序遮挡推理与响应感知搜索结合，通过有限隐藏状态模式与双层极小极大优化，搜索最坏历史一致交互。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中遮挡导致根本不确定性。现有方法多传播逐帧假设或针对预设隐藏智能体预测优化自车行为，未探索最坏的历史一致交互。
AI.method: 先构造有限隐藏状态模式，每个模式由满足多帧可见性、占据、语义地图支持及类别运动学约束的后向见证认证；再求解双层极小极大问题：内层有限oracle在到达目的地与乘坐舒适性上最大化自车驾驶评分，外层搜索选择使该最优响应值最小的合法隐藏车辆轨迹。
AI.result: 在八个Waymo Open Motion Dataset场景中，将可见性记忆时域从K=1增至K=20，每场景平均保留的车辆、行人及总隐藏种子数分别减少18.12%、21.67%、18.45%。HC-MTS识别出六个可避免反例，其余两场景在有限搜索预算内未找到合法的致碰撞攻击者。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效缩减隐藏状态空间并揭示可避免的遮挡风险反例，在有限预算下对部分场景未发现合法致碰撞攻击者。

title: PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations
summary: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率Allen代数（PAA），将Allen区间代数的13个清晰关系扩展为基于区间边界概率分布的生成式、完备的概率化版本，并通过蒙特卡洛实验验证、开源为Python包。
AI.motivation: 经典Allen区间代数的13个基本关系是对精确区间边界的清晰谓词，无法处理来自语言、感知、数据库或不确定历史中时间、时长和边界不确定的情形，也难以表达"just before""roughly during"等具有程度含义的表达。
AI.method: 假设时间点为高斯分布，区间由高斯中点和截断高斯时长构成；将每个关系视为同一概率空间中的边界排序谓词。点-点关系化为误差函数，点-区间与区间-区间关系化为由线性不等式诱导的多元高斯正交域概率；通过容差带使接触关系（meets, starts, finishes, equals）获得正测度，在单一容差下13个关系构成真划分，容差趋于零时退化为清晰Allen代数；并将各关系分解为相关感知的时间原语。
AI.result: 构造导出而非假设Allen分类体系：粗粒度谓词（precedence、overlap、containment等）为叶节点并集，其概率为叶概率之和；该层次结构在区间退化为点时保持一致，13个关系依次归约为5个再归约为3个。代数具有尺度不变性，并能将"shortly before"等程度表达与接触关系区分开。所有结果经蒙特卡洛验证，并发布为经过测试的开源Python包。
AI.conclusion: PAA为不确定性时间推理提供了一个生成式、完备且尺度不变的概率框架，既保留了Allen代数的分类结构，又赋予其概率语义和容差机制，适用于自然语言与不确定数据中的定性时间关系建模。

title: COMPASS: Ordered Clustered Routing at 100K Scale
summary: Large-scale routing often requires visiting clusters of nodes in a prescribed order, giving rise to the Ordered Clustered Traveling Salesman Problem (OCTSP). Optimizing each cluster independently seems natural, but misses non-local dependencies. We introduce the COMPASS algorithm for OCTSP, which combines search with learning-accelerated routing by orchestrating parallel sub-solvers. COMPASS has no quality ceiling and its solutions keep improving with compute. It exploits the clustered structure, and can reach exact solutions in time exponential in cluster size rather than instance size. Empirically, COMPASS consistently outperforms alternative methods. Unlike common large-scale routing solvers, COMPASS consumes general distance matrices and is not limited to coordinate inputs. We demonstrate scaling to 100K synthetic nodes and to 28.5K real e-commerce nodes. To our knowledge, the latter is the largest reported routing solution over asymmetric distances, 9x beyond established ATSP benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COMPASS 算法求解有序聚类旅行商问题（OCTSP），通过搜索与学习加速路由协同、并行子求解器编排，利用聚类结构实现计算可扩展、无质量上限且可收敛至精确解。
AI.motivation: 大规模路由常需按指定顺序访问节点簇，形成 OCTSP。独立优化各簇虽自然，但会忽略簇间非局部依赖，导致解质量受限。
AI.method: COMPASS 将搜索与学习加速路由结合，编排并行子求解器；利用聚类结构，使达到精确解的时间复杂度与簇规模而非实例规模呈指数关系；直接使用通用距离矩阵，不依赖坐标输入。
AI.result: 在实验中持续优于对比方法；可扩展至 10 万合成节点及 2.85 万真实电商节点；后者为目前报道的非对称距离最大规模路由解，较既有 ATSP 基准超出 9 倍。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS 为 OCTSP 提供可随算力持续改进、无质量上限的可扩展求解框架，兼具聚类结构利用与通用距离矩阵适配能力，适用于超大规模实际路由场景。

title: Grounded Product Understanding in Livestream Videos
summary: E-commerce livestreams have emerged as an important channel for presenting products to online consumers, containing multiple products whose information is scattered in different moments. This poses significant challenges for downstream product understanding applications, such as product-centric livestream clipping, where models need to identify the product and its relevant segments for information gathering. However, existing benchmarks for general product understanding typically evaluate product retrieval and temporal localization in isolation, leaving the critical correspondence between product identity and temporal evidence largely unassessed. To address this limitation, we introduce GPUB, a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,000 livestream instances with quality-controlled multi-moment temporal annotations and a catalog of over 31K fashion products. GPUB supports three evaluation tasks: the main task Grounded Product Understanding (GPrU) requires jointly identifying the target product and localizing its supporting moments from a livestream video and a candidate product set; Product Retrieval and Product Moment Localization serve as two complementary subtasks. Evaluation of existing multimodal models shows that GPrU remains highly challenging, with the best-performing baseline achieving only 10.13% Pair mAP@.3. To narrow the performance gap, we further develop UniPro, a unified product understanding model that derives product-aligned and temporally structured representations from shared multimodal encoding, improving Pair mAP@.3 to 21.53% while achieving 37.23% Joint R@1@.3 on GPrU.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GPUB基准与UniPro模型，用于电商直播中"产品识别+时间定位"的联合理解任务。
AI.motivation: 电商直播中产品信息分散在不同时间片段，下游应用（如产品导向的直播切片）需同时识别产品并定位其相关片段。然而现有产品理解基准通常将"产品检索"与"时间定位"割裂评估，未考察产品身份与时间证据之间的对应关系，因此缺少针对该联合能力的评测基准与方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建GPUB基准：包含3,000个直播实例、经过质量控制的多时刻时间标注，以及超过31K时尚产品目录；设置三项任务，主任务Grounded Product Understanding (GPrU)需在给定直播视频与候选产品集下联合识别目标产品并定位其支撑时刻，产品检索与产品时刻定位作为两个互补子任务。2) 提出UniPro统一产品理解模型：从共享多模态编码中导出"产品对齐"与"时间结构化"的表示，以缩小性能差距。
AI.result: 现有多模态模型在GPrU上表现困难，最佳基线仅达10.13% Pair mAP@.3；UniPro将Pair mAP@.3提升至21.53%，并在GPrU上取得37.23% Joint R@1@.3。
AI.conclusion: GPUB填补了产品身份与时间证据联合评估的空白，证实GPrU任务仍具高度挑战性；UniPro通过统一多模态表示显著提升联合理解性能，为电商直播产品理解提供基准与方法支撑。（注：Joint R@1@.3具体指标含义需参照原文定义。）

title: Towards AI-enhanced control: a numerical technique for trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot for pancreatic surgery
summary: The paper presents a numerical approach for the end-effector trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot designed for minimally invasive pancreatic surgery. The approach is tailored for real-time master-slave control architecture and uses a 3D space mouse for command input for velocity control. The trajectory smoothing is achieved by generating S-curves in the end-effector velocity fields, thus controlling the accelerations, which in turn reduces tissue trauma in the minimally invasive procedures. Real-time control is enabled by segmenting the S-curves based on the command inputs from the 3D space mouse. A special case is considered where the acceleration time is constant for all command inputs. Numeric results demonstrate stable transitions (without abrupt changes) in both the end-effector parameter space and in the active joints parameters, thereby validating the proposed approach. Further work aims to test the approach on an experimental model and integrate it into AI-based training modules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向微创胰腺手术并联机器人末端执行器轨迹平滑的数值方法，通过速度场S曲线控制加速度以降低组织创伤，并支持实时主从控制。
AI.motivation: 微创胰腺手术中，末端执行器的急变运动易造成组织创伤，需在实时主从控制架构下实现平滑的轨迹过渡，以提升操作安全性。
AI.method: 面向实时主从控制架构，采用3D空间鼠标输入进行速度控制；在末端执行器速度场中生成S曲线以控制加速度，并基于空间鼠标指令对S曲线分段实现实时控制；同时考虑加速度时间恒定的特殊情况。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，末端执行器参数空间与主动关节参数中均实现无突变的平稳过渡，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该数值方法可实现并联机器人末端轨迹的平稳平滑过渡，降低微创手术中的组织损伤；后续将在实验模型上测试，并集成至基于AI的训练模块。

title: Ownership in AI-Assisted Everyday Tasks
summary: When does work done with AI still feel like ours? As AI becomes woven into everyday tasks, we must examine what happens to our sense of ownership and contribution when a machine shares in producing what we make. We report an exploratory qualitative survey in which participants were asked to describe two recent, self-selected tasks completed with AI: one that felt like their own and one that did not. We find that felt ownership depends on the process of collaboration: people disown work when they merely approve AI's suggestions, but retain ownership when they lead, iterate, or rewrite. Ownership can also extend to settings where people own the vision for a project but not the execution; respondents reported high ownership on tasks they could not have completed without AI. Loss of personal voice and a lack of comprehension of the output both erode ownership. Finally, willingness to disclose AI use is often decoupled from actual pride or ownership, and instead shaped by community norms and fear of credit erasure. We propose several research directions as a result of these findings to promote AI development that supports people's sense of authorship over their own lives.

AI.tldr: 通过探索性定性调查，发现人机协作中的"所有权感"取决于协作过程：主导、迭代、改写可保留所有权，仅批准AI建议则导致剥夺感；愿景归属、理解程度、个人声音及社群规范均影响AI披露意愿。
AI.motivation: AI日益融入日常任务，需要考察当机器参与创作时，人的所有权感与贡献感会发生什么变化，以推动支持人们"作者身份"的AI发展方向。
AI.method: 探索性定性调查研究：让参与者描述两项近期自选的、借助AI完成的任务，一项感觉属于自己，一项不属于自己，并进行对比分析。
AI.result: 所有权感取决于协作过程——仅批准AI建议会剥夺所有权，而主导、迭代或改写则保留所有权；所有权也可延伸至"拥有愿景但不负责执行"的情形，受访者对那些离开AI无法完成的任务报告了高所有权；个人声音的丧失与对输出缺乏理解会侵蚀所有权；AI使用的披露意愿常与真实的骄傲或所有权脱钩，而受社群规范和"功劳被抹除"的恐惧影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现提出若干研究方向，以促进能够支持人们对自己生活拥有作者感的AI发展。

title: Minimax-Optimal Online Contract Design with Unrestricted Bounded Contracts
summary: We study repeated contract design when a principal observes outcomes but not the actions that generate them. The principal may use any bounded outcome-contingent payment vector, and the agent's best response can make expected profit discontinuous in those payments. For every fixed number $m\ge2$ of outcomes, the minimax regret over $T$ rounds is of order $T^{m/(m+1)}$, up to logarithmic factors. The upper bound allows arbitrary action spaces and agent heterogeneity, without smoothness or monotone-surplus assumptions. Its key is an effective-dimension reduction that the benchmark can be normalized even when fixed tie-breaking is not shift invariant, after which revealed preference yields a monotone response map in payment-difference coordinates. A learning policy built on a Lipschitz parametrization of this map attains the rate using only observed outcome categories. The lower-bound construction accounts for how incentive losses accumulate across outcome dimensions. It shows that each additional contractible outcome creates a precise and unavoidable increase in the worst-case cost of learning.

AI.tldr: 研究重复合约设计中的minimax regret，对任意m≥2个结果，T轮最小最大后悔为Θ(T^{m/(m+1)})（对数因子内），适用于任意动作空间与代理人异质性。
AI.motivation: 委托人只能观察到结果而无法观察生成结果的动作，且代理人的最优反应可能使期望利润关于支付向量不连续，这给学习与合约设计带来根本性困难。论文旨在刻画此类重复合约设计问题的最优学习速率，并明确可合约结果数量对学习代价的影响。
AI.method: 上界：通过有效维度归约，将基准归一化，即使固定平局打破规则不具备平移不变性；在支付差坐标下，由显示偏好得到单调响应映射，再用Lipschitz参数化构建学习策略，仅利用观测到的结果类别。下界：构造考虑激励损失如何跨结果维度累积的实例。
AI.result: 对每个固定的结果数m≥2，T轮最小最大后悔的阶为T^{m/(m+1)}（忽略对数因子）。上界无需平滑性或单调剩余假设，适用于任意动作空间与代理人异质性；下界表明每增加一个可合约结果，都会带来精确且不可避免的最坏情形学习代价上升。
AI.conclusion: 论文确立了重复合约设计中依赖结果数量m的紧致minimax regret速率，揭示了多结果维度对学习复杂度的不可避免影响，并提供无需强假设的通用学习策略框架。

title: Automated Goldsmith's Mark Retrieval in Silverware
comment: Accepted at the VISART workshop, ECCV 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures, 1 table
summary: For art historians, goldsmith marks play a critical role in the identification and dating of artifacts. In practice, experts must manually compare a query mark against hundreds of documented examples, a process that is both tedious and highly dependent on specialist knowledge. To address this, we present an AI-assisted retrieval pipeline that combines mark localization with metric-learning fine-tuning across three backbone architectures: an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, a supervised ViT-S/16, and a self-supervised DINOv2 ViT-S/14. We conduct a systematic evaluation of cropping strategies, where we measure the impact of no cropping, manual ground-truth cropping, and learned detection-based cropping, and assess their interaction with each backbone. Our strongest configuration, DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with manual crop and metric-learning fine-tuning, achieves an mAP of 62.63% and a Top-1 accuracy of 73.74%. Our experiments show that self-supervised pretraining and mark localization are the two most impactful factors, with learned cropping recovering the majority of the gain from manual cropping without requiring ground-truth annotations at inference time. To enable reproducibility and adoption in the digital humanities, we release our manually annotated dataset and codebase, and deploy the system via a public web interface.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AI辅助的金匠标记检索流程，结合标记定位与度量学习微调，在三种骨干网络上系统评估裁剪策略。
AI.motivation: 艺术史研究中金匠标记对文物鉴定与断代至关重要，但专家需人工比对查询标记与数百个已记录样本，过程繁琐且高度依赖专业知识。为缓解这一问题，作者希望构建自动化的辅助检索系统。
AI.method: 方法上，论文将标记定位与度量学习（metric-learning）微调相结合，比较三种骨干架构：ImageNet预训练的ResNet-50、有监督ViT-S/16、自监督DINOv2 ViT-S/14；并系统评估不裁剪、人工标注真值裁剪、基于学习检测的裁剪三种策略及其与各骨干的交互作用。
AI.result: 最佳配置为DINOv2 ViT-S/14 + 人工裁剪 + 度量学习微调，达到mAP 62.63%和Top-1准确率73.74%。实验表明自监督预训练与标记定位是两个影响最大的因素；学习式裁剪可恢复人工裁剪的大部分增益，且推理时无需真值标注。
AI.conclusion: 论文释放了人工标注数据集与代码库，并通过公开网页接口部署系统，以支持数字人文学科的可复现性与实际采用。

title: Integrated Guidance and Control of a Mother-Child UAV-UGV System for Cooperative Missions
summary: Autonomous recovery of a small multirotor onto a hovering multirotor carrier differs from recovery onto ground or shipborne platforms because the recovery surface is itself an actively controlled, thrust-limited aerial vehicle. This paper presents a field-validated autonomy framework for a heterogeneous rover-mothership-child system executing rover supervision, mothership transit, child deployment and sortie, autonomous return, aerial recovery, and synchronized descent. The recovery stack combines jerk-bounded reference generation, disturbance-observer-augmented planar tracking, feasibility-aware vertical control, a discrete-time barrier-based safety filter for relative vertical geometry, and communication-aware carrier-state prediction. The contribution is the coordinated system-level integration of these methods for recovery onto a hovering multirotor and its full-scale outdoor validation. The framework is implemented on a PX4-ROS 2 architecture using RTK-enabled GNSS, IMU, and barometric fusion, with mothership-side 1D lidar used only as an auxiliary near-contact cue. RTK-fixed positioning was maintained throughout testing. Across 20 outdoor cooperative missions, 17 successfully completed deployment, sortie, and recovery, giving an observed mission success rate of 85%. For successful recoveries, mean terminal-alignment time was 6.3 s, mean planar alignment error at acceptance was 0.18 m, maximum terminal planar deviation was 0.32 m within a 0.40 m capture radius, and minimum logged relative vertical separation during coupled descent was 0.41 m. Mothership planar station-keeping RMS error was 0.25 m. The three unsuccessful trials occurred at different mission stages and are analyzed separately. Results demonstrate practical autonomous aerial recovery within the tested outdoor operating envelope.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并外场验证了一套异构“漫游车-母舰-子机”系统的自主空中回收框架，在20次户外协同任务中17次成功完成部署、出击与回收，任务成功率达85%。
AI.motivation: 小型多旋翼回收至悬停多旋翼母舰与回收至地面/舰船平台不同：回收面本身是主动控制、推力受限的飞行器，相对几何持续变化，且存在通信与状态预测难题，因此需要系统级自主回收方案。
AI.method: 回收栈包含：加加速度有界的参考轨迹生成、扰动观测器增强的平面跟踪、可行性感知的垂直控制、基于离散时间障碍函数的相对垂直几何安全滤波器，以及通信感知的母舰状态预测；各方法在系统层面协同集成。硬件基于PX4-ROS 2架构，融合RTK GNSS、IMU与气压计，母舰侧一维激光雷达仅作近距接触辅助线索。
AI.result: 全程保持RTK固定解。20次户外协同任务中17次成功完成部署、出击与回收，成功率85%。成功回收的终端对准平均耗时6.3 s，接受时刻平均平面对准误差0.18 m，0.40 m捕获半径内最大终端平面偏差0.32 m，耦合下降阶段最小相对垂直间距0.41 m；母舰平面定点RMS误差0.25 m。3次失败分布于不同任务阶段并单独分析。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在测试的户外工况包线内，所提框架可实现实用的自主空中回收，验证了系统级集成方法的有效性；失败案例的分阶段分析为进一步提升鲁棒性提供了依据。

title: Deep Noir: Autonomous Steering Discovery via Architectural Chronometry in Transformer Models
summary: Activation steering modifies LLM behavior at inference time, but identifying where and how strongly to steer remains manual. We introduce Deep Noir, a framework that uses Logit Lens convergence and causal head-level attribution to autonomously discover optimal steering parameters. Across three scales (1B x 3, 2-3B x 2, and 7-9B x 4), our engine achieves 16.7 percentage-point improvement on spam at 1B (standard deviation 4.7; 39 runs), with gains increasing to 21 to 42 percentage points at 7-9B across four architectures. On SST-2 sentiment, it achieves a 13.1 percentage-point improvement with zero code changes. Mechanistic grounding enables automated discovery of intervention points that generalize across tasks and architectures. On sentiment, RepE without head masking fails to improve over baseline, while Deep Noir improves all models (p less than 0.01). We further show that steering creates a predictable prompt-injection attack surface whose vulnerability increases monotonically with steering magnitude. This finding is relevant to agent systems deploying steered classifiers.

AI.tldr: Deep Noir：利用 Logit Lens 收敛与因果注意力头归因，自动发现激活引导参数，跨 1B–9B 规模与多种架构显著提升性能，并揭示引导幅度与提示注入脆弱性之间的单调关系。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）能在推理阶段改变大模型行为，但"在哪里引导、引导多强"仍依赖人工试错，缺乏自动化且可迁移的发现机制；同时引导带来的潜在安全风险尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 提出 Deep Noir 框架：以 Logit Lens 收敛性定位有效干预层，结合因果层面的注意力头归因（causal head-level attribution）筛选关键头，从而自动确定引导位置与强度；无需改动代码即可迁移到新任务；并通过实验考察引导幅度对提示注入攻击面的影响。
AI.result: 在三个规模档（1B×3、2–3B×2、7–9B×4）上，1B 垃圾信息任务提升 16.7 个百分点（标准差 4.7，39 次运行），7–9B 在四种架构上增益升至 21–42 个百分点；SST-2 情感任务零代码改动提升 13.1 个百分点。情感任务中，未做头掩码的 RepE 未能超过基线，而 Deep Noir 对所有模型均有提升（p<0.01）。此外，引导制造出可预测的提示注入攻击面，且脆弱性随引导幅度单调上升。
AI.conclusion: 机制层面的归因使干预点的自动发现具备跨任务、跨架构的泛化能力，验证了自动化激活引导的可行性与有效性；但引导幅度会单调放大提示注入风险，对部署引导式分类器的智能体系统具有直接安全启示。

title: Learning Principal-Agent Contracts for Equitable Smallholder Carbon Farming under Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection
summary: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming. It is ironic that real-world carbon programs largely fail to reach them. We study this important gap through the lens of contract design. An aggregator offers a single pooled contract to a heterogeneous population of smallholder farmers who have private adoption costs (adverse selection) and exert unobserved effort (moral hazard), with agronomic outcomes evolving over multiple seasons. We formulate this evolving contracting problem as a POMDP and use reinforcement learning to learn a dynamic profit-maximising contract. We analyse the performance of the aggregator under various conditions. We find that a profit-maximising aggregator does not merely inherit the exclusion of smallholders, it amplifies it. On large farms the aggregator realises 87.7% of achievable adoption, against only 8.2% on smallholdings.
